title: Intermediate / Senior Frontend Developer (32–40 hours)
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to contribute to the development of user-friendly software with real social impact? Are you a front-end developer who enjoys building intuitive interfaces and isn’t afraid to make small follow-up adjustments on the back end?

You’ll have the opportunity to apply your creativity and technical expertise to an educational software product used by schools.


About the Organization

We are an ICT partner in education, supporting teachers and school boards with administrative systems, testing tools, and student monitoring solutions. Our primary focus is primary education.

Our main product is a student monitoring system that helps schools effectively track and guide student development.


What You’ll Do

  • Contribute to the ongoing development of a student monitoring platform
  • Help renew the current tech stack into a modern, future-proof environment
  • Focus primarily on the frontend, built with Vue, Nuxt, and TypeScript in a component-based architecture
  • Actively work on UX/UI improvements
  • Collaborate closely with your team and the Product Owner to translate requirements into smart, feasible solutions
  • Occasionally make small follow-up changes on the back end when needed


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience working with large codebases
  • Ability to translate user and business needs into technical solutions
  • Confidence in advising on technical decisions
  • A strong focus on software quality and maintainability


Your Profile

  • HBO level of working and thinking
  • Experience with TypeScript
  • Experience with modern frameworks such as Vue, React, or Angular
  • Experience with unit testing and E2E testing
  • Nice to have / Plus points:
  • Vue 3 & Composition API
  • Nuxt
  • Accessibility best practices
  • C#
  • Experience designing user-friendly applications


What We Offer

  • A competitive salary, based on experience
  • 30 days of vacation (based on a 40-hour workweek)
  • Solid secondary benefits, including a pension plan
  • Opportunities for training and professional development
  • Hybrid working
  • An informal, collaborative working environment

title: Front end Developer
descriptionHtml:
Functieomschrijving

Development vanuit een breder perspectief

Hoe gaaf is het om oplossingen te bouwen die direct effect hebben op het financiële leven van jou, je buurman, je broer, je neef, je ouders, you name it. Bij Yellowtail sta jij aan de basis hiervan. We bouwen aan oplossingen voor pensioenen, hypotheken, leningen maar ook voor de overheid. Grote klanten zoals Aegon en ABN Amro maken inmiddels gebruiken van onze software. Omdat we software bouwen voor financiële instellingen zijn we ISO en SOC gecertificeerd.

Als Senior Front-end Developer ben jij hierin een belangrijke schakel! Jij zorgt er tenslotte voor dat onze software-oplossing voor elke klant specifiek en gebruiksklaar wordt gemaakt. Geen standaardoplossingen maar maatwerk voor elke klant. Dat is waar wij goed in zijn! Naast het bouwen van software houd je je ook bezig met het reviewen van code, het verbeteren van het development proces en het onderzoeken van nieuwe technieken met bijbehorende implicaties.

Ons streven is om jouw werk zo leuk en uitdagend mogelijk te houden.

Waarom is Senior Frond-End Developer jouw nieuwe job?

Jij krijgt energie van het bouwen van software, daarom doe je dit al enkele jaren. Daarin heb je je al op diverse vlakken ontwikkeld. Zo is het opzetten van een applicatie vanaf scratch voor jou no problem, draai je je hand niet om voor het schrijven van specificaties en is TypeScript vertrouwde programmeertaal voor jou.

Je weet dat je als developer nooit klaar bent met leren. Voor jou is je baan pas echt een leuke job als je je steeds verder kunt ontwikkelen en nieuwe technieken kunt leren. Bij het bepalen wie welk project oppakt, weet jij precies waarin jij het beste tot je recht komt. Daar ga je dan ook voor want je weet, pas dan kun je groeien!

Maar niet alleen je eigen groei is belangrijk. Je zet je ook graag in voor de groei van het team en helpt de junior collega’s bij hun ontwikkeling tot ervaren developers.

Stack

Als Front-end Developer Hoef Je Uiteraard Nog Geen Ervaring Te Hebben Met Álle Technieken Die Wij Bij Yellowtail Gebruiken. Het Is Wel Goed Om Te Weten Waarin Je Je Nog Kunt Ontwikkelen. De Stack Waarmee We Werken Is

  • Angular/React/React Native/VueJS
  • Cypress
  • C#, .NET Core
  • MongoDB
  • Docker
  • Azure Devops (infra as code)
  • Kubernetes

Wie zijn jouw collega’s?

Jouw collega’s vormen een divers en internationaal team dat uit Back-end/Front-End Developers bestaat. Je hebt niet alleen collega’s in Nederland maar ook in Zuid-Afrika en India. Je spreekt en schrijft dan ook vloeiend Engels.

Vereisten

Wat wij belangrijk vinden

Als Senior Front-End Developer Spreek En Schrijf Je Goed Nederlands En Kun Je Jezelf Verstaanbaar Maken In Engels. Daarnaast Neem Je Wat Ons Betreft Vooral Ervaring Mee. Ervaring Met

  • Development, 5 jaar of meer
  • Minimaal 1 van onze front-end frameworks
  • REST API-integratie
  • End to end testing
  • Build pipelines
  • Git & Git flow

What’s in it for you? 

Bij Ons Ben Je Verzekerd Van Een Werkomgeving Waarin Alle Basiszaken Perfect Geregeld Zijn. Denk Aan De Lekkerste Lunches Die Worden Verzorgd, De Nieuwste MacBook En Telefoon Die Voor Je Klaarligt, Een Prima Pensioenregeling En Een Soepele Salaris- En Kostenafhandeling. Maar Dat Is Nog Lang Niet Alles! Wat Ons Écht Onderscheidt Is Onze Manier Van Werken

  • Je mag volledig jezelf zijn en hoeft niet te voldoen aan een bepaald imago of stereotype. We zien je graag zoals je bent;
  • Je krijgt alle ruimte en kansen geboden om te groeien en te leren. Samen gaan we op zoek naar jouw talenten en ontwikkelen deze verder;
  • Een mobiliteitsvergoeding van €800, kan je ook als salaris uit laten betalen;
  • Je mag fouten maken want daar leer je van. We helpen op te staan en te groeien;
  • Je hebt de ontwikkeling van je salaris grotendeels zelf in de hand. De salarisrange van deze functie is tussen de €3.900 en € 5.300 bruto per maand (afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring) en jij hebt invloed op de groei hiervan;
  • Je bepaalt grotendeels zelf waar en wanneer je werkt. Wij geloven in een goede werk-privé balans dus helpen we je om je thuiswerkplek goed en verantwoord in te richten. Maar we gaan verder: je kunt bij ons zelfs vanaf je favoriete vakantiebestemming remote werken;
  • Je kunt veel leuke activiteiten ondernemen met collega’s. Zo hebben we 2x per jaar een trip met het bedrijf, elke maand een Cultural FriYay en regelmatig andere (sportieve, interessante, leerzame) evenementen;
  • En wil je op kantoor even een pauze nemen, kun je altijd je collega uitdagen voor een potje dart, tafelvoetbal of tafeltennis!

title: Full-Stack Developer (Amsterdam)
descriptionHtml:
What You’ll Do

  • Ship production features across the stack
  • Work in tight loops: build → test → measure → refine
  • Use AI tools daily (Cursor, Claude, etc.) and push them further; automate glue work, generate scaffolds, build evals, multiply your own output
  • Take ownership of outcomes, not tickets

What We’re Looking For

We don’t care about years of experience. We care that you can build.\ You might be a fit if:

  • You can own features end-to-end and enjoy doing so
  • You ship fast and care about quality, clean architecture, solid tests, good UI
  • You’re resourceful and persistent, you figure things out
  • You’ve built things you’re proud of (products, open source, side projects)
  • You use AI tools daily and want to keep raising that bar
  • You think in systems and multipliers, not just tasks

Stack

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, AWS
  • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js

title: Frontend Developer (React) 6 Month Contract - Amsterdam
descriptionHtml:
Frontend Developer (React)

Length of contract: 6 Months

Location: Amsterdam

AND Introduction

At AND, we accelerate the development of digital capabilities. In practice, that means helping ambitious leaders and organisations build the teams, products, processes and even operational structures they need to close the digital skills gap within their organisation today, so that they thrive tomorrow.

Clients rely on our experience, agility and craft skills across tech and business strategy, software development and product management to address some of the toughest challenges facing their businesses.

We bring aboard thinkers, tinkerers, passionate software craftspeople and inspiring technologists to help us solve these challenges. Together, we're united by a sense of pragmatism, purpose and a deeply-held belief that digital products and technology alone won't transform a business or save the world: it's the people that count.

About You

As a Front End Developer, you will build remarkable, digital products in Agile environments, using your background in Javascript. As a result, you will need to be able to:

  • Work on large-scale, multiple industries, eCommerce and enterprise-level software development projects using languages and technologies such as React, JavaScript and more
  • Champion software quality and technical vision for AND and our clients
  • Champion TDD/BDD/XP Software development

To Do That, It's Essential You Bring The Following

  • You have a passion for Front-End development and building user-friendly interfaces, as well as knowledge of UX design principles
  • You have skills in Front-End web engineering including JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, React, testing & State Management (like Redux). And to know your way around Git very well.
  • Familiarity with: CI/CD, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Jest, AWS (certification is a plus)
  • Facilitate problem solving and work as a team to make them a reality
  • Work in a collaborative environment where your ideas and opinions are valued and respected
  • The ability to travel freely to deliver product builds

It's Helpful If You Also Have

  • Full stack experience or flexibility to learn other technologies including Python

Joining AND

From the work we deliver, to the way we serve and support our people, we work hard to ensure that there's nowhere quite like AND. But joining a company is a two-way street: the fit has to work on both sides. So before you apply, here's three key things to understand about us:

  • We're built for people - like, real humans. Not ‘resources' or ‘staff'. That means happiness and wellbeing really do matter to us, and we hate unnecessary hierarchy and bureaucracy.
  • There's no well-trodden path ahead: AND is growing fast and forging a new trail. That's exciting, and gives us all the autonomy and opportunity we love - but bear in mind it also demands focus, patience and resilience.
  • Diversity is a priority. After all, to build great products that a wide variety of different people love to use, we need a wide variety of people to help us build them. So diversity is more than a policy or a word: it's business critical for us.

Still sound good? Great! Fill out the short application form below and we'll be in touch.

companySlogan: We’re on a mission to close the world’s digital skills gap.
companyDescription:
AND Digital is on a mission to close the world’s digital skills gap. We do that by doing things differently when we work with our clients, communities and colleagues. Instead of working FOR exciting brands (like British Airways, Heineken and Nike), we work WITH them, and that's not just a party line. We combine our people with our clients' people to form a single project team, so collaborative you can't tell our ANDis from our clients. By working together, we help our partners understand and map out the challenges they're trying to solve. Then, by building their digital products as one team, we teach them the same digital skills we have. That means when we leave, they can own their apps, websites and future projects independently. Pretty cool huh?

We have cross-functional teams working across the UK, Netherlands and East Coast US - and growing by demand. Our unique, city-based Club model means we can offer the agility and personalised service of a small local company, with the security and clout of a global organisation.

title: Front-end Developer
descriptionHtml:
Bij Sumedia zijn we op zoek naar een Front-End Developer om ons team te komen versterken.

Jouw nieuwe uitdaging

Ben jij een front-end developer die op zoek is naar meer dan het standaardwerk? Zoek je een plek waar je écht uitgedaagd wordt en waar de nieuwste technieken je dagelijkse tools zijn? Dan hebben wij goed nieuws: bij Sumedia krijg je de ruimte en support om uit te blinken in je vak én om samen te groeien met andere talentvolle developers.

Hoe het is om bij ons te werken

Werken bij Sumedia betekent werken in vaste, hechte teams waarin je samen projecten van begin tot eind oppakt. Die directe samenwerking zorgt ervoor dat je snel kunt schakelen, ideeën kunt uitwisselen en samen tot het beste resultaat komt. Innovatieve technieken als Vue.js, GreenSock (GSAP), moderne JavaScript-frameworks en geavanceerde WordPress-oplossingen zijn bij ons dagelijkse kost. Zelfs als je daar nog niet volledig in thuis bent, krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen – zowel in projecten als tijdens zelfstudie, ondersteund door ervaren collega's.

Je werkt aan indrukwekkende projecten voor de grootste namen van Nederland, waarin webdesign en techniek écht next-level zijn. En naast uitdagend werk krijg je volop de kans om je verder te specialiseren, bijvoorbeeld in animaties, WordPress, of cutting-edge front-end libraries.

About you!

We zoeken front-end developers die passie hebben voor hun vak en altijd willen blijven groeien.

We zijn op zoek naar front-end developers die niet alleen technisch vaardig zijn, maar ook de drive hebben om zichzelf én ons werk naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Jij houdt van de dynamiek van een agency, denkt in oplossingen en haalt energie uit het werken in een ambitieus team.

Jij

  • Hebt meerdere jaren ervaring met HTML en CSS;
  • Kent JavaScript en PHP als je broekzak;
  • Bent bekend met GIT en de GIT Flow-methode;
  • Werkt graag volledig agile en volgens de nieuwste Scrum-methodieken;
  • Hebt bij voorkeur ervaring met maatwerk WordPress-development;
  • Ervaring bij een digital agency is een pré;
  • Werkt graag in een hecht en ambitieus development-team.

Wat krijg jij van ons?

  • Een goed salaris – wij betalen graag voor topkwaliteit;
  • 26 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband;
  • Je kan een leasefiets via Lease a bike leasen;
  • 10% van je tijd recht op zelfstudie;
  • Meedoen met de lunchregeling en elke maandag een gezamenlijke lunch;
  • Een persoonlijk groeiplan: samen stippelen we jouw ontwikkelpad uit;
  • Regelmatig legendarische borrels en barbecues als de zon schijnt op ons dakterras.

Word jij onze nieuwe front-end topper?

Bij Sumedia bieden we je niet alleen een baan, maar een plek waar je kunt uitgroeien tot de beste versie van jezelf. Klaar om je skills naar het hoogste niveau te tillen en écht impact te maken met jouw werk? Dan willen we jou graag ontmoeten!

Overtuigd?

Solliciteer direct!

En naast uitdagend werk krijg je volop de kans om je verder te specialiseren, bijvoorbeeld in animaties, WordPress, of cutting-edge front-end libraries.About you!We zoeken front-end developers die passie hebben voor hun vak en altijd willen blijven groeien.We zijn op zoek naar front-end developers die niet alleen technisch vaardig zijn, maar ook de drive hebben om zichzelf én ons werk naar een hoger niveau te tillen. title: Web Developer
descriptionHtml:
TOUCHING HEARTS CREATING MEMORIES

We are a leading global theater production company producing musicals across Europe, with 16 theaters in the Netherlands, Germany, Spain, France, and Italy, plus offices in the UK. We bring some of the world’s best-known musicals to the stage, developed by international partners and their creative teams, including Disney's The Lion King, MJ the Musical, and Moulin Rouge! The Musical.

We also create our own original productions, such as Anastasia and TINA – The Tina Turner Musical, sharing them worldwide through tours and licensing. We also have our own in-house ticketing system, ensuring a seamless customer experience.

With around 2,000 employees, we are committed to exceptional shows and a welcoming experience for all. If you want to be part of a creative, dynamic team that brings the magic of theater to life worldwide, we’d love to hear from you!

We’re looking for a Web Developer (Full Stack) to help take ownership of, and gradually evolve, the digital platform behind Stage Entertainment’s international ticket sales and customer journey.

Today, our platform is Drupal-based and PHP-driven, hosted in Azure, and used across multiple European markets. This is a living system, not a finished product. Over time, we expect it to evolve toward a more decoupled architecture, potentially including a headless CMS, modern frontend frameworks (such as React or Vue), and changes to backend services where they make clear technical and business sense.

This role suits an engineer who is comfortable working with what exist today, while also contributing to where the platform should go next. Someone who can balance reliability and delivery with thoughtful, incremental modernization.

You’ll work closely with developer, designer, and business stakeholders across markets contributing both to day-to-day delivery and longer-term technical direction.

What You’ll Work On First

  • Maintain and improve our Drupal-based websites. Focusing on stability, performance, and security across multiple countries.
  • Take ownership of existing functionality as responsibility transitions into our internal teams.
  • Build reusable, scalable features that work across markets rather than solving the same problem repeatedly.
  • Collaborate with other developers, designers, and stakeholders te deliver clear, reliable user experience.
  • Improve code quality through testing, code reviews, and documentation.
  • Contribute to CI/CD practices and help keep our Azure-hosted environment reliable and predictable.

What You’ll Help Shape Over Time

  • The gradual move toward a more decoupled platform. Including clearer frontend/backend separation and shared components.
  • The introduction of modern frontend technologies. Where they genuinely improve maintainability our user experience.
  • Ongoing evaluation of CMS and backend choices. Guided by stability, maintainability, and business impact, not trends.
  • Improvements in scalability, observability, and performance. As traffic, personalization, and commercial needs grow.

Required

What we’re looking for

  • Experience building and maintaining PHP-based web applications or platforms.
  • A solid understanding of web architecture. Including REST API’s, databases, and backend driven websites.
  • Experience working in existing or legacy codebases and improving them step by step.
  • Comfort working with frontend developers, backend developers, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A mindset focused on ownership, learning, and long-term quality, rather thar quick fixes.

Nice to have (Not required)

  • Experience with Drupal or other CMS-driven platforms (monolithic or headless).
  • Exposure to frontend framework such as React, Vue or Angular.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or similar).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, Docker, or DevOps practices.
  • Experience working on e-commerce, ticketing or high traffic consumer platforms.

What Success Looks Like

After 6 months, you:

  • Have shipped multiple features or improvements to production.
  • Understand how the current platform is structured and how data flows through it.
  • Contribute confidently to code reviews and technical discussions.
  • Work independently while staying closely connected to the rest of the team.

After 12 Months, You

  • Own meaningful parts of the web platform.
  • Help reduce dependency on external agencies.
  • Contribute actively to architectural and platform decisions.
  • Raise the bar for quality, reliability and maintainability across the team.

What Does Stage Entertainment Offer

  • 25 vacation days, 1 D&I day and 2 designated days off from Stage Entertainment.
  • Competitive salary in line with the market.
  • Good pension scheme and travel allowance.
  • Great if you work in the office, but we also offer the opportunity to work partially from home.
  • The opportunity to work remotely for two weeks at a destination of your choice.
  • We value your personal development, that's why there are plenty of opportunities for training and education.
  • Your work makes an impact both Stage Entertainment headquarters and internationally. You will work with diverse, passionate colleagues all over Europe.

Passion connects us: Step into the next STAGE of your career.

Take the stage and let's arrange a meeting to discuss the exciting opportunities that await you here!

Stage Entertainment encourages candidates to apply for this vacancy, even though they don’t fit all qualifications. However, candidates must demonstrate a history of innate curiosity and rapid learning and articulate how skills and experiences are transferable to our company.

Stage Entertainment ensures we are always recruiting a diverse mix of colleagues who are representative of the diverse audiences we attract. In doing so, we have access to a broad range of ideas, perspectives and insights that allow us to touch hearts and create memories. Please find more information about our DE&I initiatives: DEI | Stage Entertainment (stage-entertainment.com)

title: Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Ons techteam blijft groeien! We hebben ambitieuze plannen en zoeken daarom een Senior Full Stack Developer!

Fulltime

  • Amsterdam, Nederland

Over de functie

Wij zijn op zoek naar een Senior Full Stack Developer die de verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor onze advertentie-infrastructuur binnen een netwerk van 70+ websites met veel verkeer. Je werkt zowel aan de frontend als backend en zorgt ervoor dat onze technologie snel, stabiel en winstgevend is.

Je werkt voornamelijk met TypeScript en daarnaast ook met CSS / JS / Nginx / NextJS.

Met een bereik van 12 miljoen unieke bezoekers per maand is PXR de grootste uitgever op het gebied van sport en lifestyle.

De rol

Je ontwikkelt systemen voor monitoring en automatische waarschuwingen, zodat problemen worden opgemerkt vóór ze impact hebben. Ervaring of interesse in advertentietechnologie (zoals header bidding, VAST, CMP) is een grote pre.

We werken met de mobile teams ook uitvoerig aan in-app advertenties, dus affiniteit met Flutter en/of native apps is een mooie bonus.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de front-end scripts (TS)
  • Verantwoordelijk voor het inladen, herladen en correct meten van advertenties en consent management platformen
  • Optimaliseren van advertentieprestaties en betrouwbaarheid
  • Bouwen van monitoring- en waarschuwings flows
  • Samenwerken met teams voor design, data en product om advertentieprestaties te verbeteren
  • Leiding geven aan de bouw van een showcase-website (NextJS) voor advertentieformaten
  • Ondersteunen bij het integreren van creatieve advertentie-uitingen
  • Ondersteunen van de mobile teams voor de advertentie integraties

Jouw ervaring

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met JavaScript
  • Ervaren in TypeScript
  • Bekend VM’s en cloudomgevingen
  • Basis ervaring met Kubernetes is een plus
  • Kennis van of interesse in advertentietechnologie (zoals header bidding, VAST, CMP)
  • Analytisch, zelfstandig en oplossingsgericht
  • Goede beheersing van Engels; Nederlands is een plus

Onze Perks

  • Een baan bij één van de snelst groeiende mediabedrijven van Nederland;
  • Een uitdagende functie van 32 tot 40 uur;
  • De hard- en software die jij nodig hebt om fijn te kunnen werken;
  • Een eigen ontwikkelingstraject met begeleiding die ruimte biedt om te groeien op persoonlijk vlak;
  • Een enthousiast, betrokken team binnen een dynamische, informele en groeiende organisatie, waarin ook veel ruimte is om successen samen te vieren. Regelmatig worden gezellige borrels en de leukste teamuitjes georganiseerd;
  • Een fijne werkplek op een mooi kantoor met de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken.

Solliciteer

Wil je ons team komen versterken als Full Stack Developer? Dan horen we graag van je!

Solliciteer nu

title: Junior Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
What drives us

You probably remember the best customer journey you’ve ever experienced, and the worst one too. But why is that? What can businesses do to keep you engaged, solve your problems, and make your life easier and more beautiful, not just in one moment, but across every interaction?


“The entire customer journey. One platform”


People move between channels, platforms, apps and physical locations without thinking about it. Wherever your journey starts and wherever it continues, our goal is simple and ambitious: “Enable growing businesses to serve, sell, interact and engage through one Global AI Powered Customer Engagement Platform. We connect conversations, customer data and payments with AI Agents, so that businesses all over the world can grow faster, together.


All our services are fully integrated within our unique business structure, consisting of four business units: Connect, Pay, Live, and Engage.


Now, we’re looking for a Junior Full Stack Developer to join the Mobile Service Cloud development team!


What you will do

We are building the ultimate Global AI-Powered Customer Engagement Platform that lets businesses connect with customers, automate work, and handle every interaction through one reliable, user-friendly platform. That is our mission for 2026.


In your first 12 months, you will:

Take ownership of the development of the Mobile Service Cloud—a robust, cloud-native contact center platform trusted by leading brands like Auping, Fleurop, Revolution Beauty, AS Watson, and Yoursurprise. This platform consolidates communication channels such as Email, Phone, Live Chat, Contact Forms, WhatsApp, and Facebook Messenger into one seamless experience.


The Mobile Service Cloud is a mature and well-established solution with a proven track record of running 24/7, supporting thousands of customer service agents, and resolving millions of customer inquiries. It’s a critical tool that enables businesses to deliver exceptional customer experiences at scale.


The future of customer service lies in automation and AI-powered solutions. While Mobile Service Cloud already supports millions of conversations, we’re continuously innovating to make customer interactions smarter and more efficient. By leveraging cutting-edge AI technologies like HALO, we’re developing intelligent customer service agents that can handle inquiries autonomously, freeing up human agents to focus on more complex tasks. Join us and be part of this exciting journey!


Besides that, you will:

  • Improve processes using AI, automation and smart tooling
  • Make decisions fast, test ideas, and learn from what doesn’t work
  • Help shape how this role will look a year from now
  • Success is measured by impact, not by perfect plans.


That’s why you ideally have

  • Some experience with C#, .NET, Entity Framework, and SQL. You’re eager to write clean, maintainable code and learn modern development practices.
  • While your focus is on backend development, you’re open to working with frontend technologies like Vue.js or jQuery when needed.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure or other cloud platforms is a plus. You’re excited to learn about Docker, Kubernetes, and microservices.
  • The mentality of a strong team player, you commit to quality and have a growth-oriented attitude
  • You are fluent in English and based near Arnhem or open to commuting


The reality at CM.com

We believe honesty creates better matches. So here it is:

  • You work on-site with your team, collaboration happens face to face.
  • Priorities can shift quickly as technology and insights evolve.
  • AI will change how your role looks, fast. Some tasks you do today may disappear next year.
  • We move before everything is finished or polished.
  • For this position, we can only consider candidates who already hold a permanent work and residence permit for the Netherlands.


If that excites you, you’ll probably feel at home here. If you’re looking for predictability and fixed boundaries, this may not be the right place.


What drives you

Every CM.com colleague, connects to our 4 shared values:


Drive and Lead

We value your expertise and professional judgement. You understand the mission of CM.com and feel ownership over your role and its contribution to the bigger picture. You take initiative, make decisions and recognize opportunities. Making mistakes is part of moving forward.


Grow and Learn

Growing Faster Together is not just our purpose, it’s how we work. The growth of our colleagues and our customers is our priority. Our organization is designed to support this through the CM Academy, the Young Professional Program and our own CM Business Adventure, the CMBA. But growth also comes from daily curiosity.


You enjoy stepping outside your comfort zone and you like to experiment, learn continuously and actively share knowledge and insights with others.


Together and Care

At CM.com, we work together. We believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. Diversity is therefore essential to us.


We value the social side of work. We trust one another, show genuine interest and care about one another’s well-being. You are looking for that connection, you prefer being together on-site, sharing ideas, meals, workouts and conversations, and you believe that energy is created by meeting in person.


Speed and Change

For more than 25 years, we have operated at the forefront of innovation. Change is not something we respond to, it’s something we actively drive.


By welcoming AI Agents into our organisation, we fundamentally change how work is done. This allows us to move faster, do more with fewer people and continuously rethink roles and responsibilities. You are comfortable with that reality and want to contribute to progress rather than maintaining the status quo.


Company Benefits

At CM.com, we believe in empowering our people to do what they love, excel at what they do, and make a meaningful impact. As a CM.com club member, you’ll have the following benefits:

  • Onboarding: Join our unique 3-days Global Onboarding program in our Headquarters in Breda, a deep dive into the culture of CM.com.
  • Healthy food: Daily healthy lunches and snacks to keep you energized.
  • Effortless commute: The Shuttle mobility card, commuting allowance and Lease-a-bike options get you where you need to be. We have CM company cars that you can use for client visits as well.
  • Invest in your future: A solid pension plan.
  • Time off: Recharge with 25 vacation days, plus the option to purchase 10 additional days.
  • Own your success: Become a shareholder with our Employee Share Purchase Program.
  • Your Development: We support your growth and development through initiatives like the CM Academy, Udemy courses, exclusive meetups with thought leaders, the Young Professional Program, and our own CM Business Adventure (CMBA), ensuring you’re always learning and evolving
  • Vitality: Our Vitality Team organizes a year-round vitality program to support a healthy body and mind for all colleagues. Think of stress prevention workshops, ergonomist visit, weekly bootcamps, yoga sessions and our CM sports day.
  • Together at CM.com: Weekly drinks, board game nights, karaoke throwdowns, yearly ski trip, and more! We have something for everyone.

Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and drive us forward. We welcome everyone, regardless of age, background, or beliefs.

Making mistakes is part of moving forward.Grow and LearnGrowing Faster Together is not just our purpose, it’s how we work. The growth of our colleagues and our customers is our priority. Our organization is designed to support this through the CM Academy, the Young Professional Program and our own CM Business Adventure, the CMBA. But growth also comes from daily curiosity.You enjoy stepping outside your comfort zone and you like to experiment, learn continuously and actively share knowledge and insights with others.Together and CareAt CM.com, we work together. We believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. Diversity is therefore essential to us.We value the social side of work. We trust one another, show genuine interest and care about one another’s well-being. You are looking for that connection, you prefer being together on-site, sharing ideas, meals, workouts and conversations, and you believe that energy is created by meeting in person.Speed and ChangeFor more than 25 years, we have operated at the forefront of innovation. Change is not something we respond to, it’s something we actively drive.By welcoming AI Agents into our organisation, we fundamentally change how work is done. This allows us to move faster, do more with fewer people and continuously rethink roles and responsibilities. You are comfortable with that reality and want to contribute to progress rather than maintaining the status quo.Company BenefitsAt CM.com, we believe in empowering our people to do what they love, excel at what they do, and make a meaningful impact. As a CM.com club member, you’ll have the following benefits:Onboarding: Join our unique 3-days Global Onboarding program in our Headquarters in Breda, a deep dive into the culture of CM.com.Healthy food: Daily healthy lunches and snacks to keep you energized.Effortless commute: The Shuttle mobility card, commuting allowance and Lease-a-bike options get you where you need to be. We have CM company cars that you can use for client visits as well.Invest in your future: A solid pension plan.Time off: Recharge with 25 vacation days, plus the option to purchase 10 additional days.Own your success: Become a shareholder with our Employee Share Purchase Program.Your Development: We support your growth and development through initiatives like the CM Academy, Udemy courses, exclusive meetups with thought leaders, the Young Professional Program, and our own CM Business Adventure (CMBA), ensuring you’re always learning and evolvingVitality: Our Vitality Team organizes a year-round vitality program to support a healthy body and mind for all colleagues. Think of stress prevention workshops, ergonomist visit, weekly bootcamps, yoga sessions and our CM sports day.Together at CM.com: Weekly drinks, board game nights, karaoke throwdowns, yearly ski trip, and more! We have something for everyone.Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and drive us forward. We welcome everyone, regardless of age, background, or beliefs.

title: Full Stack Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Full Stack Engineer – AI-Driven SaaS Product – up to EUR 85K – Utrecht / Hybrid


Join us and help launch our new AI-driven platform for grant writing!


Applying for grants is often complex and time-consuming — we want to change that and help researchers and companies do what they do best: focus on impactful research and innovation. That’s why we started building an AI-driven platform that automates the process of writing grant proposals. Our mission is to automate all repetitive and manual actions via our platform, while adding innovative features that help users write better grant proposals.


Although we are a small team, we are closely linked with Brainial, who have been revolutionizing tender management with their AI-driven SaaS platform. As a spin-off, we are leveraging their knowledge and experience so we can hit the ground running, with the added benefit of creating something from scratch. In addition, we are also linked with Catalyze, an innovation consultancy and funding specialist that has been helping organizations accelerate high-impact innovations. We are still missing one key player, and that’s why we are currently looking for a Full Stack Engineer.


This challenge is perfect for you if you:

  • Are a medior/senior-level engineer with strong backend and frontend experience. Bonus points if you have experience in AI & ML;
  • Have demonstrable seniority with JavaScript, React, and TypeScript;
  • Have demonstrable seniority with Python and FastAPI;
  • Have an interest in software architecture and scalability;
  • Are proactive and independent, but thrive in collaboration. You enjoy turning complex challenges into practical steps and communicating them clearly — making collaboration easy and enjoyable for others.


Some of the benefits we offer:

  • Working with ambitious and driven people in a great start-up environment. We’re ambitious, not exhausting. You’ll have the freedom and flexibility to do your best work in a way that suits you;
  • As we’ve just started, we have many exciting plans ahead. This means plenty of growth opportunities: with rapid growth, new roles emerge. Deliver results, show energy, and challenge assumptions, and you’ll quickly take on new challenges and responsibilities;
  • A space to grow. We support continuous learning — through research, courses, and curiosity — and value the knowledge you bring back to the team;
  • Real impact. Working in the grant writing field means you help some of the most innovative companies and researchers make a real difference;
  • Hybrid working is supported, but we like to work together in the office three days a week — yes, there will be snacks;
  • A gross annual salary of up to €85k, a secondary benefits package, and of course the essentials like a laptop and travel card.



Interested!? Contact me via stephan@salentorecruitment.com.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a full-stack engineer to join our small and growing team.

We value small and high performing teams and are looking for a full-time software engineer to join alongside the current core team. The responsibilities will go beyond just the technical stack, and you'll be expected to contribute to the company strategy and will have a lot of influence over the product and company culture going forward.

Some Things We're Looking For

  • You have experience or interest in building interactive products that teams love: you're excited about building the most user-friendly products for teams to take their raw data and turn it into insights.
  • You appreciate good design (UI/UX) and are passionate about building products that people love to use
  • You're a fantastic communicator, especially in a remote team and are happy to continuously challenge existing ideas
  • You have experience or an interest in open source projects
  • You're thoughtful about creating and maintaining a world-class engineering culture
  • You are based within GMT ± 3

What The Job Involves

  • Build and own features from start to finish: plan, build, test, deploy, iterate
  • Work in a small high performing team with a lot of collaboration and getting feedback directly from our users!
  • From time to time, we'll expect you to produce content or present to our community. We're big believers in engaging with our community as much as possible.
  • Interacting with our users in the community (through Discourse, Twitter or Github) and reviewing their issues and using the feedback to prioritise our work
  • Having an ownership mindset: being comfortable with both responsibility and accountability

Our Tech Stack

While we don't expect you to have used all the components of our stack, it'd be great to know which parts of it you're familiar with:

  • Primary stack: Typescript, React, Node, SQL
  • Frameworks: express, react-hooks
  • Infrastructure: Docker, GCP

Frontend Developer React

ParaPy is growing its development team and looking for a junior, medior, and senior frontend developer (3 positions!), for whom React holds little secrets and who enjoys working with modern web-technologies such as Three.js / WebGL, Typescript and Redux. Come join our passionate team of developers dedicated to drastically accelerate engineering design and give engineers more time to explore, optimize and innovate!

ParaPy

At ParaPy we believe that the future engineer creates smart software applications that automate routine work, freeing up time to explore more design ideas, optimize and innovate. We are developing a software platform that enables engineers to create, integrate and deploy such applications without needing a degree in Computer Science. Engineers use our signature Knowledge-Based Engineering language to capture design intent and various automation toolboxes to accelerate time-consuming human-computer interactions like 3D modelling, simulation, and pre- / post-processing thereof. ParaPy is used nowadays to radically accelerate design processes for a vast range of products like aircraft, ships, offshore structures, factories and buildings.

What You’ll Work On

You will develop functionality that empowers engineers to create advanced (3D) web applications in Python without demanding in-depth knowledge of HTML, JavaScript and CSS. Moreover, you will create low-code solutions to speed up application development and a cloud-based environment in which engineers collaborate while executing engineering processes. Most of these technologies are either from-scratch or in an early prototyping phase, allowing you to pioneer and “shape” the future. Together with our project leads, you will have the chance to closely interact with some of our strategical customers (leaders in their respective industries) to identify requirements and convert these into new actionable features.

What’s In It For You

  • Work in a highly talented team and in an open learning environment
  • Energizing atmosphere of YES!Delft; Europe’s leading tech incubator
  • Time and budget for personal development and freedom to try out new technologies on the platform
  • A good salary and the opportunity to grow with the company
  • Engage with leading customers in a variety of industries such as GKN Fokker (aerospace), Aker Solutions (energy) and Royal HaskoningDHV (AEC)

You will ideally

  • Have professional experience in React, JavaScript and TypeScript. We are growing our team with 3 developers and are looking for the following levels of experience:
  • junior: 1+ year
  • medior: 3+ years
  • senior: 5+ years
  • Have a BSc in Computer Science or equivalent
  • Enjoy writing clean and maintainable code

How To Apply

Please email Reinier van Dijk (info@parapy.nl) with your CV and motivating:

  • Why you’re interested in ParaPy
  • What your expert contribution would be (soft and/or hard skills) and which level of experience you have
  • Earliest availability to start
  • Anything else you think we should know 😊
  • Twitter
  • Linkedin

title: Front-end Developer
descriptionHtml:
Werken bij een van de leukste internetbureaus van Rotterdam vanuit Goes. #kangewoon

OVER DE ROL

Als Front-end developer bij 23G ga je aan de slag voor verschillende, vaak uitdagende, projecten. Je krijgt veel vrijheid en hebt meestal korte lijntjes met de opdrachtgever. Je kiest zelf of je afwisseling wilt of juist vastigheid. We bieden je alles wat je nodig hebt om je skills naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Samen met onze UX'ers, designers, projectmanagers en backend-enders lever je applicaties op waar je trots op kunt zijn.

We bouwen de meeste applicaties met Vue.js en Laravel. Als het project erom vraagt kiezen we voor een single-page app met REST API. Stylen doen we met Tailwind CSS. Daarnaast doen we app development met React Native. Schaalbaarheid vinden we belangrijk, dus draaien onze applicaties in de cloud van AWS. Word jij ook enthousiast van deze stack? Kom bij ons werken!

OVER JOU

  • Je hebt 2+ jaren ervaring als front-end developer
  • Ervaring met Vue.js of React
  • Actuele kennis van HTML, SCSS of JavaScript/Typescript
  • Je hecht veel waarde aan goede code
  • Je leert graag nieuwe dingen en deelt je kennis met anderen
  • Je spreekt en schrijft Nederlands en Engels

WAT JE VAN ONS KUNT VERWACHTEN

  • Salaris volgens Model Baarda (eerlijk en transparant belonen naar toegevoegde waarde) Voor een medior developer is dat bijvoorbeeld tussen de €2.872 en €4.788 per maand.
  • 25 vakantiedagen
  • MacBook, iPhone en randapparatuur
  • Reiskostenvergoeding en pensioenregeling
  • Uitjes, feestjes en reizen (Las Vegas, wintersport in Italië; check onze Instagram)
  • Gave kantoren in Rotterdam en Goes.
  • Ruimte voor ideeën en initiatieven
  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden
  • AWS Certification

BEDRIJFSPROFIEL

Met intelligent optimisme is elk probleem een kans en elke case een uitdaging om te laten zien dat het kan. Dat is onze visie.

En dat kunnen we als geen ander. Als ervaren optimisten zijn we elke dag aan het experimenteren, constant op zoek naar wat technisch mogelijk is. Dat komt doordat wij geloven dat het kan. Wat de vraag ook is. We kunnen het omdat we het willen kunnen. En zelfs als het niet kan, dan zorgen we dat het kan. Nee is simpelweg geen optie. Want ja, het #kangewoon.

SOLLICITEER

Wil je ons team komen versterken als Front-end Developer? Dan horen we graag van je!

HET SOLLICITATIEPROCES

  • Je solliciteert hierboven 👆
  • We nodigen je uit voor een kennismaking.
  • Je komt een aantal uurtjes bij ons meelopen. Wordt het 'm niet? Dan krijg je een kleine vergoeding voor je tijd.
  • Tekenen!

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Front-end Developer
descriptionHtml:
Werken bij een van de leukste internetbureaus van Rotterdam. #kangewoon

OVER DE ROL

Als Front-end developer bij 23G ga je aan de slag voor verschillende, vaak uitdagende, projecten. Je krijgt veel vrijheid en hebt meestal korte lijntjes met de opdrachtgever. Je kiest zelf of je afwisseling wilt of juist vastigheid. We bieden je alles wat je nodig hebt om je skills naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Samen met onze UX'ers, designers, projectmanagers en backend-enders lever je applicaties op waar je trots op kunt zijn.

We bouwen de meeste applicaties met Vue.js en Laravel. Als het project erom vraagt kiezen we voor een single-page app met REST API. Stylen doen we met Tailwind CSS. Daarnaast doen we app development met React Native. Schaalbaarheid vinden we belangrijk, dus draaien onze applicaties in de cloud van AWS. Word jij ook enthousiast van deze stack? Kom bij ons werken!

OVER JOU

  • Je hebt 2+ jaren ervaring als front-end developer
  • Ervaring met Vue.js of React
  • Actuele kennis van HTML, SCSS of JavaScript/Typescript
  • Je hecht veel waarde aan goede code
  • Je leert graag nieuwe dingen en deelt je kennis met anderen
  • Je spreekt en schrijft Nederlands en Engels

WAT JE VAN ONS KUNT VERWACHTEN

  • Salaris volgens Model Baarda (eerlijk en transparant belonen naar toegevoegde waarde) Voor een medior developer is dat bijvoorbeeld tussen de €2.872 en €4.788 per maand.
  • 25 vakantiedagen
  • MacBook, iPhone en randapparatuur
  • Reiskostenvergoeding en pensioenregeling
  • Uitjes, feestjes en reizen (Las Vegas, wintersport in Italië; check onze Instagram)
  • Gave kantoren in Rotterdam en Goes.
  • Ruimte voor ideeën en initiatieven
  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden
  • AWS Certification

BEDRIJFSPROFIEL

Met intelligent optimisme is elk probleem een kans en elke case een uitdaging om te laten zien dat het kan. Dat is onze visie.

En dat kunnen we als geen ander. Als ervaren optimisten zijn we elke dag aan het experimenteren, constant op zoek naar wat technisch mogelijk is. Dat komt doordat wij geloven dat het kan. Wat de vraag ook is. We kunnen het omdat we het willen kunnen. En zelfs als het niet kan, dan zorgen we dat het kan. Nee is simpelweg geen optie. Want ja, het #kangewoon.

SOLLICITEER

Wil je ons team komen versterken als Front-end Developer? Dan horen we graag van je!

HET SOLLICITATIEPROCES

  • Je solliciteert hierboven 👆
  • We nodigen je uit voor een kennismaking.
  • Je komt een aantal uurtjes bij ons meelopen. Wordt het 'm niet? Dan krijg je een kleine vergoeding voor je tijd.
  • Tekenen!

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Full Stack Engineer Intern
descriptionHtml:
Leading the future in luxury electric and mobility

At Lucid, we set out to introduce the most captivating, luxury electric vehicles that elevate the human experience and transcend the perceived limitations of space, performance, and intelligence. Vehicles that are intuitive, liberating, and designed for the future of mobility.

We plan to lead in this new era of luxury electric by returning to the fundamentals of great design – where every decision we make is in service of the individual and environment. Because when you are no longer bound by convention, you are free to define your own experience.

Come work alongside some of the most accomplished minds in the industry. Beyond providing competitive salaries, we’re providing a community for innovators who want to make an immediate and significant impact. If you are driven to create a better, more sustainable future, then this is the right place for you.

Join Lucid’s innovative engineering team in Amsterdam and help build world-class web applications that empower businesses globally. This internship is designed to give you hands-on experience in full-stack development while working with cutting-edge technologies in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Learning Opportunities

As a Full Stack Engineer Intern, you will:

  • Collaborate with experienced engineers to design, develop, and deploy scalable web applications.
  • Work on both front-end and back-end components using React, Java, and Node.js.
  • Integrate and maintain cloud-based solutions on AWS.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure high-quality deliverables.
  • Learn best practices in software development, including agile methodologies and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Contribute to real-world projects that impact thousands of users.

Skills & Qualifications

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with Java, Node.js, and React.
  • Basic understanding of cloud platforms (AWS preferred).
  • Knowledge of databases (SQL or NoSQL) and RESTful APIs.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

What We Offer

  • A supportive and inclusive environment where your ideas matter.
  • Hands-on experience with modern tech stacks and real-world projects.
  • Mentorship from experienced engineers to accelerate your growth.
  • Networking opportunities within Lucid and exposure to cross-functional teams.
  • Competitive internship compensation and flexible working arrangements.
  • A vibrant office in Amsterdam with a diverse and collaborative culture.

Additional Compensation and Benefits: Lucid offers a wide range of competitive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, vacation, and 401k. The successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing such programs. (Cash or equity incentive awards, if any, will depend on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and company performance.)

By Submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. If you are a California resident, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.

To all recruitment agencies: Lucid Motors does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers alias or other Lucid Motors employees. Lucid Motors is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Frontend Developer
descriptionHtml:
TimeEdit was established in Sweden in the mid 90’s by an astrophysicist making a timetabling application from an Excel sheet on crack. Since then, the system has been professionalised and developed further to arguably become the world’s most modern fleet of resource management tools for higher education institutions. As a leading SaaS company within Edtech we are now moving to redefine the future of Acedmic Operations.

Today, TimeEdit is a market leader in Europe and one of Scandinavia’s fastest-growing Edtech companies. On average, our customers spend 20% less on facilities, representing more than 4MEUR (!) in savings per year (yes, we’re pretty proud of that!). Less money spent on empty rooms means more resources allocated to research projects and higher education quality.

We recently celebrated our 200th customer and are growing fast through new exciting applications and a global roll-out. Today, more than seven hundred thousand students, teachers and schedulers use our products every day (yes, we’re pretty proud about that, too!).

Our office is located at Vondellaan in the heart of Utrecht.

About TimeEdit

At TimeEdit, we are on a mission to reshape how universities and colleges operate globally. Our Academic Operations Platform is a crucial component for over 200 institutions worldwide empowering them to manage complex scheduling, resource allocation, and curriculum planning with greater efficiency and a data-driven, student-centric approach serving more than 2.5 million students. As a fast-growing, Gothenburg-based SaaS company, we are at the heart of an industry undergoing significant digital transformation. We foster a culture of transparency and flexibility, empowering our team members with the context and freedom to drive real impact.

We are looking for a new Frontend Developer to join our amazing team in Utrecht, working 2-3 days from the office.

The role

With the market transitioning away from legacy monoliths, Excel spreadsheets and home-grown has-beens, the TimeEdit Engineering team plays a pivotal role in defining the next generation of digital tools for universities across the globe to use. To accelerate our growth journey, we are seeking an additional set of skilled hands to join our team and help develop the timetabling and resource management products of the future.

As a Frontend Developer At TimeEdit, You Will

  • Create, innovate and develop our curriculum management and student facing products with JavaScript/TypeScript and React
  • Be part of an empowered engineering team consisting of an Engineering Manager and 3 software engineers, delivering a product used by more than 1 million students, faculty and staff
  • Work with modern, cutting-edge technologies, learn from experienced team members, and experiment with new tools and approaches with the support of a learning budget
  • Continuously work with team and company leadership to develop our processes, workflows and tools to make sure our culture and employee satisfaction is as cutting edge as the products we like to build

Your day-to-day

  • Ship your own and your team’s code to different environments with autonomy
  • Conduct sprint planning and help crafting technical specifications to complement the PMs business requirements
  • Participate, lead and help improve TimeEdit’s agile, empowered, development process
  • Reflect and evaluate on how we can keep improving our methodology, our culture, and the business value and outcomes we deliver
  • Be part of an exciting and challenging growth journey together with some of the world's most talented Engineers, Product Managers, Customer Success managers and Sales representatives

We urge you to apply if you..

  • Have at least 1 year of experience as a software engineer with JavaScript, TypeScript, and React
  • Experience with a cloud provider such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud is desirable
  • Possess great communication skills; fluent in English, verbal and written

We believe you are an individual who enjoys contributing your own ideas, approaching challenges with independence, curiosity, and enthusiasm, and questioning the way we think. You are a self-starter who enjoys “blank canvas” problem solving. We are a company with high ambitions, and we believe that you have them too.

title: Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
At AlisQI we're looking for a Full Stack PHP Engineer to join our dev team.

About AlisQI

AlisQI is the no-code Quality Management Software for manufacturers. We empower manufacturing companies to transform their operations with easy-to-implement, highly flexible, cloud-based software. Our integrated approach to Quality Management allows manufacturers to grow a Culture of Quality, unlock their factory’s full potential, become smart and more profitable.

We are looking for people that, like ourselves, are smart, pragmatic, direct and on a mission! As we are looking to create a diverse and inclusive culture, we explicitly invite women, people of color, and non-Dutch people to react. Our development team is made up of 50% women and non-Dutch individuals. Read more about our core values.

The challenge

We work with a mature, business-critical codebase that supports more than 180 factories worldwide. We have big plans, including:

  • Migrating our monolithic platform into a structured, domain-driven architecture built on top of Symfony and its components
  • Improving performance and scalability through implementation of queued workers
  • Building a secure and thoughtful API that is usable by developers and our customer-facing AI tools

Our Team's Ambition Is To Continuously Improve And Extend The Application Through a Truly Agile Process. We've Built a Great Environment To Support This Goal

  • A small, diverse, and collaborative dev team
  • Thoughtfulness matter more than lines-of-code
  • Contributions to the open source community through our business-critical Twig static analyzer (TwigQI)
  • Lastly, we build trust - we hired you, and you should be able to do great work because of that!

We're now looking for a full stack engineer who can help us deliver high-quality features quickly and sustainably. Alongside day-to-day development, you'll also take part in discussions around improving our architecture as we gradually move toward a cleaner and more modern codebase.

The role is weighted toward back-end development (roughly 80%), with the remaining 20% dedicated to front-end tasks to keep things well-rounded.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

  • Creating, testing, and maintaining software that aligns with customer requirements and business objectives
  • Contributing ideas to improve technical design and development processes
  • Investigating issues, responding to incidents, and documenting solutions

About You

  • A seasoned PHP engineer with experience working outside of a framework (we are moving towards Symfony, but our code is currently proprietary with components)
  • Experience managing databases, including migrations, optimization, and ORM/Repository patterns
  • Some exposure to JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Open to trying AI tooling in the workflow and evaluating impact with data, not hype
  • Resident in the Netherlands

Nice to have

  • A good understanding of Twig. A massive plus if you have experience working with Twig internals!
  • Worked with Stimulus/Hotwire
  • Infrastructure management, such as PaaS (Platform.sh) and Microsoft Azure
  • Worked in a B2B or Enterprise environment that builds for resilience

What We Offer

We are independent thinkers and expect our team to be independent as well. We strive to continuously improve ourselves and are always experimenting with technologies.

  • We are a remote company, so you work from home, but are constantly in touch with the team through Slack and Teams.
  • We meet twice a year in person to socialize and celebrate our achievements together! We also have a monthly work together day for those living in the Netherlands.
  • As we are growing, there will be plenty of opportunity to learn and venture into new areas.
  • We would love it if you were better at stuff than we are. Help us bring AlisQI to its next level of growth!
  • We provide competitive compensation.
  • You’ll receive everything you need for a comfortable home office, including a laptop and two screens.
  • We provide an education budget because we want you to keep growing, attend events and conferences, and improve your skills.

Recruitment process

  • Chat with Pauline (Head of Development) to better understand your background, career plan and answer any questions you may have (30 min.)
  • At home challenge to evaluate your skills and give you a taste of what working at AlisQI would look like (~ 2 hours)
  • Technical interview with James (Tech lead) and one of our Back-end Developers to debrief your challenge, dive deeper into technical topics, and give you a sneak preview of our codebase (1 hour, non-disclosure agreement required)
  • Chat with some of your direct colleagues and discuss work culture (30 min.)

If you’re selected, we’ll contact you with an offer!

Apply for the job

Do you want to join our team as our new Back-End Developer? Then we'd love to hear about you!

companySlogan: We enable manufacturing companies to make their Quality Management smart and omnipresent. Save time and get smart today.
companyDescription:
AlisQI is a no-code Quality Management platform that enables companies to make their Quality Management smart, data-driven and omnipresent. We help our customer to save up to 20% on time, increase the quality level and reduce waste by up to 15%.

We focus on flexibility and ease of implementation. You can create your own processes and workflows, so that Alis perfectly reflects your physical processes and flows.

In many companies, quality management is still reactive and ad hoc. Problems are handled manually when they occur, rather than prevented proactively.

In addition, quality management is often still isolated; quality is not yet widely supported in the organization and supply chain.

We help our customers to become agile and efficient by turning quality management from ad hoc and reactive to smart and proactive. We involve the entire organization and supply chain in quality. This is how we shift Quality Control, Quality Assurance and QESH from isolated to omnipresent.

Our software is used around the globe. From start-up to Fortune 500.

title: Junior Full-Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij meebouwen aan digitale producten die ertoe doen? Dan zoeken we jou!

Ben jij die gepassioneerde

junior developer waar wij naar zoeken?

Of je nu net bent afgestudeerd en staat te springen om te beginnen, of al een jaartje (of twee) ervaring hebt: we leren je graag kennen.

Bij ons krijg je volop de ruimte om te groeien, word je intensief begeleid en werk je mee aan projecten die ertoe doen. Geen testcode in een krochten van Github, maar échte impact maken vanaf dag één.

Ervaring met Ruby on Rails, React of Node is mooi meegenomen. Maar wat we écht belangrijk vinden, is dat je leergierig bent, oog hebt voor kwaliteit en het leuk vindt om dingen te bouwen die gewoon goed werken. We werken met moderne tools en best practices (+ staan altijd open voor een frisse blik!), en houden daarbij altijd rekening met snelheid, gebruiksgemak en schaalbaarheid.

Waar kom je te werken?

Voormedia is een klein, ervaren softwarebedrijf in Amsterdam-Noord. We staan bekend om het oplossen van complexe vraagstukken met slimme, doordachte oplossingen. We zijn servicegericht tot in de details en zetten graag die extra stap om onze klanten écht vooruit te helpen.

Als full-service creative consultancy maken we op maat gemaakte weboplossingen voor allerlei sectoren, van hospitality tot overheid.

We zijn een hechte club van tien developers en designers met verschillende achtergronden. Jong van geest, altijd in beweging, en met veel ruimte om je eigen ideeën in te brengen. Bij ons geen vaste hokjes of zware hiërarchie, maar veel samenwerking, korte lijnen en een gezonde dosis humor.

En dan hebben we nog onze favoriete traditie: de expeditie. Tijdens zo’n week sluiten we het kantoor en gaan we samen op avontuur, bedacht door twee collega’s die iets van hun bucketlist willen afvinken. Het levert verrassende uitdagingen, mooie gesprekken en momenten op die je dichter bij je collega’s brengen. Je leert niet alleen het team beter kennen, maar ook jezelf.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt een passie voor development (maar écht).
  • Je hebt een hbo-opleiding afgerond, of je kunt aantoonbaar op dat niveau werken en denken.
  • Je hebt al wat vlieguren gemaakt: minstens een jaar ervaring in development.
  • Je bent zonder twijfel een tikkeltje eigenwijs (vinden we fijn), zolang je open blijft staan om te leren.
  • Je bent niet bang om je mond open te trekken als je ergens op vastloopt.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een fijne, flexibele werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam-Noord
  • Een mooi startsalaris tussen de €2850 en €3250 (o.b.v. 40 uur)
  • 25 vakantiedagen
  • 8% vakantiegeld
  • Pensioenregeling
  • MacBook Pro en iPhone van de zaak
  • Reiskostenvergoeding
  • Veel vrijheid om je werk op jouw manier te doen
  • En natuurlijk: onze legendarische Voormedia-expedities 🎒

Klinkt dit als iets voor jou? Mooi.

Solliciteer vandaag nog. We maken graag kennis met je!

title: Junior Frontend Developer (React.js)
descriptionHtml:
Op het hoofdkantoor

Bij Albert Heijn werken is niet zomaar een baan. Het is werk met betekenis. Je werkt in een informele cultuur samen met een bevlogen team dat graag voorop wil blijven lopen en verschil wil maken. Met jouw unieke talent maak je impact op het leven van al onze klanten. Je leert van experts in hun vakgebied en we helpen je jouw loopbaan vorm te geven. Je kunt bij ons flexibel werken, zowel vanuit huis als op ons hoofdkantoor in Zaandam. Een baan bij Albert Heijn is niet alleen een baan voor nu, maar ook voor later

Wat betekent dit voor jou?

Are you ready to be a part of something transformative? Join the AH Stores as a Junior React Developer and embark on a journey to reshape our traditional tech infrastructure into a modern, cutting-edge technology landscape that touches the lives of millions of customers daily! As a Junior React Developer, you'll play a supporting role in our ongoing transformation and micro service adventure. If you have a fervor for working with the leading front end tech stack React, helping make amazing applications for the Stores landscape, and much more, then this is the ideal place for you!

This Is How You Will Reinvent Food Retail.

  • Contribute to building front end applications within our modern tech landscape with React
  • Work closely within a product team, participating in agile ceremonies, story refinement, code changes, deployments, and production support activities.
  • Strive to understand the flow of our business application processes within AH Stores, translating functional front end requirements into technical solutions that our users will use daily in our Stores. Your ability to communicate your ideas effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders will be invaluable.


As a member of one of our product teams, you will be at the forefront of driving change across the entire Store cluster. Our team is a diverse and inclusive group of individuals, bound together by a shared 'can-do' attitude, a problem-solving approach, by means of Agile methodology. We possess the ability to swiftly validate assumptions without getting bogged down in protracted discussions. Above all, we hold high regard for every team member, respecting their unique perspectives and expertise.

Your office.

Together with your team you will work on inspiring projects to accelerate our transition into a hybrid Food & Tech company. We want to leverage data and technology to future-proof food shopping and give our customers accessibility to healthy food more easily available for everyone. At Albert Heijn, you team up with inspiring peers in the data, digital and tech domains. A community of diverse individuals who share a common goal; to create digital solutions that make (online) shopping simpler and more inspiring. Are you ready to reinvent the way millions of people buy and enjoy their food? We invest heavily in data, digital and tech. And that includes investing in your career! Our teams work in a hybrid way: both from home as well as in the office. We are located right next to the train station Zaandam.

We think it’s important to be part of an high-belonging team; a team where you can be yourself and feel safe, accepted and appreciated. For this job we are preferably looking for someone who brings diversity in our team, in the widest possible sense. Someone who is a great addition to our team by bringing other ideas to the table. So don’t check all the boxes? Don’t worry, we probably don’t either 😉. Don’t hesitate to apply if you think you are up for the challenge, we’re happy to have a look at your resume!

The recipe for maximum impact:

  • 0-2 years of work experience as a Frontend Developer in React;
  • Knowledge of Azure, HTML5, CSS, Javascript
  • Big bonus if you have worked in the retail domain before; 
  • You enjoy teamwork and making things happen;
  • You’re tech savvy, pro-active and have a big passion for tech.


What We Offer.

At Albert Heijn we aim to grow, and this is only possible if you grow along with us. As we work together to build our brand and your career, you can count on (based on 40 hours per week): 

  • An annual salary up to 52k including holiday allowance and a flexible bonus. Depending on your experience;  
  • 45 days of paid leave to enjoy your well-deserved holidays: 25,5 regular vacation days and 19,5 ADV days. Enjoy!
  • Flexible working hours; 
  • Access to a challenging training curriculum – AH Tech Academy; 
  • An excellent pension plan where we as an employer contribute 4,5 more than you as an employee;  
  • A travel allowance or a NS-business card for traveling to and from Zaandam by train; 
  • Attractive discounts on various insurance policies; 
  • 10% staff discount on groceries in all Albert Heijn stores, to a maximum of €300 per year;
  • A free Mijn Albert Heijn Premium membership with many benefits;
  • A company laptop and telephone.


We’re Albert Heijn, food retail reinventors. 🚀

Albert Heijn goes way back. More than 135 years, to be exact. So for millions of people, food shopping is synonymous with the Albert Heijn brand. We didn’t achieve this with a complacent, ‘hey, if it works today, it’ll work tomorrow’ approach, but by continually rethinking our propositions and staying plugged in to customer demands. More than 125,000 colleagues? Check. Over 1,250 stores in the Netherlands and Flanders? Check. The leading online food retail platform? Check, we build, run and love it.

Together we make eating better the easy choice. For everyone.

The world around us has changed, and significantly at that. These changes have impact on the lives of our customers, colleagues and partners. And therefore, also on Albert Heijn. We’re moving towards a new world with new opportunities and challenges. Albert Heijn wants more people to eat fresher, healthier and more sustainable food. Eating brings us together, keeps us healthier and contributes positively to the world. Our mission is: Together we make eating better the easy choice. For everyone.

Albert Heijn the Netherlands is B Corp certified. This underscores our purpose, through which we aim to contribute to a healthier, more social, and sustainable society. B Corp certification is a designation that a business is meeting high standards of verified performance, accountability and transparency.

Ready to contribute to our mission?

Do you want to play an active role in changing the food retail landscape as we know it? Then hop on board and join us on our expedition. Would you like to learn more first, before you apply to Albert Heijn? We’re happy to tell you everything about this vacancy! An assessment might be part of our selection process.

companyDescription:
Bij Albert Heijn geloven we dat eten en drinken een essentiële rol speelt bij de grote uitdagingen in de maatschappij. Het levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan een gezonde levensstijl, het verbindt mensen en draagt bij aan een beter klimaat en daarmee een duurzame samenleving. Onze missie is dan ook: ‘Samen beter eten bereikbaar maken. Voor iedereen.’ 

Elke dag zit boordevol keuzes en met alle mogelijkheden van tegenwoordig is kiezen niet altijd makkelijk. Daarbij snapt Albert Heijn dat beter eten voor iedereen anders is, maar uiteindelijk willen we allemaal hetzelfde: ons goed voelen en lekker in ons vel zitten. Dit kunnen we realiseren door gezonder te eten. Door te weten waar ons voedsel vandaan komt en er samen van te genieten. Door een bijdrage te leveren aan het beter achterlaten van de wereld voor de generaties na ons. Dat gaat niet vanzelf. Daarom nemen we iedereen stap voor stap mee op weg naar beter eten. 

Albert Heijn Nederland is B Corp gecertificeerd. Deze certificering onderstreept onze missie waarmee we een bijdrage leveren aan een gezonde, sociale en duurzame samenleving. De B Corp certificering wordt toegekend aan bedrijven die voldoen aan hoge normen voor sociale- en milieuprestaties, transparantie en verantwoordelijkheid. Het behalen van de B Corp certificering is een aanmoediging om op de ingeslagen weg verder te gaan. 

Overal en op elk moment zijn wij de vertrouwde en inspirerende partner van onze klanten, al meer dan 135 jaar. Met meer dan 1.250 winkels, 9 home shop centers, 6 distributiecentra en 125.000 collega’s dragen we samen bij aan onze missie. 

Wil je weten wat de carrièremogelijkheden zijn? Ga naar werk.ah.nl. 
Meer weten over wat wij nog meer doen? Ga naar over.ah.nl.

title: Frontend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We’re on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every move simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing in their new city.

With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we’re proud to be Europe’s largest mid-term rental platform. And we’re just getting started.

Our international teams are driven by a shared purpose: to empower students to embrace change, unlock their potential, and shape a world without borders.

You’ll Find Us In Rotterdam, Paris, And Cergy, Working Across Cultures And Time Zones, Always Guided By Our Four Core Values

  • Ownership
  • We are Enablers
  • We are Changemakers
  • We are Connectors

Your impact

As a Frontend Software Engineer in HousingAnywhere, you will become part of one of our product teams and work directly with other engineers and product managers towards the specific team mission and goals.

By becoming more efficient and effective we will be able to scale our operations at a much faster pace. On a more human level, we’re going to positively reinforce the daily work lives of our colleagues and empower them to grow and to spend their time on those matters that really matter and make an impact.

Besides empowering our colleagues we will also make an active commitment to embedding data privacy and security standards into our internal tooling.

Our stack

Our backend runs on Golang, with PostgreSQL database(s). We run our services inside Docker containers in a Kubernetes cluster, all running in GCP. We use gRPC and messaging queue(s) in addition to HTTP for communication. Our Frontend stack is built on React/TypeScript. We love Git. We are quickly moving towards cross-platform Domain and Event-driven architecture.

Your profile: 👩🏻👨🏾👦🏼👽

  • You’re a Javascript expert, and you understand the mechanics of the browser (DOM, event loop, rendering pipeline) to build performant web applications.
  • Experience with React, Typescript. Node.js is a must
  • You’re experienced with test automation and you are interested in TDD best practices
  • Experience with online marketplaces, service providers and/or API development would be a great strength
  • You have at least 2 years of experience in web development

Your Responsibilities 🚀

  • A product-oriented person: you love developing products that help people and you’re driven by the impact you can make.
  • A real team player. You understand your colleagues may have different opinions and you consider them to make our product better. You understand how to challenge ideas, disagree and still commit to team decisions
  • A strategic thinker. You take initiative and are comfortable in interacting with stakeholders to elicit and clarify requirements and to create a plan to deliver your work in a timely manner.
  • A problem solver. You start from the problems and not the solutions, and you go the extra mile to find innovative and pragmatic solutions to the problems at hand.
  • A pragmatic and quality-driven engineer. You believe in the importance of writing good unit, integration and E2E tests.
  • An advocate of clean and simple solutions. When writing code you take into account who will read your code, and make your intentions clear and explicit for others to work with it.
  • A tech enthusiast! You are interested in new technologies and you constantly seek to improve yourself.

What’s in it for you

  • Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum!
  • Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days).
  • Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year!
  • 1,000 EUR personal development budget.
  • Complete coverage for commuting.
  • Personal equipment, including laptop and ergonomic setup.
  • Gym membership discount with GoVital or OneFit.
  • Dutch/English classes budget.
  • Variable pension scheme.
  • Diverse international community (46+ nationalities).
  • Pet-friendly office in Rotterdam city centre.
  • Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday.

What can you expect from our hiring process? Read more here.
