title: Junior (web) developer
descriptionHtml:
Wij zijn op zoek naar een enthousiaste, creatieve en ambitieuze developer. Je gaat fulltime aan de slag in een enthousiast en jong team dat verantwoordelijk is voor de realisatie en onderhoud van verschillende web-portalen, websites, webshops en API koppelingen.

Functieomschrijving

De gebruiker echt centraal stellen, dat is jouw belangrijkste doel als (web) developer bij Gladior. Ervoor zorgen dat de gebruiker intuïtief en efficiënt zich door een web-portaal kan begeven. Bij voorkeur met een glimlach, doordat de experience net iet anders, beter of leuker is. Jouw rol is om verschillende open source platformen zo te ontwikkelen, in te richten en samen te laten werken met allerlei data om dit te bereiken.

Voorbeelden van gerealiseerde projecten: https://www.gladior.com/voorbeelden/

Bij Gladior vinden we vooral je persoonlijkheid erg belangrijk; dat je ambitieus en positief ingesteld bent. Dat betekent dat je nadenkt over je eigen ontwikkeling, een passie hebt voor het behalen van resultaten én dat je klantgericht bent. We doen dit namelijk allemaal voor onze klanten en die van hen. Jij maakt dus graag iets tofs (en effectiefs) voor onze klanten, maakt toffe dromen een realiteit en denkt in oplossingen. Dit alles leidt tot een allround inzetbare collega voor ons, die we op verschillende plekken binnen onze organisatie kunnen inzetten.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden

Daarvoor hoefde je niet ver te scrollen, hè? Wij durven van onszelf te zeggen dat we goed betalen, daarom staat deze alinea zo hoog. Je stroomt bij ons in als junior Web Developer (€ 30.000 - € 40.000 per jaar) met prima doorgroeimogelijkheden naar medior Web Developer (€ 40.000 - € 50.000 per jaar). We zijn een kennisorganisatie en zijn op zoek naar een bepaald karakter passend binnen het huidige Gladior team. Wat je exact gaat verdienen is afhankelijk van je werkervaring en competenties.

Secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een goede pensioenregeling, de flexibiliteit om thuis te werken en de mogelijkheid om 20% van je werktijd te besteden aan ontwikkeling binnen je vakgebied zijn inbegrepen. Omdat Gladior een kennisorganisatie is die waarde hecht aan groei en ontwikkeling, zoeken we iemand met het juiste karakter die binnen ons huidige team past. Tijdens een persoonlijk gesprek bespreken we graag hoe jouw groeitraject bij Gladior eruit kan zien.

Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt een developer gerelateerde studie afgerond of je bent een fanatieke developer-hobbyist;
  • Je bent beschikbaar voor 32-40 uur per week bij fulltime dienstverband;
  • Je denkt in oplossingen en uitdagingen in plaats van in “problemen”;
  • Je houdt van afwisseling en werkt graag aan meerdere projecten tegelijk;
  • Je hebt kennis van HTML(5), CSS(3) en Javascript;
  • Wij doen veel nieuwe en unieke dingen en daardoor is leergierigheid een vereiste;

Jouw werkzaamheden

Maximaal 80% van je tijd besteed je voor klanten, denk hierbij aan:

  • Het optimaliseren van platformen om daarmee de gebruikersinteractie te verbeteren;
  • De realisatie applicaties zoals webshops, web-portalen, websites en API koppelingen, gezamenlijk met een multidisciplinair team aan specialisten.

Minimaal 20% van je tijd is voor zelfontwikkeling en Gladior, denk hierbij aan:

  • LinkedIn Learning cursussen;
  • Deelname aan onze brainstormsessies.

Je beschikt 100% van je tijd over het Gladior Hart en Brein

title: Frontend Developer
descriptionHtml:
Job description

DESCRIPTION OF THE TASKS:

• Write and debug web frontend code in SPA frameworks, such as Vue.js and Angular.

• Manage the front-end build configuration and the appropriate npm tasks.

• Work with Typescript and modern web development.

• Write CSS and HTML by using SASS and Semantic UI.

• Participate in the .NET implementation of a micro-services solution, being able to write backend code in a reliable, scalable, secure and testable way, implementing resilient integrations, satisfying requirements and service level agreements.

• Deploy and manage services on Kubernetes.

• Implement validation mechanisms as unit and integration tests for both back-end and front-end code.

• Implement OAUTH authentication mechanisms.

• Liaise with other technical Teams in order to push new features / changes to production.

Write and maintain technical documentation of the solution implemented. Account for secure coding practices, as well as logging and auditing features.




REQUIREMENTS:

More than 12 years in IT

More than 5 years of experience in Software Development

More than 3 years of experience in front-end Development with Vuejs and Typescript

More than 1 year of experience on debugging Angular codebase

More than 5 years of experience in back-end Development in Microsoft .NET (C#) and .NET Core

More than 3 years of experience with highly scalable systems and microservices

More than 3 years of experience working in a team. following Agile/SCRUM methodology procedures and disciplines.

More than 3 years of experience in developing applications that publish and consume messages via AMQP, including handling message routing, queuing, and error handling.

More than 3 years of experience on estimating the work to be done upon request.

Good knowledge of SDLC best practices

Good knowledge of the design, documentation and development of full stack solutions

Excellent knowledge of the design and development of back-end components (REST APIs, integration patterns, micro-services)

Excellent knowledge of relational databases, focusing on Microsoft SQL Server (schema design, procedural scripting etc.)

Excellent knowledge of version control with Git and Git practices

Knowledge Elasticsearch

Excellent knowledge of using containers and orchestrators (Kubernetes)




Delivery mode : remote (within Europe)

ONLY EU CITIZENS

title: Frontend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Frontend Engineer (Vue.js)

Location: Amsterdam

Type: Full-time

Ready to join one of the most ambitious tech teams in the Netherlands?

In 2023 we received the prestigious Oryx Award by the Dutch Financial Newspaper (FD), for the company with the most exceptional growth performance. We were awarded 1st place by the Deloitte Fast 50 in 2019 for growth and innovation, 7th place in 2020. We’ve continued our strong growth during and after Covid times, and have ambitious plans for the future. Now, we are looking for a driven and skilled Frontend Engineer to join our team to further conceptualize and execute our growth ambition.

About Experiencegift

Experiencegift is home to Hotelgift, Flightgift, Traingift, and Activitygift, the world’s leading experience gift brands. Our products let people gift unforgettable experiences across 750,000 hotels, 400 airlines, 50,000 activities, and train journeys all over Europe. We believe experiences are more meaningful than things. Our mission is to make giving experiences easy, joyful, and global. Operating in 50+ countries with offices in Amsterdam, London, Athens, and New York, we’re a close-knit team of 50+ people from 15+ nationalities.

What makes the role so great?

You will develop and refine high-quality Vue.js 3 applications, turning designs into fast, intuitive interfaces. Expect to work closely with design and backend teams, influence architectural decisions, and help evolve a growing frontend ecosystem. This role offers meaningful ownership, technical variety, and space to grow.

What will you do?

  • Build, maintain, and scale Vue.js 3 applications using TypeScript, Vite, and Pinia.
  • Translate Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive interfaces using HTML, CSS, and modern styling techniques.
  • Implement animations and micro-interactions that enhance user experience.
  • Develop secure, reliable API integrations including authentication and token handling.
  • Optimize for performance, accessibility, SEO, and cross-browser consistency.
  • Contribute to component libraries, design systems, and frontend architecture.
  • Participate in code reviews, share best practices, and collaborate across teams.


Who are you?

  • Passionate & curious: You love front-end development, and you enjoy learning and experimenting.
  • Problem-solving: You are not afraid of challenges, and you are able to utilize the proper means to find solutions.
  • Collaborative: Ability to work effectively in a team and independently with minimal supervision.
  • Detail-oriented: You pay attention to details, ensuring every design implementation feels just right.


What will you bring?Core Experience

  • Strong experience developing with Vue.js 3 (Composition API, component patterns, state management).
  • Solid proficiency in TypeScript and modern build tooling.
  • Mastery of CSS:
    • Grid, Flexbox, custom properties
    • Responsive layouts and mobile-first design
    • Preprocessors such as Sass or Less
    • Ability to turn Figma designs into polished, consistent UI
    • Comfort with animations, transitions, and interaction patterns
  • Strong understanding of browser behavior, rendering, and performance optimization.
  • Experience integrating APIs, handling authentication flows, and managing sessions.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD workflows, Git branching strategies, and scalable project structures.
Nice to Haves

  • Experience with Nuxt 3, SSR/ISR, or hybrid rendering.
  • Knowledge of design systems (tokens, Storybook, component governance).
  • Understanding of frontend security best practices (XSS, CSRF, CORS, CSP).
  • Testing experience with Vitest, Cypress, or Playwright.
  • Exposure to React, SvelteKit, or SolidJS.
  • Basic understanding of Node.js or serverless functions.
  • Accessibility awareness (WCAG, ARIA).


Why Join Us?

  • Work on high-impact products where frontend excellence is a core value.
  • Autonomy to shape engineering standards and influence technical direction.
  • Work on ambitious, high-impact systems that reach millions of users.
  • Collaborative culture that values precision, performance, and creativity.
  • Small team, large scope: every person counts, every decision matters.
  • Flexible work setup and room to grow into architectural or leadership roles.
  • A culture that enables and rewards initiative, curiosity, and exceptional performance.
  • Young, friendly, ambitious, international team in Amsterdam, Athens, and London.


What can you expect from us?

  • Salary reflective of skills and experience and performance-based bonus potential
  • Top-tier equipment
  • Pension plan
  • 25 vacation days
  • Hybrid policy (two days from home optional)
  • Amazing office at Museumplein in Amsterdam
  • Lunch and snacks provided
  • Fun after work and monthly events
  • Complimentary ClassPass subscription
  • Flexibility of working from abroad 2 weeks per year
  • Awesome annual trip abroad with the entire company


This is a full-time job (40H/week) based in Amsterdam and is available as soon as possible.

At Experiencegift we offer you the opportunity to work in a scale-up culture where everything you do matters. In our office in the center of Amsterdam, you will have the freedom to experiment and evolve your own projects. You will be part of an international, driven, award-winning team and will gain experience in a very fast-growing scale-up environment. By providing a creative, dynamic, and innovative environment, we empower our people for unlimited success.

Ready to make a real impact in a thriving company? Apply directly here or visit our career page for more details. We are looking forward to meeting you!

No agencies please, we manage our recruitment processes internally.

title: FRONT END DEVELOPER
descriptionHtml:
Zit digitaal in jouw DNA? Ben jij een expert in het creëren van sensationele User Experiences die voldoen aan de laatste technische standaarden? Krijg jij een kick van het opleveren van opdrachten binnen het budget en voor de deadline is verstreken? In dat geval, zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Je maakt deel uit van een multidisciplinair team. Als front end developer weet je, net als onze backend developers, hoe je een design vertaalt naar werkende, technische producten. Je bent in staat om problemen te tackelen vanuit het perspectief van een klant maar ook vanuit de gebruiker. Je bent flexibel en op de hoogte van de laatste ontwikkelingen in Javascript en de nieuwste front end frameworks. Je kan doorgroeien in de rol van full stack developer en/of technical lead. Of misschien focus jij je op je werk als chief Frontender. Uiteraard hangt dat allemaal af van jouw eigen ambities en talenten!

Wat verwachten we van jou?

  • HBO/WO denkniveau (diploma is niet verplicht)
  • 3+ jaar relevante werkervaring
  • Grondige kennis van HTML, CSS/Sass en Javascript/Typescript
  • Ervaring met Vue.js en/of React
  • Ervaring met AJAX en REST api’s
  • Ervaring met Git / GitLab

Wat bieden we jou?

Eenvoud ontwikkelt innovatieve webapplicaties voor bedrijven. We hechten veel waarde aan persoonlijk contact, loyaliteit en een down-to-earth en gemoedelijke sfeer.

Een heel fijne werkomgeving, waarin veel te leren valt

Een uitstekend salaris

Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden (pensioen, reisvergoeding, leerbudget, vakantiedagen)

Gedeeltelijk op afstand werken

Geinteresseerd?

Naast je CV zouden we graag een brief met jouw motivatie willen ontvangen op recruitment@eenvoud.nl. Probeer te formuleren wat jou uniek maakt en waarom Eenvoud jou zou moeten uitnodigen voor een gesprek.

Acquisitie gebaseerd op deze vacature wordt niet geapprecieerd.

companySlogan: We design every app and website to have appeal, meaning and impact to users. No bullshit, we just keep it Eenvoud.
companyDescription:
Eenvoud creates innovative and effective digital solutions, whether it is an application or a website or a hybrid combination. We work in a small and very skilled team and deliver creative and high quality solutions for our SME and International clients, branched in a great scope. Examples of our customers are JDE, BASF, Gemeente Amsterdam, Amsterdam UMC, but also a broad range of yacht builders van den Hoven Yachts and NGO`s like Aqua for All. Next to this Eenvoud participates in several startups and we are working on our own products to market.

The company was founded in 20213 by two partners, Rik van Dijk en Jasper Kums, whom had been self-employed for 6 years in online solutions. In 2021 another partner joined the team with comparable background, Peter Bijsterveld. Eenvoud is based in Amsterdam West, no dull office space with suspended ceiling, but an apartment like environment on the ground floor with it`s own garden as well, situated in a living area, enough commotion to be found!

Our mission is to make it as easy as possible for our clients, as simple as that. Simple solutions for complex problems. We have the knowledge and skills to develop all solutions in house. We stay innovative and relevant by closely following technological developments on a day to day basis and taking our customers by the hand in their digital journey.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Full-Stack Software Engineer at Weheat

Contact

View Website

Description

Are you ready to tackle exciting technical challenges that shape the future of sustainable heating? At Weheat, we’re looking for a talented Full-Stack Software Engineer to build the applications and systems that power our next-generation heat pumps. Your work will span across frontend and backend development, enabling real-time diagnostics, intuitive control, and smart optimization for devices used worldwide.

‍

What You’ll Work On

  • Frontend Development: Design and maintain intuitive (web) applications that provide users with real-time insights, control, and monitoring of IoT-enabled heat pumps.
  • Backend Development: Build robust systems to manage the remote diagnostics, monitoring, and control of IoT-enabled devices.
  • API Design & Integration: Develop scalable, secure APIs and ensure seamless communication between heat pumps, mobile apps, cloud systems, and frontend interfaces.
  • Data Collection & Visualization: Create efficient data pipelines to gather performance metrics and craft dynamic dashboards to display trends and diagnostics in visually compelling ways.
  • Database Design: Architect scalable and secure databases to store critical device and user data, ensuring performance and reliability.
  • Cross-Platform Support: Build applications optimized for a variety of devices and browsers to provide a consistent and exceptional user experience.
  • Machine Learning Integration: Collaborate with the data science team to implement machine learning models that optimize energy usage and system performance.
  • Performance & Reliability: Ensure fast, fault-tolerant systems and applications that support thousands of devices with minimal downtime.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with firmware engineers, UX designers, and product teams to ensure cohesive user experiences and technical excellence.

‍

Our Tech Stack

  • Frontend: JavaScript, TypeScript, React (native), Next.js.
  • Backend: C#, .NET Core, Python (for ML).
  • State Management: React Query.
  • Styling: Tailwind CSS.
  • Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Azure, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • DevOps: GitHub Actions, Expo, CI/CD pipelines, ELK.
  • Protocols: REST APIs, MQTT for IoT device communication.
  • Testing: Cypress, Detox.

‍

Why You’ll Love This Role

  • Cutting-Edge Challenges: Tackle problems like real-time data collection, low-latency diagnostics, IoT scalability, and interactive frontend experiences.
  • Collaborative Teamwork: Join a passionate group of engineers and innovators who value creativity and excellence.
  • Meaningful Impact: Your work will directly reduce energy waste and contribute to a greener planet.
  • Freedom and Growth: Enjoy autonomy while shouldering significant responsibility, providing opportunities for both personal and professional growth.

‍

Requirements

  • Experience: 1+ years of experience in full-stack software development.
  • Languages: Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and C#.
  • Frontend Skills: Expertise in building responsive and interactive (web) applications.
  • Backend Skills: Strong understanding of building robust systems and APIs.
  • Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical skills and a knack for eliminating inefficiencies.
  • Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team.
  • Mindset: Entrepreneurial drive, eagerness for challenges, and passion for sustainability.
  • Bonus: Experience with machine learning or IoT technologies.

‍

What do we offer you?

  • Join an adventure to redefine sustainable heating and make your mark on the tech industry's future.
  • Collaborate with elite engineers in an environment that pushes you to exceed your limits.
  • Access to cutting-edge technology and tools, including a laptop and iPhone for work and personal use.
  • Compensation for overtime hours, either financially or as extra holidays – your choice.
  • Competitive benefits, including a yearly bonus and a total of 33 vacation days (including public holidays).

title: Frontend Developer
descriptionHtml:
About the Job


🚀 Frontend Developer

📍 On-site / Hybrid | Deventer (NL-based)

🕒 Full-time | 1-5 years experience


Are you a passionate Front-end developer with passion for code and sports? Sportmonks offers you the opportunity to combine your programming skills with your love for sports. As a Frontend Developer, you’ll work on exciting projects such as football widgets with live scores and statistics that are used by sports fans and businesses all over the world.


And that’s not all: you’ll also contribute to improving the customer onboarding experience and help shape the frontend of our data platform. This platform plays a key role in our company—it collects, manages, and distributes large amounts of real-time sports data to our customers. If you're ready to make a real impact with your work, we’d love to have you on our team.


Who we are

🚀 Fast-growing scale-up based in the Netherlands, founded in 2016

⚽ Born from sports passion—we started as a small team of sports enthusiast

🌍 Global reach, now trusted by over 70,000 customers worldwide

📊 We provide reliable and comprehensive sports data via APIs for:

  • Websites & mobile apps
  • Fantasy games
  • Media companies
  • Analytics platforms
  • and more!


🤝 Trusted by top-tier brands, including:

  • City Football Group
  • Red Bull Racing
  • RB Leipzig
  • Dutch FA (KNVB)
  • VI


What our enthusiastic developers say about Sportmonks

"I’ve learned a lot at Sportmonks. They’ve always supported me well, and I enjoy working here." - Milan Weiss


"Sportmonks offers a great environment with a fun team where you feel at welcome in the company immediately—even while working remotely." - David Perez


What the ideal candidate looks like…

  • A Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • 1-5 years of experience building web solutions like website or apps
  • Has the ambition to grow into broader development team management responsibilities
  • Strong coding skills, but also a good sense for guiding and supporting team members
  • Naturally stays up to date with the latest tech trends and loves to experiment with new tools and ideas—no push needed
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Available to work at least 2 days per week from our office in Deventer


Your team

At Sportmonks, you’ll become part of a driven team of developers, who love what they do by combining their love for coding and sports. We’re serious about writing great code, but just as serious about keeping things fun, relaxed, and collaborative.


The core of our development team is based in the Netherlands, which means plenty of opportunities for in-person collaboration. At the same time, we also work with talented developers across the world —so you’ll be part of an international remote-friendly culture that values flexibility and trust, but requires 100% responsibility .


What we offer

At Sportmonks, we believe in creating the right environment for developers to thrive. That means:

  • €2700 - €3500 per month (depending on your knowledge and experience)
  • Our growth is your growth - benefit from an attractive bonus
  • A team of tech and sports enthusiastic colleagues
  • A startup culture that encourages ownership, initiative, and innovation
  • The chance to make real impact in a growing sports data related international company


Are you ready to take to join us and build something meaningful in the world of sports data? We’d love to get to know you! Just send us your CV and a short motivation letter to and let’s have an informal chat to explore the match.

title: Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

We are looking for an innovative and collaborative Full Stack Developer to join our team. This role is for a versatile developer who can take ownership of features from concept to deployment. You will be building robust, scalable applications by connecting a polished frontend to powerful backend services, with a focus on creating seamless, end-to-end products that may include AI-powered features.

What We Need

  • Eye for Design: A strong sense of aesthetics and usability, with the ability to translate design concepts into beautiful, functional user interfaces.
  • Excellent Communicator & Team Player: Articulate, collaborative, and able to work effectively within a team environment, sharing ideas and feedback constructively.
  • Adaptable & Innovative Mindset: A natural curiosity and eagerness to explore new technologies and venture into uncharted territory. You shouldn't shy away from learning something new to solve a problem.
  • AI-Enhanced Workflow: Fully embraces AI technologies to optimize their workflow, from in-IDE assistants (like GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to external tools and command-line agents.
  • Knowledge of Design Systems: Experience with or a solid understanding of design systems is a significant plus. Familiarity with tools like Figma and Tokens Studio is highly valued.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications using our core stack.
  • Architect and build AI-powered features and applications, integrating with large language models (LLMs) and other AI services.
  • Build responsive and performant user interfaces with React and Next.js, utilizing our design system and component libraries built with Storybook and Vanilla Extract.
  • Develop and manage server-side logic and APIs using Node.js.
  • In cooperation with our TechOps department, deploy and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security.
  • Collaborate with frontend and backend developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic.

Key technical strengths we’re looking for

  • Frontend: Strong proficiency in React, Next.js, Vanilla Extract, Vite, and Storybook.
  • Backend: Solid experience with Node.js.
  • Headless CMS: Experience architecting and integrating solutions with headless CMS platforms like Sanity (our default), Contentful, DatoCMS, or Strapi.
  • Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS).
  • AI Integration: Familiarity with building applications that leverage AI/ML APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Hugging Face, Anthropic) is highly desirable.
  • Design Integration: Experience working with Figma and Tokens Studio to implement designs accurately.
  • Databases: Knowledge of both SQL and NoSQL databases.

About Us

We’ve been exploring technology's potential to deliver breakthrough innovations since 1998. We believe that deep technical know-how combined with cutting-edge creativity drives change to future-proof businesses. Change relies on radical synergy. Technology and creativity should work in perfect unison. Tech enables creativity. Creativity unlocks the potential of tech.

Our track record of disruptive ventures and innovative ideas shows that we have transformative thinking deeply ingrained in our DNA. We punch above our weight when it comes to consulting, creating and maintaining digital ecosystems for global clients like VodafoneZiggo, Polestar, citizenM, and Philips. With a team of 450+ specialists across brand, experience, technology, and data & AI, we have the power to drive fundamental transformation at scale.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion

Our people are a true cross-section of society. That’s how we ensure that the services, campaigns, and products we create uphold the same quality regardless of who interacts with them. We welcome everybody and respect individual identities. We are convinced that diversity stimulates creativity and ensures innovations.

title: Junior/Medior PHP Developer
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to a valuable next step in your career. This is your chance to harness your creativity and develop your skill set by working on advanced web applications. At DongIT, we have a wide range of projects thirsty for your ingenuity and craving for innovative design.

Apply Now

Working at DongIT

Description

Developing at a Junior/Medior level means participating in various large and challenging web projects within a team of experienced developers. Fitting in with the team and taking feedback to the heart is key to your own success and growth and builds towards delivering excellence.

You will work on various complex web applications with privacy-sensitive data, which must meet high requirements. We translate our customer requests into safe, maintainable, and clean code in a structured and accurate manner. You will find yourself in a dynamic environment and perform work based on open source frameworks using a ticket system, version management, continuous integration, unit testing, security, and release management.

Requirements

  • HBO/WO education level completed in a relevant major such as:
    • Computer Science.
    • Software Engineering or Development.
    • Communication & Multimedia Design.
  • Knowledge base:
    • Apache, PHP, and CSS/HTML.
    • Linux and MySQL.
  • Experience:
    • 1 - 3 years experience in a relevant line of work, either from a previous job, education, or personal work.
    • Developing websites/applications.
    • Development frameworks, such as Laravel, CakePHP, Symfony, or Drupal.
What you enjoy

  • Working accurately in a high-paced environment.
  • Translating your creativity to output.
  • Active participation in the company and providing innovative ideas.
  • Working as a team player, but also functioning independently when needed.

What we have to offer

  • Large and challenging web development projects.
  • High-end laptop.
  • A platform and encouragement for your own initiative and input.
  • Time and budget to follow training and courses.
  • An opportunity to build on your track record and your development skills.
  • Option for full remote work and flexible working hours.
  • Comfortable workplace in the center of Leiden, just a 5-minute walk from the central station.
  • Travel compensation or an NS train card.
  • Market-based salary, dependent on experience and level of education.
  • Pension plan and other enticing bonus models.

Apply Now

Note: Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated. We do not accept candidates through third parties, including recruitment parties, employment agencies, headhunters, and outsourcing organizations.

companyDescription:
DongIT is an independent cybersecurity and software development company, specialized in web security, penetration testing, and custom web applications. We help organizations worldwide identify, assess, and reduce security risks in web and mobile applications, networks, and IT infrastructures.

Our expert team of ethical hackers and developers delivers high-quality services, including:
• Penetration testing & security audits
• Secure code reviews & vulnerability assessments
• IT security training & workshops
• Development of advanced security tools and web platforms

We are the creators of Security Reporter, the all-in-one platform for professional pentest reporting, used by security teams and pentesters around the world.

Through websecurityscan.eu, we offer in-depth and tailored security testing services. Our development division focuses on building secure, privacy-sensitive, and technically complex custom web applications for clients in both the public and private sectors.

From our headquarters in Leiden, the Netherlands, we conduct independent security research in critical sectors and contribute to the global cybersecurity community through innovation and open-source development.

Learn more:
• Web development & careers: dongit.eu
• Penetration testing & security services: websecurityscan.eu
• Pentest reporting platform: securityreporter.app

title: Full-stack developer (PHP + TS)
descriptionHtml:
About us:

Planner 5D is a global hub for home design, uniting over 100+ million users in 230 territories around our planet (yes, we have 2 users connecting from Antarctica each month!). Our platform simplifies the home renovation process from concept to execution, and this process has never been more straightforward with our cutting-edge software. You don't need to be a professional designer to enhance your home or workspace. We are dedicated to streamlining the design experience, making the customization of dream homes accessible to everyone.

Our cross-platform presence spans Web, iOS, Android, Windows, and MacOS, ensuring seamless synchronization for our users. Planner 5D is more than just software; it's a vibrant community of enthusiastic and product-oriented professionals. From diverse backgrounds, our team collaborates across time zones, fueled by a shared passion to revolutionize the home design market.

We are constantly looking for like-minded talent eager to take ownership and drive innovation within our expanding suite of tools. Join us in shaping the future of home design.

We are searching for senior full-stack web developer who will join our web team and work on new features, improving and maintaining our current solution.

Our tech stack: PHP 8.4, Symfony, PHPUnit, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Git., Docker.

For front-end part: native Javascript, JQuery(legacy code), Typescript, React, Three.js(OpenGL), Webpack, Websocket, Jest (unit tests), Docker, SVG.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, test, and maintain high-quality PHP applications;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features;
  • Write clean, modular, and reusable code;
  • Follow best practices - SOLID, STUPID, design patterns, writing tests, writing self-documenting or well documented code, etc.;
  • Optimize application performance and scalability;
  • Troubleshoot and debug applications to resolve performance and other issues;
  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends


We expect:

  • 4+ years of experience in modern Web development;
  • Strong PHP skills with at least one framework (Symfony / Api Platform / Laravel);
  • JavaScript (ES6+) / TypeScript proficiency;
  • Familiarity with React.js / Vue.js / Angular (or at least JQuery);
  • Solid understanding of SQL (SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL, …), plus experience with caching and messaging tools like Memcached, Redis, MongoDB, Message Queues;
  • Comfortable working with REST, JSON, XML, HTML, Git, Docker, etc.;
  • You care about clean, maintainable code — applying SOLID, DRY, KISS, Clean Architecture, and spotting code smells is second nature;
  • You follow best practices in security, performance, memory management, data structures, and scalability;
  • Good understanding of server infrastructure, web protocols (HTTP, Web Sockets, ...);
  • English skills starting from B1


Nice to have

  • Understanding of mathematics, geometry
  • Experience with 2D/3D graphics (Canvas, WebGL, OpenGL, …)
  • Familiarity with payment systems / APIs (PayPal, Stripe, Apple / Google payment processing, ...)
  • Understanding of Russian or Lithuanian languages


You will be truly welcome in our team if:

  • Love what you do: We're looking for team members who truly enjoy their work and bring that enthusiasm to the team every day
  • Tech geek at heart: If coding, experimenting with new software tools, or curious about tech trends is your thing, you're speaking our language
  • with solution-oriented mindset: When you are faced with challenges, you start thinking of possible solutions instead of dwelling on the problems
  • Have tech hobbies? Yes, Please!: programming, microcontrollers, 3D printing, physics, mathematics, etc
  • Team Player Who Gets It: We value team members who can grasp tasks quickly and communicate their ideas effectively – teamwork makes the dream work!


What we offer:

  • Great work environment that balances freedom and responsibility
  • Our team is made up of friendly and passionate enthusiasts who are eager to help and share their knowledge
  • We believe in work-life balance, so you'll receive around 30+ days of paid holidays per year
  • Company computer equipment by request
  • Education courses for our team members, and we're willing to allocate funds toward your training expenses
  • English classes on our corporate platform
  • Offline company events in Lithuania and online team-building
  • Unlimited free Planner5D subscriptions


Note: We only consider applications from candidates currently based in locations: Lithuania or Netherlands. Visa sponsorship is available if you hold primary residence with work authorization.

title: Full-Stack Developer (Fulltime)
descriptionHtml:
Eduface is een Nederlandse EdTech-startup die een AI-assistent bouwt voor feedback en beoordeling in het hoger onderwijs. Ons lokaal gehoste model helpt universiteiten de kwaliteit van feedback te verbeteren, terwijl docenten doorgaans tot 50% van hun tijd besparen. Getraind met data van de Universiteit Leiden en de Radboud Universiteit, presteert ons model beter dan GPT-4 op Nederlandse benchmarks en is het specifiek ontwikkeld voor academisch schrijven, met accurate, didactische feedback in zowel het Nederlands als Engels. Door onze eigen efficiënte, privacy-first AI te ontwikkelen in plaats van commerciële API’s te gebruiken, garanderen we volledige controle, transparantie en naleving van de EU AI Act.


Tasks

Als Full-Stack Developer bij Eduface werk je aan zowel de frontend als backend van ons platform. Je ontwikkelt koppelingen met learning management systems (LMS) en verbindt ons platform met onze AI-modellen, zodat docenten en studenten een soepele en betrouwbare gebruikerservaring hebben.


Requirements

Must-haves:



  • 2+ jaar professionele ervaring in full-stack webdevelopment

  • Expert in JavaScript en TypeScript

  • Sterke ervaring met Vue 3, waaronder:

  • Pinia voor state management

  • Vue I18n voor lokalisatie

  • Zod voor validatie

  • TailwindCSS en Reka UI voor styling en componenten

  • Bekendheid met Feature-Sliced Design-principes

  • Backend-ervaring met Fastify (of vergelijkbare frameworks zoals Express)

  • Grondig begrip van REST API-ontwerp, requestvalidatie en authenticatie

  • Ervaren met PostgreSQL, schema-ontwerp en query-optimalisatie

  • Ervaring met het integreren van Socket.IO of andere realtime communicatiesystemen

  • Sterke kennis van softwarearchitectuur, schaalbaarheid en modulair design

  • Ervaring met security best practices, waaronder authenticatiestromen, datavalidatie, rate limiting en veilige data-afhandeling

  • Ervaring met het bouwen en onderhouden van complexe, impactvolle systemen (bijv. multi-tenant SaaS, gedistribueerde componenten of realtime apps)

  • Bekend met CI/CD-workflows en deployment (wij hosten op Railway)

  • Schrijft schone, onderhoudbare en goed gedocumenteerde code

  • Voelt zich comfortabel bij het zelfstandig maken van architectonische en productbepalende beslissingen

  • Begrijpt en omarmt AI-tools — gebruikt AI om efficiëntie, codekwaliteit en workflow te verbeteren en ziet de waarde ervan in moderne softwareontwikkeling

  • Sterke probleemoplossende en debugging-skills, met focus op performance en betrouwbaarheid


Benefits

We bieden een fulltime functie waarbij je deel uitmaakt van ons kleine, getalenteerde development team om Eduface verder te bouwen. Je werkt in een startup-omgeving met veel autonomie, eigenaarschap en invloed op technische beslissingen.


Word lid van Eduface als Full-Stack Developer (Fulltime) en vorm de toekomst van onderwijsinnovatie. Samen creëren we technologieën die leren transformeren. Solliciteer nu en maak impact!

title: Front-end developer
descriptionHtml:
Bij Harborn zijn we voortdurend op zoek naar talenten (experience, growth & technology) die onze passie voor digitalisering delen. We begrijpen dat jouw talent misschien net niet helemaal aansluit bij de openstaande vacatures of je bent onze aanstaande vacature al voor omdat we lekker druk zijn!

Daarom staan we altijd open voor sollicitaties van mensen met een passie voor techniek en de drive om het verschil te maken.

Jij bent op zoek naar een baan bij een van de beste high-end bureaus van Nederland! Bij Harborn krijg je de kans om niet alleen indrukwekkende designs te creëren, maar ook actief bij te dragen aan de ultieme gebruikerservaring voor onze klanten. Hier werk je samen met een team van experts, experimenteer je met de nieuwste technologieën en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf continu te ontwikkelen. Klaar om impact te maken? Wij zijn Harborn – en we kijken ernaar uit om jou te leren kennen!

Unieke campus op de Westblaak in Rotterdam

Ons kantoor is een ware hotspot voor creativiteit en technologie, ontworpen door de architect Jamie van Lede. Gevestigd in hartje Rotterdam, biedt onze unieke 'campus' de perfecte omgeving om te innoveren en samen te groeien. Bij Harborn staat jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal, leer je élke dag en wordt het begrip 'innovatie' daadwerkelijk in praktijk gebracht.

We zijn als Harborn perfect bereikbaar met OV (Metrostation Beurs) en de fiets. Midden in de stad met op elke hoek leuke horeca en de energie van een stad die altijd in beweging is. Daarnaast is ons kantoor van alle gemakken voorzien waardoor meetings ook gemakkelijk digitaal kunnen worden gedaan.

Werken bij Harborn moet je ervaren

Harborn bouwt sinds 1999 aan de digitale wereld. Waar we in de beginjaren een grote focus hadden op web, zijn we ondertussen doorgegroeid naar een breed softwarehuis, met een track-record van meer dan 1.000 digitale projecten. Een digital tech-agency met 50+ code lovers. Wij maken digitale producten waar gebruikers echt blij van worden. Van conversie-gedreven websites tot zeer geavanceerde bedrijfsapplicaties op basis van Artificial Intelligence (AI). Want wij denken en bouwen mee aan de digitale innovatie en transformatie van onze opdrachtgevers, dat is onze missie. Wij zijn de slimste kinderen van de klas. Elke week besteden we gemiddeld één dag aan innovatie en nieuwe technologie. En wij zijn ondernemende geesten die geen uitdaging uit de weg gaan. Nemen initiatief, tonen lef en zijn altijd gericht op resultaat.

Sinds 2024 zijn we daarnaast onderdeel van EPSA Netherlands. Samen blinken we uit in kostenoptimalisatie, (operationele) transformaties en digitale en AI-oplossingen. In de drie pijlers Procurement, Business Transformation en Digital hebben we de echte sterspelers in hun niche in huis. We combineren een missie-kritische aanpak met een full-service mindset: spot on in analyses, ondernemend in oplossingen en met een sterke focus op groei.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Front-end developer bij Harborn werk je samen met een multidisciplinair team van designers, developers en een delivery manager aan de meest uiteenlopende projecten voor onze diverse klanten. Bij ons ben jij niet alleen bezig met het ontwikkelen van prachtige designs, maar ook met het uitdenken van de beste gebruikerservaring voor onze klanten. Jij bent degene die de designs omzet in functionele, aantrekkelijke en toegankelijke websites en webapplicaties.

Maar dat is niet alles! Bij ons krijg je ook de kans om in contact te staan met onze klanten. Jij bent degene die hen op de hoogte houdt van de voortgang van het project en hen voorziet van technische ondersteuning.

Je werkt met de nieuwste webtechnologieën en frameworks, zoals React, Vue.js, Angular, SCSS en Typescript. Voor een volledig overzicht van onze techstack check je https://techradar.harborn.com/.

Jouw Verantwoordelijkheden

  • Ontwikkelen van schaalbare, high-performance webapplicaties.
  • Bouwen van gebruiksvriendelijke, pixel-perfecte interfaces met oog voor UX en interactie.
  • Zorgen voor hoge codekwaliteit via onderhoudbare code, testing en geautomatiseerde delivery.
  • Integreren van API’s en systemen binnen moderne webapplicaties.
  • Actief samenwerken met collega’s en bijdragen aan kennisdeling binnen het front-end chapter.
  • Afstemmen met klanten en vertalen van technische uitdagingen naar heldere oplossingen.

Wat breng je mee?

Je bent een ervaren Front-end developer met ruime ervaring in klantcontact en het vertalen van technische vraagstukken naar duidelijke oplossingen. Je bent in staat om zelfstandig technische keuzes te maken en deze te beargumenteren naar de klant. Als Front-end developer ben je proactief, analytisch sterk en overtuigend in je communicatie. Je voelt je comfortabel in de rol van adviseur en weet bruggen te slaan.

Verder Beschik Je Over

  • Minimaal hbo werk- en denkniveau
  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift
  • Minimaal 1 - 3 jaar ervaring als Front-End Developer
  • Ruime ervaring met React en Vue.js (of bereidheid om met beide te werken).
  • Sterk in TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML en CSS3 (SCSS).
  • Kennis van GSAP en WCAG is een pré
  • Ervaring met Agile en DevOps werkwijze
  • Bekend met Scrum, GitFlow en CI/CD processen binnen een DevOps-team.
  • Kennis van API’s en state management
  • Ervaring met REST en frameworks zoals Nuxt/Next
  • Kennis van headless CMS’en zoals Strapi, Prismic of Storyblok is een pré.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Wij bieden een fijne en gezellige werksfeer, met toffe maandelijkse Harborrels, ontbijt en lunch op kantoor en een prachtig nieuw kantoor in hartje centrum van Rotterdam! Onze enthousiaste collega's zijn de sleutel tot succes. We zijn groot genoeg voor het echte werk maar ook niet te groot. Een club waar je energie van krijgt en jou verder pusht op gebied van innovaties en skills ontwikkeling. Elke dag met energie naar je werk. Daar gaan we voor!

Daarnaast bieden wij jou een mooi totaalpakket van arbeidsvoorwaarden waaronder;

💰 Een uitstekend salaris, passend bij jouw kennis, ervaring en potentieel – er is ruimte voor groei als jij die meebrengt.

💻 MacBook van de zaak, zodat je overal goed kunt werken.

🏠 Hybride werken – flexibel vanuit huis of op kantoor.

💡 Maandelijkse vergoeding voor thuiswerken en internet.

🚆 NS Business Card, of liever op de fiets? Dan ontvang je €0,40 per km.

🎉 Vrij op of rond je verjaardag – een cadeautje van ons!

📚 €1.000 opleidingsbudget per jaar om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen.

🚀 Maandelijkse keynotes & workshops over digitale innovatie.

🍻 Teamactiviteiten & borrels in een inspirerend kantoor in hartje Rotterdam.

Nog steeds enthousiast?

Dan maken wij graag kennis met jou! Solliciteer via onderstaande knop en versterk ons talentvolle team!

title: Web Developer
descriptionHtml:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Our mission is great open source

It is our mission to make open source software available to people everywhere. We create world-renowned software, impacting the lives of millions of people every day.

The web team works in a multi-disciplinary environment with visual designers, UX designers and other developers to bring exciting new web projects to life. We help and learn from each other and constantly strive to improve both our work and our processes.

Required skills and experience

  • Demonstrable experience of work on modern web applications
  • A strong understanding of HTML, CSS with SCSS and JavaScript
  • Experience with Javascript components libraries
  • Experience with TypeScript
  • Experience with responsive user interfaces for a wide range of devices and browsers
  • Experience with Git or other version control systems
  • Awareness of SEO best practice
  • Consideration of accessibility in all aspects of your work
  • A strong understanding of web performance in complex user interfaces
  • Ability to interact with UX, designers and server-side developers
  • Curiosity about technology and a thirst to learn
  • Based in EMEA timezones (Europe, the Middle East and Africa)
  • University degree or equivalent education

Useful experience if you have it

  • Familiarity with Linux desktop technologies
  • Server-side languages, such as Python or NodeJS
  • Experience working on a large scale React (with TypeScript) project
  • A history of open source contributions
  • Relevant work experience

Who you are

We want a Web Developer who loves what they do. You are passionate about web standards and keep abreast of new developments in our industry. You always look for opportunities to improve your skills. You like to show off what you're working on and also learn from others. You have strong attention to detail and value the design of a product as much as you value the code. You have strong communication skills and maybe even blog once in a while. You're aware of the latest CSS techniques but also know the limitations that developing for a broad audience can bring - actually, you embrace the challenge.

In this team

  • You'll create high fidelity websites and web apps using the latest incarnations of HTML, CSS (SCSS) and Javascript (React and TypeScript)
  • You'll help maintain existing projects including updating content and adding new pages
  • You'll manage incoming requests for updates and liaise with or delegate to other people as necessary
  • You'll ensure the standard of our output remains high and consistent across our whole product portfolio
  • You'll ensure new pages are published according to specification and in compliance with our web style guide
  • You'll participate in and contribute to our living style guide, Vanilla Framework.
  • Work closely with UX designers and visual designers to implement exemplary user experiences.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

companyDescription:
We deliver open source to the world faster,  more securely and more cost effectively than any other company.

We're also the publishers of Ubuntu, the world’s most popular enterprise Linux from cloud to edge, together with a passionate global community of 200,000+ contributors. 

Ubuntu means 'humanity to others'​. We chose it because it embodies the generosity at the heart of open source, the new normal for platforms and innovation.

Together with a community of 200,000, we publish an operating system that runs from the tiny connected devices up to the world's biggest mainframes, the platform that everybody uses on the public cloud, and the workstation experience of the world's most productive developers.

Secure and reliable, elegant and intuitive, and open for innovation - this is the future of open source, which is why we're proud to be the developers of the fastest growing Linux in the world despite already being the most widely deployed.

Front-end developer

Heb jij een hart voor webapplicaties en ben je een getalenteerde front-end developer? Novaware heeft de perfecte rol voor jou!

Bij Novaware krijg je de kans om te werken aan diverse webapplicaties voor een breed scala aan klanten, variërend van Provincie Overijssel tot Ballast Nedam en van Zwolse Theaters tot het LUMC. Elk project biedt unieke uitdagingen, waardoor je werk nooit saai wordt. Ben je klaar om deze uitdagingen aan te gaan?

Jouw rol

Als front-end developer bij Novaware zet je designs om in functionerende websites, portals en applicaties. Je maakt gebruik van het Umbraco CMS, een open-source platform gebaseerd op .NET. Samen met je back-end collega's zorg je ervoor dat alles naadloos werkt.

Voorbeeldproject: Schouten Zekerheid

In je rol krijg je de kans om aan projecten zoals de multisite van Schouten Zekerheid te werken. Voor dit project werd het design aangeleverd in Figma, waarna de front-end vervolgens werd ontwikkeld met tools zoals Vue.js, TypeScript, SCSS en Webpack.

Wat Wij Zoeken

  • Afgeronde HBO-opleiding
  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring
  • Uitgebreide kennis van HTML5, CSS3 en JavaScript
  • Kunnen vertalen van UX-design naar werkende functionaliteit
  • Ervaring met het bouwen van responsieve en mobielvriendelijke websites
  • Ervaring met optimaliseren van de performance van een website met daarbij ook technieken voor het minimaliseren en comprimeren van bestanden
  • Bekend zijn met de nieuwste webstandaarden en -technieken, evenals met frameworks zoals Vue.js en Angular
  • Bekend zijn met het optimaliseren van websites voor verschillende browsers
  • Communicatief ingesteld

Wij Bieden

  • Een salaris tussen de €2750 - 4000 bruto per maand (afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring) o.b.v. fulltime (40 uur),
  • Pensioen,
  • Laptop,
  • 26 vakantiedagen,
  • Reiskostenvergoeding,
  • Zelfstandige functie met veel verantwoordelijkheid
  • Betrokken en gezellig team
  • De vrijheid om je eigen (thuis)werktijden in te richten,
  • Elke dinsdag en donderdag verzorgde lunch met alle collega’s,
  • Kans om jezelf te ontwikkelen met een ruim studiebudget en de daarbij benodigde uren
  • Jaarlijkse uitjes naar Denemarken (Codegarden), DUUG en een weekendje weg met het team
  • Solliciteer

Elke sollicitatie wordt bij ons door meerdere mensen bekeken.

  • Persoonlijk bericht

Zijn we enthousiast? Dan maken we een afspraak. Maar je hoort altijd iets van ons.

  • Gesprek 1

We zagen je compleet doormidden.

Geintje natuurlijk, dat zagen doen we tijdens het 2e gesprek.

We willen zeker weten dat je je thuis voelt bij Novaware. Daarom hebben we een grondige sollicitatieprocedure waarbij je verschillende collega's ontmoet. Zo krijg je een duidelijk beeld van je toekomstige functie en van ons bedrijf.

title: Full Stack Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Runway is building a first-of-its-kind tool for teams to track, automate, and collaborate on their mobile app releases. We're already used by industry-leading mobile teams to ship some of your favorite apps for food delivery, fitness, finance, and more!

We’re a small but mighty team, and there’s a lot to do. From building out new release automations, to adding support for even more third-party integrations, to diving into entirely greenfield new areas of the platform, you’ll be working closely with the rest of the team from inception to design, planning and implementation.

We build a lot of features, and we ship them fast. As a member of the team, you’ll need to develop a finely tuned sense of prioritization - when to make tradeoffs, when to write tests, and all while keeping the end-user experience top of mind. You’ll need to be comfortable rolling with changes, owning features end-to-end, and learning on the fly when needed.

We’re a distributed team with an NYC center of gravity. Our backend is written in Go, and our web application in React with Typescript (but when it comes to new hires and their prior experience, we're totally language-agnostic – we're looking for awesome engineers, period).

This role is fully remote and we welcome applicants from anywhere within 6ish hours of NYC in terms of timezone.

About You

We’re looking for people that are humble, hard working, and good team players.

There’s no room for big egos at a small startup. Everyone pitches in and is ready to roll up their sleeves to do anything and everything they can to carry the team forward. We help each other out, trust each other’s skills, and aren’t afraid to take the lead on things when necessary.

This is not a FAANG job. If you’re looking for a place where you can coast, this isn’t it. Everyone on the team works hard, learns something new every day, and gets things done. You won’t be building a small toggle hidden deep in the bowels of a monolith product. You’ll be valued, respected, and your work will matter.

We’re looking for great engineers, period. It doesn’t matter which parts of the stack you usually work in, as long as you’re keen to learn parts of the stack you’re less familiar with and to contribute across the board. And if you have experience with mobile apps, that’s a bonus – we love geeking out about the nuances of building & shipping mobile apps, and we believe that translates to an even better experience for our users.

Additional information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

When you apply

Please include a description of your recent experience or a resume, context on why you're looking for a new role and what would excite you in said new role, and links to anything you think will speak to your experience and interests!

title: Frontend Developer
descriptionHtml:
About Yournii 

Yournii is a fast-growing SaaS platform that helps franchises and retail brands translate national marketing into effective local store activation. We combine intelligent automation, integrations, and a scalable architecture to improve operational efficiency and reduce waste. 


Role Overview 

As a Mid-Level Frontend Developer, you will be responsible for building and improving user-facing features of our SaaS platform. You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver high-quality, scalable frontend solutions that support franchise brands across the globe. 

This role is ideal for a developer who enjoys building polished UI, improving frontend performance, and contributing to frontend architecture and UX. 


Responsibilities 

  • Develop responsive and interactive UI using Vue 3 
  • Convert UX/UI designs into clean, maintainable frontend code 
  • Improve frontend performance, accessibility, and usability 
  • Build reusable components and support frontend architecture 
  • Collaborate with backend developers to integrate APIs 
  • Participate in code reviews and help maintain quality standards 


Requirements 

  • 3–5 years of frontend development experience 
  • Strong Vue 3 and modern JavaScript/TypeScript skills 
  • Experience with component-based architecture and state management 
  • Focus on performance, quality, and UX 
  • Comfortable working with remote and international teams in English 

 

What We Offer 

  • Impactful work in a fast-growing SaaS company 
  • Opportunity to shape frontend architecture and product direction 
  • Collaborative international team and growth opportunities 
  • Gross salary range: 4000-4500/month

title: Frontend developer
descriptionHtml:
About us:

Planner 5D is a global hub for home design, uniting over 100+ million users in 230 territories around our planet (yes, we have 2 users connecting from Antarctica each month!). Our platform simplifies the home renovation process from concept to execution, and this process has never been more straightforward with our cutting-edge software. You don't need to be a professional designer to enhance your home or workspace. We are dedicated to streamlining the design experience, making the customization of dream homes accessible to everyone.

Our cross-platform presence spans Web, iOS, Android, Windows, and MacOS, ensuring seamless synchronization for our users. Planner 5D is more than just software; it's a vibrant community of enthusiastic and product-oriented professionals. From diverse backgrounds, our team collaborates across time zones, fueled by a shared passion to revolutionize the home design market.

We are constantly looking for like-minded talent eager to take ownership and drive innovation within our expanding suite of tools. Join us in shaping the future of home design.

We’re looking for Frontend developer who share our passion for writing clean, maintainable, and efficient code using JavaScript and TypeScript.

Your main focus will be improving and refactoring existing code, writing tests, and ensuring performance and stability of our product. Note that we use object-oriented programming (OOP) approach mainly as well as we work according to strict coding standards and other technical requirements.

Our tech stack: PHP 7.4(8.1), Symfony, PHPUnit, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Git., Docker.

For the front-end part: native Javascript, JQuery(legacy code), Typescript, Three.js(OpenGL), SVG, Canvas, WebGL, Webpack, Websocket, Jest (unit tests), Docker.

Required knowledge and deep understanding of:

  • 5+ years of experience of Web development
  • JavaScript
  • TypeScript
  • Popular frameworks and libraries (AngularJS, Vue, jQuery)
  • Experience with REST APIs, JSON, HTML, Git
  • ECMAScript 6+
  • Ability to write clean and maintainable code
  • Following best practices in performance, security, and architecture
  • Intermediate in English


Nice to have:

  • Understanding of mathematics, geometry
  • Understanding of web protocols (HTTP, WebSockets)
  • Experience with 3D graphics (Three.js, WebGL)
  • Interest in technology, experimentation, or personal tech projects
  • Understanding of Russian or Lithuanian languages


Character requirements:

  • Passionate about software development and quality code
  • Strong communication and analytical skills
  • Wish to learn, use and understand new technologies
  • Team player who can also work independently


What we offer:

  • Great work environment that balances freedom and responsibility
  • Our team is made up of friendly and passionate enthusiasts who are eager to help and share their knowledge
  • We believe in work-life balance, so you'll receive around 30+ days of paid holidays per year
  • Company computer equipment by request
  • Education courses for our team members, and we're willing to allocate funds toward your training expenses
  • English classes on our corporate platform
  • Offline company events in Lithuania and online team-building
  • Unlimited free Planner5D subscriptions


Note: We only consider applications from candidates currently based in locations: Lithuania or Netherlands. Visa sponsorship is available if you hold primary residence with work authorization.

title: Fulltime front-end developer - 32 of 40 uur
descriptionHtml:
Internetdiensten Nederland is op zoek naar een frisse fulltime front-end developer. Je gaat aan de slag in het team met het meebouwen aan websites, webshops en webportalen in Joomla! en Wordpress. Hier kun je je eigen creativiteit in meenemen, het team en de opdrachtgever voorzien van praktische tips hoe een website nog succesvoller en mooier kan worden. Anticiperen en proactief meedenken met de klant vinden we bij Internetdiensten Nederland enorm belangrijk. In je functie werk je ook samen met designers, back-end developers en projectleiders. Ervaring in webdevelopment is een pré.

Kom kennismaken of solliciteren.

Bel of mail, we reageren zo snel mogelijk.

title: Full stack developer
descriptionHtml:
Merapar is a strong brand within the Media and Entertainment, growing very fast. TV is our first love but we are rapidly expanding into new areas such as IoT, Data Management and Analytics.

Being part of our global professional services organisation you have the opportunity to assist the team in the further development of Merapar as a great place to work.

Driven by passion, we help clients to imagine, build and implement strategic infrastructures, workflows and consumer facing applications to bring content to users worldwide.

The people who work for Merapar are our primary asset and we encourage differences being an inclusive organisation. We invest in training and certification, e.g. in AWS technologies and Agile methodologies. We believe in Agile management and development principles and actively support our self-organising teams.

  • We are customer focused >> Engage. Don’t ignore.
  • We work as a team >> Work together. Don’t swim alone.
  • We improve, learn and share >> Advance. Don’t stagnate.
  • We encourage difference >> Be yourself. Don’t conform.
  • We deliver quality >> Excel. Don’t settle.

About The Role

You

  • Are part of our development team, developing cutting edge distributed software systems
  • Work with our European colleagues in project implementation
  • Define and develop microservices and cloud-based systems
  • Design and implement features in an agile development environment
  • Are responsible for the correct execution of functional and non-functional test cases/test procedures

You have

  • Been a Full Stack developer in an agile environment using multiple languages, with skills in both Back-End and Front-End development
  • +5 years of experience in all or some of the following languages: Java, JavaScript, Node.JS, Python, Typescript, HTML, CSS and React
  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Science, Engineering or a Computing related subject or equal by experience
  • Knowledge and experience of cloud development (AWS or Google Cloud)
  • Knowledge and experience with Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery, Test Driven Development, Behaviour Driven Development
  • An ability to propose suggestions for improvement, to identify and solve problems
  • An open-mind and a natural curiosity for new technologies
  • Excellent knowledge of Dutch and English
  • An understanding of security, scalability and resilience

Wanna be part of us? Then join us!

Join us, and let's create something remarkable together. Be more than just an employee; be a vital part of a story that's still being written. If you would like to know more about the role, please contact Maud Mutsaars on 06-42851017 or apply for the role via the button on this webpage.

title: Web Front End Developer
descriptionHtml:
Marktplaats in The Netherlands, and 2dehands and 2ememain in Belgium, are part of Adevinta: a global online classifieds specialist. The three brands are hosted on a multi-tenant platform, operated from our Amsterdam location, and are the top players in the classifieds space throughout the Benelux region.

We offer consumers the opportunity to trade their unwanted products and contribute to a greener, circular economy. We offer businesses - of all sizes, from the smallest hobbyist to the biggest brands in Benelux - a platform to showcase their goods and services online to over 11 million monthly unique users.

About The Team

What you’ll do & Who you are

You will join our multi-disciplinary C2C Buyers team in Amsterdam as a midlevel front-end developer, reporting to the team's Engineering Manager.

You will help buyers find the most relevant deals using modern technologies in a microservices architecture. We take a data-driven, experimental, and Agile approach, using neural networks for personalized content, using daily multiple-rollouts, A/B testing, and insights-driven feature development.

What You'll Do

  • Work on our high-availability infrastructure, improving the customer experience, the revenues, the architecture and the technologies.
  • Design and implement new projects in collaboration with colleagues and partners
  • Help to improve work in all areas: coding, processes, testing, tools, collaboration, ...
  • Be a technical partner for the organisation to help the business create requirements
  • We will work with you to grow your skills and your career at Marktplaats.

Who You Are

You have experience in software development in online areas, with a big codebase and a large user base. At least 3+ years of full-time employment on large and distributed systems. You like and breathe Agile development, focus on delivering, and like to take an active role in improving how we work.

  • Core Skills:
    • Experience with modern JavaScript (ES2020+), TypeScript, and React (Hooks and server-side rendering).
    • Proficiency with HTML5, CSS3 (SASS, CSS Modules), and responsive design principles.
    • Experience with testing libraries like Jest and React Testing Library; ability to debug and solve cross-browser compatibility and performance issues.
    • Experience with server-side tools like Node.js and Express.js.
    • Familiarity with modern build and bundling tools such as Webpack, Babel, or Vite.
    • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and running services in cloud environments like GCP, AWS.
  • Bonus Skills:
    • Experience with React Frameworks like Next js, Playwright and CSS-in-JS
  • Other Skills:
    • Experience communicating proposals, status updates and solutions to colleagues, team members and collaborators.
    • Foster collaboration and align with other teams.
    • A motivated approach to work
    • Experience in collaborating with others and contributing independently to bring work and projects to completion.
    • A commitment to learning, staying updated on industry trends, and exploring creative solutions while addressing edge cases.
    • You are a current resident of the Netherlands and you are legally able to work here.
Benefits

Life at Adevinta comes with its perks! Our Adevintans enjoy the following benefits:

  • An attractive Base Salary 💸
  • Participation in our Short Term Incentive plan (annual bonus) 🏆
  • Work From Anywhere: Enjoy up to 20 days a year of working from anywhere! Maybe not from the moon🌛well why not! just make sure you have internet connection! 🌍
  • A 24/7 Employee Assistance Program for you and your family, because we care ❤️
  • Win together, lose together is one of our key behaviours. At Adevinta you will find a collaborative environment with an opportunity to explore your potential and grow 🌱

On top of these, we also provide a range of locally relevant benefits. Wanna know more? Apply and ask our recruiters! ✨

Adevinta is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.

If you feel like you don’t meet all of the requirements for this role but are interested, please consider applying anyway. Research suggests that women and individuals from underrepresented groups may self-select out of opportunities if they don’t meet 100% of the job requirements. We strongly encourage people from historically excluded groups to apply and look forward to speaking with you.

companyDescription:
Marktplaats is part of Adevinta, a leading online classifieds group and champion for sustainable commerce with a focus on Europe. Together, we are changing commerce.

With an average of over 8 million unique visitors and around 350,000 new advertisements per day, Marktplaats is the largest online marketplace in the Netherlands for private and business sellers of second-hand and new products.

There is something for everyone on Marktplaats. Four new ads are added every second. From furniture and clothing to cars and everyday products, it finds a second, third or even fourth life through Marktplaats. At Marktplaats, every deal makes a big difference. Every month we connect millions of buyers and sellers. In this way, users of Marktplaats jointly contribute to a world in which people share more and waste less.

title: Medior Front-End Developer
descriptionHtml:
Onze missie? “Realizing a positive future around the globe” 🌍

"Wij streven naar een positieve toekomst wereldwijd. In een snel veranderende wereld zetten wij ons in voor een betere morgen. Door grote merken en bedrijven te betrekken, creëren we strategieën en technologieën die menselijkheid centraal stellen. Onze mix van data, creativiteit en technologie leidt tot impactvolle oplossingen. Wij geloven: hoe groter de impact, hoe beter."

Jouw rol bij ons

Als Medior Front-End Developer speel je een belangrijke rol in het ontwikkelen van hoogwaardige en innovatieve digitale oplossingen voor onze klanten. Je werkt aan uitdagende front-end vraagstukken en denkt actief mee over technische keuzes en optimalisaties. Je krijgt de kans om jezelf te ontwikkelen binnen een ervaren team, waarbij je samenwerkt met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines zoals back-end development en design.

Jouw Focus Ligt Op

✨ Front-End ontwikkeling: Je ontwerpt en bouwt robuuste, gebruiksvriendelijke en schaalbare front-end oplossingen met moderne technologieën.

🔧 Technische keuzes en optimalisatie: Je denkt mee over technische architecturen en implementaties, en draagt bij aan continue verbeteringen in het ontwikkelproces.

🎮 Innovatie: Je onderzoekt nieuwe frameworks, tools en technologieën en helpt deze te implementeren om onze projecten te optimaliseren.

🔝 Samenwerking: Je werkt nauw samen met back-end developers, designers en andere disciplines om digitale oplossingen te realiseren die voldoen aan de verwachtingen van onze klanten.

Waarom hier?

🤝 Cultuur van samen: Ontdek een wereld waar samenwerking, diversiteit en plezier naadloos samenvloeien.

📚 Jouw ontwikkeling: In een omgeving die bruist van de energie en innovatie, is jouw persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling onze prioriteit.

🚀 Samen groeien: Jouw expertise helpt ons strategisch en duurzaam te schalen in deze spannende groeifase.

⚖️ Werk-privé balans: We geloven sterk in het belang van een gezonde werk-privé balans en bieden flexibiliteit om dit te waarborgen.

🌈 Wees jezelf: Bij ons kun je altijd je authentieke zelf zijn. We vieren diversiteit en inclusiviteit en stimuleren een open en respectvolle werkomgeving.

Jij Brengt Mee

📜 Front-End expertise: Je hebt ervaring met HTML5, CSS3 en JavaScript/TypeScript, en werkt met frameworks zoals React, Next.js, Vue of Angular.

🔧 Technische veelzijdigheid: Je hebt kennis van Git, SASS en Webpack. Ervaring met back-end technieken zoals C# en .NET is een plus.

🚀 Leergierigheid: Je bent gedreven om je technische vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen en nieuwe technologieën te ontdekken.

📈 Taalvaardigheid en communicatie: Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal en kunt technische concepten helder uitleggen.

⌚ Beschikbaarheid: 32-40 uur per week. Deze functie is géén remote rol, maar vanuit ons kantoor in Rotterdam.

Non EU? DotControl is currently not in the position to hire non-European nationals as we do not have a sponsorship by the IND.

Wij Bieden Jou

🏙️ Inspirerende werkplek: Een bureau met een view in de iconische Van Nelle Fabriek in Rotterdam.

💰 Aantrekkelijk salaris: Een competitief salaris tussen de €3.500 en €4.500 bruto per maand.

🔮 Toekomstbestendig: Een pensioenregeling om ook jouw toekomst veilig te stellen.

🍽 Eten, Drinken, Vieren: Dagelijkse lunches, feestjes, en welverdiende vrijdagmiddagborrels.

📈 Groeipad: Ruimte voor ontwikkeling en innovatie, ondersteund door een educatiebudget.

👥 Teamspirit: Dagelijkse samenwerking met een getalenteerd en divers team.

title: Full-Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Promptwatch is building the leading GEO platform, helping businesses optimize their visibility across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI. We handle millions of clicks, citations, and visits per day - processing real-time data streams, tracking AI search patterns across 3,000+ domains, and synthesizing insights that drive decisions for thousands of companies. The technical challenges are real: ingesting and analyzing terabytes of log data, building distributed systems that prompt AI models millions of times daily, and creating real-time analytics pipelines that turn massive datasets into actionable intelligence within seconds.


As a Full-Stack Developer, you'll own entire features from database design to frontend interfaces. Ship code to production within hours, impacting thousands of businesses immediately. Work directly with the founding team to transform complex AI search data into intuitive user experiences. You'll have autonomy to choose your tools and define technical standards while solving real challenges: handling massive data volumes, building reliable distributed systems, and creating interfaces that make complex data actionable. If you thrive on optimizing performance at scale and want to see immediate impact from your work, you'll fit right in.



What You'll Do

  • Owning the entire application layer (React / Next.js, Node / Fastify, data models)
  • Designing and operating event queues, background jobs, and real-time APIs
  • Managing Google Cloud CI / CD, container builds, backups, and cost monitoring
  • Setting up logs, metrics, tracing, dashboards
  • Pairing with product and design to scope features and run user tests
  • Driving code reviews + testing culture



What We're Looking For

  • React 19 and Next.js (pages router)
  • Strong TypeScript knowledge
  • Node with Fastify
  • tRPC + traditional REST endpoints
  • Event queues and job schedulers (SQS, pgboss, etc.)
  • Postgres with Prisma or a comparable ORM
  • Tailwind, Shadcn components
  • Monorepo tooling (Turborepo, etc.)
  • Jest or Vitest (or similar)



Nice to Have

  • Experience with large amounts of data
  • Data visualization
  • Data analysis and analytics


Compensation

Base salary: €65,000 - €110,000


Equity: Meaningful equity stake


Perks: Great office location, team off-sites, company sports activities

Do you see yourself thriving and growing in this role? Apply now and join us in shaping the future of AI Search.
