title: Backend Developer (PHP, Symfony)
descriptionHtml:
At Cocoroco we are looking for a Back-End Developer to further build and scale our talent platform.

About Us

We are Cocoroco. We are building the most trusted talent platform that enables companies to easily connect with high quality remote talent. There will always be a need for skilled people and for a flexible and efficient way to find talent. Our platform unlocks the full potential of global talent. By combining remote work, a skill-based matching engine, and deep local market expertise, we connect companies with the right talent at scale. Companies such as Rituals, Picnic and Vodafone are already actively using our platform.

To build out our talent platform and integrations, we are now looking for a Backend Developer to join us at our Herengracht office in the center of Amsterdam. You will closely work with our tech and data team to launch innovative use cases that further strengthen our platform’s features and integrations. This gives you the opportunity to be part of a profitable and fast growing tech startup, with plenty of room to help define our data roadmap. The ideal candidate is able to take ownership of our backend layer and lead its further development.

Does this sound like the challenge you are looking for? Apply now.

Role

About the role

  • Backend developer (Symfony, PHP)
  • Reporting to Tech Lead

Objective

  • Build, validate and maintain the backend of our talent platform web application

Scope

  • Backend software development and third party API integrations
  • Work closely with our tech team and external dev agency

Responsibilities

  • Build and optimize backend features with a focus on scalability, security and reliability
  • Build and optimize RESTful APIs to support seamless frontend interaction
  • Design and manage database architectures (MySQL) for efficiency and performance
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and implement new features
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to team knowledge sharing
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to streamline deployment processes
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve backend application performance, ensuring high availability
  • Contribute to infrastructure as code using tools like Terraform

Requirements

Technical skills:

  • Proficiency in PHP and Symfony
  • Strong knowledge of MySQL and database optimization
  • Understanding of RESTful APIs and microservices architecture
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices
  • AI and machine learning knowledge is a plus

Experience

  • 2 - 5 years of work experience with backend development
  • Proven track record of developing scalable backend applications
  • Experience in database management and performance optimization
  • Demonstrated ability to work on complex projects from concept to deployment
  • Experience in managing and deploying applications in cloud environments

Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

Nice To Have

  • Experience with SaaS, platforms, marketplaces, or AI-driven products
  • Understanding of generative AI for backend interactions
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)

Benefits

Perks and benefits:

  • Competitive salary on a labor contract
  • Opportunity to work on a high-impact product with real users
  • Direct collaboration with founders and other engineers
  • Professional development and growth opportunities
  • Flexible working hours and remote work options

Application Process

  • Submit your resume and motivation why you are a good fit for this role
  • Screening call
  • Technical assessment
  • Cultural face-to-face interview
  • Second interview
  • Offer

Will you become our new Back-End Developer within a fast-growing, profitable tech startup in Amsterdam? You will work directly with the founders and the rest of the tech team, learn at high speed, and grow with the company. We look forward to your application.

Apply for the job

Do you want to join our team? Then we'd love to hear about you!

title: Frontend Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Weheat re-engineert warmtepompen omdat we geloven dat dit product een sleutelrol speelt in de energietransitie en radicale innovatie verdient. We herontwerpen vanaf de printplaat om koolstofarme verwarming betaalbaar en eenvoudig te maken. Onze software is net zo cruciaal: onze intelligentie neemt de complexiteit voor haar rekening zodat huiseigenaren dat niet hoeven te doen en maximaliseert zo hun besparingen en CO2-reductie.


Jouw missie

Bij Weheat zorg jij dat gebruikers moeiteloos werken met onze slimme warmtepompen. Als Frontend Software Engineer ontwerp je heldere, snelle interfaces die realtime data tot leven brengen. Jij vertaalt complexe techniek naar eenvoud op het scherm—samen met UX-designers en backend-collega’s. Je bouwt schaalbare webapplicaties die sturen op comfort, kosten en CO₂-besparing. Elke klik telt. Jouw code maakt duurzame keuzes logisch en makkelijk voor iedereen.


Je past bij ons als…

  • Je hebt 1+ jaar ervaring met frontendapplicaties bouwen
  • Je werkt graag met TypeScript en JavaScript
  • Je integreert API’s en visualiseert realtime data
  • Je houdt van snelheid, eenvoud en slimme UX
  • Je jaagt efficiëntie na en denkt oplossingsgericht


Onze cultuur in één minuut

We zijn een team van 80 mensen die knallen voor het klimaat – de klok tikt. Meetings houden we kort, zodat we kunnen bouwen. Jij pakt problemen van begin tot eind aan en werkt met collega’s die scherp zijn en van je verwachten dat je hen uitdaagt. Overwerken? Jouw keuze: uitbetalen of extra vrije dagen (bovenop je 33 vakantiedagen, inclusief feestdagen). Bonus als we onze doelen halen. Je krijgt topgear: laptop, iPhone en een fabriek vol tools om ideeën om te zetten in hardware en code. We vieren successen en mikken elke dag weer hoger.

Jij vertaalt complexe techniek naar eenvoud op het scherm—samen met UX-designers en backend-collega’s. Je bouwt schaalbare webapplicaties die sturen op comfort, kosten en CO₂-besparing. title: Fullstack Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript)
descriptionHtml:
Fullstack Engineer (Node.js / NestJS / Next.js)

Amsterdam – Hybrid

Full-time

About Creative Clicks

Creative Clicks is a high-growth performance marketing company building and scaling data-driven digital products globally. We operate across 65+ countries, combining the speed of a startup with the scale of an international organization.

Our engineering team builds the platforms and services that power our mobile apps, internal tools, and product infrastructure. As we continue to scale, we’re looking for a Fullstack Engineer who enjoys ownership, impact, and working across the entire stack.

About The Role

As a Fullstack Engineer, you’ll work on real products used at scale — not demos or side projects. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Design, Mobile, and BI to design, build, and operate applications that need to be fast, reliable, and secure.

You’ll be involved end-to-end: from shaping solutions and architecture to shipping features to production and keeping them running. This is a hands-on role for someone who likes to build, own, and improve.

If you enjoy working in a startup-style environment where decisions are made quickly and your work directly impacts the business, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, Prisma, and PostgreSQL
  • Develop clean, performant frontend applications using Next.js, React, and TypeScript
  • Design and optimize APIs consumed by mobile apps (Flutter) and internal tools
  • Own database design, migrations, indexing, and performance optimization
  • Implement secure authentication and authorization flows (JWT, OAuth)
  • Write high-quality, testable code (unit, integration, API, and E2E tests)
  • Debug and resolve issues across frontend, backend, and infrastructure
  • Deploy and operate services on AWS, working with EKS, Docker, CI/CD, and Helm
  • Improve system performance, developer experience, monitoring, and deployment workflows
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ship features quickly and reliably


What You Bring

  • Strong experience with Node.js, NestJS, and TypeScript
  • 4+ years of experience as a FullStack Developer
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM
  • Solid frontend experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript
  • Experience designing and maintaining REST APIs
  • Good understanding of authentication, authorization, and security best practices
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests
  • Production experience running applications on AWS
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), and CI/CD pipelines
  • Ownership mindset — you’re comfortable taking responsibility from idea to production
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with a small, fast-moving team


Nice to Have

  • Experience working with or supporting mobile teams (Flutter)
  • Startup or scale-up background
  • Exposure to microservices or event-driven systems (SNS, SQS, Kafka)
  • Interest in improving developer experience, tooling, or performance


What We Offer

Competitive salary

Hybrid working model (Amsterdam HQ)

25 vacation days

A mission-driven team shaping the future of healthcare

A culture of innovation, ownership, and collaboration

Additional Information

This role is open only to candidates already residing in the Netherlands.

Creative Clicks is proud to be a diverse and equal opportunity employer. Selection decisions are based solely on job-related factors.

title: Frontend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About The Team

Miro is on a mission to empower teams to create the next big thing. Our platform facilitates visual collaboration for millions of users daily, enabling them to brainstorm, design, and bring ideas to life. We're looking for a passionate and skilled Frontend Software Engineer to join Table Views team in Amsterdam.

Table Views team (Structured Modes stream) is at the forefront of Miro's structured widget capabilities. We are a small, highly experienced group responsible for enabling our customers to visualize and interact with first and third-party structured content directly on the canvas. Our work is foundational, driving the seamless movement between multiple stages and accelerating Miro's adoption in the definition and delivery phases of innovation. We thrive on tackling complex technical challenges within our core canvas collaboration ecosystem, powering critical structured formats like Tables, Timelines, Kanban View and Documents, as well as high-impact integrations such as Jira.

About The Role

As an Frontend Software Engineer for the Tables team, you will step into a pivotal role at the heart of Miro's collaborative canvas. This opportunity arises from the immense growth and strategic importance of structured tabular content within our platform. You will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and maintaining our FE mainly services that power all our tabular capabilities across the entire collaborative platform (e.g. Kanban, Timeline, etc).

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define, design and implement new capabilities in the domain including bringing new ideas and designing solutions from start to finish
  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable, and reliable capabilities in the team domain using Typescript, React, Canvas, WS and related technologies (sometimes BE technologies too, e.g. Java, Kotlin etc)
  • Contribute to the overall architecture and technical direction of the team domain, ensuring our engineering ecosystem meet the evolving needs of our growing user base
  • Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code, adhering to best practices and coding standards
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing sessions in the stream
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, ensuring high availability and performance of our services
  • Contribute to improving our development processes and tools

What You’ll Need

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, with a proven track record of leading initiatives within complex, large-scale environments (more focus on FE)
  • Excellent knowledge of Javascript and related FE technologies (React, Typescript, Webpack etc)
  • Good working knowledge of creating high-performance interfaces using fundamental rendering technologies such as WebGL, Canvas API or related 2D graphics libraries (e.g. PixiJS, Skia etc)
  • Experience in developing interactive products with realtime technologies (e.g. Websocket)
  • Good knowledge of Java and related technologies (e.g. Maven, Spring Boot etc)
  • Good knowledge of relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as PostgreSQL
  • Experience with AWS services (S3, EC2, RDS, DynamoDB, ElastiCache etc)
  • Working basic knowledge of infra technologies and processes (deployment, contracts, gRPC etc) to co-design solutions with our other engineers
  • Working knowledge of microservices architecture
  • Working knowledge of distributed event stream platforms for high-performance data pipelines (e.g. Kafka etc)

What's In It For You

  • Competitive equity package
  • Medical insurance coverage
  • Lunch, snacks and drinks provided in the office
  • Wellbeing benefit and WFH equipment allowance
  • Annual learning and development allowance to grow your skills and career
  • Travel allowance for your commute
  • Opportunity to work for a globally diverse team
  • Inspiring workplace in the heart of Amsterdam

About Miro

Miro is a visual workspace for innovation that enables distributed teams of any size to build the next big thing. The platform's infinite canvas enables teams to lead engaging workshops and meetings, design products, brainstorm ideas, and more. Miro, co-headquartered in San Francisco and Amsterdam, serves more than 100M users and 250,000 companies collaborate in the Innovation Workspace. Miro was founded in 2011 and currently has more than 1,600 employees in 13 hubs around the world.

We are a team of dreamers. We look for individuals who dream big, work hard, and above all stay humble. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do and through our work together we hope to create a supportive, welcoming, and innovative environment. We strive to play as a team to win the world and create a better version of ourselves every day. If this sounds like something that excites you, we want to hear from you!

Check Out More About Life At Miro

  • Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@lifeatmiro
  • Blog: https://miro.com/careers/life-at-miro/all/
  • Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mirohq/

At Miro, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration across cultural differences. Miro’s mission — Empower teams to create the next big thing — is how we think about our product, people, and culture. We believe that creating big things requires diverse and inclusive teams. Diversity invites all talent with different demography, identities and styles to step in, and inclusion invites them to step closer together. Every day, we are working to build a more diverse Miro, cultivate a sense of belonging for future and current Mironeers around the world, and foster an environment where everyone can collaborate and embrace differences.

Miro handles and uses personal data of job applicants in line with its Recruitment Privacy Policy found here.

title: Stage Web Developer
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij iemand die het beste uit zichzelf wil halen en zich wil blijven ontwikkelen? Dan zoeken wij jou!

Wij zijn een online marketing bureau met een duidelijke ambitie om dé specialist te zijn op het gebied van e-commerce. We bouwen webshops en zorgen voor aantoonbaar méér resultaat op het gebied van online marketing.

Wij bieden je een leuke werkplek met een informele sfeer. Persoonlijke ontwikkeling vinden we belangrijk en hierin voorzien we dan ook ruim.

Wat ga je doen als Web Developer bij Inventus?

Je gaat je samen met ons team bezig houden met algemene website ontwikkeling. Denk hierbij aan HTML, CSS, webpagina’s responsive maken etc. Ligt jouw focus meer op backend? Dan ga je o.a. zorgen dat de modules gekoppeld worden met het frontend gedeelte en houd je je bezig met API’s.

Wat zoeken we in jou?

  • Je volgt een gerelateerde HBO of MBO (BOL) opleiding
  • Je hebt al een eerste stage afgerond en brengt die ervaring mee
  • Je bent geïnteresseerd in de nieuwste ontwikkelingen en trends
  • Je hebt aandacht voor details en bent probleemoplossend ingesteld
  • Je bent leergierig
  • Je spreekt uitstekend Nederlands en bent daarnaast communicatief sterk richting je collega’s (Nederlandstalig team). *

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Goede begeleiding tijdens je stage/afstuderen
  • Stagevergoeding, afhankelijk van het aantal dagen dat je meewerkt
  • Een jong en gezellig team
  • Vrijdagmiddag borrel vanaf 16.00 uur

Inventus Online

Wij zijn een jong en hecht team dat bestaat uit 20+ gedreven medewerkers die nieuwsgierig zijn naar alles in de wereld van online marketing. Hierin zijn we ambitieus en constant op zoek naar de nieuwste innovaties. We doen er alles aan om onze klanten te helpen hun e-commerce ambities te realiseren en deze naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Daarnaast houden we van gezelligheid en het vieren van onze successen, op vrijdagmiddag tijdens de vrijmibo maar ook tijdens team-uitjes en onze jaarlijkse zomer barbecue.

Wil je meer informatie over de vacature, werkzaamheden, arbeidsvoorwaarden en meer? Neem dan contact met ons op. Stuur een berichtje naar hrm@inventus.online met hierin je CV en eventueel een motivatie. Wij nemen daarna zo snel mogelijk contact met je op. *

We zijn nieuwsgierig naar jou!

  • Omdat beheersing van de Nederlandse taal essentieel is voor het goed kunnen uitvoeren van de functie, kunnen we sollicitaties die niet in het Nederlands zijn opgesteld helaas niet in behandeling nemen.
  • Wegens de feestdagen worden sollicitaties na deze periode in behandeling genomen.

companySlogan: Voor jouw e-commerce ambities
companyDescription:
WIJ ZIJN INVENTUS
Wij realiseren e-commerce ambities. Dat doen we al sinds 2008 op onze eigen nuchtere, herkenbare en succesvolle manier. Onze werkwijze draait om kennis, communicatie en persoonlijke betrokkenheid. We vinden het belangrijk dat onze klanten op een persoonlijke en heldere manier worden geholpen. Dit doen we door marketing, data en techniek te combineren met persoonlijke betrokkenheid.

Wij werken volledig transparant en in overleg met de klant. Door resultaten inzichtelijk te maken en te communiceren in begrijpelijke taal, nemen wij de klant bij de hand in de wereld van e-commerce. Samen gaan we voor het beste resultaat en zetten we op de juiste momenten de juiste stappen. 

Samen resultaten behalen geeft ons energie. Die resultaten behalen we met een team vol professionals. De wereld van e-commerce kent voor ons geen geheimen en nieuwe ontwikkelingen voeren wij automatisch door in onze projecten. Zie ons als de regisseur van online doelstellingen. Wij draaien aan de knoppen, zodat de klant kan groeien. We halen het maximale uit de klant en uit zijn of haar business.

Inventus staat altijd voor jou klaar. Wil je weten wat wij voor jouw bedrijf op het gebied van e-commerce kunnen betekenen? Maak dan kennis met ons team en daag ons uit met jouw ambities.

🚀 #1 E-commercebureau Emerce100 2022
🚀 #2 Fonk150 Digital Agencies 2022
🚀 Google Premier Partner 2023

title: Fullstack developer
descriptionHtml:
Werk aan een internationaal platform dat miljoenen gebruikers bedient.

Ben jij een ervaren Full-Stack Developer die graag innovatieve features bouwt voor een wereldwijd platform? Hier krijg je de kans om te werken in een high-performance omgeving waar snelheid, schaalbaarheid en teamwork centraal staan. Het is de ideale plek om code, ideeën en visie tot leven te brengen op grote schaal.


Over de organisatie

Dit is geen doorsnee bedrijf. Het is een internationale scale-up met grote ambities: het bouwen van het grootste printplatform van Europa. Dat vraagt om mensen die willen winnen, snel leren en houden van verandering.

Wat dit uniek maakt voor jou:

  • 🌍 Internationale teams in Rotterdam & andere Europese steden met meer dan 40 nationaliteiten
  • 🚀 Veel groeiruimte – de vrijheid om dingen zelf uit te vogelen
  • 💬 Feedback is daily business – leren van elkaar zit in het DNA
  • 🎯 Echte ownership – vrijheid krijg je als je het waarmaakt
  • 🥗 Eten & sport – dagelijks ontbijt/lunch op kantoor, Urban Sports Club, bootcamp
  • 🎉 Events – maandelijkse Keynotes, HITWeek, seizoensopeningen en een legendarisch kerstfeest 😉


De cultuur voelt als topsport: intens, maar ongelooflijk leerzaam. Het is niet voor iedereen, maar wie dit zoekt, haalt hier het beste uit zichzelf.


Wat maakt deze rol uniek?

  • Je ontwikkelt in de volledige breedte: van backend API’s tot gebruiksvriendelijke front-end features
  • Je werkt met een moderne techstack (Node.js, Vue.js, PHP) in een cloud-native omgeving
  • Je hebt directe invloed op roadmap, UX en technische keuzes
  • Je werkt in een internationale setting met veel creatieve vrijheid


Wat ga je doen?

  • Ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van nieuwe platformfeatures
  • Samenwerken met designers, product owners en andere developers om ideeën tot leven te brengen
  • Meedenken over architectuur, performance en schaalbaarheid
  • Bijdragen aan continue verbetering van processen, tools en codekwaliteit
  • Kennis delen en junior developers coachen


Wat breng jij mee?

  • Ruime ervaring als Full-Stack Developer, met sterke skills in JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js, Vue.js of vergelijkbaar)
  • Ervaring met minimaal één extra programmeertaal (bij voorkeur PHP)
  • Sterke probleemoplossende vaardigheden en een pragmatische aanpak
  • Ervaring in snelle, dynamische omgevingen (scale-up/startup is een pré)
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een teamgerichte instelling


Bonuspunten voor:

  • Ervaring als mentor of technisch leider
  • Ervaring met cloudplatformen (AWS, GCP of Azure)
  • Affiniteit met performance tuning en schaalbare architectuur


Wat krijg je terug?

  • Salaris tot €6.000 per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring
  • Fulltime dienstverband (40 uur) met voorkeur voor 5 dagen per week op kantoor
  • Uitzonderingen: max. 1 dag thuiswerken als je echt ver van de stad woont
  • Dagelijks ontbijt & lunch op kantoor, plus korting bij sportabonnementen
  • 24/7 toegang tot bedrijfsfitness
  • Budget en tijd voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling
  • Werken in een internationale scale-up waar je vrijheid én verantwoordelijkheid krijgt


👉 Klaar om impact te maken in een rol waar techniek en innovatie samenkomen?

Solliciteer direct of neem contact op voor een vertrouwelijk gesprek.

title: Backend Developer
descriptionHtml:
Are you a talented and passionate Backend Developer? Do you have experience designing robust architectures and building scalable backend systems that power modern digital products? If so, OWOW Agency is looking for you to join our dynamic team as a Backend Developer.

About Us

OWOW A.K.A. Omnipresent World of Wizkids is a digital agency that designs and develops web platforms and mobile apps for innovative clients around the globe. We work with a diverse range of organisations, from ambitious startups to industry leaders. At OWOW you will find a team of 30+ Wizkids from various digital disciplines who work together to create meaningful digital experiences.

About Your Role

OWOW is looking for an experienced Backend Developer who understands how to design clean, scalable, and future-proof backend architectures. You will build and maintain the systems that power our apps, websites, and platforms. You enjoy solving complex backend challenges, setting up cloud infrastructure, and implementing real-time communication features. You take ownership of your technical decisions and collaborate closely with designers, frontend developers, and product owners.

Your Experience And Knowledge

  • Minimum of three years of proven experience in backend development.
  • Strong understanding of backend architecture, design patterns, scalability, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with Node.js and frameworks such as NestJS.
  • Hands-on experience with databases such as PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
  • Strong experience designing and building REST APIs.
  • Experience with GraphQL is a plus.
  • Experience with real-time communication technologies (WebSockets or MQTT).
  • AWS knowledge is required. You have hands-on experience setting up or maintaining cloud environments.
  • Experience with CI/CD workflows is a plus.
  • Based in the Netherlands and willing to work from our Eindhoven office (hybrid work policy).
  • Proficient in English or Dutch, spoken and written.
  • Comfortable working in sprints within a multidisciplinary team.

What We Offer You In Return

  • You'll be working with a modern backend stack including Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, GraphQL, and AWS.
  • The OWOW Way of Working (OWOWWOW): Freedom and flexibility in your working hours, work location, and days off.
  • A competitive salary.
  • Pension plan.
  • Potential long-term equity opportunities.
  • Travel and work from home allowance.
  • Hybrid working options.
  • A company laptop.
  • Lots of freedom to take ownership and seize opportunities.
  • Delicious lunch with great colleagues when you're at the office.
  • A health coach for your body and mind.
  • Friday afternoon drinks, team activities, and occasional parties.
  • An awesome office located near Eindhoven Central Station.

Are you the next Wizkid that meets the qualifications? Apply nOWOW and add your resume, motivation, and portfolio!

companyDescription:
Making a difference to society drives us. Truly making an impact with IT. And while we think it's the most normal thing in the world, it does make working for Topicus very, very different. Every day, millions of people use our products. - IT solutions that genuinely benefit healthcare, education, the financial sector and the social domain.

In all the areas where our tech know-how can help, we try to give citizens control, increase their self-reliance and reduce their vulnerability. To this end, we transform complex issues and technology into user-friendly tech platforms and products. 

We do this from Deventer, our hometown, where we are developing our own Topicus Campus, but also from Zwolle, Utrecht, Dodewaard, Groningen, 's Hertogenbosch, Leiden, Wageningen, Gouda and even in Vietnam and Romania. And thanks to over 1,000 'Topicans', a merger with Total Specific Solutions (TSS) and a listing on the TSX, we have the innovative drive and strength to realise our growth ambitions. 

Our aim is to become smarter every day. To get better and to develop our skills. We do this through our Development Compass, the Topicus University, guilds, the coaching pool, the Topicus Technology Master and great events. As we serve multiple markets, we have access to a wealth of knowledge, experience and tools. 

We like sharing our expertise also with people outside our company! Whether it's through our annual developer conference TopiConf, meet-ups, guest lectures or our social content. Check for yourself what our Topicans have to say!

title: Full Stack Software Engineer II
descriptionHtml:
At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you make. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the food you sample. Through our products, partners and people, we can empower everyone to experience the world.

We’re a truly global e-commerce company, with business operations in nearly every country and city on the planet. And we want to make it easy for everyone, anywhere in the world, to pay for their travel or do business with our platform - whenever and however it’s convenient for them.

Do you want to work on a software that impacts millions of customers around the world, solving some of the world's most sophisticated e-commerce challenges? We are looking for talented Full-Stack Engineers to join our Amsterdam HQ.

We are looking for Full-Stack Engineers across multiple teams in our Business Units; Marketplace, ABU and Trips.

More information on the different teams and business units can be found here.

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Design and implement end-to-end product features in collaboration with UX Designers, Data scientists, and other Developers.
  • Evaluating customer needs and coming up with ideal solutions for it, assessing different languages (Perl, Java, Javascript, Python, etc), architecture and risks.
  • Rapidly developing next-generation scalable, flexible, and high-performance systems, with end-to-end ownership by monitoring and adjusting SLIs and SLOs.
  • Continuously learn and apply modern development methodologies and tools
  • Deploy and maintain software in production
  • Proactively propose improvement ideas to reduce technical debt and increase business impact of your team


Qualifications and Skills:

  • 4+ years of experience in a relevant role, preferably in a commercial environment
  • Software development experience working with Java, Python, Scala, Kotlin and Javascript and React framework using modern tools and methodologies.
  • Demonstrable experience with MySQL and PostgreSQL or similar relational databases
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes is a plus.
  • Understanding of modern front end architecture principles and design practices: micro frontend architecture, SSR, SPA, responsive design, progressive enhancement, graceful degradation
  • Knowledge of GraphQL is a plusAbility to write high-performance, reusable code
  • Writing unit and integration tests for the codeExperience with data-driven product development: analytics, A/B testing, etc
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal


Benefits & Perks: Global Impact, Personal Relevance:

  • Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parental (22-weeks paid leave), grandparent, bereavement, and care leave
  • Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, working from home furniture and ergonomic support, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country)
  • A beautiful sustainable HQ Campus in Amsterdam, that offers on-site meals, coffee, and snacks, multi-faith and breastfeeding rooms at the office*
  • Commuting allowance and bike reimbursement scheme
  • Discounts & Wallet credits to spend on our products, upgrade to Booking.com Genius Level 3, and friends & family Booking.com discount vouchers
  • Free access to online learning platforms, development and mentorship programs
  • Global Employee Assistance Program, free Headspace membership


Inclusion at Booking.com:

Inclusion has been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations.

Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It’s a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech.”

We ensure that colleagues with disabilities are provided the adjustments and tools they need to participate in the job application and interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Key Skills

Java

Python

Javascript

React

Pre-Employment Screening

If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.

companySlogan: Making It Easier for Everyone to Experience the World.
companyDescription:
A career at Booking.com is all about the journey, helping you explore new challenges in a place where you can be your best self. With plenty of exciting twists, turns and opportunities along the way. 

We’ve always been pioneers, on a mission to shape the future of travel through cutting edge technology, to make it easier for everyone to enjoy amazing experiences wherever they go. Under a desert sky, or in the heart of a bustling city. Discovering the perfect hideaway, or the perfect paella.

When you join us, you’ll be part of a community where taking a different path and trying something new is celebrated and supported. And where making a difference counts. 

We’re determined to make the world of travel more sustainable, more accessible, and more inclusive, to create a positive impact on a global scale.
That’s why we’re always looking for people who search for better solutions, the ones eager to stray off the beaten path to find new ways of doing things.
Because at Booking.com it’s more than a job, it’s a journey we’re on together.

title: Medior/Senior Frontend Developer
descriptionHtml:
Bij CowManager zoeken we een enthousiaste Medior of Senior Frontend Developer die samen met ons team werkt aan gebruiksvriendelijke en moderne webapplicaties. Jij zorgt ervoor dat boeren wereldwijd eenvoudig en intuïtief inzicht krijgen in de gezondheid en productiviteit van hun koeien.


Je komt terecht in een team met ervaren frontend specialisten, waardoor er veel ruimte is om te leren en door te groeien. We werken met Vue 3, maar ervaring met andere frontend frameworks is ook welkom: als jij de drive hebt om je in Vue te verdiepen, zorgen wij voor de begeleiding en kennisdeling.


Je richt je vooral op de doorontwikkeling van onze webapplicatie. Je werkt nauw samen met UX-designers, backend-developers en testers, waarbij je sparringpartner bent voor designkeuzes en meedenkt over generieke componenten.


Wat ga je doen?


  • Bouwen en onderhouden van intuïtieve en schaalbare webapplicaties.
  • Werken aan herbruikbare UI-componenten en meedenken over frontend-architectuur.
  • Samenwerken met UX-designers om ontwerpen om te zetten naar praktische, toegankelijke oplossingen.
  • Integreren van frontend met bestaande en nieuwe API's.
  • Actief bijdragen in ons agile scrumteam, met ruimte om ideeën en verbeteringen in te brengen.


Over CowManager


Bij CowManager ontwikkelen we innovatieve IoT-oorsensoren die de vitale functies van koeien meten. Deze data wordt via ons geavanceerde managementsysteem vertaald naar waardevolle inzichten over gedrag, waarmee boeren de gezondheid en vruchtbaarheid van hun koeien efficiënt kunnen monitoren. Aan de hand van machine learning modellen berekenen we een verscheidenheid aan meldingen over individuele koeien en de kudde. Onze oplossingen worden wereldwijd toegepast en leveren een belangrijke bijdrage aan een duurzame, efficiënte en diervriendelijke veehouderij.


Wie ben jij?


  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als Frontend Developer in een professionele, agile omgeving.
  • Je hebt ervaring met Vue (must).
  • Je hebt een goed gevoel voor UX en begrijpt hoe je designs vertaalt naar gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met component testing. Je begrijpt de meerwaarde van goed geteste componenten voor houdbaarheid, schaalbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid van de applicatie.
  • Je hebt plezier in teamwork en haalt energie uit technisch overleg.
  • Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technieken en wil jezelf blijven ontwikkelen


Wat bieden wij jou?


  • Een salaris tussen de €4.000 en €6.000 met 8% vakantiegeld.
  • Variabele eindejaarsbonus (tot 10% van het jaarsalaris).
  • Pensioenplan (2/3 CowManager, 1/3 zelf).
  • 25 verlofdagen op basis van 40 uur (met optie om extra dagen bij te kopen).
  • Maandelijkse kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en zakelijke kilometers.

We werken met Vue 3, maar ervaring met andere frontend frameworks is ook welkom: als jij de drive hebt om je in Vue te verdiepen, zorgen wij voor de begeleiding en kennisdeling.Je richt je vooral op de doorontwikkeling van onze webapplicatie. Je werkt nauw samen met UX-designers, backend-developers en testers, waarbij je sparringpartner bent voor designkeuzes en meedenkt over generieke componenten.Wat ga je doen? companyDescription:
Let’s Be Honest

It’s not always easy being a farmer. Keeping your herd healthy, complying with guidelines and being profitable at the same time is a tough job. We understand those challenges. In fact, we were in the middle of them. After four generations of farming, we discovered that farming could be done easier. It had to be done easier. And that’s why, in 1984, our story started. We’ve invented the first ear sensors for cows. And we’ve been frontrunners ever since. 

Today we make sure that you’re always ahead. Prepared for what’s coming. Have all the data you want at hand, at any time. Helping you reach your goals, whatever your ambitions are. And whether you have 20 or 20,000 cows… with our cow monitoring service you’ll have eyes on all of them. 

So let’s go for it and give your cows the best life possible. Share the benefits of our smart data solutions. Challenge us to come up with new necessary developments as well. Say moo to bad results. And let’s do better together.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

We’re looking for Full Stack Software Egineer with strong TypeScript and mobile development skills to join our fully remote team. You’ll lead the charge on building high-impact, scalable mobile applications, collaborating with a global team of engineers, and working within a modern, AI-assisted development workflow.

Send your resume here: service@startchapterone.com

or

apply here: https://eg.indeed.com/job/full-stack-software-engineer-610e60fc5defa9a5

Tech Stack We Love

Core Mobile & Web Stack

  • Mobile: React Native (Expo + bare workflows)
  • Frontend (Web, for cross-collab): React / Next.js
  • Backend: NestJS (Node.js), TypeScript, Prisma (ORM)
  • Database: PostgreSQL
  • API: REST, GraphQL

Also In Use

  • Python (for data processing & AI agents)
  • CI/CD with GitHub Actions

Must-have Tools

  • Cursor IDE (or proven experience with similar AI-assisted development tools)

You’ll

  • Design and develop world-class mobile apps with React Native, ensuring responsiveness, accessibility, and performance.
  • Implement modular, maintainable code using TypeScript.
  • Integrate apps with scalable back-end APIs (NestJS, GraphQL/REST).
  • Optimize mobile performance across platforms (iOS and Android).
  • Collaborate with designers, web engineers, and back-end developers to deliver polished features end-to-end.
  • Contribute to code reviews and CI/CD workflows.

You Have

  • Proven experience shipping React Native apps to production (must provide portfolio or GitHub links).
  • Strong TypeScript knowledge and experience with cross-platform optimization.
  • Familiarity with Next.js or React for web is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of Git workflows and CI/CD best practices.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Minimum 3 years of professional experience.

Application Process

  • Screening call
  • Mandatory: Share your proudest GitHub (or App Store/Play Store) project.
  • Take-home coding task relevant to mobile stack.
  • Live coding session.

Why Join Us?

  • Fully remote role
  • Build cutting-edge mobile apps with modern, AI-assisted workflows
  • Growth-driven, collaborative culture

Job Type: Full-time

Work Location: Remote

title: Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
“Come as you are”

Everyone is welcome here. Diversity & Inclusion are at our core. Far above any technical competence, we value respect, openness, and trusted collaboration. We do not tolerate intolerance.

About The Company

We’re looking for a Medior Full Stack Developer (Frontend-Focused) to join the Hypernode Tech Team. Hypernode is a specialist managed hosting provider with a complete focus on e-commerce. On our hosting platform, we host web shops built with Magento, Shopware, WooCommerce, and Akeneo among others. We collaborate extensively with website builders and developers to provide top-notch hosting solutions for their shops. We are the market leader in the Benelux region, and our growth ambitions now extend far beyond. Hypernode is part of team.blue, a leading digital enabler for companies and entrepreneurs, serving over 3.3 million customers in 22 countries, supported by 3600+ colleagues across Europe.

What Your Day Looks Like

You’ll be part of an agile team, building, improving, and maintaining Hypernode’s service offering. We value code quality, write automated tests (unit and integration), perform code reviews as standard, and follow continuous delivery practices.

Together with your colleagues you will work on diverse projects such as:

  • The Hypernode Control Panel for managed hosting.
  • Internal and external APIs and client libraries.
  • Our automation engine.
  • The popular Magento security tool MageReport.
  • Various other web services that are written in Python and Django.
  • You’ll collaborate closely with a motivated development team and stakeholders across technical, commercial, product, and operational areas, all with the goal of delivering the best possible services for our customers.


What You’ll Need

You are a software developer with a passion for modern web technology and have a drive to solve real problems for users in the web hosting and e-commerce space.

Quality and maintainability are non-negotiable for you, and you bring creative thinking to complex challenges that span multiple systems. You’re excited to work across the full stack and are not afraid of getting your hands dirty digging all the way down the stack from building web applications to interacting with servers on the system level. You thrive on and enjoy understanding how everything fits together.

Your profile

  • Professional experience with Python or Django.
  • Experience with JavaScript and CSS.
  • Experience with version control workflows (we use Git & GitLab).
  • Experience designing, building, and integrating APIs.
  • Interest in modern web development and the ever-evolving front-end landscape.
  • Understanding of browser concepts on a deep level (web vitals, web profiling and page rendering).
  • Capable of reasoning about complex systems and interconnected (micro) services.
  • Familiar with concepts related to servers and Linux, clusters, domain registration and SSL.
  • Able to debug and troubleshoot across the full stack (frontend, backend, server).
  • You are willing to participate in a rotating on-call schedule.
  • Great communication skills (our team language is English).


Our tech stack

Our core stack includes Python, Django, React/Vue, and Linux (Debian), but we utilize a variety of other technologies as well. We’re constantly evolving our platform, and you’ll have the opportunity to influence our technical direction and help shape the tools we use.

Nice to have

  • Eager to learn about the domains and technologies involved at Hypernode.
  • Bonus points for experience with Typescript, React/Vue, Tailwind.
  • Bonus points for experience with Adobe Commerce / Magento.
  • Knowledge of Scrum.


What We Offer

Join a high-impact team where your ideas shape real outcomes. At Hypernode, you’ll enjoy the agility and close-knit culture of a small team, backed by the resources, stability, and opportunities that come with being part of team.blue.

Practicalities

Language: English is our primary language in tech. Dutch is a plus, but not a requirement.

Location: Arnhem based with flexible hybrid working options for those based in the Netherlands. Candidates based outside the Netherlands will be working remotely.

Start Date: As soon as possible

title: Full Stack Developer - JS/TS node.js
descriptionHtml:
Over the Company


M-Cube is a leading company in In-Store Digital Engagement solutions, offering an extensive portfolio of solutions that range from in-store radio to digital signage, interactivity and mobile apps. M-Cube develops innovative digital solutions to improve service, engagement, customer retention and communication within the retail industry.


M-Cube, established in 2001, during the years expanded its range of services with the aim of creating increasingly personalized customer journeys by bringing the advantages of the online world into the physical store.


With offices in Italy, United Kingdom, France, Belgium, The Netherlands, Germany, Spain, China and Hong Kong, an operational branch in New York and a consolidated network of global partners, M-Cube currently manages over 50,000 installations around the world for over 400 brands in the Fashion & Luxury, Retail, Finance & Insurance, QSR, Grocery Retail and Automotive sectors.


The Job

For our branch M-Cube NL we are seeking a talented and driven Full Stack Developer to join our growing product development team. As a key member, you will help design, build, and optimize the software that powers our digital signage solutions. You will collaborate with product managers, UX/UI designers, and fellow developers to deliver reliable and scalable applications.


Main responsibilities

  • Develop robust, maintainable, and scalable applications using TypeScript across the stack.
  • Design and consume APIs to enable smooth connectivity between front-end and back-end systems.
  • Collaborate effectively with team members to solve complex technical challenges and deliver high-quality features.
  • Contribute to technical discussions and architectural decisions, sharing your curiosity and insights.
  • Write clean, well-documented code and participate in code reviews.
  • Troubleshoot, test, and maintain the core product software to ensure strong optimization and functionality.
  • Remain up-to-date with the latest industry trends and best practices.


Essential Skills

  • Proficiency in TypeScript (Node.js and/or client-side frameworks such as React/Vue/Angular).
  • Experience with both front-end and back-end development.
  • Curiosity and willingness to experiment with new technologies and solutions.
  • Excellent teamwork and communication skills; ability to collaborate in a multicultural environment.


Desirable Skills

  • Strong time-management skills and the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Analytical mindset with the capacity to assess information and make informed decisions.
  • Innovation-oriented attitude, contributing fresh ideas and creative solutions.
  • Results-driven approach, consistently working toward achieving set goals.


Our offer

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge digital signage projects for a global audience.
  • Collaborative, innovative, and supportive international team culture.
  • Continuous learning and personal development.
  • Flexible work arrangements.


Salary range

€45.000 - €55.000


Worksite

Amsterdam Oost

title: Front-end ontwikkelaar
descriptionHtml:
Omschrijving

DJI heeft binnen de Strafrechtketen de uitvoerende verantwoordelijkheid op basis van de gegevens die zij daarvoor van het Centraal Justitieel Incasso Bureau (CJIB) heeft aangeleverd gekregen. Het project Digitaliseren Strafrechtketen heeft een koppelvlak gerealiseerd om met elektronisch berichtenverkeer de gegevensuitwisseling tussen het CJIB en DJI te structureren. Binnen dat reeds bestaande koppelvlak is er voor DJI een heel specifieke inrichting met TOPdesk gemaakt die op dit moment de Front-end heeft voor de eindgebruikers. Die TOPdesk inrichting is echter zeer complex, er zijn voor eindgebruikers concessies gedaan omdat TOPdesk beperkingen heeft en de TOPdesk inrichting dus niet optimaal kan aansluiten op de gebruikerswensen.

De doelstelling van de nieuwe front-end is om een betere "user experience" te kunnen realiseren en tevens bepaalde veldvalidaties in te bouwen. In technische zin moet de nieuwe front-end gekoppeld worden aan de bestaande backend van TOPdesk door met de bestaande API-services van TOPdesk de gegevens vanuit de TOPdesk registers op te halen naar de nieuwe front-end en na gegevensupdate ook weer weg te schrijven.

Je bent als Front-end ontwikkelaar lid van het projectteam voor het project Digitaliseren Strafrechtketen een bestaand onderdeel (TOPdesk) van een keten-systeem-inrichting een nieuwe front-end moet ontwikkelen

Hiervoor is reeds een ontwerp op hoofdlijnen beschikbaar die je als een werkende nieuwe Front-end op die TOPdesk inrichting moet maken.

Je stemt hiervoor af met de business analisten van het projectteam, functioneel beheer van TOPdesk en de testers binnen het projectteam. Als projectteam werken we vooral online samen en komen we in ieder geval 1 dag in de week in Den Haag samen.

Afstemming met de beheerorganisatie is in voorkomende gevallen ook in Den Haag.

Functiecriteria

  • Kandidaat is minimaal in het bezit van een HBO diploma
  • 2 jaar Kandidaat heeft tenminste 2 jaar ervaring met front-end ontwikkeling met Vue.JS en Bootstrap
  • 1 jaar Kandidaat heeft tenminste 1 jaar ervaring met API koppelingen toegepast in een front-end

Functiewensen

  • Je beschikt over een goede teamspirit. Je hebt zelfvertrouwen, doorzettingsvermogen en overtuigingskracht.
  • Je bent flexibel, hebt een proactieve instelling en bent klantgericht.
  • Je bent goed in de verbinding leggen tussen klantwensen en ICT realisatie.
  • Je hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands, zowel in woord als geschrift.
  • Je hebt ervaring met JIRA en het werken in scrum teams.
  • Je hebt kennis van en ervaring met TOPdesk
  • Kennis van en aantoonbare ervaring in de strafrechtketen
  • Je bent van onbesproken gedrag en kunt zonder problemen een Verklaring omtrent gedrag (VOG) krijgen

Inzetgegevens

26-01-2026 tm 25-07-2026 met optie verlenging

36 uur per week

Den Haag

ZZP: NEE

Stuur ons uiterlijk 19 januari 2026, voor 17:00 uur jouw NL CV in Word, motivatie, beschikbaarheid en uurtarief.

title: Senior Casual Game Developer (web-tech, remote, full time)
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior Web Developer who will contribute to the entire lifecycle of HTML5 casual game development - from inception to live maintenance. As a key player, you'll champion the delivery of top-notch products, becoming an integral part of an agile, multidisciplinary, and creatively charged game development team.

About CoolGames

At CoolGames, we're proud to be a leading international HTML5 game studio, working with some of the world's biggest ‘Big Tech' game platforms, such as Netflix, Discord, Facebook and Microsoft Play. We also work with famous games IP such as Battleship, Angry Birds and Monopoly.

CoolGames is part of Keesing, the world's largest Braintainment company. Keesing is a financially strong publisher of engaging sudokus, crosswords and many other puzzles & games with a presence in over 20 countries headquartered in The Netherlands.

With the CoolGames HQ in Amsterdam, supported by our global remote teams, we offer market-competitive salaries, the chance to contribute to successful casual games that are played by millions and work directly with some of the biggest brands in the world. We believe in creativity, collaboration and delivering world-class gaming experiences, while giving you the choice to either join our Amsterdam studio or become part of our remote teams.

If you want to grow your career in a profitable, internationally recognized company, work closely with world-famous partners and be part of a highly professional international team - CoolGames is the right place for you.

About The Role

As a Game Developer at CoolGames, you take responsibility for delivering high quality products. Your teamwork will be fundamental to the success of the products you work on.

You will be part of a multidisciplinary development team collaborating with game designers, game artists, quality assurance engineers, and fellow game developers. You work on developing new titles, evolving existing games, as well as contributing to the maintenance and evolving our internal tooling.

You are adept at managing your time and productivity with the goal to deliver robust code while meeting established deadlines.

Next to working on features for our games your responsibilities include optimisation, debugging, fixing bugs, performing code reviews, reviewing requirements, working on platform compatibility and ensuring our games remain stable and performant.

Requirements

About You

You are proactive and thrive on taking ownership and responsibility. You write clean, readable and maintainable code. Sharing your skills and experience with the team is something you have consistently been praised for. You are open to feedback and eager to learn. You embrace collaboration and have a "you can count on me" attitude. You flourish in an environment where teamwork and communication are important.

The right candidate meets most of the following requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience programming professionally;
  • Solid knowledge of development best practices;
  • Knows how to strike a balance between speed and quality;
  • Estimations are consistently on point
  • Proactively communicates and mitigates technical risk;
  • Excellent at contributing to technical design & technical decision making;
  • Understands the commercial reality of casual games;
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum development practices;
  • Experience with version control tools like git;
  • Experience with web game tech (e.g. PIXI/Phaser/Three.js);
  • Experience with HTML5 games, Typescript and JavaScript is a plus;

Benefits

What we can offer you

  • An international team of 50+ professionals from almost 20 different countries;
  • Work closely with some of the biggest (upcoming) game platforms in the world on high-quality casual games that are played by millions of gamers;
  • Competitive remuneration;
  • A flexible remote working environment;
  • A very open, informal and international company culture where everyone can make a difference.

title: Full Stack Developer, Integrations
descriptionHtml:
Teifi Digital, a Shopify Plus Platinum partner, excels in resolving complex e-commerce challenges. We focus on integrating large catalogs, sophisticated data frameworks, and legacy systems into seamless unified commerce and B2B solutions, delivering unparalleled customer experiences. Our skill in deploying Shopify Plus caters to top-tier merchants in manufacturing, parts, distribution, retail, and B2B, ensuring minimal technical debt and maximized e-commerce revenue.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Full Stack Developer with expertise in web and Shopify app development. In this role, you will build custom microservices, private apps, and integrations for our clients, as well as contribute to the development of Teifi Labs products. You will be responsible for back-end development using TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, GraphQL, and REST APIs, while also contributing to front-end work using React where necessary.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop custom Shopify apps, microservices, and integrations using TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, and REST APIs.
  • Build and maintain scalable backend architectures that integrate seamlessly with Shopify and third-party services.
  • Implement and manage integrations with external systems like ERPs, WMS, and POS, ensuring smooth data flow and functionality.
  • Work on front-end projects where necessary, utilizing React and the Shopify Polaris component library to build user-friendly interfaces.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, particularly in app integrations and customizations for Shopify Plus clients.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including designers, developers, and product managers, to deliver tailored solutions.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of our development processes and app infrastructure.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation, including technical specifications and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Full Stack Developer, with a focus on building microservices and Shopify apps.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, GraphQL, and REST APIs.
  • Experience working with front-end technologies, particularly React, Remix, HTML, and Tailwind/CSS.
  • In-depth knowledge of Shopify's architecture, APIs, and app ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and agile development methodologies.
  • Experience integrating third-party services such as ERPs, WMS, and POS systems with Shopify.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail in building scalable, secure applications.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team in a remote/hybrid environment.

Benefits & Perks

  • Ongoing professional development through training programs, certifications, and peer mentorship
  • Hybrid work model depending on role, with a Granville Island office and free on-site parking
  • Flexibility in work hours designed to accommodate appointments and personal responsibilities
  • Comprehensive health and dental coverage in Canada, plus a health spending account
  • Paid office closure between Christmas and New Year’s
  • Regular team culture events, stocked office snacks, and a dog friendly workplace
  • Performance based bonus opportunities for full-time employees

The Pay Range For This Role Is

100,000 - 120,000 CAD per year(Vancouver)

title: Medior/Senior Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to work in a dynamic environment where your code really makes a difference? Are you a passionate developer who enjoys tackling complex technical challenges?

Join Momo Medical’s Interface Innovators team and build the internal tools that boost caregivers' experience and reduce bottlenecks for the company’s growth. Your code will streamline operations for production, support, and logistics teams serving nursing homes across Europe and North America.

Who is Momo?

Momo Medical is a fast-growing and ambitious scale-up, tackling one of the biggest societal challenges: the future of elderly care. Over the next decade, demand for care is expected to double, while 30% of the current workforce is projected to retire. Our innovative solutions aim to reduce the pressure on healthcare workers while improving the quality of care for residents.

The most valuable aspects of the role

🚀 Your code helps improve the internal operation of a rapidly growing international company.

⚓ Work together with many teams, such as production, customer success, and hardware, to translate real-world problems into reliable software.

💛 You contribute to better care for nursing home residents and help reduce the workload for healthcare professionals.

📍 You’re available 32 - 40 hours per week and happy to spend at least 4 days per week with the team in Delft.

🎊 Thursday pizza nights, Friday drinks, team activities, travel allowance, pension plan, and plenty of growth opportunities that match your ambitions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As part of a multidisciplinary team, often several teams at once, you will work on innovative solutions that have a direct impact on healthcare professionals in the Netherlands and abroad. You will have the opportunity to develop your skills, specialize or grow into a team leader role. You can work on the front-end or the back-end, or even better: both!

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Design, build, and maintain TypeScript services and React apps that power internal operations.
  • Work together with production, customer success, and hardware teams to translate real-world problems into reliable software.
  • Automate manual workflows and improve reliability through observability, testing, and CI/CD.
  • Mentor teammates, set technical direction, and help prioritize the roadmap.


Who are you?

  • You have an advanced skillset of React, Node, and TypeScript backed by a track record of delivering full-stack features end-to-end in fast-paced environments.
  • You validate your features with automated tests, using tools like Jest and Cucumber to keep the experience reliable.
  • You’re comfortable modelling data and tuning performance in relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
  • A good level of English is required, and it is a plus if you can speak Dutch.
  • You enjoy collaborating with colleagues across the company and keeping multiple initiatives moving forward.
  • You’re available 32–40 hours per week and happy to spend at least four days a week with the team in Delft.


Why join Momo Medical?

Because you want to make a difference in healthcare at home and abroad. Because you are excited about a fast-growing scale-up where no two days are the same. And because you want to work with young, enthusiastic and talented international colleagues who all work hard to make healthcare a little bit better every day.

  • Salary: €4,000–5,000 (medior) or €5,000–6,000 (senior) per month based on 40 hours, plus 8% holiday allowance.
  • 30 vacation days per year - including public holidays (celebrate Christmas, Eid Al-Fitr, or any other holiday of your choice!).
  • Hybrid working, and a laptop of your choice.
  • Pension plan and travel reimbursement
  • Guided mentorship and clear paths toward tech lead or specialist roles.
  • Provided lunches, weekly company drinks and dinners, and regular team and company events.
  • Reimbursement of travel expenses and a pension plan


Good to know

Tech at Momo

At Momo, we use the following tools: JavaScript, React, TypeScript, Express, Jest, Node, PostgreSQL, Docker, GitHub, and AWS.

What are the next steps?

First, we’ll review your CV and motivation to get a sense of how you are and to envision how you might fit within our team. After that, you’ll receive a short take-home assignment that helps us understand how you think, and you get insights into the kind of work we do at Momo. The next step is a chat at our offices in Delft, where we can go more in-depth on the role, the team and the Momo culture. Then, as a final exploration, you’ll have the chance to spend a work-along day with us to experience a day at Momo and to meet more people working on the same mission. When both you and we see the match, we’ll share an offer and start the onboarding process so you can join us in supporting caregivers!

title: Front End Engineer/Developer
companyName: Jobs In Cyprus - Job Portal in Cyprus
descriptionHtml:
Job Detail

  • Job ID 25875

Overview

Job Description

Placement Type

Temporary

Salary

$55-75 Hourly

Start Date

Jan 19, 2026

We are looking for a Front End Engineer to join our distributed product team. In this role, you will be responsible for building the “face” of our applications, ensuring a seamless, high-performance, and accessible experience for all users.

As a remote-first organization, we value clear communication, self-motivation, and the ability to collaborate asynchronously. While this is a remote position, candidates must be able to work Eastern Standard Time (EST) core hours to facilitate real-time collaboration with our product and design teams.

Core Responsibilities

  • UI/UX Implementation: Translate high-fidelity Figma designs and wireframes into clean, semantic, and responsive code.
  • Feature Development: Build and maintain scalable, reusable components using modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Vue, or Next.js).
  • Performance Optimization: Audit and improve web performance (Core Web Vitals) to ensure lightning-fast load times and smooth interactions.
  • API Integration: Collaborate with Backend Engineers to integrate RESTful or GraphQL APIs and manage application state effectively.
  • Accessibility (a11y): Ensure all features meet WCAG 2.2/3.0 compliance standards, making our platform inclusive for all users.
  • Code Quality: Participate in peer code reviews, write unit/integration tests (Jest, Cypress, or Playwright), and maintain technical documentation.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product Managers and Designers to advocate for technical feasibility and user-centric solutions.

Requirements

  • Experience: 3+ years of professional experience in front-end development (Mid to Senior level).
  • Tech Stack: Mastery of JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and CSS3 (Tailwind, SCSS, or Styled Components).
  • Frameworks: Proficiency in React 18/19 or Next.js.
  • Tooling: Experience with modern build tools (Vite, Webpack) and version control (Git).
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, essential for a remote environment.
  • Schedule: Ability to maintain a consistent 9-to-5 schedule within the EST time zone.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor).
  • Familiarity with Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Static Site Generation (SSG).
  • Prior experience working in a fully remote, Agile/Scrum environment.
  • Knowledge of mobile-first development and Progressive Web Apps (PWAs).

The target hiring compensation range for this role is $55 to $75. Compensation is based on several factors including, but not limited to education, relevant work experience, relevant certifications, and location.

About Aquent Talent

Aquent Talent connects the best talent in marketing, creative, and design with the world’s biggest brands.

Our eligible talent get access to amazing benefits like subsidized health, vision, and dental plans, paid sick leave, and retirement plans with a match. We also offer free online training through Aquent Gymnasium. More information on our awesome benefits!

Aquent is an equal-opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics. We’re about creating an inclusive environment—one where different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are valued, and everyone can contribute, grow their careers, and thrive.

title: Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Over de functie

Als Full Stack Developer word je onderdeel van een team van ontwikkelaars en werk je nauw samen aan uiteenlopende projecten. Je krijgt de kans om jouw creativiteit en technische vaardigheden in te zetten om tastbare innovaties en verbeteringen te realiseren voor toonaangevende Nederlandse bedrijven. Of je nu werkt aan het verbeteren van de prestaties, het optimaliseren van de toegankelijkheid of het verhogen van de zichtbaarheid van applicaties, jouw expertise is onmisbaar in het leveren van impactvolle oplossingen.

Het team waarin je terechtkomt bestaat uit specialisten in applicatie- en softwareontwikkeling. Intern zorgen deze mensen ervoor dat systemen naadloos integreren, met het bedrijfsdoel voor ogen. Jij bent op intern vlak verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, coderen en testen van nieuwe functionaliteiten, terwijl je technische problemen oplost, prestaties optimaliseert en documentatie nauwkeurig bijhoudt. Je blijft op de hoogte van de nieuwste trends in design en technologie en combineert deze kennis met een oplossingsgerichte aanpak. Daarnaast werk je intensief samen met andere teams en houd je scherp toezicht op elk detail, zodat jouw oplossingen consistent voldoen aan de hoge kwaliteitsnormen van het bedrijf.

Jouw kwaliteiten

We zoeken een gedreven professional die een sleutelrol wil spelen in de groei van zowel deze organisatie als de klanten. Jij bent iemand die graag uitdagingen aangaat en met enthousiasme bijdraagt aan digitale transformatie en technologische vooruitgang. Bij deze werkgever krijg je de kans om je vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen in een hecht en samenwerkend team, waarbij je werkt aan projecten die echt impact maken. Als je jezelf herkent in (de meeste van) onderstaande kwalificaties, kijken we uit naar jouw sollicitatie!

Je beschikt over;

  • Een afgeronde bacheloropleiding;
  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring als Full Stack Developer of in een vergelijkbare functie;
  • Een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal;
  • Kennis en ervaring met Java en/of C#, HTML, CSS en Angular en/of React;
  • Een beschikbaarheid van 32 tot 40 uur per week.



De voordelen

Bij deze werkgever krijg je volop vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid, met ruimte voor jouw ideeën en inbreng. Jouw stem wordt gewaardeerd en je wordt actief betrokken bij belangrijke keuzes en oplossingen. Samen met een team van hoogopgeleide professionals werk je aan projecten voor de meest vooraanstaande bedrijven in Europa in uiteenlopende sectoren. Dit maakt je werk interessant en leerzaam.

De arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn voor elke werknemer goed geregeld. Reken als Full Stack Developer onder andere op;

  • Een salaris tussen de €3.000,- en €6.500,-;
  • Een mobiliteitsbudget dat je kunt gebruiken voor een leaseauto of je eigen vervoer;
  • Flex benefit budget en collectieve regelingen;
  • Laptop naar keuze, een telefoon en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek;
  • Teambuilding, games, evenementen en meer;
  • Een flexibele werkomgeving waarin je zelf je tijd en plaats kan bepalen.



Leer de organisatie kennen

Onze opdrachtgever is een toonaangevende aanbieder van digitale oplossingen. Met duizenden toegewijde medewerkers (verdeeld over kantoren in meer dan 30 landen) ondersteunen ze klanten wereldwijd bij het realiseren van digitale transformaties binnen hun bedrijven. De overtuiging van deze organisatie? Technologie is slechts een hulpmiddel; het zijn mensen die echte verandering mogelijk maken. Daarom zetten ze klanten en medewerkers centraal in alles wat ze doen en stimuleren ze zowel zelfstandigheid als samenwerking om het beste uit iedereen te halen.

Werken bij deze organisatie betekent volop kansen om je carrière te ontwikkelen, zowel in Nederland als internationaal. Je wordt onderdeel van een groot netwerk van professionals die in verschillende fasen van hun loopbaan zitten. Dit zorgt voor een inspirerende werkomgeving en geeft je de mogelijkheid om diverse contacten op te doen tijdens je werk.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Hey there! 👋 Ready to Shape the Future of Digital Banking? At DevOptix, we build scalable, high-performance software for some of the largest banks and financial institutions in the Netherlands. We are looking for a Senior Java Engineer to join our team and work on cutting-edge banking solutions.


Tasks

  • Build Scalable Systems – Design, develop, and maintain high-quality Java and Kotlin applications and services that go beyond client expectations and set new industry benchmarks.

  • Collaborate & Innovate – Work closely with cross-functional teams to craft cutting-edge solutions that prioritize performance, scalability, and long-term maintainability using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles.

  • Work with Modern Architectures – Develop microservices and RESTful APIs using frameworks like Spring, ensuring robust and efficient systems that drive real business impact.

  • Streaming & Observability – Implement real-time data processing with Kafka and ensure system reliability through monitoring and logging with ELK Stack and Grafana.

  • Cloud & Orchestration – Deploy and manage applications in cloud environments (AWS, Azure) using Kubernetes and OpenShift to ensure high availability and scalability.

  • Optimize & Enhance – Continuously improve existing systems, refactoring and optimizing for performance while following modern development best practices.

  • Shape the Future – Participate in architectural discussions, designing future-proof solutions that keep our clients at the forefront of the industry.

  • Engage with Clients – Partner directly with clients to understand their needs, offer expert technical guidance, and deliver meaningful, results-driven solutions.

  • Share & Grow – Contribute to technical documentation, mentor teammates, and help drive a culture of continuous learning and innovation.


Requirements

You are a motivated and experienced professional who thrives on solving complex problems and contributing to impactful projects. You have:



  • 8+ years of hands-on professional experience in Java development, with a strong understanding of object-oriented principles and design patterns.

  • Proficiency in Kotlin is a strong plus, as we increasingly leverage it for modern service development.

  • Expertise in the Spring ecosystem, microservices architecture, and RESTful APIs.

  • Strong experience with Kafka for event-driven architectures.

  • Deep understanding of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and its application in complex business domains.

  • Experience with Kubernetes and OpenShift for container orchestration.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, specifically AWS and Azure, along with Azure DevOps for CI/CD.

  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.

  • A passion for exploring emerging technologies and applying them to real-world challenges.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and strong interpersonal communication abilities in English.


We will be extra happy if you have:



  • AI & Generative AI Interest – Hands-on experience or a passion for exploring emerging technologies, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Spring AI, or API-based LLMs is a plus.

  • Dutch Language Journey – While English is our primary working language, speaking Dutch is important for our long-term success in the local market. We hope all our consultants reach a B2 level of Dutch. If you are on your Dutch journey, we are happy to support you with training and certification up to B2 level.

  • Industry Experience – Prior experience in banking, financial services, telecommunications, or similar industries.

  • Knowledge Sharing – A passion for writing technical blogs, public speaking, open source or to contribute to the tech community in another way.

  • Educational Background – A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.


Benefits

  • Competitive Salary and Benefits – We have a transparent rewards structure with clear career growth opportunities.

  • Language Support – We are committed to your growth. If you're looking to improve your Dutch, we'll cover training and certification costs to help you reach B2 level.

  • Relocation and Sponsorship – We provide visa sponsorship and relocation assistance, helping you settle smoothly into the Netherlands.

  • Generative AI Experimentation – Be part of a forward-thinking team exploring the latest advancements in AI and its real-world applications.

  • Challenging Projects – Work on impactful, cutting-edge projects for top-tier clients in banking, telecommunications, and e-commerce.

  • Professional Growth – Access annual educational budgets, conferences, and continuous learning opportunities to sharpen your skills.

  • A Collaborative Environment – Join a talented, driven team that values innovation, excellence, and knowledge sharing.


Your expertise matters. Join us at DevOptix and help create next generation solutions!
