companySlogan: Fewer surprises. Stronger teams. Real impact.
companyDescription:
Hiring individual engineers is easy, getting real software outcomes is hard.

DevOptix is a software consultancy led by engineers. We help companies modernise systems, build new products, and stabilise their delivery by putting the right expertise in the right place. Sometimes this involves a senior engineer contributing specialist expertise to support delivery within a defined scope of work, other times it calls for a delivery team that carries the outcome from start to finish.

Our focus is simple
• Modernisation that cleans up legacy instead of adding more complexity
• Cloud and platform engineering that is stable, observable, and cost aware
• Integration and APIs that make systems work together instead of fighting each other
• Applied AI where it actually moves the needle for the business

Many of our consultants come from South Africa. They bring a strong work ethic, solid engineering skills, and an easy cultural fit because they speak English and Afrikaans and learn Dutch quickly.

DevOptix is SNA certified (NEN 4400-1). That means our clients and partners can rely on compliant, transparent, and professional operations behind the scenes, not only on strong engineers on site.

Today we work with larger organisations through partner networks on complex engineering challenges, while increasingly focusing on SMEs that want a partner who takes ownership of delivery.

If you need help modernising your software, moving to the cloud, or strengthening your engineering capability, reach out.

We are always open to conversations with
• SMEs that want a serious engineering partner
• Partners who value reliable consultants and smooth collaboration
• Senior engineers who want to do meaningful work in the Netherlands and beyond

title: PHP Developer
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een PHP Developer die energie krijgt van het bouwen aan schaalbare back-end systemen en apps die écht impact maken? Je werkt aan de toekomst van mobiliteit voor meer dan een miljoen reizigers. Je schrijft code die niet alleen werkt, maar het verschil maakt in de gebruikerservaring. We zitten midden in een transformatie: van silo’s naar domeinen, van on-prem naar cloud. Dat betekent dat je niet in een vast stramien stapt, maar actief meebouwt aan de toekomst. Bij ons is geen dag hetzelfde – en dat is precies wat het leuk maakt.

Wil jij werken bij een inclusieve, dynamische organisatie waar je echt het verschil kunt maken? Bij Mobility Invest Group draait alles om samen doen, betrouwbaar, verbeteren. Je komt terecht in een snelgroeiende organisatie waar jouw ideeën écht gehoord worden en je de ruimte krijgt om te leren en impact te maken – of je nu ervaren bent of net begint. We zijn een erkend inclusief werkgever in Amersfoort: bij ons is iedereen welkom, ongeacht je achtergrond.

Wij bieden jou!

  • Een salaris van €4.000 tot €6.000 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;
  • Dagelijks een verzorgde lunch, een eigen grand café met wekelijkse borrels, leuke teamuitjes en personeelsfeesten;
  • Een fijne werkomgeving op loopafstand van het centrum en station van Amersfoort;
  • Vitaliteit op de werkvloer: stoelmassages, een voetbal- en padelteam, en nog veel meer;
  • Nog meer goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een premievrij pensioen, een zakelijk ov-reiskaart (tweede klas), fietsvergoeding en opleidingsbudget om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen;
  • Een open werkomgeving waarin samenwerken, humor en elkaar helpen vanzelfsprekend zijn;
  • Een werkwijze gebaseerd op vertrouwen: je hebt veel flexibiliteit en ruime mogelijkheden om ook vanuit huis te werken;
  • Een informele organisatie waar je je welkom voelt. Wij geloven dat de kracht van diversiteit en inclusiviteit de kwaliteit van ons werk verhoogt.


Wat ga je doen?

  • Ontwikkelen van schaalbare en veilige back-end services in PHP (met moderne patterns en libraries);
  • Samenwerken in domeingerichte teams die van idee tot productie verantwoordelijkheid dragen;
  • Meebouwen aan een architectuur die Flexible by Design en Stable & Secure is;
  • Werken aan features die direct impact hebben: van transacties tot mobiliteitsdiensten;
  • Kwaliteit bewaken door middel van testing, code reviews en CI/CD;
  • Bijdragen aan innovaties: we moedigen experimenten en sidequests aan.


Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt een MBO- of HBO-werk en denkniveau;
  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met PHP en moderne ontwikkelpraktijken;
  • Je hebt kennis van REST/GraphQL API’s, databases (Postgres, MySQL) en OTAP/CI/CD pipelines;
  • Je bent 32 tot 40 uur beschikbaar;
  • Je bent het liefst woonachtig in de regio Amersfoort of reist binnen ongeveer 30 minuten naar kantoor;
  • Je hebt affiniteit met domeingericht werken en agile/scrum;
  • Je voelt je verantwoordelijk voor kwaliteit én continuïteit;
  • Je bent leergierigheid: skills kun je leren, mindset breng je zelf mee.


Meer over ons:

Mobility Invest Group (MIG) integreert alle vormen van duurzame mobiliteit (OV, elektrische auto, -step, -scooter en deelfiets etc.) tot één duurzame en creatieve oplossing. Dat doen wij door alle vormen van mobiliteit op een app en/of op een pas beschikbaar te stellen voor de zakelijke markt. Ook richten wij ons op duurzame CO2 mobiliteitsvraagstukken, gedragsverandering, het sociale domein, de consument en het vereenvoudigen van rittenregistratie en declaraties voor de klant en zijn werknemer.

Onder de Mobility Invest Group vallen een aantal (internationale) merklabels waaronder; Reisbalans, Dumoco, Dumoco International, WijMobiel en Ottimo.

Werk jij mee aan onze ‘way-to-zero’ voor 1 miljoen mensen?

We zien je CV en motivatie graag tegemoet! Solliciteer eenvoudig via onderstaande button.

Heb je vragen over deze vacature of wil je even sparren? Neem gerust contact op met Romy via romy.vanessen@mobiliteitsfabriek.nl of bel naar +31 6 23 28 17 86. Ze helpt je graag verder!

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

Je komt terecht in een snelgroeiende organisatie waar jouw ideeën écht gehoord worden en je de ruimte krijgt om te leren en impact te maken – of je nu ervaren bent of net begint. We zijn een erkend inclusief werkgever in Amersfoort: bij ons is iedereen welkom, ongeacht je achtergrond.Wij bieden jou!Een salaris van €4.000 tot €6.000 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;Dagelijks een verzorgde lunch, een eigen grand café met wekelijkse borrels, leuke teamuitjes en personeelsfeesten;Een fijne werkomgeving op loopafstand van het centrum en station van Amersfoort;Vitaliteit op de werkvloer: stoelmassages, een voetbal- en padelteam, en nog veel meer;Nog meer goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een premievrij pensioen, een zakelijk ov-reiskaart (tweede klas), fietsvergoeding en opleidingsbudget om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen;Een open werkomgeving waarin samenwerken, humor en elkaar helpen vanzelfsprekend zijn;Een werkwijze gebaseerd op vertrouwen: je hebt veel flexibiliteit en ruime mogelijkheden om ook vanuit huis te werken;Een informele organisatie waar je je welkom voelt. Wij geloven dat de kracht van diversiteit en inclusiviteit de kwaliteit van ons werk verhoogt.Wat ga je doen?Ontwikkelen van schaalbare en veilige back-end services in PHP (met moderne patterns en libraries);Samenwerken in domeingerichte teams die van idee tot productie verantwoordelijkheid dragen;Meebouwen aan een architectuur die Flexible by Design en Stable & Secure is;Werken aan features die direct impact hebben: van transacties tot mobiliteitsdiensten;Kwaliteit bewaken door middel van testing, code reviews en CI/CD;Bijdragen aan innovaties: we moedigen experimenten en sidequests aan.Wie ben jij?Je hebt een MBO- of HBO-werk en denkniveau;Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met PHP en moderne ontwikkelpraktijken;Je hebt kennis van REST/GraphQL API’s, databases (Postgres, MySQL) en OTAP/CI/CD pipelines;Je bent 32 tot 40 uur beschikbaar;Je bent het liefst woonachtig in de regio Amersfoort of reist binnen ongeveer 30 minuten naar kantoor;Je hebt affiniteit met domeingericht werken en agile/scrum;Je voelt je verantwoordelijk voor kwaliteit én continuïteit;Je bent leergierigheid: skills kun je leren, mindset breng je zelf mee.Meer over ons:Mobility Invest Group (MIG) integreert alle vormen van duurzame mobiliteit (OV, elektrische auto, -step, -scooter en deelfiets etc.) tot één duurzame en creatieve oplossing. Dat doen wij door alle vormen van mobiliteit op een app en/of op een pas beschikbaar te stellen voor de zakelijke markt. Ook richten wij ons op duurzame CO2 mobiliteitsvraagstukken, gedragsverandering, het sociale domein, de consument en het vereenvoudigen van rittenregistratie en declaraties voor de klant en zijn werknemer.Onder de Mobility Invest Group vallen een aantal (internationale) merklabels waaronder; Reisbalans, Dumoco, Dumoco International, WijMobiel en Ottimo.Werk jij mee aan onze ‘way-to-zero’ voor 1 miljoen mensen?We zien je CV en motivatie graag tegemoet! Solliciteer eenvoudig via onderstaande button.Heb je vragen over deze vacature of wil je even sparren? Neem gerust contact op met Romy via romy.vanessen@mobiliteitsfabriek.nl of bel naar +31 6 23 28 17 86. Ze helpt je graag verder!Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

Met het best beschikbare maatwerk pakket voor reiskostendeclaraties, kilometer-, ritten- en CO2-registratie, verantwoording van OV-kaartgebruik en voor een persoonlijk werknemers mobiliteitsbudget.

title: Stage FrontEnd Developer
descriptionHtml:
Bouw jij mee aan de digitale overheid van morgen? Bij Atabix maken we digitale dienstverlening eenvoudiger voor burgers en professionals. Wat in 2009 begon, is uitgegroeid tot een team van ruim 170 experts die dagelijks impact maken. Met onze software helpen we overheden hun werkprocessen te digitaliseren. Minder papierwerk, snellere dienstverlening en applicaties die écht werken.



Wij groeien hard en zoeken talent dat verder kijkt. Zie jij kansen? Wil je code schrijven die er niet alleen goed uitziet, maar ook maatschappelijk relevant is? Dan is dit jouw plek



Jouw rol als Stagiair Frontend Tijdens deze stage draai je volwaardig mee in een van onze ontwikkelteams. Je wordt niet weggestopt in een hoekje, maar werkt samen met ervaren Front-end Developers, Back-enders en Designers aan applicaties en microservices voor onze klanten of ons eigen product, de Atabase Suite


Je leert hoe je designs vertaalt naar strakke, werkende interfaces. Schone code, schaalbaarheid en user experience staan hierbij centraal.

  • Leren & Bouwen: Je werkt aan de user interface van onze applicaties en zorgt dat deze intuïtief en snel werken
  • Samenwerken: Je schakelt met designers over de 'look and feel' en met back-enders over de data-integratie
  • Quality Code: Je leert werken volgens moderne standaarden. Je schrikt niet van een code review; sterker nog, daar leer je juist van
  • Oog voor Design: Jij wordt enthousiast als pixels op de juiste plek staan en de gebruikerservaring soepel verloopt



Wie ben jij? Je bent bezig met een relevante HBO- of WO-opleiding (bijvoorbeeld Informatica, Software Engineering of CMD) en zoekt een plek waar je jouw skills naar een hoger niveau kunt tillen. Je hoeft nog niet alles te weten, maar je moet wél alles willen leren.

  • Passie voor code: Je hebt naast je studie al eens geproefd aan programmeren. Misschien heb je een eigen website gebouwd, een project op GitHub staan of certificaten gehaald die laten zien dat je meer wilt dan alleen de basis
  • Tech stack: Je hebt basiskennis van HTML, CSS en JavaScript/TypeScript. Ervaring met een framework (zoals Vue, React of Angular) is een grote pre
  • Soft Skills: Je snapt dat software bouwen teamsport is. Misschien heb je dit geleerd tijdens een bijbaan, een bestuursjaar of in de sportkantine: jij weet hoe je communiceert en samenwerkt
  • Taal: Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands



Wat bieden wij jou? Bij Atabix kom je terecht in een warm bad. We zijn vakkundig, daadkrachtig en betrokken

  • Uitstekende begeleiding: Je krijgt een ervaren mentor die je helpt groeien
  • Stagevergoeding: Een marktconforme vergoeding voor je harde werk
  • Ruimte voor school: Moet je een onderzoek doen of een opdracht voor school afronden? Daar maken we tijd voor
  • Cultuur: Een gezellige lunch, borrels, teamuitjes en een kantoor waar je jezelf mag zijn.
  • Lunch geregeld op kantoor. Warme en koude opties!

title: Full Stack Developer ✨
descriptionHtml:
Full Stack Developer

Fulltime - Kantoor / Hybrid / Remote

Omschrijving

Gaat je hart sneller kloppen van een strakke code en ben je gemotiveerd om nieuwe technologieën te leren? Wil je ook werken in een jong en snelgroeiend bedrijf? Dan hebben we een match gevonden.

‍

Wij zijn Onesix en wij helpen horeca ondernemers te groeien door middel van slimme technologie, zoals de Onesix Kiosk en Online Kiosk. Jaarlijks maken miljoenen mensen gebruik van Onesix producten, we groeien hard en daar hebben we jouw hulp bij nodig.

Werkzaamheden

Je werkt mee aan de uitbreiding en verbetering van de Onesix-producten. Wat dit werk leuk maakt, is de grote diversiteit aan tickets en technische uitdagingen. De ene dag verbeter je de gebruikerservaring in het dashboard, de volgende dag automatiseer je interne processen of bouw je API’s waar miljoenen transacties doorheen lopen. Je werkt aan performance, schaalbaarheid, betrouwbaarheid en slimme integraties met externe systemen. Geen week is hetzelfde.

Je test nieuwe features die door collega’s zijn gebouwd, denkt actief mee over verbeteringen en voert die ook zelf door. Daarnaast krijg je veel ruimte om eigen ideeën om te zetten in concrete verbeteringen en nieuwe functionaliteiten. Op de roadmap staan meerdere nieuwe producten waarbij jij een duidelijke bijdrage levert.

Je komt terecht in een jong, snelgroeiend team met grote ambities. We geloven niet in een 9-tot-5-mentaliteit. Je bent welkom op kantoor in Den Bosch, maar werken kan net zo goed remote, bijvoorbeeld vanuit Bangkok of Indonesië, waar ook collega’s werken. De enige eis is dat de US-tijdzone is uitgesloten, dan slapen we 😉

‍

Dit Ga Je Doen

👊 Designen, coden en ownership van nieuwe features

👊 Robuuste, schaalbare, goed geteste code schrijven

👊 Samen met het team de roadmap priotiseren en uitvoeren

👊 Werken in backend, frontend, apps en interne tools

👊 Debuggen en problemen oplossen in de live omgeving

Dit Bieden Wij

✔️ Een goed salaris

✔️ Vrijheid in werktijden en locatie

✔️ Vrijheid in vakantie, jij bepaalt wanneer en hoe lang

✔️ MacBook Pro + Monitors

✔️ AirPods Pro

✔️ Gratis lunch + geweldige uitjes/borrels

Dit Ben Jij

✅ Ervaring met AI-native tools als Claude Code/Cursor om te coden, debuggen en te refactoren

✅ Ervaring PHP, Laravel

✅ Ervaring TypeScript, React, Node.js

✅ Ervaring met SQL en PostgreSQL als database

✅ Probleem oplossend vermogen, communicatief en goed in debuggen

🤩 BONUS: Design gedreven ontwikkeling met goed gevoel voor UI/UX

🤩 BONUS: Ervaring met het bouwen van producten die gebruik maken van LLMs via OpenAI, OpenRouter

Solliciteren?

Chat met ons via de website, bel ons of stuur een berichtje naar info@byonesix.com. Deel je werk / Github profiel en waarom je bij Onesix wilt werken. Je hoeft geen lange formele mail te schrijven, die lezen we toch niet ;)

Mail naar info@byonesix.com

Bel ons

title: Full-Stack Developer, full-time
descriptionHtml:
Location: Ede, the NetherlandsStart date: February 2026


Are you a Full-Stack Developer with experience in Rust? Are you looking for a job in which you can contribute to a truly innovative system with real impact on future food production? We need your help and expertise to integrate our greenhouse automation systems and plant logistics. Together we build the fully synchronized food factory of the future. 


Your responsibilities

As a Full-Stack Developer, you will be responsible for:

  • Feature development: Own features from concept through implementation, including design, development, code review, automated tests, and deployment.
  • Backend development: Design and implement server-side services and tooling in Rust.
  • API design & development: Create and maintain well-documented REST/HTTP APIs using OpenAPI.
  • CI/CD and automation: Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for build, test, and deployment workflows.
  • Infrastructure as code & operations: Manage infrastructure and deployments with containerization (Docker) and an Atomic Linux based deployment system; write, review, and diagnose IaC and operational runbooks.
  • Frontend development: While not your primary responsibility, the role may also involve some UI work, helping build our UIs using TypeScript and Nuxt.
  • Production troubleshooting: Monitor, debug, and diagnose issues in our live greenhouse environment to maintain a working system and healthy set of plants.


Your skills and experience

What will you bring to our team?

We are looking for a flexible team player and strong communicator who enjoys working in a multi-disciplinary team in a truly innovative environment where plants, hardware and software come together. You have a passion for technology and want to use your strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail to make robust technological solutions for a greenhouse environment. This isn't your run-of-the-mill web application; we're combining the latest in web technologies, industrial automation and AI. We need an engineer who loves to learn and with an eye for detail.


Your profile:

  • You hold a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science (or similar).
  • You have at least 5 years working experience in backend development.
  • You are proficient in Rust.
  • You have experience in working with typescript (at least 2 years frontend development).
  • You are able to look beyond a single subsystem, you recognise future bottlenecks and seek knowledge and expertise outside SAIA where necessary.
  • Bonus points for any experience with OpenAPI or similar API-first development.
  • Bonus points for any experience in cloud infrastructure-as-code (terraform or similar technologies).
  • A driver’s license is required.
  • Proficiency in English is required
  • Proficiency in Dutch is a plus.


Are you interested, please apply! Or if you have any questions, contact us at recruitment@saia.tech!



What do we offer you?

What can you expect as a Full-Stack Developer at SAIA?

  • Excellent employment conditions, including 25 days paid vacation
  • A competitive full-time salary (between € 4800,- and € 6400,- depending on your level of experience)
  • Career opportunities within our growing company
  • Be part of our international interdisciplinary team working on our innovative automated greenhouse (including experts in greenhouse cultivation, AI, robot design and more).
  • Work with external machine builders and other parties to deploy our systems to customer locations 
  • An environment that facilitates and respects critical thinking, as well as open communication with all colleagues in the company.
  • Work in our high-tech greenhouse, very centrally located right next to Ede-Wageningen train station. 
  • Highly skilled, motivated and ambitious colleagues who love robots, technology, plants and food!


About SAIA

At SAIA we do things differently. We aim to make high-tech growing accessible to anyone, anywhere. We built a disruptive automated greenhouse, the food factory of the future. Our robot does not need to hunt for harvestable produce in the greenhouse jungle. Instead, we are the first to mobilise our plants so that we can bring them to our robot for easy, reliable deleafing and harvesting. We are now bringing our automated greenhouse to our first customers and are looking for new team members to help us do so.


You will work closely with an interdisciplinary team of experts in the field of AI and greenhouse cultivation to create an integrated system. At SAIA, responsibility and ownership of your work are central. We are a relatively small team (20 people) working together on one big product, so working well together with people outside your specialisation is essential. We are looking for someone who looks beyond a single subsystem, someone who recognizes future bottlenecks and seeks knowledge and expertise outside Saia where necessary. Critical thinking is highly valued and respected, as is open communication with all colleagues in the company.


You work together with both juniors and experienced engineers in different formations. Our dynamic and close-knit team consists of highly skilled, motivated and ambitious people who love robots, technology, plants and food. We work efficiently with plenty of room for laughter, through the good times and the bad. Together we strive for a better world and healthy food for everyone.


Our state-of-the-art Automated Greenhouse is located in Ede on the World Food Centre ground,  where we work on our plants, robots and machines. 


>> Want to know more? Please contact us at recruitment@saia.tech!

companySlogan: Autonomous Indoor Farming
companyDescription:
Every community should have access to local, high quality fresh produce. The demand of healthy fruits and vegetables is increasing rapidly worldwide because the middle class is expanding and the population is growing. Meanwhile, climate change and the depopulation of the countryside are already having a large negative impact on yields and food security.

Indoor Farming offers a controlled climate and protection from the changes outside. It brings a solution to the increasing global water scarcities by using drastically less water. Yields are typically higher too, so less land has to be used.

However, scaling up Indoor Farms around the world is not as easy as it seems. A local, reliable pool of quality workers is needed, which is increasingly hard to come by. Also, to control large-scale farms, a lot of expert knowledge is required.

SAIA believes that in order for indoor growing to become accessible everywhere, we need robots to help the workers and we need A.I. to empower the growers in controlling their farms optimally.

Through SAIA we will help the transition to Autonomous Indoor Farming. For improved food security, better jobs and healthy meals for everyone.

title: Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Amsterdam, NL

Shape a future with purpose at Arup in Amsterdam.

Redefine the built environment through digital innovation.

Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 75 years, guiding how we shape a better world.

Join our Digital Services team at Arup in the Netherlands, where innovation and collaboration drive our cutting-edge projects. We are redefining how technology enhances engineering and planning across the built and natural environments. With a focus on sustainable and impactful digital solutions, we bring together engineers, data scientists, planners, and designers to solve complex, real-world challenges.

The Opportunity

Help us transform the built environment through advanced digital solutions. You will have the opportunity to lead, innovate, and contribute to high-impact projects that integrate engineering excellence with digital tools. This role offers you a platform to grow as a leader in full-stack development while shaping sustainable and efficient solutions alongside a passionate, multidisciplinary team.

As a Full Stack Developer At Arup, You Will


  • Take ownership of end-to-end feature development—designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, user-friendly web applications that support our digital and engineering projects. You will implement intuitive front-end interfaces and robust back-end systems using modern frameworks and tools.
  • Collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams to understand user needs, contribute to technical architecture decisions, and integrate platforms with other digital services. You’ll also use 3D and spatial data visualization to make complex datasets accessible and actionable.
  • Mentor junior developers and help build a strong engineering culture through knowledge sharing, pair programming, and leadership in best practices.
  • Ensure high-quality, secure, and reliable software through participation in code reviews, testing, and DevOps processes.
  • Stay at the forefront of innovation by engaging in research and experimentation with emerging technologies, while also contributing technical expertise to bids, proposals, and client discussions.


Does this role inspire you?

About

We're looking for someone who is passionate about building scalable digital tools that enable sustainable and smart infrastructure. We also value:


  • Proven full stack development expertise (around 5 years) with experience in both front-end (React, Next.js, HTML/CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript) and back-end (Node.js, Python, .NET or similar) technologies.
  • Experience with databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), APIs, and cloud services (e.g., AWS or Azure).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and automated testing.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead and inspire small technical teams.
  • Knowledge of spatial and 3D data visualization tools is a strong plus.


Why Arup?

At Arup, we believe in rewarding our members for their contributions to our shared success. As a trust-owned company, we have the freedom to pursue meaningful work that aligns with our purpose and values. We also offer a unique profit share program, allowing our members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

Benefits That Work For You


  • Professional Growth & Development: Benefit from continuous learning opportunities, training programs, and mentorship to enhance your skills and advance your career at Arup.
  • Global Opportunities: Collaborate with colleagues worldwide and explore potential short-term or long-term assignments at other Arup offices and project locations.
  • Financial Well-being & Ownership: Receive a competitive salary and benefits package and share in Arup's success through our global profit-sharing programme.
  • Flexible & Hybrid Working: We support our people in maintaining a healthy work-life balance through our flexible and hybrid working policies. This role requires office presence at least two days per week, complemented by flexible working arrangements.
  • Well-being and Inclusive Culture: We prioritise your well-being and foster an inclusive culture where you can be your authentic self and thrive, supported by various employee networks and initiatives.


At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective where individuality is encouraged. Our strength comes from how we respect, share, and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas. You'll have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, and to the clients and communities we serve.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of the world around us. We actively promote a culture of inclusion where everyone feels welcome, respected, and valued.

We welcome applications from talented individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, disability, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible. If you need any assistance or adjustments, please visit our Candidate Support page for contact information and assistance. We're happy to help.

Do you want to join us in shaping a better world?

Click on “Apply for Job”

title: Full Stack MERN Developer
descriptionHtml:
About Us:


Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our clients, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world.


About the Role:


We’re looking for a Front-End Software Engineer with a passion for crafting high-quality, user-centric interfaces. In this role, you’ll focus on building responsive, accessible, and performant UI experiences using React, TypeScript, and Next.js. You’ll collaborate closely with designers to translate Figma designs into production-ready pages, leveraging our design system to ensure consistency and scalability across the product. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys bringing designs to life with clean, maintainable code and has a strong eye for detail and user experience.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Develop and maintain responsive, accessible UI components and pages using React, TypeScript, and Next.js
  • Implement designs accurately from Figma, ensuring high visual and functional fidelity
  • Optimize front-end performance and accessibility across browsers and devices
  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions within Agile Scrum team


Required Skills & Technologies:


Frontend Development

  • TypeScript (mandatory)
  • React
  • Next.js


Cloud & Infrastructure

  • AWS (Amazon Web Services)
  • AWS Secrets Manager
  • Kubernetes (K8s) & Amazon EKS
  • Docker & Helm
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
  • Cloud-native architecture


DevOps & Platform Engineering

  • GitOps workflows
  • ArgoCD
  • CI/CD pipelines


Enterprise Integration

  • RESTful API integration
  • Microservices architecture
  • CRM and Headless CMS integration


Networking & Security

  • Security best practices
  • Secrets management


Experience Requirements:


  • Minimum 5 years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong experience in frontend development using React, Next.js, or React Native.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and container orchestration.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and working in Scrum teams.
  • Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures.


Preferred (Nice-to-Have) Experience:


  • IaC with Terraform
  • AWS cloud services and deployment
  • Development of enterprise-grade applications
  • Experience with large-scale, business-critical systems
  • Integration with third-party systems (CRM, APIs, enterprise platforms)



Diversity and Inclusion at Wipro


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, marital status, age, ethnic and national origin, sexual and political orientation and disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention. Come to Wipro. Realize your ambitions. Applications from people with disabilities are explicitly welcome.

title: Backend & Frontend Developer
descriptionHtml:
Join the team building the automation platform redefining how real-world systems operate.

Base360.ai is an intelligent automation engine that connects data, orchestrates workflows, and powers large-scale operational systems.

We turn fragmented, manual processes into clean, automated pipelines that businesses can rely on globally.

We’re looking for a Backend & Frontend Developer to help build the core platform — from API services and real-time automations to intuitive dashboards and control interfaces.

If you enjoy working across the stack, solving complex problems, and building products that run real operations, you’ll feel at home here.

💡 What You’ll Build

You will design and build the systems and interfaces that power Base360.ai:

  • Scalable backend services and APIs
  • Automation workflows and event-driven microservices
  • Clean, fast, and intuitive frontend tools for monitoring and control
  • Integrations with third-party platforms and data sources
  • Real-time dashboards and operational control panels

Your work will directly influence how teams automate, monitor, and scale mission-critical operations.

⚙️ Your Mission

Build Core Backend Services

Design APIs, data flows, and backend logic that form the foundation of Base360.ai.

Develop Frontend Interfaces

Create responsive dashboards and tools that make complex automation systems simple to manage.

Implement Automation Workflows

Build event-driven services, micro-automations, and intelligent logic that power real-time operations.

Integrate External Platforms

Connect Base360.ai with key partners like Stripe, Twilio, Airbnb, Hostaway, and internal systems.

Engineer for Scale & Reliability

Design solutions that are robust, observable, fault-tolerant, and built for high-throughput environments.

Collaborate Across Functions

Work closely with product, data, and operations to turn automation challenges into elegant, functional software.

🧠 You’re a Great Fit If You Have

  • Experience with Node.js / TypeScript, Python (FastAPI), or similar backend frameworks
  • Strong understanding of React or another modern frontend library
  • Familiarity with AWS, serverless technologies, or cloud-native development
  • Knowledge of APIs, microservices, and event-driven architecture
  • A passion for automation, system design, and simplifying complexity
  • A builder mindset — pragmatic, fast, clean, and ownership-driven
  • Ability to work across backend + frontend and deliver production-ready solutions

🌍 Why You’ll Love Working Here

High Ownership

You build real systems, not isolated features — and you shape the platform’s architecture.

Real-World Impact

Your software will power automation for live operational environments at scale.

Fast-Moving Environment

Small team, no bureaucracy, and the ability to ship quickly.

Technical Creativity

Freedom to design, experiment, and build ambitious solutions.

Remote-First Culture

Work from anywhere — we care about outcomes, not hours.

🚫 This Role Is Not for You If

  • You prefer repetitive tasks over new challenges
  • You want rigid structure or slow processes
  • “Good enough” is good enough
  • You’re not driven to improve and master your craft

title: Frontend Engineer - Ad Alliance
descriptionHtml:
Your Profile

  • You have at least 4 years of experience working as a frontend engineer.
  • Giving and receiving feedback is something that comes as a second nature, you want to grow yourself and the people around you.
  • You are a passionate software engineer with a good understanding of the core frontend web technologies (JavaScript/Typescript, HTML, CSS, React, Next.js).
  • You embrace agentic development tools such as Cursor to explore options quickly, automate repetitive toil, and keep quality high.
  • Able to write simple and effective code that solves business problems
  • You are actively working on developing yourself, eager to learn and open to different idea’s.
  • You live in the Netherlands and can work together with the team in our Hilversum office at least 2 times a week.
  • You are diligent and kind, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • The advertising domain interests you and you are eager to understand everything there is to know about bringing advertisements to our and our partner’s products.


Your Tasks

  • Contribute to the features of your development team, by designing, building and operating features end to end.
  • You talk to business and understand their needs over their asks, trying to optimize value creation for the products that you work on.
  • You contribute to your chapter, improving our engineering practices and growing the development teams across the company.
  • You don’t mind contributing outside the area of expertise, in the end it is more important to get a feature out well than it is to get your part done.
  • You help and coach more junior developers by providing feedback and guiding them in their tasks.


Your Team

The team's mission is about creating value for Ad Alliance as the number 1 video Sales House. Mostly focused on automating Sales processes from buying the campaigns, till the moment of invoicing the campaigns, and everything in between.

As a crucial member of this team, you will be collaborating with individuals from various departments and roles, including business analysts, sales, marketing, and operations.

As a team we believe that having a strong connection helps to improve the results. We work a few days per week in the office where we seek this connection with each other as team, and our stakeholders. All of those things happen in an environment where we are encouraging, open, critical and respectful to each other.


About Us

About Ad Alliance

Ad Alliance is a media company, established in 2020, responsible for the sales of the largest media brands in the Netherlands. We collaborate with media agencies and advertisers to achieve the best results for their objectives by offering a wide range of cross-media advertising opportunities within our network of campaigns on TV, online, through licensing and partnerships on platforms including RTL, Discovery Networks Benelux, The Walt Disney Company, Paramount, We Are Era, DPG Media and recently HBO Max.

We work in an informal atmosphere with 150 result-driven colleagues. We do this in our beautiful office building in Hilversum, as well as from home. We share the same passion for the media brands we work for, and we believe that collaboration is very important.

About RTL


RTL started in 1989 as the first commercial broadcaster in the Netherlands. Our mission has not changed since then: we want to reach and inspire everyone in the Netherlands with essential stories that touch the heart and mind. RTL has five television channels (RTL 4, RTL 5, RTL 7, RTL 8 and RTL Z), streaming platform Videoland, three digital theme channels (RTL Lounge, RTL Crime, RTL Telekids), sales organization Ad Alliance and the platforms RTL Nieuws & Entertainment and RTL Weer / Buienradar. RTL Nieuws, Editie NL and RTL Z bring you 24/7 the latest news, their own journalistic research and interpretation via the broadcasts, website, app and socials. Our makers tell the stories that are relevant to the Netherlands. Personal, recognizable, close by and thanks to our tech and content experts you can view it where and when you want. We are always looking for new colleagues who bring a perspective that complements and makes us better

title: Lead Developer (all-in-one-security) - WordPress
descriptionHtml:
Here's who we are:

At Team Updraft our DNA is in world-leading software for WordPress that helps our customers to backup, restore, clone, secure and optimize their WordPress websites. Our global team is behind some of the most popular WordPress plugins in the world! Used by more than 5 million WordPress website owners, our plugins have a reputation for being reliable and powerful.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Lead Developer to join us, to be successful in this role you will have deep knowledge and experience developing WordPress, and a passion for security with demonstrable experience in this area.

You will have the option to choose your own hours from 32 up to 40 per week, and you can work remotely from anywhere in the world, we simply ask that you have 4 hours of crossover with UK working hours per day.

————————————————————-

Lead Developer (all-in-one-security)

Competitive Salary (depending On Experience)

Fully Remote

We have an exciting opportunity for a Web Developer with excellent PHP, JS and WordPress experience to join a growing, ambitious team to help further develop one of the world's leading WordPress security plugins - All-In-One Security: WordPress Security Plugin (aiosplugin.com)

AIOS is responsible for protecting over 1 million websites worldwide. You will play a leading role in the company's aim to continue to be the dominant player in the plugin industry.

You will be working together with a small, global team involved in development and testing. Overseeing the development and maintenance of the AIOS plugin, ensuring features are delivered to a high standard and guiding the work of the other developers.

The day-to-day role

  • Work in PHP, JavaScript and WordPress libraries to write clean, efficient and secure code
  • Line managing the plugin development team
  • Ensuring tasks are appropriately assigned, reviewed, and completed by the team
  • Maintaining high technical standards in the code base
  • Utilising senior developer's knowledge to achieve the best direction for the plugin
  • Identifying priorities, resolving blockers
  • Acting as the key point of contact for technical queries related to the plugin
  • Liaising with QA and Product Managers to align development work with wider business goals

Your exact responsibilities will depend on your experience, how this fits with other members of the team and subject to discussion and agreement!

Requirements

You'll definitely need experience with:

  • PHP - you'll have experience of developing in WordPress, ideally on the development of a plugin
  • JavaScript - a smaller part of the role, but important
  • Online security - keeping up to date with the latest threats and security issues that relate to websites
  • Firewalls or other related security technologies
  • Managing other developers

It would be nice if you have experience with:

GitHub / GitLab / Git - nice to have, but can be learnt quickly by good developers used to alternatives like SVN.

Benefits

Why Join Us?

We are a globally distributed, highly flexible team that values autonomy and impact. You'll have the freedom to manage your own time and work from anywhere in the world (with the exception of Antarctica!). While we primarily work remotely, we also offer:

  • The option to work from our co-working space in Newport, Wales, if you're UK-based
  • Opportunities to connect with the team at annual WordCamp events across Europe, Asia, or the US
  • Regular online connections through 1:1s, team meetings, and company updates

We believe in flexible working and are open to discussing various arrangements - whether you're looking for freelance, employed, part-time, full-time, permanent, or contract work, we're keen to find the right fit for the right candidate.

If you're ready to make a significant impact as our new Lead Developer for our AIOS Plugin and help us shape the future of TeamUpdraft, we encourage you to apply!

title: Full-Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Eerst de feiten.

  • Gewoon een goed salaris tussen de €3050 en €6050.
  • Mobiliteitsvergoeding of auto van de zaak.
  • 26 offline vakantiedagen met zakgeld.
  • Een contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week.
  • Thuiswerken? Natuurlijk!


Dit ga jij doen.

Maak jij met jouw skills en drive alles mogelijk? Dan kan het maar zo zijn dat jij Arcady-DNA hebt. En dat jij die Full-Stack Developer bent die onze klanten doet verbazen én groeien. Als Arcadian werk je voor en met onze klanten aan innovatieve projecten met veel exposure. Je beweegt soepel mee in Agile development teams en spreekt vloeiend de talen van andere technische specialisten.


Aanhaken bij het gehele software development proces? Doe je net zo makkelijk. Samen met andere full-stackers zetten jullie de beste browser experience in code neer. Meedenken en adviseren over de implementatie en technische haalbaarheid: met jouw heldere blik zie je hoe het moet en wat er kan. Net zo helder zie je kansen. En je pakt ze ook nog.


Je bent natuurlijk al slim. Bij Arcady word je nóg slimmer. Van de projecten die je op- en aanpakt, van de kennissessies in onze eigen Arcademy en van de vele conferenties en workshop die je gaat volgen. Vooruitgang, daar houden wij van. Net als jij.


Over Arcady.

Wij zijn Arcady. Een agile softwareclub in Zwolle waar meer dan 60 beresterke Arcadians dagelijks organisaties in een stroomversnelling brengen.


De digitale wereld verandert. Wij helpen organisaties hier snel en effectief op in te spelen. Dit doen we met de inzet van high performance teams en specialistische expertise.


Onze Arcadians bouwen ‘next-level’ softwareoplossingen die de time-to-market van projecten verkorten en het interne kennisniveau bij de opdrachtgever vergroten. A-klanten als Uitgekookt, Niverplast, Hogeschool Windesheim en The Learning Network hebben we al geholpen in deze digitale transformatie. En daar zijn we trots op!


Positieve energie, fun en ondernemend. Dat is wat Arcady bijzonder maakt. Naast gezelligheid met collega’s en een fijne werksfeer vinden wij ontwikkeling heel belangrijk. Want weten is winnen. Zowel op persoonlijk als op inhoudelijk vlak. Wij helpen je daarbij. Zodat jij de beste versie van jezelf wordt.


Dit ben en kan jij.

Fluent spoken and written Dutch is a requirement for this position


Jij bent een Fullstack Developer met Arcady-DNA. Dan kan je dus heel wat. Hartstikke veel zelfs. En toch wil je blijven leren. Beter worden. Continu. Wat je al weet, deel je met collega’s. Want als iets beter kan, mag (moet) dat gezegd worden. Houden we van.


Verder heb jij:

  • Meerdere jaren ervaring als developer
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met minstens één van de grote JS-frameworks: Angular, React of Vue
  • Ervaring met applicaties met veel concurrent users (daar word je juist warm van)
  • Kennis van C#, MVC, ASP.NET, .NET Core, Azure en TypeScript
  • Het vermogen om UX-designs te vertalen naar high-performant end-to-end features


Daarnaast:

  • Werk je soepel met NPM, MSBuild en/of Azure Pipelines
  • Deins je niet terug voor GraphQL, SignalR, Application Insights, Clean- en SOLID code
  • Weet je wanneer SQL of NoSQL de juiste keuze is
  • Graaf je door tot je het snapt. En deel je die kennis via GitHub, een blog of gewoon met je team


What's in it for you?

Behoorlijk wat. Natuurlijk sowieso de standaard zaken, zoals je die bij elk bedrijf kunt krijgen of halen. Bij Arcady gaan we altijd voor beter en een schepje meer. Wat dacht je van:

  • Natuurlijk: een meer dan fijn salaris. Om over naar huis te schrijven zelfs.
  • Een winstdelingsuitkering en vakantiegeld.
  • Uitstekende pensioenregeling én onkostenvergoeding;
  • €2.500,- opleidingsbudget voor (internationale) congressen en
  • workshops en 5 studiedagen per jaar.
  • Veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap en eigen initiatieven.


Wacht, er is meer;

  • Je werk versnellen met GitHub Copilot van de zaak.
  • Werken aan uitdagende projecten bij de gaafste A-klanten in de regio.
  • Elke twee weken kennisdeling met collega's tijdens onze Brainpower++.
  • Kennissessies in onze Arcademy en via Webdev Zwolle.
  • Zorgeloos op weg met je eigen leaseauto;


Nee echt, er is nóg meer;

  • Een ruim hardware budget (€3500) voor een laptop, smartphone en accessoires naar keuze.
  • Een gaaf kantoor in hartje Zwolle met de lekkerste koffie en cappuccino en Nintendo Switch.
  • Relaxte informele werksfeer met knetterfijne collega's.
  • Lekker lunchen in de stad.
  • Offline-time op de vrijdagmiddag bij de Barcady.


Dit was het wel zo’n beetje. Voor nu.


Pak het moment.

Ben jij de Full-Stack Developer die we zoeken? We komen graag met je in contact. Solliciteer direct door op de button te klikken.

Vragen over de functie? Stel ze aan Mike via 06 82 09 05 62 of via m.degooijer@arcady.nl.

companyDescription:
Arcady staat voor agile software, slimme oplossingen en de technische kennis van morgen. Wij helpen organisaties groeien. In innovatiekracht en rendement. Noem ons meerwaardemakers of toekomstbouwers. We zijn bovenal businesspartner met ideeën én resultaten. Daar houden we van. Daarom kiezen bedrijven voor Arcady. 

Wij doen dit met professionals die stuk voor stuk autoriteit zijn en uitblinken op hun domein. Wij zijn uniek, jong, dynamisch en enthousiast, maar vooral gefocust op (uw) resultaat. En.. ondernemend zijn we ook, want wij laten ons, als het even kan, op het resultaat afrekenen. Nieuwsgierig? Neem dan contact met ons op!

title: Vacature front-end (React) developer
descriptionHtml:
• Home
  • Onze vacatures
  • Vacature front-end (React) developer

Vacature front-end (React) developer

29 november 2023

Als front-end developer aan de slag in top teams voor mooie klanten die ontwikkeling van sterke front-ends belangrijk vinden? Wil je graag aan de slag met maatwerk user centered designs die naar gebruiksvriendelijke producten vertaald moeten worden en hou je van de afwisseling en dynamiek van het werken voor meerdere merken in e-commerce, dan is deze vacature het waard om verder te lezen! We zoeken een front-end developer met ervaring in headless development en een drive voor gebruiksvriendelijke producten.

Wie zijn wij precies?

Wij zijn Mooore Digital en staan bekend als gewaardeerd bureau met specialisme in maatwerk design en development. We zijn werkzaam voor voor sterke merken in e-commerce en we ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en beheren vaak alle e-commerce applicaties van onze klanten. Daarnaast werken we aan een aantal digitale producten die als stand-alone oplossing voor onze klanten of zelfs daarbuiten worden ingezet. We werken met verschillende teams van product owners, scrum masters, designers, front-end developers en back-end developers, gespecialiseerd in e-commerce, Magento maar ontwikkelen ook veel maatwerk applicaties om een sterk e-commerce landschap voor onze klanten te ontwikkelen. Dit doen we met een club van zo’n 20 professionals, maar in de praktijk versterken we ons en onze klanten ook met een select aantal zeer sterke partners op het gebied van online marketing, hosting en logistiek.

We zijn gevestigd op een prachtige centrale en uitstekend bereikbare plek in een heerlijk kantoor met bijzonder gedreven collega’s, uitzicht op de IJssel, een speciaalbier-café op rol-afstand, en dat dan op 5 minuten loopafstand van het station, dichtbij Zwolle, Dronten, Emmeloord.

Onze teams

Iedereen met een stevig stukje liefde voor development loopt al gauw met ons mee als teamlid om samen onze doelen te bereiken en top applicaties te ontwikkelen. Met elkaar vinden we het belangrijk om kwaliteit te leveren die boven de standaard ligt, we hanteren graag een eigen hoge standaard en een belangrijk onderdeel van die standaard is dat kwaliteit hand in hand gaat met lol en ontspanning. Zo bereiken we onze resultaten graag, kunnen we sterke (e-commerce) oplossingen ontwikkelen en worden we door onze klanten gewaardeerd.

Hoe ziet de functie van front-end developer eruit?

Als front-end developer houd jij je bezig met het (door)ontwikkelen van de front-end van digitale producten, applicaties die ons back-end team ontwikkelt in Magento, Laravel of volledig headless met allerlei andere stand alone systemen. Je werkt dagelijks met technieken zoals HTML, CSS, JS (VUE, Node, React, NextJS, NuxtJS, etc.) en kan hier zelfstandig mee overweg. Als teamlid van Mooore Digital werk je in een relaxed ritme in sprints en heb je naast je sprint ruimte voor randzaken. Als front-ender in projecten denk je desgewenst actief mee in de ontwikkeling van wireframes, het UX design proces en design systems.

Dagelijks werk je met een aantal collega’s samen aan een project of doorontwikkelingen voor klanten of, als je dat wenst, interne projecten. Je kunt aangeven wat goed gaat, waar je tegen issues aanloopt en waar je hulp bij nodig hebt. Vragen van klanten weet je goed om te zetten naar passende front-end oplossingen en je haalt er veel plezier uit om dat telkens net dat stapje beter te doen. Samen met je team zorg je voor succesvolle projecten en daarmee blij klanten!

Wat verwachten we van je?

  • Je werkt graag in teams;
  • Je vindt het fijn om je kennis op collega’s over te brengen en samen ideeën te ontwikkelen;
  • Je kunt goed communiceren, zowel in Nederlands als Engels;
  • Je vind het leuk om afwisselend intern of voor klanten te werken;
  • Je neemt initiatieven en houdt ervan om zelfstandig te werken;
  • Je houdt van design systems en verwerkt style graag systematisch in je projecten;
  • Je hebt eventueel ook wat kennis van Magento (pré);
  • Je weet alles van HTML, CSS, JS (VUE, Node, React, Next.js, Nuxt.js, etc.);
  • Het leren kennen van nieuwe techieken en systemen past bij de ambitie waarmee je dagelijks aan het werk bent;
  • Je ben leergierig en verbreedt graag je kennis op meerdere vlakken.

Waarom bij ons aan de slag?

  • Een bijzondere werkomgeving op een historische plek;
  • Goed bereikbaar kantoor op 5 minuten lopen van het centrale station in Kampen, 10 minuten van Zwolle (ook vanuit Flevoland of Friesland zijn we uitstekend bereikbaar);
  • Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken;
  • Uitgebreide gelegenheid voor eigen ontwikkeling;
  • De visie om te focussen op je talenten i.p.v. taken;
  • Een prettige werksfeer met bijzonder leuke en gedreven collega’s;
  • Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden, middels een goed salaris;
  • Reiskostenvergoeding;
  • Pensioenopbouw;
  • Flexibiliteit in werktijden en meer;
  • Laptop van de zaak, keuze in Linux of Mac;
  • De beste versie koffie;
  • Op vrijdag een koud biertje of iets anders bij de bar;

Concreet maken, deze baan als front-end (react) developer?

Stuur een korte maar krachtige motivatie en je c.v. naar aandeslag@mooore.nl of nodig jezelf uit om eerst eens vrijblijvend kennis te maken. Heb je nog vragen over deze vacature of zie je andere mogelijkheden om van toegevoegde waarde te zijn? Mail ons gerust of bel ons via 038-8200270 en vraag naar Hans of Tom!

Eerst kennismaken in plaats van solliciteren?

Twijfel je of wij het juiste bedrijf voor je zijn? Of wil je eerst onze cultuur proeven? Vrijdagmiddag staat altijd vrij geboekt voor dit soort kennismakingen. Kom gerust langs om ons beter te leren kennen.

p.s. als recruiter deze vacature met interesse gelezen? Sorry, we hebben geen interesse. Echt, niet bellen!

Samen met je team zorg je voor succesvolle projecten en daarmee blij klanten!Wat verwachten we van je?Je werkt graag in teams;Je vindt het fijn om je kennis op collega’s over te brengen en samen ideeën te ontwikkelen; Je kunt goed communiceren, zowel in Nederlands als Engels;Je vind het leuk om afwisselend intern of voor klanten te werken;Je neemt initiatieven en houdt ervan om zelfstandig te werken;Je houdt van design systems en verwerkt style graag systematisch in je projecten;Je hebt eventueel ook wat kennis van Magento (pré);Je weet alles van HTML, CSS, JS (VUE, Node, React, Next.js, Nuxt.js, etc.);Het leren kennen van nieuwe techieken en systemen past bij de ambitie waarmee je dagelijks aan het werk bent;Je ben leergierig en verbreedt graag je kennis op meerdere vlakken.Waarom bij ons aan de slag?Een bijzondere werkomgeving op een historische plek;Goed bereikbaar kantoor op 5 minuten lopen van het centrale station in Kampen, 10 minuten van Zwolle (ook vanuit Flevoland of Friesland zijn we uitstekend bereikbaar); Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken;Uitgebreide gelegenheid voor eigen ontwikkeling;De visie om te focussen op je talenten i.p.v. taken;Een prettige werksfeer met bijzonder leuke en gedreven collega’s;Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden, middels een goed salaris;Reiskostenvergoeding;Pensioenopbouw;Flexibiliteit in werktijden en meer;Laptop van de zaak, keuze in Linux of Mac;De beste versie koffie;Op vrijdag een koud biertje of iets anders bij de bar;Concreet maken, deze baan als front-end (react) developer?Stuur een korte maar krachtige motivatie en je c.v. naar aandeslag@mooore.nl of nodig jezelf uit om eerst eens vrijblijvend kennis te maken. Heb je nog vragen over deze vacature of zie je andere mogelijkheden om van toegevoegde waarde te zijn? Mail ons gerust of bel ons via 038-8200270 en vraag naar Hans of Tom!Eerst kennismaken in plaats van solliciteren?Twijfel je of wij het juiste bedrijf voor je zijn? Of wil je eerst onze cultuur proeven? Vrijdagmiddag staat altijd vrij geboekt voor dit soort kennismakingen. Kom gerust langs om ons beter te leren kennen.p.s. als recruiter deze vacature met interesse gelezen? Sorry, we hebben geen interesse. Echt, niet bellen!

title: Software Development Engineer IV (Full Stack)
descriptionHtml:
About Us
QuillBot was founded in 2017 with a mission to help students and professionals—especially those learning English—strengthen their writing. Today, we help over 56 million people around the world create great things. Whether you're writing, designing, coding, or collaborating, QuillBot is a place where anyone can create at the speed of thought. Our AI-powered tools help you think clearly, communicate effectively, and create beautifully—across every platform, in any format, at any skill level. If you're passionate about using technology to make the path from inspiration to execution more accessible, intentional, and relevant, come join us.

Role Overview
We’re looking for a Software development Engineer IV (Full Stack) who specializes in frontend architecture and complex product interfaces, supported by strong backend fundamentals. You’ll help shape how we build our writing and editing tool, ensuring it is modular, scalable, extensible, and maintainable as we continue adding features.

Your backend work will focus on designing APIs and services that cleanly support the editor’s needs. Your frontend work will be where you spend most of your time: establishing structure, driving architectural clarity, and building systems that make the editor easy to extend and maintain. You’ll thrive in environments with ambiguity, where not everything is fully defined yet, and where strong product thinking and design sense help shape the right solution.

Responsibilities

  • Lead frontend architecture, ensuring the editor is modular, scalable, and capable of supporting complex editing workflows.
  • Build user-facing features (React, TypeScript, CSS) with a strong emphasis on UX and performance.
  • Ensure excellent developer experience (DX) by writing clean, self-documented, and reusable code.
  • Implement and integrate APIs that power the editing experience, maintaining clean contracts between frontend and backend.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to shape both technical architecture and product experience.
  • Prototype quickly, iterate often, and bring clarity to evolving product ideas.
  • Mentor teammates and raise the bar on technical and architectural decision-making.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional experience, with deep expertise in frontend engineering for large-scale applications.
  • Proven experience architecting complex frontend systems and structuring applications for maintainability and performance.
  • Strong proficiency with React, TypeScript, CSS, and component-driven development.
  • Experience designing scalable APIs or integrating with backend services.
  • Strong practices in testing, documentation, and code quality.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in cross-functional teams.
  •  

Bonus Points

  • An eye for design and UX — translating product ideas and mocks into polished user experiences.
  • Experience with design systems and component-driven development.
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, evolving product spaces where iteration is the norm.
  • Strong sense of product ownership and ability to think from the user’s perspective.
  • Previous experience in SaaS, AI-powered products, or large-scale platforms.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus
  • Pension plan through the Zwitserleven Pension Fund
  • A minimum of 33 days paid time off (including 7 public holidays and a day off on your birthday)
  • A yearly personal development budget of €500
  • Free consultations at OpenUp
  • Discount and extra credits on a ClassPass monthly subscription
  • A remote-friendly culture, including working abroad for up to 3 months
  • The flexibility to work from home, including a monthly working from home allowance of €60 per month
  • Parenthood: minimum of 6 weeks fully paid partner leave & 16 weeks fully paid maternity leave
  • Travel allowance: (NS business card or kilometre allowance of €0.23/km)
  • Healthy lunch and snacks at the office
  • Employee referral program
  • Premium access to QuillBot & LanguageTooler

*Benefits and benefit amounts differ by region. A comprehensive list applicable to your region will be provided in your interview process. 

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don't apply for roles if they don't meet all the criteria. We strongly encourage you to apply if you're interested: we'd love to learn how you can amplify our team with your unique experience!

This role is eligible for hire in Netherlands.

We are a virtual-first company and have employees dispersed throughout the United States, Canada, India, Israel, Germany, and the Netherlands. We have a market-based pay structure that varies by location. The base pay for this position is dependent on multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed. You may also be eligible to participate in our bonus program and may be offered benefits, and other types of compensation.

#QuillBot


In accordance with applicable pay transparency laws, we provide a good-faith base salary range for each role. Total compensation may also include equity, which is determined by role, level, and location. The base salary for this role if filled within Netherlands is as follows.

Netherlands Pay Range: €85.000 EUR - €115.000 EUR

Equal ​Employment Opportunity Statement ​(EEO)
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity and ​inclusion within our company.  ​We will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender ​identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, ​veteran status, or ​ability status. We will ensure that individuals who are differently abled are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment as provided to other applicants or employees. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Full stack-ontwikkelaar
descriptionHtml:
See Your Future 

At Salacia, our mission is simple yet powerful: put sustainability on equal footing with finance. We help companies and investors make smarter decisions by turning ESG reporting into actionable insights through real-time data and automation. 


The world of ESG Reporting is rapidly and continuously changing. As a full-stack developer, you will drive improvement in the way our customers collect, process and use data to gain actionable insights in their ESG performance. You will work in a multifunctional team to build and maintain new functionality and find new and innovative ways to increase the performance and maintainability of our platform using AI and applying high coding standards.  


Do you have what it takes to become our newest team member? Get in touch!  


What You Will Be Doing 

As a full-stack developer at Salacia Solutions, you will play a key role in developing further our application, increasing the impact we can make on our planet through the usage of our tools by our customers. 

 

Your Responsibilities 

Develop and maintain scalable back-end services and APIs 


  • Develop and maintain features and UI components in our application using modern frameworks (React, Remix, Typescript, Playwright), designing and implementing database schemas and data pipelines 
  • Collaborate closely with the Product-, UX-, DevOps- and Support teams 
  • Actively participate in Retro’s, Refinements and sprint planning sessions 
  • Ensure code quality through testing, code reviews, best practices and documentation. 
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and technical strategy 
  • Help improve performance, security, and reliability of the platform 
  • Stay up to date with trends and best practices 

 

What are we looking for: 

  • 3–5 years of experience 
  • Proficiency in Python, React Typescript, MongoDB, Clickhouse (bonus points for Remix, Go, Kubernetes) 
  • Experience with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture 
  • Solid understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases 
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) 
  • Passion for clean, maintainable code and good software practices 
  • Interest in ESG, sustainability, or impact-driven tech 
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills (Working language: English) 
  • Not afraid to work at a highly dynamic scale-up 
  • Able to work at our centrally located office in Rotterdam a few days a week

 

What We Offer 

  • Become part of the change you want to see in the world. We create real impact, by helping companies track and reduce their environmental footprint 
  • We invite you to help shape the future of our growing organization 
  • It is our priority to create the work / private life balance that brings out the best in each individual team member. What this means for you, you tell us! In terms of working hours, working location, paid breaks, et cetera 
  • A competitive salary package 
  • A flexible, highly motivated, dynamic and fun organisation 


How to Apply 

If you are excited about using your communication and problem-solving skills to drive positive environmental change, we would love to hear from you.


Please note that this position is only open to candidates who live and are already authorised to work in the Netherlands. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship. 


You can send your CV and a brief motivation letter to hrm@salaciasolutions.com. 


Salacia Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer (Mid / Senior Level)
descriptionHtml:
At Cutr we're looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our product team.

About The Job

As a Full-Stack Software Engineer at Cutr, you’ll help reinvent how designers and wood manufacturers collaborate—building tools that make manufacturing easier, faster, and more sustainable. You'll be involved in the entire product development lifecycle including the design, development, deployment and maintenance of new and existing features. You'll write clean and functional code on the front and back-end. You'll collaborate closely with our development & product teams to ensure system consistency and to create a great user experience. You'll write reusable and maintainable code. You'll also perform UI tests to optimize performance. Ultimately, your work will have direct impact on the stability and user experience of our products.

Our Tech Stack At a High Level

  • Frontend: Vue.js and React.js
  • Backend: Node.js (Express), PostgreSQL
  • Infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes

This role is Amsterdam or remote in locations that are near/compatible with Central European Timezone.

This role is full-time (5 days/week), and we’re not able to offer part-time arrangements

About You

  • You have ~5+ years of full-time software engineering experience (or equivalent proven expertise).
  • You leverage AI tools daily to accelerate your workflow, from prototyping to production. You know how to get high-quality code shipped fast with AI.
  • You are comfortable with front-end and back-end languages. You have worked with Javascript, databases, web servers, and designers
  • You have experience with testing and debugging
  • You're analytical and good at time management
  • You have great communication and problem-solving skills
  • You are ambitious. You want to quickly grow your career at an early stage venture-backed startup and make a big impact on the business, and if you’ve been a founder or early team member before, even better.

Compensation And Benefits

  • Competitive equity package
  • Tools and resources you need to do your best work
  • Generous PTO policy
  • Team off-sites around every 6 months

Note: some benefits depend on local employment practices and law

About Us

Cutr is the platform for designers to get things made. We are a team of engineers, woodworkers and designers with the shared objective of making wood manufacturing easier, faster and cheaper for everyone involved. We care about moving the world to a zero-carbon future, and believe a 10x better wood manufacturing industry is the key to achieving it. We're backed by the best and we'd LOVE to meet you.

Our Process

  • Initial chat with hiring manager - We'll chat about the role and goals (yours and ours).
  • Code exercise - You'll work through a coding exercise with a couple members of the engineering team
  • "On-site" (often remote) - You will meet more members of the team, with rounds including product/design, operations, and engineering.
  • Offer! 🎉

We Care About

Customer Obsession - Everything we do should revolve around our customers. We can have great ideas as experienced product builders, but those ideas should come from a high degree of understanding of the problems our customers are experiencing.

Diversity - We believe that as a team our ability to solve problems is greater when we’re looking at the problems from different perspectives. This means we’re actively working to build a team of diverse backgrounds and experiences and building an inclusive environment that empowers individuality, empathy, and innovation.

Maturity - We want to work with people who can approach teamwork with empathy and humility. We’re all working hard to solve difficult problems, and along the way we might disagree about how to do that. How we positively resolve these conflicts matters and makes us a better team.

Apply for the job

Do you want to join our team as our new Full Stack Software Engineer? Then we'd love to hear from you!

title: Full Stack Support Developer (.NET with React/Angular)
descriptionHtml:
Senior Content Platform Support Engineer (.NET with React/Angular), content management systems CMS


Contract duration: 12 months and extendable.

Location: Hybrid 3 days per week from the The Hague offices.

Experience level: 6 to 12 years


We are looking for an experienced .NET Content Platform Support Engineer to support and maintain enterprise level content management and web platforms. This role is focused on debugging, troubleshooting, and supporting existing applications rather than new development. The ideal candidate will have strong exposure to content management stacks, modern web technologies, and the .NET framework, with the ability to work closely with digital, content, and business teams.


Key Responsibilities

• Support and troubleshoot applications built on the .NET framework

• Debug and resolve issues across content management platforms and web applications

• Work with digital content workflows including publishing, approvals, and versioning

• Collaborate with front end teams working in React and or Angular to resolve integration issues

• Analyze application logs, performance issues, and production incidents

• Provide root cause analysis and recommend long term fixes

• Ensure platform stability, availability, and performance

• Support deployment and release activities in coordination with DevOps teams

• Work closely with stakeholders to understand content and platform issues


Required Skills

• Strong understanding of the .NET framework with hands on debugging experience

• Experience supporting content management systems and content driven platforms

• Solid knowledge of web development fundamentals including HTML, CSS, JavaScript

• Working knowledge of React and or Angular from a support and integration perspective

• Understanding of digital content workflows and publishing processes

• Experience troubleshooting production issues in enterprise environments

• Ability to read and analyze existing code without being a core developer

  • Work closely with back-end developers to ensure seamless integration of front-end/UI requirements.

companySlogan: Don't just fit in, find your own perfect fit.
companyDescription:
Founded in Europe in 2000, Suitsupply has grown to over 100 international stores in cities such as Milan, London, Amsterdam, Zurich, Munich, New York, Toronto, Dubai, South Korea, Shanghai, Singapore and Hong Kong. In addition to our ever-expanding number of brick-and-mortar locations, we maintain a strong online presence, allowing Suitsupply to bring our style and top-tier service to all corners of the globe. 

In an industry where fast fashion dominates and craftsmanship is fast disappearing, Suitsupply introduces a better option: one where no attention to detail or quality is ever spared. That’s why we use only the finest Italian fabrics sourced from mills such as Ferla, E. Thomas, Larusmiani and Vitale Barberis Canonico.

We have received widespread accolade from the likes of GQ, Esquire, and, perhaps most notably, a Wall Street Journal blind test that rated a $600 Suitsupply suit in a first-place tie with a $3,600 Armani. 

While high-quality suiting at an affordable price point remain at the core of all that we do, our versatile range includes jackets, trousers, outerwear, shoes, accessories and attire available as prêt à porter and made-to-measure.

At Suitsupply, we pride ourselves in taking innovative approaches to traditional problems. This has led to the development of technologies such as our Design Your Own feature, our Garmentor app, and a commitment to in-house tailoring, providing quick alterations while you wait for a perfect fit every time. Each and every sales associate receives in-depth training through our acclaimed Suit School, bringing the unmatched level of passion and expertise that make Suitsupply’s customer service stand out.

The message is clear. We believe that nobody should leave Suitsupply with anything less than a perfect fit. If you’re equally devoted to quality, check out our jobs page for opportunities to join us.

title: PHP Developer
descriptionHtml:
*No visa sponsorship possible for this role*


As a PHP engineer, you ensure that the innovative cloud software of Exact Gripp works optimally on all modern browsers and devices. At Exact, your technical skills can lead to the most beautiful innovations. And where is your career heading? That’s up to you. The career opportunities are unprecedented. 2,000 enterprising colleagues have already paved the way. Are you on board?


This is the job you are looking for:

For our Exact Gripp development team, we are looking for an enthusiastic, talented Full Stack PHP Engineer. Someone who gets excited about new ideas and techniques in the field of both back-end and front-end development and ensures that our products function optimally.

Exact Gripp is the leading cloud software for professional services companies in the SMB sector. By digitizing activities, efficiency is increased, quality is improved, errors are prevented, and margins are maximized. Using one central system to manage business relations as well as hours registration, where the accounting is fully integrated and seamless integrations exist with many business apps. Due to innovation and a high level of user-friendliness, Exact Gripp is fast-growing professional services software in the market. Exact Gripp offers functionality for planning, projects, quotes, cost monitoring, time registration, invoicing, and dashboards. To stay ahead in the market, we are rapidly expanding these functionalities, and we could use your help!


This is your team:

The Development department of Exact Gripp is known for its creativity and innovative power, which enables it to translate the high demands of customers and the market into an easy-to-use web application with an attractive visual appearance. We work closely together and, together with our product managers, we are responsible for the development of our applications.


This is what you bring:

With us, you can be yourself, and we would love to discover what sets you apart. For the position of PHP Full Stack Engineer, it’s helpful if you have a sense of perseverance. And preferably you have a technical mindset, an eye for quality, and good communication skills. What’s more, you bring:

  • At least HBO level of thinking and working
  • A strong sense of responsibility and ownership
  • A positive attitude and the ability to be critical and think in solutions
  • 4–5 years of experience with PHP tech stack
  • Good knowledge of Symfony or Laravel (we work with Symfony)
  • Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and SQL (nice to have)
  • Experience with writing and maintaining unit tests
  • Up to date with the latest techniques and standards
  • Problem-solving skills using accepted best practices and principles such as SOLID and design patterns
  • Good communication skills in English


This is what you get:

  • A competitive salary in line with your experience
  • Additional benefits include holiday pay and a thirteenth-month bonus
  • 27 vacation days, with an extra day added for each year worked at Exact (up to a maximum of 5 days)
  • 3 Giving Back days, which can be used for volunteering for a charity of your choice
  • Unlimited training opportunities, from personal development to Salesforce Trailheads
  • A mix of office and remote work, with the team in the office for 2 days a week
  • Home-office supplies
  • 100% reimbursement for commuting with public transportation or €0.23 per km if by car
  • A good retirement plan


This = Our Hiring Process

  • Introductory interview with the hiring manager
  • A short coding assignment
  • Technical interview with two engineers
  • Final offer


This = Your Onboarding

We want to make sure you feel at home at Exact. That's why you start with a 6- to 8-week onboarding, depending on your experience, in addition to our company-wide generic onboarding of 2.5 days. You'll learn all about our products and dive deep into the importance of following security measures. And of course, there's plenty of time to get to know your new colleagues and workplace! We love to celebrate our successes at our barista coffee bar or during our Friday afternoon drinks with “bitterballen.”


Ready to Join?

We’d love to have you on our team! Apply via the link below. Our Talent Acquisition Specialist will reach out within 2–3 days to answer any questions and set up initial discussions with one of our Technology Directors. If mutual interest is established, you’ll undertake a coding challenge followed by a second interview to discuss feedback with your potential manager and colleagues. The selection process concludes within two weeks and, if successful, you’ll receive an offer to join us at Exact.
