title: Software Engineer (Java / React)
descriptionHtml:
Join us and help us structure the global web

Are you an experienced full stack developer, able to deliver a functional application that looks and feels good? Are you up to date with the latest techniques, and ready to put them to practice in maintaining our product? Then we might just be the right fit.

What You'll Do

We’re looking for a senior full stack web developer to collaborate closely with our development team, working together to maintain an optimally functioning platform, ensure system consistency, and create a great user experience. Ultimately, your work will have a direct impact on the stability and user experience of our product.

As we’re building our own product, you’ll have freedom in how to approach certain aspects of your work. Your focus will be on precision and quality, rather than speed and deadlines.

Who You Are

You like to stay informed of the latest changes and keep up with new developments in the field, and have a good vision of best practices. In addition:

  • You’re proficient in full stack development (3+ years experience)
  • You have experience with Java Spring Boot API development
  • You're skilled in React and frontend development
  • You're proficient with Tailwind CSS for styling
  • You have experience with Golang for backend development and data processing
  • You have experience writing unit and integration tests
  • You've worked on several (medium to large) projects
  • You're solution-oriented, analytical, and critical of your own work
  • You're legally allowed to work in the Netherlands

What We Offer

We're a young, dynamic tech company, and you'll be part of a smart, ambitious team on a mission to structure the global web. You’ll get all the benefits of working for an agile scale-up—a relaxed work environment, the possibility to work some days from home, easy-going colleagues, and freedom in your work.

Additionally, We Offer You

  • A competitive salary based on your experience
  • 25 days of paid annual leave*
  • A holiday allowance
  • A good pension insurance
  • An annual budget of €1.200 to spend on professional or personal development
  • The best hardware of your choice: Apple or Linux
  • Hybrid work model: a mix of working from home and in the office
  • A lounge room, an in-office pool table, and a fully equipped canteen
  • Healthy and delicious buffet breakfast and lunch, and a full refrigerator in the office
  • Everything you need to work from home: a screen, keyboard, and mouse
  • €78 budget for a lease bike including maintenance**
  • A €50 internet reimbursement*
  • A monthly Thuisbezorgd budget of €50 to enjoy a meal with your colleagues or family*
  • A monthly sports budget of €40 to stay healthy and in shape: get a gym membership or buy a pair of new sport shoes*
  • A mobile phone and a monthly mobile phone subscription reimbursement of €35*
  • A compensation fee of €2 per day when you work from home
  • Fun events with colleagues: 4 Mijl van Groningen, Startup Weekend Groningen, Thursday Drinks, Board Game Nights, Pub Quizzes, Pizza Knowledge Sessions, Ping-Pong Tournaments and our memorable Dataprovider.com Outings
  • A referral reward program: refer a friend for one of our jobs
  • based on a 40-hour contract ** Additional conditions apply

Dataprovider.com transforms the internet into an ever-growing structured database

The web is the world’s greatest information source—literally and figuratively. It contains more valuable information than all annual reports and trend analyses rolled into one. However, the web is also the greatest source of information chaos: it is difficult to extract qualitative data.

Founded in Groningen in 2012, Dataprovider.com has been structuring relevant digital actions into concrete insights that are used worldwide by leading organizations such as PayPal, Statistics Netherlands, United Nations, GoDaddy, Mollie, Takeaway.com and the investment industry. We’re growing fast, and we’re always on the lookout for new talent!

Our team

Our team consists of a wide range of professionals: data scientists, data support engineers, developers, designers, account managers, and more. It’s a blend of seasoned data engineers and developers who have been working here for years, and ambitious graduates who joined the team while they were students and become an inseparable part of Dataprovider.com ever since.

Our motto is Work hard, work together, and help each other out, always. When we aren’t working hard, we’re eating ice cream (anytime of the day or year) and playing board games, ping-pong, or American pool.

Join us and help us structure the global web

If you have any questions about working at Dataprovider.com or about the selection process, don’t hesitate to contact our recruiter Gijs for more information.

  • We’ll appreciate it if recruitment agencies don’t respond to this job opening.

Our selection process

  • Application If you’re interested in this job opening, click on the Apply button and send us your resume.
  • Coffee If your application is successful, you’ll get invited to an initial meeting or a phone/video call with our recruiter, Gijs. You can ask him anything you want to know about the job.
  • Interview In the second interview, you will show your knowledge and skills, and meet some members of the team.
  • Offer Congratulations! We’re making you an offer to join our team and help us structure the global web.
  • Welcome! You’re signing a contract and meeting your colleagues: nice to meet you!

companySlogan: At Dataprovider.com, we index the web and structure the data.
companyDescription:
At Dataprovider.com, we index the web and structure the data. 

The online world might seem abstract and endless, but our expertise is ordering the chaos. In our ever-growing database, you’ll find structured web information about over 800 million domains. A filterable index, 200+ data fields, four years of historical data: Dataprovider.com offers you the whole web in one place.

Our data captures information from and about every website, right as changes happen. Use our Search Engine to build a detailed overview of company websites, online stores, cybersecurity indicators, or online technologies. Zoom in with specialized filter combinations: discover how many websites are using Shopify, accept MasterCard, are built with WordPress, or find B2B companies that specialize in logistics in your city, country, or globally. Protect your brand by identifying domain abuse, weak security protocols, or counterfeit online stores.

We help you spot micro and macro trends. With monthly updates, monitor the adoption of web technologies and gauge the performance of the companies behind them. Explore our traffic indices to gain insights into website popularity and see the volume of transactions that online services attract.

With a sleek platform and an intuitive interface with data visualizations, we can show you (almost) everything about the internet. Seamless API integrations into your workflows make the data easily accessible even beyond our platform.

Based in the Netherlands, Dataprovider.com is a global tech company with European roots. Since 2012, we’ve been structuring web data and generating insights for top organizations across the globe, from business information, asset management, and brand protection industries, to academic research and national statistics offices. We take pride in ethical and high-quality operations—made possible with our proprietary data, gathered and structured with our own software—and make the (online) world less chaotic.

title: Senior Frontend Developer (Angular/NL)
descriptionHtml:
Vacature: Frontend Developer (Angular)

Voor een overheidsorganisatie zijn wij op zoek naar een Frontend Developer (Angular) die wil meewerken aan een grootschalige Angular-migratie en het doorontwikkelen van maatschappelijk relevante applicaties. Deze applicaties worden dagelijks gebruikt door duizenden eindgebruikers en hebben directe impact op de samenleving.

Binnen deze rol werk je in een multidisciplinair team aan meerdere nieuwe en lopende projecten. Er is veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng, technische keuzes en het meedenken over de toekomstbestendigheid van het frontend-landschap.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Meewerken aan een Angular-migratie binnen een complexe overheidsomgeving
  • Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van schaalbare frontend-applicaties
  • Actief meedenken over frontend-architectuur en best practices
  • Samenwerken met backend developers, designers en stakeholders
  • Bijdragen aan kwaliteit, performance en onderhoudbaarheid van de code

Technische stack

  • Angular
  • TypeScript
  • HTML / CSS / SCSS
  • Werken binnen een moderne CI/CD- en agile omgeving

Wat breng je mee?

  • Ervaring met Angular en TypeScript (medior of senior niveau)
  • Affiniteit met complexe applicaties en langdurige projecten
  • Je denkt graag mee over architectuur en technische verbeteringen
  • Ervaring binnen grote organisaties of de overheid is een pré

Wat krijg je ervoor terug?

  • Salaris tot €85.000 per jaar (afhankelijk van ervaring)
  • Inhoudelijk sterke rol met zichtbare maatschappelijke impact
  • Hybride werken: 2 à 3 dagen per week op kantoor
  • Veel ruimte voor groei, invloed en technische diepgang
  • Werken aan projecten met lange adem en stabiliteit

Interesse?

Klinkt dit als een rol die bij je past? Solliciteer dan direct!

title: Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Bouw mee aan IDIL: hét inkoopplatform voor de industrie


Aan de slag als Developer (24-40 uur)


Als Full Stack Developer werk je samen met je collega's aan IDIL, ons inkoopplatform waarmee producenten slimmer inkopen. Je schrijft code die direct impact heeft op hoe onze klanten hun grondstoffen, verpakkingen en diensten inkopen.


De techniek


We werken met Laravel (PHP) en zitten midden in een transitie van Vue 2 naar Filament. Je code push je naar GitLab waar onze CI-omgeving automatisch tests draait. Deployment doen we met Docker containers. Geautomatiseerd testen, Agile werken en code reviews vinden we belangrijk.


Over TiSG / Indusource

Vanuit ons kantoor in Sneek ondersteunen wij FMCG-fabrikanten bij het optimaliseren van hun inkoopproces. Met een team van 25 inkoopexperts en ons inkoopplatform IDIL helpen we klanten met source-to-contract activiteiten van grondstoffen, verpakkingen en diensten.


We groeien en hebben grote digitale ambities, vandaar dat we jou zoeken.


Wat bieden wij:

  • Een uitdagende rol bij een groeiend bedrijf met een tech-first aanpak
  • Werkplek in een rustige, afgesloten ruimte waar je ongestoord kunt focussen
  • High-end laptop en dito koptelefoon om in de zone te blijven!
  • Competitief salaris op basis van je ervaring en vaardigheden
  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, boven gemiddeld aantal vrije dagen, bijdrage in je pensioenregeling en opleidingsmogelijkheden
  • Een informele en inspirerende werkomgeving met ruimte voor persoonlijke groei en ontwikkeling
  • Een gezellig team, prettige werkomgeving, lunch, borrel en teamuitjes om de teamspirit te bevorderen


Wij denken aan iemand met:

  • HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van informatica
  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als Full Stack Developer
  • Uitstekende kennis van en ervaring met OOP, design patterns en SQL databases
  • Oog voor de onderhoudbaarheid van jouw werk en dat van je collega’s
  • Ervaring met het schrijven van integratie en unit testen
  • Ervaring met SPA's en een JavaScript framework zoals Vue.js Ervaring met Filament is een pre
  • Minimaal 3 dagen / week
  • Goede beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal
  • Je woont in Nederland


Het zou leuk zijn als je ook bijdrage kan leveren aan:

  • Het beheren van VPS servers en hier affiniteit en/of ervaring mee hebben
  • Het toepassen van nieuwe technieken zoals AI
  • Security op pijl houden
  • Mooi meegenomen is het ook als je al ervaring hebt met Laravel, PHP, MySQL en/of Redis


Ben je enthousiast geworden na het lezen van deze vacature en heb je nog vragen? Neem dan contact op met Wietse Nieuwenhuis, Pathfinder en eigenaar, via 0623013698 of wietse@indusource.nl.


Wil je liever gelijk solliciteren? Stuur jouw brief en CV naar werkenbij@indusource.nl.


Wij huren geen mensen in via derde partijen.

companySlogan: Onafhankelijke inkooporganisatie voor bedrijven in de voeding en consumentengoederen industrie (FMCG).
companyDescription:
Je houdt van je werk. De passie en ambitie uit die eerste jaren voel je nog steeds. Ze worden alleen af en toe overschaduwd door de uitdagingen die een volatiele markt met zich meebrengt, net als de pittige concurrentie en steeds weer strengere wetgeving. Het ontbreekt je simpelweg aan tijd, kennis en focus. Wij zijn er voor jou. 

Als strategisch partner begrijpen we dat risicobeheersing van cruciaal belang is. We nemen de druk weg door jouw inkoopprocessen te optimaliseren en te zorgen voor meetbare verbeteringen in jouw bedrijfsresultaat. Onze aanpak is gericht op tastbare resultaten die direct bijdragen aan zakelijk succes, waardoor jij je passie, ambitie en expertise kunt benutten zonder afgeleid te worden door operationele zorgen.

Wij verzorgen we het gehele inkoopproces van grondstoffen, verpakkingen en diensten binnen de fast moving consumer goods. Sinds 2006 werpen we de blik ver vooruit, vanuit onze eigenzinnige visie op een duurzame en sociale wereld. Ons team van ervaren inkoopspecialisten volgt dagelijks jouw markt en categorie, binnen en buiten de Benelux. 

Je krijgt toegang tot actuele marktinformatie en doet waardevolle nieuwe inzichten op dankzij onze zorgvuldige benchmark met 100 bedrijven. We creëren schaalvoordeel door orders te bundelen en zorgen voor betere spreiding. Je maakt ook kennis met onze innovatieve IT-oplossingen voor contractbeheer, factuurverwerking, matching en opvolging. 

Het resultaat? Grip op rendement. Zekerheid, door strategische inkoop. Alle risico’s zijn beheerst, dus jouw passie, ambitie en deskundigheid krijgen vrij spel. Samen zijn we specialist in alles.

#Samen #Specialist #InAlles

title: Full Stack (Kotlin + React) Developer
descriptionHtml:
About the job


Beatgrid is redefining cross-media measurement with breakthrough deep-tech innovation. Built on our own Automatic Content Recognition (ACR) technology, the world’s only hybrid of audio fingerprinting and watermarking, we provide deterministic, privacy-first insights that reveal true ad effectiveness across TV and digital platforms like Netflix and YouTube.

Trusted by global leaders such as Google, Amazon Prime, Disney+, and Netflix, we set a new standard for accuracy and transparency in an increasingly fragmented media landscape.

You’ll build our measurement apps, developed on Kotlin Multiplatform, and contribute to the backend systems that power them. You will work with the latest technologies, contribute to innovations no other company has built, and enjoy the pace and excitement of an ambitious deep-tech company.


About you


Responsibilities​

  • Develop and optimize backend services using Kotlin (with Spring Boot) and frontend systems with React.
  • Design, maintain, and optimize databases using RDS and Elasticsearch for high-performance analytics.
  • Implement and optimize asynchronous messaging systems (RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Take end-to-end ownership of features across the full stack from technical design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
  • Deploy and manage applications using Docker, AWS ECS, and Terraform (IaC).
  • Ensure reliability and observability with Sentry and OpenTelemetry.
  • Work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Work in a team that embraces Scrum principles and delivers efficiently.
  • Drive continuous improvement by enhancing performance, scalability, and usability.


Qualifications


Skills and Experience

  • Proven expertise in Kotlin and React for full-stack development.
  • Strong SQL and database architecture understanding, query optimization skills.
  • Experience with messaging systems like RabbitMQ and Kafka.
  • Familiarity with API design principles, data structures, and algorithms.
  • Cloud deployment experience (AWS preferred; Azure transferable).
  • Proactive problem-solving skills, independence, and accountability
  • Creative thinking, and high attention to detail


Bonus / Nice-to-have:

  • TypeScript experience for large-scale applications.
  • UX/UI design familiarity for collaboration with design teams.
  • NoSQL database experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform or other IaC tools.
  • Elasticsearch or other search/analytics tools experience.


What's in it for you?


Perks

  • The chance to work with breakthrough technology and opportunities to join cross-team
  • projects (such as our latest work with agentic AI).
  • Use the latest frameworks and languages (Kotlin 2.2, Spring Boot 4, and more).
  • A vibrant office in the heart of The Hague, surrounded by cafés, culture, and city life.
  • A fitness club subscription in our building (with professional instructors) to keep both
  • body and mind sharp.
  • Work from home / work abroad arrangements.
  • Competitive compensation.
  • An Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP), so you share in the value you help create and
  • benefit from future exit opportunities.


Who should apply and how


We’re looking for mid-level to senior-level professionals, but potential and talent matter most. If this role excites you and fits your skills, we’d love to hear from you!

Beatgrid thrives on a healthy, collaborative culture where passion meets impact. Join us to tackle ambitious challenges, work with cutting-edge technology, and help shape the future of cross-media measurement.


Please only apply if you have a valid VISA to work in the Netherlands.

companySlogan:
The Cross-Media Ad Effectiveness Currency:
No More Unreliable Claimed Exposure Data to Measure Cross-AV & OOH Campaigns.
companyDescription:
Beatgrid: The Cross-Media Advertising Effectiveness Currency

The demand for an innovative cross-media measurement solution with first-party deduplicated data has reached new heights. 

Measurement companies struggle to keep pace with solutions that fall short by relying on modeled demographics, census data, and algorithms to connect consumers with look-alike media behaviors for cross-media measurement.

We have successfully solved this problem with our cutting-edge single-source panel approach, powered by passive mobile Automatic Content Recognition (ACR) and Geofencing technology. 

No more guesswork! Beatgrid's new-wave TRUE Single-Source™ technology has shattered industry barriers to accurately spot deduplicated reach and frequency, as well as the brand lift effect, all at a person level, across AV and OOH advertising campaigns.

Join the new cross-media advertising effectiveness currency that forward-thinking CMOs, VPs of Ad Sales, and Market Intelligence Directors are using to optimize their cross-media advertising campaigns and cut on ad waste.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Beatgrid is a fast-growing adtech company, founded in 2014 and headquartered in The Hague, Netherlands. It is the only agnostic single-source and person-level cross-media measurement solution that accurately tracks deduplicated TV and cross-media advertising R&F, brand lift, and footfall efforts with accuracy.

title: Full Stack Engineer (6 months - freelancers welcome)
descriptionHtml:
For an exciting new project within the European Defence domain, we are looking for Full Stack Software Engineers to work mainly from home, except 1 day/week at the office, Starion’s premises in Leiden, Netherlands.


Within this 6-months missions, you will be working within a newly formed team of 6 to 7 professionals and together, you will build web applications for real time users who operate in complex and dynamic environments. These applications provide real time authorization for critical administrative processes, allowing the primary work to continue without delay.


Please note: Due to the specific nature of the project and client's domain, in order to access and work on classified data and restricted systems, preference has to be given to applicants holding a European citizenship and eligible for an EU security clearance.



About the client and location

STARION Group B.V. has two offices in the Netherlands: Noordwijk and Leiden. The teams support governmental and defence organizations with secure and scalable software solutions.

For this project, you can work remotely 4 days a week, as long as you live in the Netherlands and can be on Leiden’s site at least 1 day/week. During intensive phases, this could increase up to 2 days.


Tasks and activities

The scope of work will include:

  • Designing and building robust data driven applications.
  • Optimizing high throughput collaborative systems.
  • Working according to test driven development.
  • Jointly developing the supporting tools and libraries.
  • Performing verification and validation of the SW solutions.


Skills and experience

The following skills and experience are mandatory:

  • University Degree or equivalent in Software Engineering or other relevant fields.
  • At least 3 years of experience in C# , with Test Driven Design.
  • Proven knowledge of .NET Core and Blazor
  • Experience with the MVVM design pattern.
  • Solid understanding of Relational Databases, specifically PostgreSQL.
  • Understanding of Git, GitHub and Gitlab.
  • Desire to work both autonomously and as part of a team, in an international multicultural environment.
  • Solution oriented mindset, with a customer focused communication skill.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.


The following skills and experience are valuable assets:

  • Knowledge of Dutch, both written and spoken.
  • Experience in continuous integration tools.
  • Data modelling using languages such as Ecore or UML.
  • Containerization technologies such as Docker.
  • Developing mobile and/or web applications using TypeScript or JavaScript.


Why should you apply?

  • You will have the opportunity to work within leading space and defence organisations across Europe.
  • We encourage everyone to think outside the box and to push the boundaries of traditional knowledge. This role is an opportunity to join a forward-thinking company and allows for a deeper understanding of the industry.
  • To be part of a company that values integrity, inspiration, care and collaboration.
  • Benefits include: competitive remuneration packages; unique career opportunities, including working in other countries; access to training and development programmes; flexible relocation support


We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to achieving diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all candidates, irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.


As part of our commitment to providing an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment process, we will provide reasonable adjustments and support to ensure neuro-diverse applicants or those with a disability or long-term condition can be their best during the recruitment process.

title: Back-end PHP developer
descriptionHtml:
Vacature

Back-end PHP developer

HBOFulltimeBarendrechtAPI'sLaravelMySQLJavaScriptVueWordPress

Jouw baan als Back-end PHP developer

Samen met de tech lead denk je de oplossing uit, waarna je zelf of met je collega’s aan de slag gaat om deze oplossing te realiseren. Deze vragen zijn heel divers: Headless webshop voor een internationaal B2B groothandel, koppeling met externe systemen waarbij er in één keer 10.000 artikelen op de site komen of een klantportaal waarop laboratorium- en order informatie vanuit een ERP weergegeven moeten worden.

Je werkt bij ons niet alleen met technische mensen, maar ook met creatieve ontwerpers. Die zorgen ervoor dat wat je maakt, er ook altijd goed uit ziet. Daarnaast werk je samen met projectmanagers die zorgen voor goed voorbereide opdrachten.

Jouw skills

  • Een pro-actieve ontwikkelaar met een positieve mindset.
  • Je hebt HBO+ werk- en denkniveau met minimaal 2 jaar bureau werkervaring.
  • Je kunt goed zelfstandig werken, maar bent ook zeker een team-player.
  • Ervaring met externe API-integraties, ontwerpen en bouwen van solide API’s.
  • Kennis van Laravel framework en eco systeem.
  • Ervaring met JavaScript frameworks zoals Vue.
  • Je werkt oplossingsgericht en kan goed analytisch denken.
  • MySQL databases uitdenken en opzetten.
  • Ervaring met HTML, CSS, JavaScript & WordPress is een pre.

Onze tegenprestatie

  • Al je collega’s zijn makkelijk in de omgang, net als onze klanten.
  • Een leuke uitdagende baan met veel ruimte voor jouw ideeën en inbreng
  • Een job voor 32-40 uur per week met mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken.
  • Een passend salaris met uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden.
  • Persoonlijk budget voor het bijwonen van events & trainingen.
  • Gezellige en informele werksfeer: werken in een hecht team.
  • Een creatieve en inspirerende werkplek in Barendrecht (op loopafstand van Station Lombardijen).
  • Een MacBook Pro van de zaak.

title: Stage Frontend Developer
descriptionHtml:
Als ervaren recruiter weet ik dat je bij stagiairs niet moet zoeken naar de "perfecte professional", maar naar potentie, passie en leergierigheid. Een vacaturetekst voor een stagiair moet daarom vooral uitstralen dat er ruimte is om te leren en fouten te maken, terwijl ze wel werken aan serieuze projecten.

Hier is een herschreven, wervende versie in het Nederlands, specifiek afgestemd op een Frontend Development Stagiair.

Vacature: Meewerkstage Frontend Development

Bouw jij mee aan de digitale overheid van morgen? Bij Atabix maken we digitale dienstverlening eenvoudiger voor burgers en professionals. Wat in 2009 begon, is uitgegroeid tot een team van ruim 170 experts die dagelijks impact maken. Met onze software helpen we overheden hun werkprocessen te digitaliseren. Minder papierwerk, snellere dienstverlening en applicaties die écht werken.

Wij groeien hard en zoeken talent dat verder kijkt. Zie jij kansen? Wil je code schrijven die er niet alleen goed uitziet, maar ook maatschappelijk relevant is? Dan is dit jouw plek.

Jouw rol als Stagiair Frontend Tijdens deze stage draai je volwaardig mee in een van onze ontwikkelteams. Je wordt niet weggestopt in een hoekje, maar werkt samen met ervaren Front-end Developers, Back-enders en Designers aan applicaties en microservices voor onze klanten of ons eigen product, de Atabase Suite.

Je leert hoe je designs vertaalt naar strakke, werkende interfaces. Schone code, schaalbaarheid en user experience staan hierbij centraal.

  • Leren & Bouwen: Je werkt aan de user interface van onze applicaties en zorgt dat deze intuïtief en snel werken.
  • Samenwerken: Je schakelt met designers over de 'look and feel' en met back-enders over de data-integratie.
  • Quality Code: Je leert werken volgens moderne standaarden. Je schrikt niet van een code review; sterker nog, daar leer je juist van.
  • Oog voor Design: Jij wordt enthousiast als pixels op de juiste plek staan en de gebruikerservaring soepel verloopt.

Wie ben jij? Je bent bezig met een relevante HBO- of WO-opleiding (bijvoorbeeld Informatica, Software Engineering of CMD) en zoekt een plek waar je jouw skills naar een hoger niveau kunt tillen. Je hoeft nog niet alles te weten, maar je moet wél alles willen leren.

  • Passie voor code: Je hebt naast je studie al eens geproefd aan programmeren. Misschien heb je een eigen website gebouwd, een project op GitHub staan of certificaten gehaald die laten zien dat je meer wilt dan alleen de basis.
  • Tech stack: Je hebt basiskennis van HTML, CSS en JavaScript/TypeScript. Ervaring met een framework (zoals Vue, React of Angular) is een grote pre.
  • Soft Skills: Je snapt dat software bouwen teamsport is. Misschien heb je dit geleerd tijdens een bijbaan, een bestuursjaar of in de sportkantine: jij weet hoe je communiceert en samenwerkt.
  • Taal: Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands.

Wat bieden wij jou? Bij Atabix kom je terecht in een warm bad. We zijn vakkundig, daadkrachtig en betrokken.

  • Uitstekende begeleiding: Je krijgt een ervaren mentor die je helpt groeien.
  • Stagevergoeding: Een marktconforme vergoeding voor je harde werk.
  • Ruimte voor school: Moet je een onderzoek doen of een opdracht voor school afronden? Daar maken we tijd voor.
  • Cultuur: Een gezellige lunch, borrels, teamuitjes en een kantoor waar je jezelf mag zijn.

title: PHP Developer
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een ervaren PHP Developer die graag werkt aan uitdagende projecten met impact? Bij een modern full-service digital agency in Rotterdam krijg je de kans om complexe platforms, e-commerceoplossingen en AI-gedreven software te bouwen voor bekende merken in Nederland.


Waarom jij dit interessant vindt

  • Je werkt aan high-impact projecten: van e-commerce tot maatwerkapplicaties en AI-oplossingen.
  • Invloed op technische keuzes en ruimte om standaarden te bepalen.
  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden richting lead of architect.
  • Hybride werken, maar mét sterke samenwerking op kantoor.


Wat ga je doen?

  • Ontwikkelen van backend-functionaliteit in PHP
  • Werken met frameworks zoals Laravel, Craft, Magento
  • Ontwerpen en realiseren van API-koppelingen en integraties
  • Meebouwen aan headless interfaces met React, Vue of Next.js
  • Meedenken over architectuur, security en technische richting
  • Ondersteunen van collega-developers, met kans op een lead-rol


Wat breng je mee?

  • Minimaal 6 jaar ervaring als PHP Developer
  • Ervaring met moderne frameworks (Symfony, Laravel)
  • Sterke basis in database-ontwerp
  • Teamspirit en proactieve houding
  • CI/CD & Docker ervaring is een pré


Wat krijg je?

  • Salaris: €5.000 – €5.500 bruto p/m
  • Werkweek: 32–40 uur
  • Bonusregeling, pensioen, 25 vakantiedagen
  • Laptop & moderne werktools
  • Budget voor opleiding & certificeringen
  • Hybride werkmogelijkheden
  • Gezamenlijke lunch & teamactiviteiten


Waarom nu instappen?

De organisatie groeit hard, projecten worden complexer en jouw senioriteit kan het verschil maken. Dit is hét moment om invloed uit te oefenen en samen met ons het platformlandschap verder te professionaliseren.


Klaar om impact te maken?

title: Senior Full stack developer
descriptionHtml:
At Learned, we help organizations truly support the growth of their people. With our modern HR platform, we transform traditional HR processes into a future-proof approach where performance, development, and feedback take center stage. Today, hundreds of companies – from fast-growing scale-ups to established corporates – rely on our software. And we’re growing fast. That’s why we’re looking to strengthen our development team – are you our new Senior Full Stack Developer? We are also looking for someone with ambition to grow to a lead full stack developer, so if that’s you? Read on!


Please note: for this role, it is important that you already live in the Netherlands and are able to work at the office in Utrecht three days a week.


Together, we make the difference – here’s what you’ll do

As a Senior Full Stack Developer (MERN Stack), you’ll take a leading role in designing, developing, and maintaining our SaaS platform. You’ll work across the entire stack, from designing intuitive user interfaces in React to building scalable APIs and backend services with Node.js. You collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to turn ideas into high-impact features that our customers love.


Your average week as a senior full stack developer in Utrecht looks like this:

  • Collaborate with product and design teams to scope and build new features that improve the user experience
  • Take part in four weekly sprints with your colleagues
  • Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code using modern TypeScript, React, Node.js, and MongoDB
  • Architect and implement performant and secure REST APIs that power our platform
  • Lead technical design sessions and contribute to system architecture decisions
  • Review pull requests, mentor junior developers, and help uphold high engineering standards
  • Contribute to improving developer workflows, CI/CD processes, and automated testing
  • Take ownership of projects from planning through deployment, ensuring timely delivery and high quality


In short: thanks to your work, our platform becomes faster, smarter, and more scalable – allowing customers to grow and enabling Learned to reach the next level.


What do you bring?

You’re someone who loves to build smart, scalable applications that make a real impact. You enjoy working across the stack and thrive in an environment where ownership, creativity, and growth go hand in hand.


  • You have 5+ years of experience as a full stack developer and feel at home in the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js)
  • You're fluent in JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript, and know how to build clean, scalable, and maintainable code using modern design patterns and best practices
  • You bring a sharp eye for user experience – not just in the browser, but also in how you structure APIs and backend flows
  • You’re comfortable taking the lead on technical decisions, enjoy mentoring others, and bring your team along through feedback and code reviews
  • You’re someone who sees opportunities where others see blockers – and you like to think ahead, solve problems proactively, and keep improving
  • Last but not least: you're curious, open to learning, and excited about building a platform that helps people grow at work – just like you


What can you expect from us?

At Learned at our brand new office in Utrecht, you’ll join a fast-growing, young company that’s reshaping the traditional HR market. Since our start in 2019, we've been working with a driven, international team to transform the HR industry. We’re ambitious and entrepreneurial, always moving forward toward our big goals. But having fun is just as important to us: we share healthy, fully catered lunches at the office every day and organize monthly team activities.


Here’s what you can count as a full stack developer in Utrecht on:


  • A salary between €5.250 - €6.000 gross per month (based on 40 hours & depending on your experience) and with growth potential!
  • The oppurtunity to grow to a Lead developer role on short-term
  • A MacBook and everything you need to do your job well
  • 25 vacation days based on full-time employment
  • You work at least 3 days at the office, with flexible days beyond that
  • Travel expense reimbursement via our mobility plan
  • Pension plan via Brand New Day: 10%, with 50% paid by us
  • A personal development budget of €1.000 per year (based on full-time)
  • An ambitious, international environment (with over 7 nationalities!) where we challenge each other and celebrate success together


Sounds good? Great. We'd love to hear from you – and who knows, maybe we'll be getting to know each other soon. 😉

title: Fullstack developer (Laravel, Vue, Nuxt, NextJS) bij AI development agency
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij deel uitmaken van een revolutie in softwareontwikkeling? Bij SevenLab geloven we in de kracht van AI om de toekomst vorm te geven. Met onze unieke Software Development As A Service methode nemen we alle frustraties van traditionele softwareontwikkeling weg en realiseren we cutting edge (gen)AI toepassingen.


We zijn op zoek naar een getalenteerde Fullstack Developer (backend ervaring, Vue) die ons team komt versterken en meewerkt aan innovatieve AI-oplossingen voor onze klanten.


Taken

  • Ontwikkelen van schaalbare en krachtige (AI) applicaties met behulp van het Vue-framework

  • Samenwerken met ons team van ongeveer 15 collega's aan end-to-end AI-applicatieontwikkeling

  • Incidenteel gebruik van low-code platforms zoals n8n i.c.m. je fullcode ervaring en skills

  • Vertalen van complexe AI-concepten naar praktische toepassingen voor onze klanten

  • Bijdragen aan het continu verbeteren van onze Software Development As A Service methode


Vereisten

  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met fullstack ontwikkeling, waarvan minstens 2 jaar met met een backend taal zoals nextjs, nuxt, node, laravel

  • Sterke kennis van JavaScript (bij voorkeur ervaring met Vue of Angular), HTML en CSS

  • Kennis van en ervaring met backend frameworks

  • Ervaring met het ontwerpen en implementeren van RESTful API's

  • Bekend met versiebeheer

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift

  • Ervaring met AI-technologieën zoals Machine Learning is een pré

  • Proactieve en klantgerichte instelling

  • Analytisch sterk en in staat om complexe problemen op te lossen

  • HBO / WO geschoold


Benefits

  • 28 vakantiedagen per jaar

title: Full stack-ontwikkelaar
descriptionHtml:
Werken aan websites die dagelijks miljoenen mensen bereiken?

Bij deze organisatie bouw je mee aan het advertentie-ecosysteem achter een aantal van de grootste online platformen van Nederland.


Bedrijfsprofiel

Deze organisatie combineert content, data en technologie op grote schaal. Hun platformen trekken dagelijks honderdduizenden bezoekers en draaien op infrastructuur waar performance en efficiëntie centraal staan.


Binnen het team werken developers, designers, marketeers en data specialisten samen aan high-traffic omgevingen waar innovatie nooit stilstaat. De sfeer is professioneel maar informeel: nuchter, nieuwsgierig en met ruimte voor eigen ideeën. Er wordt gewerkt vanuit een modern kantoor in Amsterdam Overamstel, waar samenwerken en plezier hand in hand gaan.


Functieomschrijving

Door de groei van het platform is er ruimte voor een Full Stack Developer binnen het advertising engineering team. In deze rol werk je aan het technische hart van de advertentie-infrastructuur, die maandelijks miljoenen impressies verzorgt over meer dan 150 websites en verschillende apps.


Je bent geen typische frontend developer: je bouwt systemen, tools en scripts die zorgen dat advertenties efficiënt, privacyproof en winstgevend worden geserveerd.


Wat je gaat doen:

  • Ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van advertentieblokken en banners met maximale performance en gebruiksvriendelijkheid
  • Bouwen en onderhouden van high-performance ad scripts met minimale afhankelijkheden
  • Werken aan CMP-flows (Consent Management) en privacy-compliant delivery
  • Automatiseren van processen rondom bidding, rapportage en inventory management
  • Monitoren van performance, testen van nieuwe formaten en meedenken over innovaties
  • Analyseren van browsergedrag en optimaliseren op renderingniveau
  • Samenwerken met sales- en productteams om directe business impact te realiseren


Het is een rol met veel autonomie en zichtbaarheid: jouw code gaat direct live en heeft impact op miljoenen gebruikers.


Functie-eisen

Wat je in huis hebt:

  • Sterke kennis van JavaScript of TypeScript, HTML en CSS
  • Ervaring met moderne frameworks zoals React, Vue of Next.js
  • Interesse in browser performance en advertising ecosystemen
  • Een pragmische, oplossingsgerichte houding
  • Ervaring met CMP’s, programmatic of Google Ads is een plus
  • Zelfstandig kunnen werken en eigenaarschap tonen
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en teammentaliteit


Arbeidsvoorwaarden

Naast een uitdagende rol krijg je uitstekende voorwaarden:

  • Salaris tot €70.000 per jaar
  • 100% reiskostenvergoeding
  • 24 vakantiedagen
  • Laptop naar keuze
  • Persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget
  • Nieuw kantoor in Amsterdam Overamstel
  • Toegang tot relevante events en conferenties
  • Gratis abonnement op hun platformen
  • Hybride werken (dinsdag en vrijdag op kantoor)


Email l.verweij@haystackpeople.nl voor extra vragen

title: Frontend Engineer - CMS Platform
descriptionHtml:
Job Description Summary:


Own and evolve our enterprise Content Management platform (Contentstack) as a reliable, secure, and scalable foundation for content operations across brands and markets. You will build and maintain extensions and integrations, steward platform governance (roles, workflows, environments), and act as the technical counterpart to the vendor— ensuring that architecture choices, usage patterns, and operations comply with our contractual, security, and data‑protection obligations while empowering product and content teams to ship value faster.


Key responsibilities:


  • Platform ownership & roadmap – Serve as the technical owner for Contentstack: define platform guardrails, backlog, and evolution strategy in line with our API‑first/composable architecture and editorial needs.
  • Build & maintain extensions – Design, develop, and run extensions, webhooks, and Automation Hub flows; integrate services (e.g., translation, search, personalization) and keep them resilient, observable, and cost‑efficient.
  • Release & environment management – Establish CI/CD for schemas, roles, and configuration in close collaboration with DevOps; manage branches/environments, versioning, and safe rollouts.
  • Governance & access control – Operate robust RBAC, SSO/SCIM, and content workflows; ensure segregation of duties across global/local roles and auditability of changes.
  • Operational excellence (SRE mindset) – Define SLOs, monitor availability, performance, and API/bandwidth quotas; lead incident response and post‑mortems; continuously reduce MTTR and change failure rate.
  • Vendor management & compliance – Act as day‑to‑day technical counterpart to Contentstack: track SLA/SLO adherence, coordinate adoption of new features, and ensure platform usage stays within MSA/DPA/security terms.
  • Architecture alignment – Ensure integrations and usage patterns follow our API‑first, loosely‑coupled architecture; partner with solution architects to keep the CMS decoupled from channel frontends.
  • Key integrations – Connect the CMS with adjacent platforms (e.g., DAM, commerce, search, translation) and maintain reliable data flows and CDNs; contribute to progressive adoption of the target DAM.
  • Enablement & documentation – Produce runbooks, admin guides, and “how‑to” content; coach content editors and engineers; keep Skillbook/portal pages current.


Competencies/Skills for position:


  • CMS/Contentstack expertise – Hands‑on with Content Delivery/Management/APIs, environments/branches, roles, and webhooks.
  • Software engineering fundamentals – Strong vanilla Javascript know-how, Vue.js/NUXT or similar; serverless/event‑driven design
  • Architecture patterns – Comfortable with MACH/composable and API‑first designs; able to keep frontends decoupled and services loosely coupled.
  • Security & data protection – Practical knowledge of SSO/SCIM, least‑privilege, audit logging; familiarity with contractual/security addenda and DPA obligations.
  • Integration skills – Experience integrating CMS with DAM, commerce, search, and translation systems; understanding of CDN/image optimization.
  • Vendor & stakeholder management – Able to translate platform needs into vendor actions; clear communication with product, content, DevOps, security, and legal partners.
  • Enablement & documentation – Proven record creating admin guides/runbooks and enabling editors/engineers through training and self‑service resources.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
descriptionHtml:
About The Job

We are looking to extend our team in the Netherlands (Groningen office) with an experienced frontend developer who embraces modern, AI-enhanced development practices. We're here to change the world of development, make it better! We're integrating Business, Development, and Operations in one platform: that's BizDevOps for you!

The traditional boundaries in software development are evolving. We're looking for a frontend specialist who leverages AI to accelerate their work, stays current with emerging technologies, and understands that modern development means working smarter with intelligent tools as your companion.

If this sounds interesting please continue reading, we’ll keep it short and efficient:

Core Frontend Skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or similar technical field of study, or equivalent practical experience
  • 3+ years of experience with HTMX, React, Vue, Angular, or similar frontend frameworks.
  • Professional HTMX experience is a must.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS
  • Experience with Git or other version control systems
  • Good knowledge of how browsers work in terms of performance, security, and functionality
  • Experience with developing for different types of platforms and device sizes
  • Understanding of proper testing strategies

AI-Enhanced Workflow

  • Experience using AI development tools to enhance productivity and code quality
  • Understanding of how to effectively collaborate with AI assistants for frontend development
  • Knowledge of AI development best practices and limitations
  • Ability to evaluate when to leverage AI assistance versus fundamental development skills

Nice to haves

  • Experience with frontend testing tools like Cypress
  • Knowledge of performance optimization and web vitals
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing
  • Understanding of modern web development practices
  • Experience working in an agile product development environment
  • Interest in or experience with integrating AI/ML capabilities into frontend applications

Skills & mindset

  • Speaking Dutch: An absolute must.
  • Design-focused: Good feel for design and user experience
  • Adaptive problem solver: Can work independently, but knows when to ask questions or collaborate
  • Great team player: Communicate effectively and translate requirements into well-designed technical solutions
  • AI-native approach: Think strategically about how AI can solve problems and enhance your workflow
  • Growth-oriented: Stay current with frontend trends and AI-powered development practices
  • Strong communicator: Excellent English communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

title: Full-Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Over Het Bedrijf

  • Wil jij werken met slimme GIS-oplossingen voor de buitenruimte?
  • Ben jij een full-stack developer met een passie voor innovatie?
  • Heb jij ervaring in ColdFusion, PostgreSQL en frontend?

Vaste baan: Full-Stack Developer ColdFusion GIS | €4.000 - €6.200

Wij ontwikkelen flexibele software voor beheer openbare ruimte.

We koppelen geo-informatie met slimme kaartapplicaties.

Je werkt in een hecht team met veel technische vrijheid.

Jouw Werkzaamheden Als Full-Stack Developer ColdFusion GIS SaaS

  • Ontwikkelen ColdFusion-componenten voor backend-functionaliteit
  • Realiseren van kaartfunctionaliteit met OpenLayers
  • Bouwen en onderhouden van mobiele apps
  • Optimaliseren ruimtelijke dataopslag met PostgreSQL PostGIS
  • Bijdragen aan een schaalbare SaaS-architectuur

Het Ideale Profiel Voor Deze Functie

  • HBO of WO in Informatica of Geoinformatica
  • 2–5 jaar ervaring als full-stack developer
  • Kennis van GIS, PostGIS en GeoServer
  • Ervaring met ColdFusion en OpenLayers
  • Bekend met REST-API’s en geodataformaten

Als Full-Stack Developer ColdFusion GIS SaaS bij dit bedrijf in Wageningen kun je rekenen op:

  • Brutosalaris €4.000 - €6.200 per maand per maand (40u)
  • Deeltijd werken is bespreekbaar in overleg
  • Werken aan kaartgerichte SaaS-oplossingen met GIS
  • Gebruik moderne tools zoals ChatGPT en AI
  • Direct contact met eindgebruikers en beheerprocessen

Eenvoudig Solliciteren

title: Stage: Front-end Developer in Groningen
descriptionHtml:
Ter aanvulling op ons ambitieuze Development Team hebben wij per september 2025 een stageplaats beschikbaar voor een enthousiaste Front-end Developer. Wil jij echt iets leren en ben je bereid om ook verantwoordelijkheden te dragen? Dan heten we je graag welkom bij B2. Bij ons ben je meer dan "de stagiair". Je draait vanaf dag één mee als volwaardig lid van ons team.

Solliciteer direct!

Wie is B2?

B2 is een internetbureau in de stad Groningen dat bestaat sinds 2004. Naast het realiseren van websites, webshops en huisstijlen verzorgen wij de online marketing voor onze klanten. Klanten in allerlei soorten en maten.

Naast werk vinden we gezelligheid erg belangrijk. De successen en mijlpalen die we behalen, vieren we met zijn allen. Wekelijks wordt er een vrijdagmiddagborrel georganiseerd, waarbij we onder het genot van een drankje een potje Mario Kart of darts spelen. Oftewel, een goede afsluiting van de werkweek.

Je toekomstige stageomgeving

Als Front-end Development stagiair(e) bij B2 ben je vanaf de eerste dag een sparringpartner voor ons gehele team. Natuurlijk heb je je eigen opdrachten en verantwoordelijkheden, maar we houden de lijntjes naar collega’s graag kort. We zijn elkaars collega’s, niet elkaars manager. Je zult dan ook volwaardig meedraaien, maar uiteraard word je daarin goed begeleid door personen die, net zoals jij, passie hebben voor webdesign.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een MBO/HBO/WO student(e) in de richting van web development of applicatie ontwikkeling. Je wil tijdens je stage leren om te werken in een team van online specialisten om de mooiste websites & webshops te realiseren.

title: Full-stack developer      .
descriptionHtml:
What are you going to do?

Are you a developer who thrives on building solutions from the ground up? Do you want to make a real impact in healthcare while enjoying the agility of a start-up and the stability of an established company? Then let’s grab a coffee (or tea).

As a Full-Stack Developer on the MediKIT team, you’ll create solutions that support and relieve GPs and their assistants so they can focus on providing care. Our product, MediKIT, is a web-based SaaS Electronic Health Record (EHR) originally built by an independent start-up and part of Nedap for the past year. This gives us the speed and flexibility of a start-up combined with the stability and resources of a well-established organisation.

You’ll work on technology that has an immediate impact on healthcare professionals. Your focus is on rapidly delivering functional applications, with time-to-market as a major driver. That means taking a pragmatic approach and solving problems end-to-end—without striving for perfect code or architecture.

Responsibilities

 Your responsibilities

  • Developing back-end components for the MediKIT platform, with an emphasis on robustness and scalability.
  • Working across the full stack, switching between back-end and front-end to rapidly deliver functional applications.
  • Collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to create innovative solutions that meet GPs’ needs.
  • Exploring and implementing new technologies that further optimise MediKIT.
  • Delivering new features quickly and effectively, without getting bogged down in unnecessary complexity.

Your team

As a Full-Stack Developer you’ll be part of the MediKIT team—a dynamic group within Nedap that blends start-up energy with the strength of a large organisation and ready to scale up. You’ll work closely with fellow developers, UX designers and domain experts to keep improving the platform.

Our offer

As a Full-stack Developer at Nedap, you make a valuable contribution to our mission: helping people become happier and more successful in their professional lives.

In addition to your salary, you’ll receive a thirteenth month’s pay, a solid pension plan, and profit sharing with the opportunity to become a Nedap shareholder.

At Nedap, everything revolves around trust and autonomy. That’s why, along with your colleagues, you decide on your own working hours and vacation days to maintain a healthy work-life balance.

We also place great importance on both personal and professional growth. You’ll receive a thorough introduction and are encouraged to keep developing yourself throughout your career.

Curious about all our terms of employment? Read more here.

Required

 Required experience and skills

As a Full-Stack Developer you’ll have a major impact on the success of the MediKIT team. It’s important that you:

  • Have at least seven years of professional experience.
  • Possess solid back-end expertise yet feel comfortable working across the full stack.
  • Are self-starting and eager to learn, able to devise solutions independently.
  • Work pragmatically and solution-oriented, rather than getting lost in theoretical perfection.
  • Thrive in a start-up environment where initiative and autonomy are essential.
  • Are familiar with TypeScript, React and Python—or willing to master these technologies quickly.

Nedap is a leader in Digital Twin Technology, bridging the physical and digital worlds in Healthcare, Livestock, Retail and Security. Through our Technology for Life philosophy, we create and scale sustainable, forward-thinking solutions that help people and organizations succeed in an ever-changing world.

We are a proud team of over 1,000 people working together to make a global impact. title: Full Stack Developer
location: Capelle aan den IJssel, South Holland, Netherlands
descriptionHtml:
Are you completely ready to showcase your skills as a Fullstack Developer at a fast-growing, international scale-up? Within our driven development team, we offer you the chance to play a crucial role in achieving our ambitious goals. Will you be the driving force behind our data goldmine? Then come aboard quickly and be part of our winning team!

Who are we?

At Leadinfo, we dominate the B2B marketing world! Leadinfo is the number one in B2B lead generation. We believe not just in numbers and campaigns but in a mix of creativity, passion, and discovering new possibilities. We are a vibrant scale-up with our headquarters in Rotterdam. We have thousands of clients and collaborate with more than 2,500 marketing agencies and major players like LinkedIn, Google, and HubSpot. Our mission? To provide every business with top-quality leads! Our young team of 80 colleagues, including 10+ software developers and data engineers, has a strong winner’s mentality to achieve this goal. We operate from our offices in the Netherlands, Belgium, Italy, Denmark, and Germany.

What will you be doing?

As a Fullstack Developer at Leadinfo, you will have a challenging and responsible role where you will work on our product, more specifically our internal tools and applications. Our goal is to provide the best user experience, and we always strive to achieve this to the fullest. That's why we constantly push the technology and iterate on all features to deliver maximum results and nothing less than a wow effect.

Your responsibilities:

  • Development and maintenance of our tools and applications: As a Fullstack Developer at Leadinfo.com, you will work on the development and maintenance of web scraping tools and related applications used to collect and analyze data from various websites. This includes writing code to extract and process data from different sources and integrating it into the platform.
  • Expansion of applications to new countries: At Leadinfo, we are growing fast and want to conquer the world with our product. To achieve this, it’s essential to build applications for our international expansion.
  • Research and development of new technologies: You will be continuously researching and implementing new technologies and frameworks to improve the platform’s performance and further optimize the user experience.
  • Mentor junior engineers, follow DevOps practices and set up best practices: As an experienced developer we expect more than just building features and reviewing code. You should help us improve our standards, put in place best practices and a culture of ownership and DevOps mentality and mentor and coach our juniors.


Requirements:

To get started as a Fullstack Developer at Leadinfo.com, you will need more than 4 years of experience as a software developer and will work with various tools and technologies, including:

  • PHP 8+ and Slim framework (no experience specifically with PHP version 8 or Slim required)
  • Cloud computing with AWS
  • Front-end development with React
  • Experience with DevOps practices and being responsible for deployment
  • The Leadinfo winner’s mentality, with passion and enthusiasm to improve every day
  • Enjoys hybrid working, both at our Dutch office and from home


Perks at Leadinfo:

At Leadinfo, we value your efforts! What do you get in return?

  • 26 vacation days + an extra day off on your birthday
  • Pension plan
  • €50 per month to spend as you like (e.g., sports, hotel stays, meal boxes, and much more)
  • A healthy work/life balance, hybrid working environment
  • MacBook
  • An international team
  • Lunch and snacks every day
  • Pool table, Xbox, and Mario Kart on the Switch
  • Lots of fun, Friday afternoon drinks, and parties!


We believe everyone can win! This is Leadinfo and we are founded on the belief that everyone can be successful and, ultimately, win. Therefore, we seek out what’s best for our customers and for our people.

Wie zoeken we?

Wij zoeken een stagiair die graag meer wil leren over het maken van websites. Je volgt nu bijvoorbeeld een opleiding in de richting van Informatica of Communication & Multimedia design en je woont op maximaal zo’n 40 minuten van ons kantoor in Assen. Binnen Pienter loop je mee bij onze webafdeling, waar de developers jouw meenemen in de dagelijkse werkzaamheden.   • een gezellig team dat jou goed gaat begeleiden;
  • mooie klanten met leuke opdrachten;
  • ruimte voor eigen inbreng;
  • een passende stagevergoeding.

Wij zijn Pienter, een online marketingbureau. Heb je een uitdaging ,dan gaan we die samen aan. Want samen krijg je de zaken slim op een rijtje. 

Sinds 2013 helpen wij bedrijven bij het behalen van hun online doelstelling. Want werk je met Pienter, dan werk je met mensen die gewoon jouw taal spreken. Allemaal vanuit hun eigen online specialisme en samen de sterkste. 

Leren door te doen en op een nuchtere manier je hersens gebruiken. Daar verleggen we grenzen mee en helpen we bedrijven een stap verder. Dat is waar we elke dag samen voor gaan. Dat zie je terug in onze klanten, ons werk én op de werkvloer.

title: (Senior) PHP Laravel Developer
descriptionHtml:
Your Role

We’re building a multi-platform DataHub for the hospitality vertical, a SaaS solution that seamlessly connects multiple systems. This platform empowers businesses like restaurants and hotels to streamline operations, from processing room charges within hotel systems to enabling loyalty programs for Point-of-Sale systems and beyond. As a (Senior) PHP Laravel Developer, your focus will be on enhancing the current product, making key architectural decisions, developing integrations and elevating overall code quality within the team.

Your work impacts thousands of customers daily. Thanks to you, Natalia can seamlessly charge her dinner to her hotel room, and Robert can redeem his loyalty points for a discount on his next stay. The integrations you build run so smoothly that guests and staff never have to think about the data behind the scenes, it just works.

Key Responsibilities

  • Tackle complex business challenges with the team, finding solutions where others see obstacles.
  • Collaborate and support your teammates, helping them overcome technical hurdles.
  • Optimize API integrations with our partners, ensuring the most efficient and effective implementation.
  • Review and refine code, enhancing both your own skills and those of your team members.
  • Innovate, speak your mind, and share your vision to continuously improve our platform.

Key Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Laravel development.
  • 3+ years of leadership experience in a similar role.
  • Strong knowledge of unit and integration testing.
  • Proficiency in Git and version control best practices.
  • Solid understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure and services.
  • Fluent English to communicate effectively in an international team.
  • A solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with SaaS platforms.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes/ EKS.
  • Familiarity with Grafana for monitoring and analytics.

You share our Core Values

  • Extreme Ownership
  • Willingness to Serve (Unreasonable Hospitality)
  • A relentless Growth Mindset
  • Playing Offense, not Defense
  • Staying confidently Humble, never Arrogant

title: Fullstack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

What are you going to do?

Joining Triple as a Fullstack Developer means taking a leading technical role in our development team. You’ll work closely with clients and act as the most technically forward-facing expert within projects. From scoping and development to deployment and optimization, you take ownership of the full stack—from infrastructure and backend systems to frontend integration when needed.

You’ll confidently dive into ongoing projects, quickly grasping what’s happening and addressing what needs attention. Programming is second nature to you—the language is merely a tool. You see the full picture: from hosting and infrastructure to databases, APIs, and frontend behavior. You’ll help set up and maintain infrastructure, monitor systems, and optimize performance from end to end.

You’ll participate in architectural discussions, define technical standards, and ensure alignment with existing competence guidelines. You won’t just write code—you’ll help shape how we build and deliver software.

Additional tasks

  • Build and maintain scalable, cloud-native backend services and frontend integrations.
  • Set up and optimize infrastructure in Azure.
  • Handle monitoring, logging, and system reliability.
  • Develop robust APIs and user-facing functionality for web and mobile applications.
  • Join sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Perform and lead code reviews, ensuring technical quality and consistency.
  • Stay ahead with emerging tools, platforms, and best practices.

Who are we looking for?

We’re looking for a highly experienced, pragmatic Fullstack Developer with a strong sense of ownership and technical leadership. You thrive in fast-moving environments, switch easily between systems and interfaces, and never lose sight of the bigger picture. You understand systems holistically, from infrastructure and architecture to frontend performance and user interaction.

You enjoy writing clean, scalable logic across the stack, but know that excellent communication and transparent decision-making are just as important. You can challenge requirements, align with clients directly, and make tough calls based on real business needs. You’re confident guiding others, and committed to maintaining high technical standards.

As a Person, You Are

  • Deeply familiar with Azure environments and DevOps tooling.
  • Skilled in containerization and microservices architecture.
  • Able to understand and optimize hosting, infrastructure, database design, APIs, and frontend behavior.
  • Capable of onboarding into any running project and quickly identifying and fixing issues.
  • A strong communicator—both with clients and within your team.
  • Driven by ownership, not afraid to take the lead.
  • Curious and sharp, constantly exploring new tech and improving your craft.
  • Able to follow and uphold technical standards within competence teams.

About The Team

We work in multidisciplinary teams that prioritize knowledge sharing and technical growth. You’ll join a backend competence group with weekly meetings, regular code reviews, and deep dives into architecture. Whether you’re mentoring juniors, collaborating with frontend developers, or challenging solution designs, you’ll be part of a team that continually learns and raises the bar. Our team culture is based on collaboration, freedom, and accountability. We support your growth, celebrate your wins, and have fun doing it—LAN parties, game nights, team trips, and more.

Requirements

  • A completed bachelor’s degree in software engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in fullstack development.
  • Strong knowledge of Azure, DevOps pipelines, infrastructure, and system monitoring.
  • Proven experience with containerization and distributed systems.
  • Confident understanding of whole system architecture (hosting, infra, DB, API, frontend).
  • Able to align with and uphold competence-specific coding standards.
  • Experience in direct client communication and requirement validation.
  • Fluent in English and Dutch.
  • Preferably located near our Alkmaar office.

Who are we?

We’ve been exploring technology's potential to deliver breakthrough innovations since 1998. We believe that deep technical know-how combined with cutting-edge creativity drives change to future-proof businesses. Change relies on radical synergy. Technology and creativity should work in perfect unison. Tech enables creativity. Creativity unlocks the potential of tech.

Our track record of disruptive ventures and innovative ideas shows that we have transformative thinking deeply ingrained in our DNA. We punch above our weight when it comes to consulting, creating, and maintaining digital ecosystems for global clients like VodafoneZiggo, Polestar, citizenM, and Philips. With a team of 450+ specialists across brand, experience, technology, and data & AI, we have the power to drive fundamental transformation at scale.

Our people are a true cross-section of society. That’s how we ensure that the services, campaigns, and products we create uphold the same quality regardless of who interacts with them. We welcome everybody and respect individual identities. We are convinced that diversity stimulates creativity and ensures innovation.

title: Senior PHP Developer
descriptionHtml:
Roll up your sleeves and get ready to design, develop, and secure advanced web applications. At DongIT, you can work on projects ranging from intricate systems for our high-end clients to our own powerful in-house platform Security Reporter.

Apply Now

Working at DongIT

Description

Developing at a senior level means your programming code is structured and reliable. You are highly accurate, and your knowledge is up-to-date through work experience, education, or your relentless interest. You use frameworks or other existing code because you recognize its added value. Identifying vulnerabilities in PHP code is part of your expertise, but you also house the skill set to fix these issues appropriately. Your passion for information security is what drives your work, and your hacker mindset is what you bring to the table.

Requirements

  • Academic level of technical education completed (BSc/MSc/PhD).
  • Knowledge base:
    • Extensive PHP and MVC knowledge.
    • HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery.
    • Linux/Unix systems.
    • Familiar with the latest development techniques and coding structures.
  • Experience:
    • 5+ years in a relevant line of work.
    • Object-oriented programming.
    • Development frameworks, such as Laravel, Symfony, CakePHP, and Drupal.
    • Other programming languages, such as Python and Java.
  • Passion for information security, with a hacker mindset.
What you enjoy

  • Coding in an accurate and structured style.
  • Translating your creativity to output.
  • Thinking along with the company and providing fresh ideas.
  • Working in a fast-paced team where collaboration will move you ahead.

  • Comfortable workplace in the center of Leiden, just a 5-minute walk from the central station.

  • Pension plan and other enticing bonus models.

Apply Now

companyDescription:
DongIT is an independent cybersecurity and software development company, specialized in web security, penetration testing, and custom web applications. We help organizations worldwide identify, assess, and reduce security risks in web and mobile applications, networks, and IT infrastructures.

Our expert team of ethical hackers and developers delivers high-quality services, including:
• Penetration testing & security audits
• Secure code reviews & vulnerability assessments
• IT security training & workshops
• Development of advanced security tools and web platforms

We are the creators of Security Reporter, the all-in-one platform for professional pentest reporting, used by security teams and pentesters around the world.

Through websecurityscan.eu, we offer in-depth and tailored security testing services. Our development division focuses on building secure, privacy-sensitive, and technically complex custom web applications for clients in both the public and private sectors.

From our headquarters in Leiden, the Netherlands, we conduct independent security research in critical sectors and contribute to the global cybersecurity community through innovation and open-source development.

• Web development & careers: dongit.eu
• Penetration testing & security services: websecurityscan.eu
• Pentest reporting platform: securityreporter.app

title: Software Engineer - Frontend & AI
descriptionHtml:
Department: Engineering

Location: Utrecht, NL

Description

You’re an excellent candidate for Bizzdesign because you …
  • Live in the Netherlands and can commute to Utrecht or Enschede, joining the team in the office around 1–2 days per week.
  • Speak fluent English (our working language)
  • Have 3+ years of experience as a Software Engineer (frontend-focused, full-stack is a plus)
  • Have hands-on experience with LLMs / AI workflows
About the role

In this role, you’ll help us build and ship AI-enabled features in a modern SaaS product. You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers to take ideas from early experiments and proofs-of-concept all the way to production-ready solutions.

AI-related work will be a primary part of your day-to-day responsibilities, and strong front-end engineering skills are equally important for delivering high-quality, user-facing experiences.

What will you do
  • Build frontend experiences that make AI feel useful, intuitive, and trustworthy
  • Design and implement AI-enabled user journeys, including UX for uncertain or evolving outputs
  • Work hands-on with LLMs: prompting, orchestration, iteration, and evaluation
  • Improve AI quality through feedback loops, prompt regression testing, and practical guardrails
  • Ship features end-to-end with strong production standards: testing, observability, CI/CD
  • Contribute to a scalable frontend codebase in TypeScript (preferably Angular)
  • Partner closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to move from idea to user value fast
What we are looking for
  • Strong hands-on software engineering experience, with solid frontend ownership
  • Confident working with JavaScript + TypeScript (Angular is a big plus)
  • Experience building and shipping AI-enabled features or workflows
  • Practical knowledge of LLMs (prompting, orchestration, iteration, evaluation)
  • Comfortable turning experiments/PoCs into production-ready solutions
  • Frontend quality mindset: testing experience (ideally Jest + Cypress)
  • Experience working on modern SaaS products with growing scale/complexity
  • Strong engineering practices: Agile, CI/CD (preferably GitHub Actions), basic Docker
  • Good judgment around maintainability, performance, and extensibility
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative, ownership-driven way of working
  • Bonus: monorepo experience (especially Nx) and a responsible AI mindset in production
What we offer
  • A competitive salary package, including an annual bonus
  • Premium pension plan to secure your future
  • 28 vacation days with the option to buy 10 extra for ultimate flexibility Hybrid working with 2 days a week in the office
  • An NS Business Card or mileage reimbursement to support your commute
  • Personal IT budget to upgrade your setup
  • Monthly work-from-home allowance to support your ideal home office setup
  • Supportive, collaborative team culture
  • Work with an international and diverse group of colleagues
  • Your input is valued, regardless of role or tenure
Recruitment process

In this role, you can expect the following interviewing process:
  • 1st Interview with our Recruiter (30 minutes)
  • 2nd Interview with the Hiring Manager (45 minutes)
  • Technical Assignment (on-site) + evaluation (timing shared during process)
  • Final Interview with key stakeholders (45 minutes)

Please note

  • Please submit your application in English, as it’s our company’s language, and you’ll be using it daily once you’re part of the team.
  • Please apply through our website or via the LinkedIn job post. Applications sent by email will not be reviewed.
  • We are not considering agency applications for this position.
  • We may use AI-based tools to support parts of the recruitment process, such as reviewing applications or resumes. These tools support our recruitment team but do not replace human decision-making, and all final hiring decisions are made by people.

DEI Statement

Bizzdesign stands for equity and inclusion. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is essential to our success, and we are committed to building a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

Bizzdesign is a global enterprise transformation SaaS company, founded over two decades ago. Today, more than 2,000 organisations in banking, insurance, aerospace, energy, government, and beyond trust us to navigate digital complexity and deliver transformation that flows.

In 2025, MEGA International, Alfabet, and Bizzdesign came together under one brand. Together, we now provide the most comprehensive end-to-end enterprise transformation offering in the market.

Our suite spans the full journey from strategy to execution, with integrated AI accelerating insights and outcomes. We take a data-driven approach that helps organizations balance innovation with cost, strengthen governance, and build operational resilience so they can make smarter investments, manage risk effectively, and deliver measurable impact.

We’re present in more than 31 countries, with offices in every major region and a team of 600+ professionals representing 32+ nationalities. Our people combine an understanding of local markets with a global perspective.

At Bizzdesign, we’re constantly building and innovating to stay ahead of the industry. Join us and help shape the future of enterprise transformation.

title: Ervaren Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Ervaren Full Stack Developer met technische visie en teamgevoel (36-40uur)

We zoeken geen codeklopper, geen solist en ook geen architect die alleen op hoog abstractieniveau opereert.

Wat we wél zoeken? Een ervaren Full Stack Developer die weet wat-ie doet, maar ook waarom. Iemand die snapt hoe je teams en producten sterker maakt – door structuur, kennisdeling en een gezonde dosis nieuwsgierigheid. Iemand die het grotere plaatje ziet, actief meedenkt en samen met het team werkt aan kwaliteit, verbetering en voortgang.

Je hoeft geen leiding te nemen, maar wél eigenaarschap. Jij denkt verder dan de taak van vandaag. Je bent iemand die ziet waar iets beter kan, dat bespreekbaar maakt en bijdraagt aan structurele groei – in onze code, onze manier van werken en in het team. Hiermee bouw je mee aan betere software, fijnere samenwerking en een werkwijze die staat als een huis.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Full Stack Developer bij Relyon:

  • Bouwen aan slimme, schaalbare en veilige features met moderne tools (zoals .NET, SQL, REST, Azure)
  • Kennis delen met je team: van debugging tot code review en van teststrategie tot DevOps
  • Meedenken over technische keuzes en verbeteringen – jij ziet wat beter kan én zegt het
  • Fouten fixen én voorkomen: je kijkt niet alleen naar het wat, maar ook naar het waarom
  • Werken aan kwaliteit en structuur in het hele ontwikkelproces (CI/CD, DoD, reviews, pipelines)
  • Samenwerken met collega’s van development, support en consultancy
  • En af en toe gewoon lekker knallen op die ene complexe use case waar iedereen z’n tanden op stukbeet


Wie ben jij?

Techniek en security:

  • Ervaring met full stack development (.NET, SQL, REST, Azure)
  • Bekend met DevOps en CI/CD
  • Begrip van secure coding en aandacht voor softwarekwaliteit
  • Bonuspunten: ervaring met security testing of pentesting


Samenwerking en mentaliteit:

  • Je werkt graag samen en maakt makkelijk contact
  • Je denkt niet in hokjes: je kijkt breder dan je eigen taak
  • Je helpt collega’s groeien door je aanpak en uitleg
  • Je stelt kritische vragen, maar komt ook met oplossingen
  • Je brengt rust, structuur en een scherp oog voor verbetering


Analytisch en vooruitdenkend:

  • Je vindt oorzaken van problemen snel en denkt in duurzame oplossingen
  • Je helpt mee onze pull request flow, Definition of Done en build pipeline te verbeteren
  • Je draagt ideeën aan voor vernieuwing, automatisering en teamprocessen.


Wat bieden wij?

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris
  • Een maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding van €75,- (o.b.v. fulltime) voor o.a. een snelle internetverbinding thuis
  • 8% vakantiegeld en uitstekende pensioenregeling
  • 27 vakantiedagen o.b.v. een fulltime contract. Heb je een parttime contract? Dan berekenen we het aantal vakantiedagen op basis van het aantal uren dat je werkt
  • Alle spullen die je nodig hebt om je werk goed te doen
  • Dagelijkse kantoorlunch tegen een kleine eigen bijdrage
  • Mogelijkheid om zowel op kantoor als thuis te werken
  • Begeleiding in je rol als Full Stack Developer en de vrijheid om hier zelf invulling aan te geven en ruimte voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling
  • Diverse mogelijkheden om door te groeien binnen onze organisatie
  • Superleuke en behulpzame collega’s waarmee je meerdere keren per jaar leuke dingen, georganiseerd door het bedrijf, kan ondernemen!


Over Fieldbuddy 

FieldBuddy bouwt slimme field service software die bedrijven helpt hun werk écht te transformeren. Van planning tot facturatie, met onze oplossingen stroomlijnen installateurs, inspecteurs en onderhoudsteams hun volledige operatie. Dankzij slimme AI en krachtige mobiele apps maken we zero-touch planning werkelijkheid. 

We zijn een groeiend team van 40 collega’s met een snel uitbreidende klantenkring in binnen- en buitenland. Met onze software, integraties en klantgerichte aanpak zijn we dé partner voor toekomstgerichte field service organisaties. FieldBuddy wordt ondersteund door Main Capital Partners, een van Europa’s leidende software-investeerders. Met hun ervaring en netwerk bouwen we verder aan onze internationale groei en innovatiekracht: met één doel: de standaard zetten in field service management. 

De markt groeit hard en wij groeien harder. Ons doel? Nog meer bedrijven laten zien dat FieldBuddy de go-to supplier is voor field service software. Daarin speelt Development een sleutelrol. En daar kom jij in beeld. 

Is dit wat voor jou?

We houden ervan om dingen slimmer, beter en soms ineens helemaal anders aan te pakken.

Samen bouwen we aan iets waar we trots op zijn.

Ben jij iemand die graag verbetert, meedenkt en initiatief toont? Dan willen we je leren kennen.

Stuur je CV op naar hrm@relyon.nl

We zijn benieuwd naar wie je bent en wat je drijft.
