title: Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Description

If you are a candidate, we’re very keen to tell you more about this position. Please continue reading! If you are an agency, Head Hunter or similar 3rd party, please scroll all the way down so you won’t miss our most important message to you.

As a Full Stack Developer at Full Circle Wind Services, you’ll be at the heart of our mission to make wind turbine operation smarter, faster, and more efficient. You will build integrations, streamline data flows, and deliver solutions that keep our operations spinning. This role plays a crucial part in automating both our internal and external processes, making it a pivotal driver of our growth and ability to scale. In other words: you’ll be the one writing the scripts that keep the wind in our sails… and our servers online.

Within a team of three Full Stack Developers, you will power real-time dashboards on the performance of our entire turbine portfolio, enable turbines to automatically start or stop depending on grid availability, and support our Control Room in becoming increasingly automated. We’re working towards building one central data hub and you will be involved in connecting all of our Business Critical services to help create insights that support our business.

It’s a great moment to come on board! We are in a transition phase, introducing the Agile / Scrum methodology, professionalizing our development approach but also implementing a new architecture. Things aren’t always as smooth as we’d like and there is a need to set quite a few things up, but that means that you’ll have a real say in the direction we take, influencing both how we work and the tools we use. Here, you won’t just work on any backend; you’ll be part of the backend of our business.

With our turbines and people spread across Europe, you’ll be part of an international team where your work connects colleagues and operations across countries and time zones.

Requirements

We are looking for a new team player with curious, proactive mindset and a drive to improve processes and systems, always ready to debug, optimise, and occasionally refactor a storm. To do so, you should have the following experience under your belt.

  • 2–5 years of software development experience, ideally in full-stack
  • Fluency with .NET (C#). We're currently working with both languages, and you'll have an impact on our future preferred language.
  • As you need to be able to read and interpret the data in our data hub, you need a strong grasp of SQL database principles
  • Experience in React

The above are the fundamental requirements. With the wide range of initiatives and projects running, we would need to to have proven experience with some 'extra's' to hit the ground running. You do not have to master all of them, and there is room to learn on the job, but you will have an advantage over others if you bring any of the below.

  • Agile/Scrum, CI/CD pipelines, and test automation
  • Next.js, TypeScript
  • REST API and /or GraphQL API services
  • Azure cloud services, including application hosting (App Service, Function Apps), secure key management (Key Vault), and scalable data storage (Blob Storage), as well as working with virtual machines.
  • Containerization technologies and principles (ACI, Docker, etc.)

What We Offer

  • A vibrant divers team, both in the field and in the office.
  • An exciting growth journey in a dynamic company
  • Inclusion in the “Metaal & Techniek” collective labour agreement
  • 200 hours of holiday per year, plus the option to buy 76 additional hours annually, for when you need to power down and reboot
  • As we're growing fast, we are big fans of meeting in the office. Having that said we value 'quality time' working from home as well. We offer you a balanced approach to your working location for that matter.

About Full Circle

At Full Circle, we've been in the wind turbine game for over two decades, and now, we're ready to spread our wings and soar as an independent entity, supporting various wind turbine brands. Our journey into independence began in 2021, and every day, our team is fuelled by the excitement of growth and autonomy.

Our Mission: Offering Top-Notch Support, No Exceptions!

We're here to dish out top-tier maintenance support to everyone in need, regardless of the turbine brand or whether you've got one or a hundred turbines in your backyard. Expect us to swoop in with agile, honest, and lightning-fast support. From routine maintenance to blade inspections, repairs, 24/7 remote monitoring, and even those must-do statutory inspections – we've got your back! Basically, everything to keep those turbines dancing in the wind.

Our Secret Sauce: Expertise, Resources, and a Personal Touch! We're renowned for our wizard-like expertise, abundant resources, and a friendly, personalized approach that ensures you squeeze every last whirl out of those turbines.

Our HQ: Where Magic Happens!

Our headquarters are nestled in the lively city of Amersfoort, Netherlands. But hey, our squad is scattered all across Europe, maintaining wind turbines across the globe.

Meet Our Funky, Spirited Team!

We're not just a team; we're a bubbling cauldron of enthusiasm and youthfulness, growing alongside our company. That makes our work environment an absolute blast—overflowing with energy and collaboration! We're open, direct, and as honest as a clear blue sky, reflecting the diverse world we live in!

Hey, You! Still Here? Join the Fun!

If you're still hanging in there and thinking, "This sounds like my kind of jam," hit that apply button. We're itching to meet folks who match our vibe and skills. Let's make some wind turbine magic together!

Join us in Amersfoort. If you're keen on renewable energy and thrive in a dynamic environment, we want you on our team!

Apply Now and Let's Rock the Wind Turbine World Together!

Note To 3rd Parties

Here at Full Circle we are very lucky to be very successful recruiting all our new employees ourselves. Something we are very proud of.

Despite our kind requests to all of you not to reach out for support in this area, our HR team, hiring managers and our front office are overwhelmed with contact requests, telephone calls, email requests and other attempts to get in touch. We know you guys are out there, we understand that this cold acquisition is part of your job, but we strongly request you to respect our time and not reach out. We want to use all the time we have to make the world a greener place!

If we ever need support, we'll work with our preferred suppliers (and no, we are not looking for new ones ;-))

We appreciate your understanding on this, and we wish you the best of luck on finding your next client.

Having that said we value 'quality time' working from home as well. We offer you a balanced approach to your working location for that matter.About Full CircleAt Full Circle, we've been in the wind turbine game for over two decades, and now, we're ready to spread our wings and soar as an independent entity, supporting various wind turbine brands. Expect us to swoop in with agile, honest, and lightning-fast support. From routine maintenance to blade inspections, repairs, 24/7 remote monitoring, and even those must-do statutory inspections – we've got your back! Basically, everything to keep those turbines dancing in the wind.Our Secret Sauce: Expertise, Resources, and a Personal Touch! We're renowned for our wizard-like expertise, abundant resources, and a friendly, personalized approach that ensures you squeeze every last whirl out of those turbines.Our HQ: Where Magic Happens!Our headquarters are nestled in the lively city of Amersfoort, Netherlands. But hey, our squad is scattered all across Europe, maintaining wind turbines across the globe.Meet Our Funky, Spirited Team!We're not just a team; we're a bubbling cauldron of enthusiasm and youthfulness, growing alongside our company. That makes our work environment an absolute blast—overflowing with energy and collaboration! We're open, direct, and as honest as a clear blue sky, reflecting the diverse world we live in!Hey, You! Still Here? Join the Fun!If you're still hanging in there and thinking, "This sounds like my kind of jam," hit that apply button. We're itching to meet folks who match our vibe and skills. Let's make some wind turbine magic together!Join us in Amersfoort. If you're keen on renewable energy and thrive in a dynamic environment, we want you on our team!Apply Now and Let's Rock the Wind Turbine World Together!Note To 3rd PartiesHere at Full Circle we are very lucky to be very successful recruiting all our new employees ourselves. Something we are very proud of.Despite our kind requests to all of you not to reach out for support in this area, our HR team, hiring managers and our front office are overwhelmed with contact requests, telephone calls, email requests and other attempts to get in touch. We know you guys are out there, we understand that this cold acquisition is part of your job, but we strongly request you to respect our time and not reach out. We want to use all the time we have to make the world a greener place!If we ever need support, we'll work with our preferred suppliers (and no, we are not looking for new ones ;-))We appreciate your understanding on this, and we wish you the best of luck on finding your next client.

title: Full Stack Developer - Product Team
descriptionHtml:
Want to make more possible? Bring marketing communications to life? We are currently looking for an Application Developer to join our team in Eindhoven. As an Application Developer you are working at the heart of the design, development, deployment and continuous improvement. You are a key player in the agile software development team that contributes to make our complex marketing operations feel effortless.


We are looking for someone who enjoys tackling complex challenges and delivering end-to-end solutions. You are proactive, innovative, and collaborative, with a passion for clean, maintainable code. You contribute to a culture of professionalism, customer service and technical excellence.


About APS Group


We bring together thinkers, content creators, and production experts, to make more possible– empowering brands to talk to their customers in the most relevant and rewarding way. We create marketing solutions for international clients, as Albert Heijn, AkzoNobel, Maersk, Hoya, and Barclays. To achieve this, we work together with the headquarter of APS in the UK and teams across the rest of the world. In The Netherlands, we work on three locations, with a team of approximately 200 employees. Groupwide, we have over 1.000 employees.


What will you be doing?


  • Build, and maintain high-performance applications using React, Next.js, Java, and modern tooling
  • Work closely with front-end and back-end developers, UX/UI designers, and DevOps engineers both within an Agile team, and through cross domain initiatives
  • Contribute to a culture of clean, testable, and maintainable code


Your profile


You are a self-motivated engineer who takes ownership and understands scalable architecture and future-ready codebases.


Must-haves:


  • Solid experience with JavaScript (ES2020) and TypeScript
  • Strong knowledge of Java
  • Proficiency in SQL and basic knowledge on databases
  • Expertise with React and Next.js
  • Familiar with modern state management patterns
  • Solid understanding of GraphQL, REST
  • Experience with Vitest, RTL, Cypress, TDD workflows, and modern build tools (such as NX)
  • A good eye for UI/UX, HTML/CSS fundamentals, and working with design systems (e.g. MUI)


Nice-to-haves:


  • Experience with Gitlab and Cloudflare
  • Experience with Spring boot is a pré
  • Knowledge of integration patterns or adapters
  • An interest in full-stack collaboration (our stack includes Java, Spring, Hybernate, microservices, Docker, Kubernetes)


What we offer


  • Salary that reflects the job's duties and responsibilities
  • 29 vacation days (for a full-time contract)
  • Good pension plan and optional collective health insurance
  • Hybrid working + remote flexibility
  • Choose your own laptop: Mac or Windows
  • Office perks: fruit and cookies
  • APS Relax: opt into fun social events organized by colleagues
  • Growth opportunities in a fast-paced, international environment


Want to join?


Send your CV and short motivation to nljobs@theapsgroup.com. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Full Stack Software Engineer, Python/React
descriptionHtml:
This is Cradle

Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools.

Machine learning is revolutionizing this space, by enabling high-fidelity protein models. At Cradle, we offer a software platform for AI-guided discovery and optimization of proteins, so that biologists can design proteins faster and at scale. We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia.

We're an experienced team of around 75 people. We've built many successful products before and have enough funding for multiple years of runway. We are distributed across two main locations, Zurich and Amsterdam, and are focused on building the best possible team culture.

We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities.

What we are looking for

We're looking for full stack software engineers who are excited to peek out of the virtual world and join us on designing a platform for optimizing biological systems! Be ready to witness first hand what happens when you leave the bits and bytes behind and try to solve challenges with nature’s constraints and complexity.

Your responsibilities

As a full stack software engineer, you will be responsible for designing and developing a service-oriented decoupled web application, which exposes our advanced machine learning models to scientific end users.

For example, this means:

  • Implementing lightweight and modularized web-based user interfaces and visualizations, e.g. to rapidly prototype new UIs as new API endpoints become available.
  • Architecting database designs to effectively store customer data, e.g. with consideration for how to represent the variability of biochemistry in future-proof ways (people invent new species of macromolecule all the time!).
  • Owning large parts of the software design and development process. We are in an early stage of the company where you will majorly contribute to the software design of the product.
  • Building modern documentation stacks which automatically stay up-to-date, e.g. through pulling in OpenAPI specifications.
  • Collaborating with biologists, machine learning experts, and scientists alike, and becoming skilled in working in their domains.

Your skills

Must haves:

  • Familiarity with designing user interfaces and are familiar with one or more popular frameworks (e.g. React).
  • The Python programming language and its ecosystem. (FastAPI, uv, ruff, pyright, …).

Nice to haves:

  • Excitement about all parts of the software stack which is reflected in your past projects. At any given day you could be asked to design a REST API, contribute to a codon optimizer*, or design a UI plugin.
  • Databases and big data systems.
  • Production systems for machine learning applications.
  • Building containerized backend systems. (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • You are kind and work well in teams. We look for team players and excellent communicators who contribute to a positive and friendly working environment.
  • Do a little research online if you don’t know what this is :)

Our commitment to inclusive hiring

Cradle evaluates all candidates based on merit, regardless of sex, gender, ethnicity, socio-economic background, or any other aspect of identity. We maintain zero tolerance for discrimination and actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

A Notice About Recruitment Scams

Please be aware that scammers are posing as us in order to get your personal details or money. We only communicate via @cradle.bio email addresses, we only make job offers after having met you in person at our office in Zurich or Amsterdam, and we never ask you to pay for anything during the interview process.

title: Full stack Ontwikkelaar
descriptionHtml:
Bij TAGGRS helpen we organisaties de volledige waarde van hun data te benutten. Als Full Stack Developer ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen, implementeren en onderhouden van onze applicaties. Jij ziet het als een uitdaging om met geavanceerde technologieën te werken en schrikt niet terug voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers.


We streven naar voortdurende verbetering, het elimineren van inefficiënties en het vergroten van onze effectiviteit. Jouw feedback en visie zijn essentieel. Als platte, transparante organisatie waarderen we jouw mening en leren we graag van jouw initiatieven.


Taken

  • Ontwikkel en optimaliseer functies binnen onze applicatie

  • Werk samen met andere teams om de applicatie nog gebruiksvriendelijker te maken

  • Draag bij aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe bedrijfsmodellen en digitale innovaties

  • Zorg voor een naadloze gebruikerservaring voor onze klanten

  • Creëer samen met je team slimme oplossingen, van proof-of-concept tot productie

  • Bouw en onderhoud applicaties met behulp van moderne front-end- en back-end-technologieën

  • Draag bij aan coderingsstandaarden, softwareontwerppraktijken en systeemarchitectuur


Vereisten

  • 3-5 jaar ervaring met TypeScript en React.js

  • Ervaring met backend-ontwikkeling in PHP en Laravel

  • Database-ervaring met Kubernetes is een plus

  • Kennis van CDN's, CMS, analytics en netwerken

  • Ervaring met drukbezochte websites is een pre

  • Bekend met A/B-testen en het volgen van websitegebruikers

  • Passie voor softwareontwikkeling en het bouwen van kwalitatieve applicaties


Benefits

Bij TAGGRS houden we van energie, groei en vooruitgang. Daarom bieden we jou:



  • Een uitdagende functie binnen een ambitieuze en snelgroeiende scale-up, waarin jouw werk direct impact maakt

  • Een uitstekende werksfeer – onze collega's beoordelen ons met 5 sterren op werktevredenheid

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris

  • Hybride werken, met een fijne balans tussen thuis en kantoor

  • Een contract voor 28–32 uur per week

  • Ruimte voor nieuwe ideeën en initiatieven, of je nu een week, maand of jaar bij ons werkt

  • Veel kansen voor professionele ontwikkeling en trainingen

  • Sterke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder:

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per km of 100% OV-vergoeding

  • 24 vakantiedagen

  • Epische feesten en teamactiviteiten

  • Een gaaf kledingpakket


Klaar om TAGGRS nóg slimmer te maken?


Herken jij jezelf in deze rol en wil je werken aan de beste tracking-oplossingen voor bedrijven wereldwijd? Solliciteer vandaag nog en word onze nieuwe Full Stack Developer!

title: Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Reaktor's award-winning tech community is looking for full-stack developers to join us in Amsterdam.

If you are in your element with a full software development cycle, have a passion for solving human problems with a holistic approach, and are curious to experience working in a low-hierarchy environment, you might just be what we're looking for.

As a Full Stack Developer at Reaktor, your job is to be an expert in a range of software development responsibilities spanning the entire software development lifecycle, from front-end to production.

Your Daily Tasks Include

  • Working together with the client’s tech and business teams and helping them to pick the right technologies suitable for their needs.
  • Implementing new features that require changes to frontend applications, backend servers, and/or databases, even on infrastructure.
  • Delivering the client and the team with world-class technical expertise.
  • Other software development-related tasks, such as debugging, designing, and participating in creating the architecture.

You are a curious-minded Developer who is comfortable working on both the back-end and front-end of an app and understands the role of infrastructure in everyday tasks.

To Thrive In This Position, You’ll Need

  • Experience in a broad range of software development modalities (backend, frontend, ops, and consulting skills).
  • We don’t have a hard limit with years of experience, but we’ve noticed that Full Stack competencies often take 5+ years to accumulate.
  • Previous experience with at least one common server-side programming language. Currently, many of our projects are built with TypeScript/JavaScript and Node.js. But, Java/Scala/Kotlin, Clojure, and Python are also used.
  • Strong knowledge of at least one common client-side language and framework. We often use TypeScript/JavaScript and React on our web app projects and Swift, Java/Scala/Kotlin, or TypeScript/JavaScript React-native on mobile.
  • Relevant skills to create new backend services and build CI/CD pipelines when the project requires.
  • Foundational knowledge in DevOps, including Continuous Integration (CI), automated deployment, and test automation
  • Know-how on databases (e.g., PostgreSQL).
  • To be comfortable engaging with the client stakeholders when needed.
  • Fluent spoken & written skills in English.
  • To be willing to work in a hybrid setup, where you work with your team at the office or the client's premises.

Why join us?

For two decades, we’ve been developing qualities and capabilities for adapting, reacting, and supporting change – building Reaktor to hold up in a fast-paced environment while ensuring the well-being of our people.

While Working At Reaktor, We’ll Provide You With

  • To be able to impact how you work. Together with the client, your team chooses the approach, technologies, and methodologies you think will work best in any given situation.
  • A community with as much support as your heart desires.
  • A team that’s not only experienced but considerate as well – they all want you to succeed.
  • A sustainable work-life balance and support for your daily life outside of work. (e.g., free moving day, Reaktor car share, sick child care services, office space to use for your private events, etc.).
  • An opportunity to grow as a professional. In addition to the day-to-day work, we offer internal training courses, community events, and 15-minute coffee breaks to discuss hot topics in tech and design.
  • A possibility to take part in more extended academy-like studies like Cloud Academy.
  • 300+ hobby clubs, from winter swimming and running to knitting and archery, that bring people together outside of (and sometimes inside) office hours. Many of these are supported by Reaktor.
  • Check more benefits & perks below

Salary & Benefits

We believe in fair compensation for our employees, and our monetary compensation for the Full Stack Developer role is between 57,500€ and 75,000€ per annum, including 8% holiday pay. Check out the other benefits & perks on our careers page.

Why not an exact number?

Everyone at Reaktor has slightly different and unique skills and competencies – which makes sense since so are the requirements of the projects they work on. The exact starting salary depends on the relevant competencies you have. Our recruitment team does our best to evaluate them during the recruitment process.

Diversity, equity, and inclusion

Together, we are committed to making Reaktor an environment that embraces and values all of our employees for the whole of who they are. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply, knowing that studies show that members of underrepresented communities don’t apply for jobs unless they fully satisfy all of the requirements. If you're thinking twice about applying for this reason, we invite you to send us your application anyway. You could be just the person we're looking for.

Read more about our DEI work here.

Interested? Drop us a line via the form below. We'll be happy to hear from you!

title: Stagiair(e)/Afstudeerder Web Development
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij op zoek naar een plek om je vaardigheden in de praktijk toe te passen? Nice! Wij zijn op zoek naar een stagiair(e) Web Developer. Meerdere zelfs. Solliciteer snel en wie weet nodigen we jou uit voor een kennismakingsgesprek. Dan gaan we niet alleen kijken of jij bij ons past, maar ook of wij bij jou passen.

Gladior is, het hele jaar door, op zoek naar een enthousiaste, leergierige en ambitieuze HBO / WO student, in de richting van Development; front-end, back-end, realisatie, koppelingen, appontwikkeling, you name it. We hebben bijvoorbeeld goede ervaringen met de opleiding Kunst & Techniek / Creative Media and Game Technologies. Iets scheppends met computers dus. Je gaat bij ons samen met collegas meehelpen aan een heleboel projecten. Je hebt altijd iemand om vragen aan te stellen, maar ook alle tijd en ruimte om het zelf uit te zoeken. Zo leer je van je collegas, van klanten en over jezelf. We zijn op zoek naar studenten met een voorliefde voor Webdesign & development en daar nog beter in willen worden. Dat betekent dat je wel een beetje kennis/ervaring moet hebben met WordPress, HTML en Javascript.

Bij Gladior vinden we vooral je persoonlijkheid erg belangrijk; dat je ambitieus en positief ingesteld bent. Dat betekent dat je nadenkt over je eigen ontwikkeling, een passie hebt voor het behalen van resultaten én dat je klantgericht bent. We doen dit namelijk allemaal voor onze klanten en die van hen. Jij maakt dus graag iets tofs (en effectiefs) voor onze klanten, maakt toffe dromen een realiteit en denkt in oplossingen. Dit alles leidt tot een allround inzetbare collega voor ons, die we op verschillende plekken binnen onze organisatie kunnen inzetten.

Werkplek

In deze fase van je carrière denken we dat het voor jou het beste is om veel bij ons op kantoor te werken, met mensen om je heen. Zo leer jij het meest en is er nooit een drempel om iets te vragen. Daarnaast leren wij jou zo het beste kennen! Een uitzondering kan echter altijd geregeld worden.

Vergoeding

Stage

  • MBO: €250/mnd
  • HBO: €350/mnd
  • WO: €400/mnd

Afstuderen

  • MBO: €300/mnd
  • HBO: €400/mnd
  • WO: €450/mnd

Jouw toekomst

We gaan er niet om liegen: we zijn altijd op zoek naar goede nieuwe teamleden. We zien daarom jouw stage of afstudeerperiode als een soort proefperiode om te kijken of we bij elkaar passen. In het verleden zijn al veel mensen "blijven plakken", waar we nu heel dankbaar voor zijn. Als we het allebei zien zitten, is het daarom zo maar mogelijk dat we je tijdens je stage/afstudeerperiode vragen parttime (€17 per uur) voor ons te werken, en/of daarna in te stromen als Junior Softwareontwikkelaar (vanaf €2350/mnd).

Jouw Profiel

  • HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau;
  • Je hebt een passie voor development en/of alles wat digitaal is;
  • Je bent leergierig en ambitieus: je wilt graag de beste zijn als persoon, maar ook als team Gladior;
  • Je hebt ervaring met minstens één van de volgende CMSen: WordPress, Magento, Lightspeed, CCV Shop;
  • Je bent positief ingesteld, creatief en vindingrijk: Je denkt in oplossingen en kijkt altijd vooruit. Je bent een positief ingesteld persoon.

Jouw Werkzaamheden

  • Ondersteunen van Developers bij werkzaamheden zoals realiseren, aanpassen en verbeteren van websites, webshops en apps;
  • Het meehelpen aan elke stap van digitale projecten: van begin tot eind;
  • Jezelf ontwikkelen in kennis en ervaring, o.a. door deelname aan onze eigen kennissessies;
  • Het meehelpen aan onze eigen Gladior Wiki: hoe kunnen we de volgende keer iets slimmer/beter doen?
  • Het doorvertalen van ontwerpen naar HTML of ze realiseren binnen een platform zoals WordPress, CCV Shop, Lightspeed of Magento

title: PHP Developer
descriptionHtml:
Dutch Speakers only!


Ben jij een ervaren PHP Developer die energie krijgt van het bouwen van slimme applicaties en complexe integraties? Wil je meewerken aan de vernieuwing van een compleet applicatielandschap van een 20 jaar oude monoliet naar een moderne microservices-architectuur? Dan is dit jouw kans om écht impact te maken.


Over de organisatie

Onze opdrachtgever is een grote speler in de dienstverlening en werkt vanuit een modern hoofdkantoor in de regio Rotterdam, met meerdere vestigingen door heel Nederland. Met ruim 600 collega’s bedienen zij zowel particuliere als zakelijke klanten én ondersteunen ze honderden partners via hun eigen platformen en services.

De interne IT-afdeling speelt een sleutelrol binnen de organisatie. Hier wordt gewerkt in een professionele, nuchtere en open cultuur met korte lijnen en veel ruimte voor eigen ideeën. Jij wordt onderdeel van het Application Development team waar developers, testers en product owners nauw samenwerken.


Waarom is dit uniek?

  • Je helpt mee om een verouderd monoliet systeem volledig opnieuw op te bouwen met de nieuwste technieken.
  • Je werkt aan een schaalbaar, robuust en flexibel landschap volgens microservices in een Azure-omgeving.
  • Je bouwt mee met Symfony, Vue, GraphQL en Betty Blocks.
  • Je komt in een backend-team van ca. 7 developers en testers dat nauw samenwerkt met het frontend/low-code team.



Wat ga je doen?

  • Ontwikkelen van maatwerkapplicaties in PHP (Symfony).
  • Bouwen en integreren van RESTful API’s en koppelingen in een complex applicatielandschap.
  • Meedenken over architectuur, schaalbaarheid en codekwaliteit.
  • Samenwerken in Agile sprints met developers, testers en product owners.
  • Bijdragen aan de transitie naar een toekomstbestendig applicatielandschap.


Wat breng jij mee?

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als PHP Developer (ervaring met Symfony is een pré).
  • Ervaring met API’s en integraties.
  • Je schrijft onderhoudbare, gestructureerde code met oog voor kwaliteit.
  • Je voelt je thuis in Agile/Scrum-teams.
  • Je woont in Nederland en spreekt goed Nederlands of Engels.


Wat krijg je terug?

  • Salaris tot €6000 bruto per maand (bespreekbaar, afhankelijk van ervaring).
  • 13e maand + vakantiegeld.
  • Premievrij pensioen.
  • 27 vakantiedagen (op basis van fulltime) met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen.
  • Hybride werken: tot 3 dagen thuis + flexibele werktijden.
  • Reiskostenvergoeding.
  • Personeelskorting op verzekeringen.
  • Opleidingsbudget en volop doorgroeimogelijkheden.
  • Een moderne werkplek in Rotterdam, goed bereikbaar met OV en auto.
  • Een collegiale sfeer met teamuitjes en borrels.


Wil jij bouwen aan een compleet vernieuwd applicatielandschap in een organisatie met serieuze impact? Solliciteer direct of neem contact op voor meer informatie.

Klaar voor je volgende stap?

title: Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Full-stack Software Developer

LYNX is an international FinTech company that offers you a relaxed and informal work environment, where you can get the best out of yourself and where 290 people contribute together to the success of our customers in 10 European countries since 2006. At our offices in the heart of Amsterdam, Berlin, Ghent and Prague, we work every day to offer private and professional investors the best trading experience.

We are looking for an experienced Full-stack Software Developer to work with our development team based in Ghent. Your mission is to build the next generation of trading related applications and services for customers and help improving our modern and dynamic web based trading platform.

Your Challenges - What Will You Do At LYNX

► Design, build and improve the LYNX application stack used for running our trading platform, giving customers the best trading experience and a way for communicating and exchanging documents with LYNX in a secure manner

► Shape the overall platform architecture and design services for new projects that help us propel the business forward

title: Full Stack Engineer(s) - Mid level
descriptionHtml:
About FareHarbor

At FareHarbor, our mission is to make experiences better for everyone. Founded in 2013 in Hawaii and acquired by Booking Holdings in 2018, FareHarbor creates powerful tools that enable our clients (think boat rentals, museums, food tours, events and more!) to operate and grow.

With over 20,000 clients across 90+ countries—we’re the largest in our industry and shaping the future of travel, together.

Our team is an ‘Ohana of 700+ people around the world. We’re passionate about pioneering an industry, embracing challenges with open arms, and delivering value to the experiences industry.

About The Role

FareHarbor, a Booking Holding Company, is looking for a full time, mid level full-stack engineers to join our product team in Amsterdam. We’re a quickly growing company with a robust product that tens of thousands of people use to run their businesses every day.

  • As part of the End User pillar’s teams you will work on the booking flow for end customers that helps clients capture more bookings, deliver better customer experiences and make smarter decisions through embedded analytics. As an engineer you will have plenty of opportunities to learn and grow by working on the experiments, product features and technological advancements. We expect a strong growth product mindset, excellent engineering skills and a readiness to work across the stack, collaborating on both server-side logic and customer-facing interfaces.
  • As part of the Core pillar, the Racoons team builds the cross-product backend and fullstack systems that power critical parts of the booking experience, from Waivers and Waitlists to Manifest v2.0, Rental booking, and Multi-tax. You’ll work on experiments, major product features and infrastructure improvements that make bookings more reliable, compliant, and performant for our clients. As an engineer on Racoons you’ll own end-to-end solutions: designing APIs and data models, implementing server-side logic, and collaborating on customer-facing UI where needed. We expect a strong product mindset, excellent engineering craft, and a readiness to work across the stack, balancing correctness, scale and speed while partnering closely with Product, Design and other engineering teams.

What You’ll Do Here

  • Design and implement complex features in our large scale, highly dynamic web application with a strong focus on reliability, performance, security, and scalability.
  • Write code that is clean, secure, well tested and documented and follows industry best practices.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to understand user needs and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Work across the stack to develop scalable, performant, well-tested solutions.
  • Coach and challenge engineers in adopting proper quality standards, both in coding and way of working.
  • Participate in code reviews.
  • Write automated tests to ensure that our applications are reliable and scalable.
  • Thinking outside the box; you're willing to consider different solutions and methods for reaching your desired outcome.

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of software development experience using server side programming languages like Python, frameworks like Django and web technologies like JavaScript/Angular/Vue/HTML/CSS
  • Have a good understanding of software design patterns and principles, including SOLID
  • Good understanding of system architecture, high-availability systems, and service-based architecture.
  • Familiarity with database technologies (e.g., SQL, NoSQL) and data storage solutions
  • Experience with working on large-scale production codebases
  • Understanding of Agile principles or similar methodologies.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Ability to prioritize and organise work to ensure quality standards with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to effectively manage against timelines, deadlines, and goals.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and to adapt to change.

Benefits

  • Global leave benefit
    • 22 weeks paid parental leave
    • 2 weeks paid grandparent leave
    • Extended care and bereavement leave
  • Life insurance policy
  • Pension Plan
  • Central Amsterdam Location
  • Discount CZ insurance
  • Working in a multicultural environment - 45 different nationalities
  • Commuting allowance for public transport & subsidized lunch
  • Wellness benefits (Headspace subscription & wellness webinars)
  • Hybrid friendly
  • Work-from-home assistance
  • Educational Opportunities
  • Social hours & events and team-building
  • 26 vacation days per year
At FareHarbor, we believe making experiences better for everyone starts with fostering a workplace where every voice is heard and everyone is empowered to thrive. We’re committed to inclusion, welcoming all qualified job seekers to apply and join our ‘ohana.

FareHarbor is an equal opportunity employer in accordance with all applicable federal, state and local laws. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. If you need adjustments during the application or interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.

To learn more about how we use your information, see our Privacy Statement for Applicants. By submitting your application, you confirm that you understand and agree that your information will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Statement for Applicants.

Any offer of work (e.g. employment, assignment) will be subjected to the successful completion of pre-employment screening.

title: Frontend Developer - Angular, Capelle aan den IJssel
location: Capelle aan den IJssel, South Holland, Netherlands
descriptionHtml:
Wat jij gaat doen

Build innovative features in Angular with real creative freedom. Youll join an autonomous team with strong ownership, a modern codebase with zero legacy and big impact. Expect a close, multicultural crew that loves to spar on ideas and also has fun together. Based in Capelle aan den IJssel, hybrid by default.

Role

As a Medior Front-end Developer at Tangelo Software, you will work on new projects, focusing heavily on innovation and creativity. You will also play a key role in redesigning our user interface, where you will independently explore possibilities and implement innovative solutions. Using modern front-end technologies, youll build scalable and user-friendly interfaces. This team works with:

  • Angular v19+
  • Angular CDK, PrimeNG
  • SCSS, TailwindCSS
  • Storybook
  • Nx monorepo
  • OpenAPI, Prism CLI
  • Docker
  • Bitbucket Pipelines
  • Cypress, Playwright, Jest

Waar je terecht komt

At Tangelo Software, youll find yourself in an informal, no-nonsense environment where you have the freedom to work independently and bring your creativity to life. Our office in Capelle aan den IJssel is where our lab team develops groundbreaking software for clients like PostNL, KPN, and Dutch banks.

The Capelle team brings together three back-end developers, three front-end developers, and a tester from different parts of the world. They share a strong professional drive and enjoy spending time together outside of work. Youll work on impactful projects without the red tape of a corporate environment. Hybrid working is possible, with at least two office days per week.

Wie jij bent

You thrive on independently discovering new possibilities and creating innovative solutions.

  • At least 2 years of experience in front-end development, with a minimum of 1 year working with Angular.
  • Experience with other JavaScript frameworks such as React and Vue.js is a plus.
  • Knowledge of UI/UX principles and experience creating scalable solutions.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Communicative, curious and open to sparring on ideas. You enjoy working and having fun as a close, multicultural team, and you value cultural fit as much as clean code.
  • Based in the Netherlands and able to be present in Capelle aan den IJssel at least 2 days per week.

Wat wij bieden

  • Salary up to 4500,- gross per month based on full-time employment.
  • 8% Holliday allowance, build up monthly and paid out once a year in May.
  • Flexible working hours with up to 3 days of remote work.
  • 28 vacation days per year based on full-time employment.
  • 30,- net per month for representation allowance.
  • Tax-free home office allowance of 2.40 per day.
  • Bonus scheme: 5% of your gross annual salary, based on achieving company results.
  • Laptop, phone, and SIM card or reimbursement for mobile phone costs.
  • Commuting allowance of 0.23 per km or full reimbursement for public transport.
  • Pension plan with ASR.
  • A relaxed, collaborative work atmosphere with opportunities to share your knowledge within the company.

title: Front-endontwikkelaar
descriptionHtml:
About us


We are Ver.iD (trade name of Subst.iD B.V.), and we are building the infrastructure for digital identity that fundamentally changes how people and organizations conduct online interactions. With the rise of digital ID wallets on mobile phones, such as Datakeeper, Digidentity, Yivi, the Dutch NL Wallet, and other public and commercial wallets, new secure and controlled ways are emerging for users to share their identity and data. This creates a new foundation for identification in online services.


Think of logging in without passwords, age verification, compliance and KYC checks, onboarding for insurance and webshops, and accessing government services. Complicated processes involving passport scans or utility bills disappear from the internet and are replaced by streamlined QR-code-based flows. Users retain full control over their data, while companies and governments can operate more easily, safely, and with greater privacy.


At Ver.iD, we are building the platform that enables organizations to seamlessly integrate all these different digital identity apps. Our customers don’t need to choose one wallet; their services work with all of them. Comparable to what Adyen did for payments, but then for digital identity.


The role


As a Frontend Developer (or Full Stack Developer with a strong frontend focus), you will work on our core product and help elevate our front-end to the highest level. You are the driving force behind high-quality interfaces and UX flows, with a strong focus on TypeScript and Vue.js. You work independently and take ownership of the entire frontend at the company. You thrive in a highly autonomous environment where you are responsible for quality, speed, and technical decisions.


What will you be doing?


  • Developing modern web applications in TypeScript and Vue.js
  • Translating Figma designs into responsive, accessible, and reusable UI components
  • Collaborating with product and backend teams to build features end-to-end
  • Building onboarding and verification flows, including QR pages and integrations with identity wallets
  • Working on backend services when needed, for example APIs for identity flows or embedded flows
  • Ensuring high quality through testing, documentation, and clean code
  • Actively contributing to technical decisions and architectural discussions


Who are you?


  • Experienced developer with at least 7 years of experience with Vue.js
  • University-educated (preferred)
  • Able to work independently and take ownership of the entire frontend development
  • Thrives in an environment with lots of freedom and responsibility, both remote and on-site
  • Holds high standards for your own work in terms of quality, speed, and reliability
  • Excellent command of TypeScript in frontend projects
  • Experienced in translating Figma designs into functional UIs
  • Familiar with modern frontend tooling and best practices
  • Experience with backend concepts and API integrations
  • Strong communicator and professional collaborator with product and engineering
  • Fluent in either Dutch or English


Why work with us?


  • You help build technology that shapes the future of digital identity
  • You work in an ambitious team with a clear mission and high quality standards
  • You get a high degree of autonomy and responsibility over technology and product direction
  • We work results-oriented and rely on craftsmanship, ownership, and intrinsic motivation


Employment type: Full-time


Benefits:


  • Stock options
  • Professional development budget
  • Christmas package
  • Friday afternoon drinks


Education:


  • Master’s degree (Preferred)

companySlogan: Integrate with all digital identity apps globally.
companyDescription:
Ver.iD is a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform that enables developers to seamlessly integrate all digital identity apps into their online services. It features a simple design studio for creating custom login and verification flows, paired with an intuitive UI/UX that allows end-users to effortlessly select their installed identity wallet and complete the process.

We support login, verification, and credential issuance flows across all identity wallets through straightforward integrations using OAuth or OpenID Connect, enabling compatibility with a wide range of existing systems. Our developer-friendly SDKs ensure a fast and frictionless implementation experience.

As over a hundred decentralized identity wallets emerge globally, Ver.iD makes integrating digital identity as easy as accepting online payments today.

title: Full-Stack Developer (VCC)
descriptionHtml:
Location: The Hague, Netherlands hybrid working three (3) days per week in the office.

Type: Full-time

Reports to: Director of Engineering

XTM Group is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in the field of translation management. Our mission is to help enterprises reach global markets more efficiently by creating, delivering, and supporting an industry-leading platform to automate and manage all aspects of the localization process.

Our culture emphasizes teamwork, collaboration, and a passion for language technology to better serve customers and employees. We are dedicated to creating a solution-oriented and inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and can contribute their best. Our core values guide their actions and are the foundation of our company culture, driving us to achieve the vision of being the leading Translation Management System for enterprises.

We're looking for a skilled developer to help build and expand VCC (Video Creation Cloud) at XTM - a platform that combines automation, media processing, and large-scale video rendering. Our environment brings together .NET, AWS, Blazor, and a custom high-performance C++ render engine.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of C# enterprise development
  • Strong experience with .NET / .NET Core
  • Experience building AWS-hosted backend services (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, IAM, Step Functions, API Gateway, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with Blazor frontend development
  • Solid understanding of clean architecture, separation of concerns, and scalable system design
  • Strong knowledge of REST APIs, async programming, and distributed workflow design
  • Ability to integrate with native code or high-performance components (C++ render engine)
  • Comfortable working with:
    • GitHub (repos, workflows, branching strategies)
    • GitHub Actions (CI/CD)
    • Jira for planning and tracking
  • Strong focus on code quality, testing, and maintainability
Also..

  • Experience with media-processing pipelines
  • Familiarity with C++ or high-performance rendering concepts
  • Understanding of microservices and event-driven architectures
  • Experience building tools or automation for content creation workflows

What You'll Work On

  • Scaling and improving backend services on AWS
  • Building and maintaining Blazor-based UI components for the Video Creation Cloud
  • Integrating with our proprietary C++ render engine
  • Designing and optimizing distributed workflows for automated video generation
  • Implementing new features end-to-end—from backend logic all the way to user-facing components
  • Participating in architectural decisions and platform evolution

Why Join

  • Work on a platform that blends cloud engineering, media automation, and high-performance rendering
  • Modern stack: .NET, AWS, Blazor, C++, GitHub Actions, Jira
  • Real impact on a fast-growing product
  • Hybrid work setup in The Hague
  • Engineering-driven, practical decision-making

Build cutting-edge video automation tech used at scale

Benefits

What You Can Expect

Beyond a competitive salary, we offer a range of benefits designed to support your life and career, including:

  • Flexible work arrangements, with options for remote and hybrid setups (location-dependent)
  • Professional development, with access to international opportunities and career advancement programs
  • Continuous learning, powered by top-tier tools, training resources, and industry expertise

Benefits may vary by location — your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Everyone Belongs at XTM

At XTM, we design experiences that reflect and include the full spectrum of people we serve — and that begins with our own team. We're dedicated to building a workplace where inclusion isn't just a value, but a daily practice. Here, you'll find the support and encouragement to grow, succeed, and truly belong — no matter your background. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion page to see how we're shaping a more inclusive future at XTM.

The Application Journey

When you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will carefully review your application. If your experience aligns with the role, we'll be in touch to guide you through the next steps.

⚠️ Recruitment Alert: Please be aware of fraudulent recruitment activity. Only engage with XTM emails ending in @xtm-intl.com and xtm.cloud OR transifex.com.

We're also committed to accessibility and inclusive hiring. If you need accommodations at any stage of the process, please indicate this in your application or speak directly with the Talent Partner.

title: Back-end & Front-end Developer Shopware
descriptionHtml:
Back-end & Front-end Developer Shopware

Ben jij een ervaren back-end en front-end developer met kennis van Shopware 6 en een scherp oog voor technische optimalisatie? Heb jij de ambitie om niet alleen te bouwen aan slimme oplossingen, maar ook een brug te vormen tussen business en development? Dan is deze functie iets voor jou.


Wat ga je doen?

Als interne back-end en front-end developer ben jij de spil tussen ons e-commerce team en onze externe Shopware-partner. Jij zorgt ervoor dat technische wensen vanuit onze organisatie worden vertaald naar heldere en uitvoerbare oplossingen. Daarnaast werk je zelf aan uitbreidingen, optimalisaties en koppelingen binnen onze Shopware 6-omgeving.


Je bent verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van maatwerkmodules en plug-ins in Shopware 6
  • Optimaliseren van integraties met ERP-, PIM- en logistieke systemen met ons e-commerce platform (Shopware).
  • Ontwerpen en implementeren van API’s en webservices
  • Monitoren en verbeteren van databaseprestaties en backend-logica
  • Sparren met onze externe developers en technische keuzes onderbouwen
  • Debuggen en oplossen van bugs en performance-issues
  • Front-end design en concepten uitwerken


Wat krijg je van ons?

Een veelzijdige en technische functie binnen een groeiend e-commercebedrijf, met volop ruimte om jouw expertise in te zetten én te ontwikkelen. Daarnaast bieden we:


  • Twee dagen per week thuiswerken bij een fulltime dienstverband
  • Fulltime of parttime dienstverband mogelijk
  • Jaarlijks persoonlijk budget voor vitaliteit of ontwikkeling
  • Korte communicatielijnen en een platte organisatie
  • Werken in een jong en ambitieus team met veel vrijheid
  • 25 vakantiedagen per jaar (obv fulltime contract)
  • Pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding
  • Flexibele werktijden, starten tussen 08.00 en 09.00 uur
  • Een prettige werkplek op ons kantoor in Waalwijk.

Er is meer...


Wat breng je mee?

  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als back-end en front-end developer, bij voorkeur met Shopware 6
  • Ervaring met PHP (Symfony), Doctrine ORM, MySQL, Twig en SCSS
  • Kennis van REST API’s, en bij voorkeur ook GraphQL en/of SOAP
  • Ervaring met koppelingen met ERP- of PIM-systemen (ervaring met Akeneo is een pré)
  • Ervaring met testing tools zoals PHPUnit of Cypress is een pré
  • Sterk analytisch denkvermogen en oog voor performance en schaalbaarheid
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels
  • Proactieve werkhouding en gevoel voor teamwork
  • CRO kennis is een pré


Over Vehikit

Vehikit is dé online groothandel voor producten in de bedrijfswageninrichting. Van busbetimmering en kasten tot daktransport en beveiliging: wij bieden alles voor een professionele en efficiënte inrichting van bedrijfswagens.


Interesse?

Ben óf ken jij de geschikte kandidaat voor deze vacature? Neem dan contact met ons op via hr@vehikit.com óf 06-38626475 (Ester Zwart/HR).

title: Full Stack Engineer (FE-Oriented)
descriptionHtml:
Location

Our Full Stack Engineer will be an integral part of our Engineering teams in EMEA.

This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal. We don't consider applications from the US for this position.

Who We Are

DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.

With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity

As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will contribute to the evolution of DoiT Cloud Intelligence by integrating Cloudwize’s innovative Cloud Cybersecurity engines into DoiT Cloud Intelligence, helping us take our automation and intelligence capabilities to the next level. You will focus on creating seamless, high-quality user experiences that make complex cloud security and intelligence data accessible and actionable. Working closely with backend engineers, you’ll build new features, enhance existing workflows, design and extend APIs, develop scalable React-based interfaces, and help define front-end standards.

Beyond integration work and feature development, you’ll collaborate closely with product managers and cloud experts to transform technical insights into clear, intuitive workflows. You’ll have ownership over projects from concept to production, influence UI/UX direction, and contribute to a unified and intelligent experience as Cloudwize and DCI come together into a single, powerful ecosystem.

Responsibilities

  • Co-own the roadmap and backlog. Own parts of the product backlog, collaborate on defining and scoping future vision of the product roadmap.
  • Implementing features. From the proposal through spec and implementation to maintenance. You're expected to propose things that you think can be an excellent addition to the products
  • Reviewing code. We believe in code reviews. And you will soon start reviewing pull requests as well!
  • Improving the health of the codebase. We’re mindful of accumulating technical debt. We dedicate one day per week to housekeeping
  • Providing feedback. The team plans and discusses the upcoming work. We provide feedback to each other, trying to find challenges and unknowns as early as possible

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of software development experience as a Full Stack Engineer.
  • Strong proficiency in React and modern front-end development (hooks, state management, component architecture, performance optimization).
  • Proven experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs, and collaborating closely with backend developers to shape data and user flows.
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud services and their usage optimization is a major plus (across Cost optimization, Security, and performance)
  • A solid understanding of programming languages, ideally knowledge of Typescript and Go/Python programming languages, but if you don’t, you will be willing to learn and fully embrace these languages
  • Experience in system design and application design, including reusable UI patterns and scalable architectures.
  • Embraces continuous development and learning
  • Knowledge of software engineering practices
  • Experience with Git/GitHub
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal
  • Self-organized, Goal-oriented, self-motivated individual who is confident, thorough and tenacious
  • Ability to effectively operate with flexibility in a fast-paced, constantly evolving team environment
  • A great sense of humor and enjoys having fun at work

Bonus Points

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience

Are you a Do’er?

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.

We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button.

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Flexible Working Options
  • Health Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

Many Do’ers, One Team

DoiT unites as Many Do’ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal—it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

title: PHP Developer
descriptionHtml:
Over de organisatie:

Deze organisatie is al meer dan 25 jaar specialist in het ontwikkelen van innovatieve applicaties binnen de domeinen onderwijs en zorg. Hun software wordt voornamelijk intern gebruikt en is altijd ontworpen met de eindgebruiker in gedachten: mensen die willen leren, groeien en actief meedoen.


Wat je hier vindt: volop ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, een gezonde werk-privébalans en een inspirerende werkplek in een penthouse met dakterras en uitzicht. Inmiddels werken er wereldwijd meer dan 1.000 collega’s, maar de cultuur blijft informeel, betrokken en mensgericht.

Het team bestaat uit 13 PHP developers, en 3 .NET developers (waarvan 2 senior), een product owner, een business analist en een manager. De sfeer is informeel, vriendschappelijk en laagdrempelig. Er wordt samen geluncht en op vrijdagmiddag is er een vast moment voor een borrel met hun eigen gebrouwen bier.


Functie omschrijving:

Samen met je team werk je aan uiteenlopende maatwerkapplicaties met maatschappelijke impact. Een voorbeeldproject is een e-learning applicatie voor Ahold, zij willen hun medewerkers goed opleiden en maken hierom gebruik van maatwerksoftware. In het geval van A-hold hebben ze dan ook veel maatwerk geleverd met verschillende koppelingen en modules.


Als ervaren kracht in het team zul jij je meer focussen op de complexere zaken, bijvoorbeeld door vorm te geven aan de architectuur in bepaalde projecten. Hiernaast kun je meer junior programmeurs begeleiden in hun ontwikkeling, en/of code reviewen.


Eisen:

  • Je hebt ruime ervaring met PHP en Symfony
  • Je bent bekend met Typescript en Javascript met Vue, Angular.
  • Kennis van Python, Laravel, jQuery, CSS, Bash, CI/CD is een pre
  • Je hebt het analytische vermogen om technische uitdagingen aan te gaan en creatieve oplossingen voor te stellen die de gebruikerservaring aanzienlijk verbeteren
  • Je kunt zowel zelfstandig als in een team functioneren
  • Je neemt graag de senior rol op je binnen een team, en kunt meer junior programmeurs helpen in hun ontwikkeling.


Aanbod:

  • Een salaris indicatie tot € 5500,- bruto o.b.v. fulltime
  • Flexibele werktijden/ thuiswerkmogelijkheden 2 dagen kantoor rest kan vanuit huis
  • Je krijgt een individueel budget voor relevante opleidingen/trainingen
  • Je inbreng en ideeën worden serieus genomen
  • Jaarcontract met zicht op een vast contract
  • Pensioenregeling
  • Thuiswerk- en reiskostenvergoeding
  • Korting op je zorgverzekering
  • Bijdrage aan je sportabonnement
  • 25 vakantiedagen
  • 8% vakantiegeld

Hiernaast kun je meer junior programmeurs begeleiden in hun ontwikkeling, en/of code reviewen.Eisen:Je hebt ruime ervaring met PHP en SymfonyJe bent bekend met Typescript en Javascript met Vue, Angular.Kennis van Python, Laravel, jQuery, CSS, Bash, CI/CD is een preJe hebt het analytische vermogen om technische uitdagingen aan te gaan en creatieve oplossingen voor te stellen die de gebruikerservaring aanzienlijk verbeterenJe kunt zowel zelfstandig als in een team functionerenJe neemt graag de senior rol op je binnen een team, en kunt meer junior programmeurs helpen in hun ontwikkeling.Aanbod:Een salaris indicatie tot € 5500,- bruto o.b.v. fulltimeFlexibele werktijden/ thuiswerkmogelijkheden 2 dagen kantoor rest kan vanuit huisJe krijgt een individueel budget voor relevante opleidingen/trainingenJe inbreng en ideeën worden serieus genomenJaarcontract met zicht op een vast contractPensioenregelingThuiswerk- en reiskostenvergoedingKorting op je zorgverzekeringBijdrage aan je sportabonnement25 vakantiedagen8% vakantiegeld

companyDescription:
Starapple is een bemiddelingsbureau voor bedrijven die op zoek zijn naar ICT specialisten met uiterst specifieke vaardigheden. Wij bieden ontwikkelaars en overige ICT-ers precies de uitdagingen waarnaar ze op zoek zijn. Dankzij een grondige analyse van de beide partijen en kennis van de uit te voeren taken en  gevraagde vaardigheden, zijn wij in staat om goede en langdurige matches te maken.

In 2008 is Starapple gestart met de bemiddeling van Microsoft .NET development (C# / VB.NET / ASP.NET) specialisten voor een vast dienstverband. PHP en Java experts volgden al snel. Vanwege de groeiende vraag  naar een ‘one-stop-shop’ hebben we ervoor gekozen om naast software ontwikkeling ook beheer- en testspecialisten aan onze dienstverlening toe te voegen. Tegenwoordig hebben we ook data warehousing (Oracle en SQL dba), BI, ERP en CRM (Microsoft Dynamics, SAP en overige ERP en CRM pakketten) specialisten en consultants in huis.

Al sinds onze start onderscheiden wij ons met een zeer gedreven en persoonlijke aanwezigheid op de Nederlandse ICT markt. Ambitie moet tenslotte van beide kanten komen. De drijvende kracht achter Starapple is een groep enthousiaste en gespecialiseerd opgeleide, service gerichte consultants. Iedere consultant beslaat een aparte regio en een technische expertise. Samen hebben ze al meer dan 5000 specialisten en bedrijven succesvol met elkaar verbonden.

title: Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Join our team

CLEVER°FRANKE is an enthusiastic, multi-disciplinary team of 40+ people with 15 different nationalities from across the world and we use English as a primary language to communicate and collaborate. We are interaction designers, visual designers, developers, project managers, data analysts and others. All with a passion for what we do. We are curious about the world around us and apply the same curiosity to our work and projects.


We are looking for

As a Full Stack Developer, you will work on cutting-edge projects that make a real difference. Your role will span the entire development spectrum. You will be our go-to team member for defining back-end solutions, pipelines, and hosting, while also bringing experience in crafting intuitive front-end interfaces. As a technologist, you will take a leading role in projects and collaborate with a multi-disciplinary team to produce high-quality user experiences.

Our tech stack is ever evolving. We are not married to any specific technology and are pragmatic: we choose the stack that fits the job best. We are always open to fresh perspectives on building, scaling, and maintaining software projects. We’re continuously exploring and innovating, and like to work with emerging technologies like AI, AR/VR and physical interfaces.

Though we always adapt our approach to the requirements of a specific project, the development workflow of a typical C°F project will generally include submitting pull requests that trigger CI/CD pipelines with various code-quality checks and automated deployment to a serverless platform like Vercel or Netlify. Team members will perform code reviews to safeguard code-quality as well as QA reviews to make sure all work we do meets the high quality standard that we set for ourselves.


What you bring

As a Full Stack Developer, you will bring at least 5 years of experience in full-stack development, with a proven track record in backend development. You have an innovative mindset and eagerness to explore new technologies. Next to that, you will bring:

  • Expertise in back-end development, API-design and databases (e.g. Node.js, Python, Swagger, GraphQL, PostgreSQL)
  • Solid front-end skills: experience with reactive frameworks like React and styling solutions like CSS-in-JS, SCSS, etc
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and cloud deployment platforms (AWS, Azure, Vercel, Netlify)
  • Proficiency in Git, code-reviews and CI/CD workflows (e.g. GitHub Actions, Gitlab CI)
  • Excellent communication skills in English.


We’d be especially excited if you also have experience in:

  • TypeScript
  • Search engine technologies like ElasticSearch
  • Different CMS (both headless and traditional)
  • Developing AI-driven products, including integration with LLMs through APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic) or self-hosted models
  • Infrastructure-as-code tooling (e.g. Terraform)


We’ll give you

  • Full-time/part-time role (32-40 hours per week);
  • A competitive salary, based on your background and experience;
  • Support from a friendly, passionate, down-to-earth team;
  • A personal development budget of 1000 euro per year for trainings tailored to your personal and professional growth;
  • A personal wellbeing budget of 250 euros per year (purchase a bike, fitness or yoga membership);
  • Two extra holidays per calendar year, because we all have events in our life that we need time for (weddings, celebrating religious or cultural events);
  • Hybrid working from our studio or home – (at least 2 days per week in the studio);
  • A healthy, abundant lunch every day in the studio;
  • Paid train expenses from your home to the studio;
  • A collective pension plan;
  • A MacBook and all the peripherals you need;
  • Inspiring team events; such as our annual team prototyping day, team trainings, sport events and conference visits.


We’ll support you

We find it important that you grow and challenge yourself and we want to ensure that you are supported in this. That’s why we offer:

  • Training courses: tailored to your experience level and needs, personal development planning, and feedback sessions.
  • Our People & Culture Manager: who will help you with your professional and personal development.
  • CLEVER°FRANKE Development week: about 3 times a year, we organize a week where the entire studio fully focuses on personal and professional growth, outside of client projects.
  • CLEVER°FRANKE Prototype Day: a day full of creativity, innovation, learning, and working with colleagues in a hands-on environment.


Would you like to join us?

Apply now with your CV and portfolio, and some questions we’ll ask to get to know you a little better.

Please note that for this position we are looking for someone who has EU working permit. The position is based in The Netherlands.

If you successfully pass through our screening, we’ll invite you to the interview process, which entails three further conversations to ensure you get to know our culture and the role better, and to identify whether there is a fit from both sides.


You’re welcome at CLEVER°FRANKE regardless of your appearance, identity or background. It’s not a place you have to ‘fit in’ but somewhere everyone can feel themselves and be their best to do their best.

Studies suggest that women and underrepresented groups tend to hesitate to apply for a job if their CV isn’t a perfect fit. Here, we look for talent and potential – not just formal experience and expertise. So if you like the role and think you could be awesome at it, go ahead and apply.

title: Senior PHP Developer
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to build scalable, secure software that powers next-generation fintech platforms across Europe? Join a fast-growing tech company where reliability, performance, and clean architecture are key.


What you’ll do

As a Senior Backend Developer, you’ll design and maintain high-availability backend systems that support millions of users. You’ll architect microservices, optimize performance, and shape technical strategy, while mentoring others in a collaborative, agile team.


You will:

  • Build and optimize scalable APIs and backend systems (PHP, Laravel/Symfony).
  • Work with MySQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.
  • Drive architectural decisions to ensure performance, reliability, and security.
  • Collaborate with experienced engineers and share knowledge across teams.


What’s in it for you

  • 💼 Salary up to €95,000/year all included
  • 🧠 Growth through training, certifications, and mentorship.
  • 🌴 24 holidays + 2 recharge days.
  • 🚲 NS Business Card, bike plan & hybrid work setup.
  • 💻 MacBook, home office setup & modern office.
  • 🥗 Catered lunches, team events & a developer-first culture.


Who you are

✅ Strong experience with PHP, Laravel/Symfony, MySQL, and microservices.

✅ Skilled in Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.

✅ Passionate about scalability, security, and quality code.

✅ Fluent in English and living in the Netherlands.

title: PHP Developer
descriptionHtml:
Only applicants already living in The Netherlands.

Alphacomm makes large European companies more successful and financially healthier by securing their revenue. From increasing the average revenue per user, eliminating payment fraud in online transactions, and slashing the risk of non- and late payments, we are operating on top of our customers’ priorities.

With locations in Rotterdam, Romania, UK and Germany we operate on an international scale as the trusted partner for many large organizations in Europe. With our experience-based knowledge and our ability to connect the dots, we help our customers to secure their revenue and have fun while working with us.

Your challenge

Alphacomm is on the hunt for talented and experienced PHP Developers to join our dynamic Reloads (Checkmaxx) product team. We need someone who can handle the crucial role in the development and maintenance of our innovative solution suite as we scale towards our goal of processing €1 billion in transaction value.

As the Developer for Reloads at Alphacomm you:

  • Design, develop, document and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code
  • Collaborate within and across product teams to support the definition, design, and deployment of new features
  • Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of the solution
  • Identify / fix bugs and performance bottlenecks in an efficient manner with little-to-no downtime
  • Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and ensure best practices
  • Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends; ensure you are gaining and sharing knowledge
  • Work in Rotterdam, travel time from your home max. 60 minutes.


You will work in a cross functional scrum team where you are responsible for creating clean code with a huge business sense

  • Integration of new solutions build or buy to our PaaS platform.
  • Integrate our customer to our PaaS Platform and its products and services.
  • Finding generic solutions which are reusable and can accommodate multiple customers
  • Think about how our solutions can be improved and expanded.
  • Be customer centric but also critical on thе customer needs.
  • Be proactive in picking up new things to improve thе solutions we offer.


About You

  • Ideally, you have a College Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, but experience is more important.
  • You have a 100% match with our core values
  • You are fluent in English
  • You have experience with version management and love structured work
  • Experience with backend development technologies and processes (additionally having front-end experience is a plus)
  • You have at least 4-6 years experience in a similar position
  • You embrace agile methodologies
  • Proficient in PHP, Symfony, Silex, Doctrine, Composer, Bitbucket, Docker, AWS, GIT. Experience and certification in Pimcore framework is ideal.


You MUST live in The Netherlands (and are able to come to the office minimal 60% of the time, we feel nothing beats face to face contact ) AND have a visa to work here.

You will become part of a close-knit and well-functioning team with a typical “Rotterdam” mentality. That means we are committed to our goals and your input and ideas are appreciated.

Our organization is based on the following core values:

  • Care
  • Eyes on the prize
  • Walk the talk
  • Think Different
  • Have fun


What you can expect from us:

  • A good salary
  • 25 days of vacation leave
  • Travel allowance
  • Pension scheme, 50% paid by us
  • The opportunity to contribute and be part of a fast-growing company
  • Direct lines of communication
  • A great place to work with a bunch of great international colleagues


Location for position: Rotterdam (NL)

If you're a proactive and results-oriented individual with a knack for making development fun, we would love to hear from you.

Join our team at Alphacomm and let's create some product magic together!
