title: Full-Stack Mobile Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Over Ons

Clockworks is een AI-specialist uit Rotterdam. Al meer dan tien jaar bouwen we oplossingen die complexe handmatige processen omzetten in slimme, robuuste automatisering. Van computer vision tot workflow-software: wij zorgen dat AI gewoon werkt.

Onze technologie wordt gebruikt in industriële en logistieke omgevingen waar stabiliteit, performance en gebruiksgemak cruciaal zijn. We combineren diepe AI-expertise met sterke software engineering–principes, en ontwikkelen alles van mobiele apps tot cloud-native AI-platformen.

Een van onze belangrijkste producten is Blicker AI: een AI-oplossing die (utiliteits)meters automatisch digitaliseert op basis van een foto. Deze technologie vormt de kern van een gloednieuwe SaaS-applicatie die we momenteel ontwikkelen voor het complete beheer van meters en andere utility assets.

Daarnaast bouwen we aan een nieuwe propositie waarin LiDAR-scanning en AI worden gecombineerd voor nauwkeurige 3D-captures en analyses van assets bij aanleg van energie-netten en andere nutsvoorzieningen. Voor deze applicatie ontwikkelen we een nieuwe iOS-app met Swift, ARKit en device-side intelligente verwerking, en precies daarom zoeken we versterking op mobile & full-stack vlak.

Jouw Rol - Full-Stack Software Engineer met iOS-focus

We zoeken een full-stack engineer die moderne webapplicaties kan bouwen én ervaren is in native iOS-ontwikkeling met Swift. Je werkt aan frontend applicaties in React, backend-services in Python, en onze iOS-applicaties waarin we intensief gebruikmaken van ARKit, LiDAR en device-side verwerking.

Een pré (maar geen must): ervaring met Core ML, bijvoorbeeld voor on-device modelloading, optimalisatie of modelconversie. Dit zou enorm goed aansluiten bij onze mobile AI-ambities.

Wat je gaat doenFrontend ontwikkeling

  • Werken aan moderne webapps in React + TypeScript, met gebruik van UI frameworks als MUI.
  • Bouwen van schaalbare, modulaire frontend-architecturen.


iOS / Mobile Development

  • Bouwen, uitbreiden en onderhouden van native iOS-apps in Swift met ARKit, LiDAR-scanning, 3D capture en device-side sensor fusion.
  • Optimaliseren van mobile UX voor complexe AI-functionaliteit.
  • Integreren van AI-modellen on-device en samenwerken met de AI-engineers voor performance en stabiliteit.
  • (Pré) Werken met Core ML voor modeldeployment, quantization of pipelines.


Backend & Cloud

  • Ontwikkelen van backend-services in Python (FastAPI/Django).
  • Ontwerpen en integreren van REST/GraphQL API’s.
  • Ontwerpen en beheren van relationele databases (Postgres).
  • Meewerken aan robuuste, schaalbare cloudarchitecturen (Azure/AWS) en containerized workflows (Docker/Kubernetes).


Product ontwerp

  • Overleggen met stakeholders om tot een wenselijk ontwerp te komen.
  • Ontwerpen van gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces voor AI-tools, dashboards en workflows.
  • Visueel ontwerp vastleggen (bijvoorbeeld in Figma of Adobe XD) om te kunnen delen met je collega’s.


Engineering culture

  • Nauw samenwerken in een klein, technisch sterk team.
  • Zelfstandig werken; zelf beslissingen durven nemen en actief meedenken over wat beter kan. Neem vooral initiatief wanneer iets niet klopt. Zo zorgen we er samen voor dat we snel, wendbaar en innovatief blijven werken, waarin iedereen de kans heeft om bij te dragen en onze producten continu te blijven verbeteren.


Wat we zoeken

Onze ideale kandidaat heeft;

  • 5+ jaar ervaring als software engineer.
  • Sterke frontend vaardigheden: React, TypeScript, moderne webdevelopment.
  • Ervaring met native iOS-ontwikkeling in Swift
  • Ervaring met ARKit of vergelijkbare 3D/AR frameworks is een mooie pré
  • Comfortabel met backend-werk in Python.
  • Uitstekend in Nederlands én Engels.
  • Je houdt van autonomie, duidelijke verantwoordelijkheid en snel schakelen.


Waarom Clockworks?

  • Unieke mix van mobile, web en AI-integration — weinig plekken bieden deze combinatie.
  • Veel verantwoordelijkheid, weinig bureaucratie — jouw werk maakt direct impact op echte producten.
  • Leuk, nuchter team waar kwaliteit en plezier belangrijk zijn.
  • Flexibel werken en sterk arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket.


Solliciteren

Interesse? Stuur je CV en korte motivatie naar careers@clockworks.co.

Geen acquisitie of bemiddeling door recruitmentbureaus aub.

companySlogan: Make it simple.
companyDescription:
Bij Clockworks geloven we dat kunstmatige intelligentie niet ingewikkeld hóéft te zijn. Waar AI vaak wordt neergezet als rocket science, maken wij het juist simpel , zonder concessies aan kwaliteit, veiligheid of schaalbaarheid.

Als echte AI-vakmensen ontwikkelen we maatwerkoplossingen die doen wat ze moeten doen: complexe, tijdrovende bedrijfsprocessen omzetten in slimme, efficiënte workflows. Geen demo’s of proof of concepts die in een la verdwijnen, maar robuuste oplossingen die in de praktijk direct waarde leveren. Veilig, schaalbaar en betaalbaar.

Onze kracht zit in eenvoud. Zoals een klok aan de buitenkant simpel tijd toont, terwijl er vanbinnen een complex radarwerk draait, zo werken wij ook. We sleutelen net zolang tot het werkt. Want alleen als iets écht eenvoudig voelt, weet je dat het klopt.

title: Senior Frontend Developer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Senior Frontend Developer (m/f/d)

Amsterdam, hybrid

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

This role is part of our Experience & Engineering team based in the Netherlands. We combine our skills in developing future-ready technical solutions with our expertise in creating beautiful designs to deliver exceptional and engaging digital experiences that build lasting relationships with our clients like Gant, Inter Milan, bol.com and Just Eat Takeaway.

Job Purpose

We’re looking for a Frontend Developer who thrives on translating high-fidelity designs and clear acceptance criteria into polished, performant, and accessible digital experiences. At DEPT®, your work will directly shape the frontlines of global digital platforms — where visual excellence, responsiveness, and accessibility matter. You’ll work alongside multidisciplinary teams to create frontends that meet today’s standards and tomorrow’s expectations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate tickets and acceptance criteria into functional, testable components using React, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript.
  • Build interfaces from Figma designs with high visual accuracy and attention to pixel perfection.
  • Develop responsive layouts and components that adapt elegantly across devices and breakpoints.
  • Ensure all components are accessible and inclusive, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA compliance standards.
  • Optimize UIs for Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) and other performance metrics.
  • Contribute to and maintain shared component libraries and frontend standards.
  • Collaborate with designers, QA, and backend developers to validate requirements and ship features.
  • Follow clean coding practices like DRY, KISS, and component reuse to keep the codebase scalable and maintainable.
  • Great to have: Working knowledge of Framer Motion, GSAP, ThreeJS, or other animation frameworks


What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience building frontend applications, preferably in agency or multi-project environments.
  • Fluency in React, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript, with strong attention to detail and usability.
  • High working proficiency in both Dutch and English.
  • Knowledge on how to bring Figma designs to life, down to the last pixel — but know when perfection gives way to pragmatism.
  • Ability to build fully responsive UIs that look and behave well on all modern devices and browsers.
  • Understanding of optimisation for Core Web Vitals and real-world performance benchmarks.
  • Ability to apply WCAG 2.2 AA standards — including semantic markup, keyboard accessibility, and visual contrast.
  • Passion for UI quality, maintainability, and collaborating with designers and backend engineers.
  • Application of clean code principles like DRY, KISS, and modularity to your work.
  • Clear communication and contribution to a healthy, collaborative team dynamic.


WE OFFER

  • A flexible, hybrid working policy (2-3 days from the office, depending on location) and the opportunity to work from abroad for 13 weeks a year.
  • 24 vacation days per year and the possibility to buy an unlimited number of extra vacation days.
  • DEPT®/YOU Learning Menu and DEPT®/YOU Special Programs. Develop your skills with courses and programs tailored to your needs.
  • Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform, gym and wellness discounts, and healthy lunches at the office.
  • A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021 and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.
  • Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!
  • The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.
  • Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.


WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

title: Senior Frontend Developer (Product Team)
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are 🌍

Manychat helps creators and businesses automate and scale conversations across Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram, and TikTok, driving stronger engagement, more conversions, and sustainable growth.

With a distributed team across three continents, we build a platform used by more than 1.5 million customers worldwide. We move fast, ship with high ownership, and solve complex product and technical challenges at scale.

Who We're Looking For 🌟

We’re looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who thrives in a cross-functional, product-driven environment. Someone who enjoys collaborating with backend engineers, designers, and product managers to shape thoughtful, user-focused solutions across complex product areas.

Engineers who excel at Manychat think in terms of user value and product impact, look beyond the code to how the team works, enjoy high-complexity problems, appreciate collaborative ownership, and communicate clearly while raising the bar for others.

Frontend at Manychat ⚛️

Our tech stack is: React, Redux, Typescript, Vite, XState, Jest, Playwright.

Here is what stands out about being a frontend engineer at Manychat:

  • Frontend team with real depth. With an average of 9+ years of experience, most of our 30+ engineers are seniors supported by a strong group of tech leads who shape the architecture. It’s a high-bar environment where growth accelerates naturally through thoughtful reviews and solid engineering practices.
  • Engineering connection with Meta. We are an official Meta Business Partner, giving our engineers a direct line into Meta’s ecosystem. This includes early access to new APIs, insight into upcoming platform changes, and the chance to build features aligned with the standards of one of the world’s largest tech companies.
  • Build for millions. Our platform processes 1**+ billion messages a year** for more than 1.5 million customers in 170+ countries, so the features you ship have real global reach.
  • Go beyond standard UI work. Alongside product features, you’ll contribute to complex interactive experiences like our Flow Builder, built on WebGL and PixiJS, so you’ll have opportunities to work on complex interactive systems, not just forms and dashboards.
  • Build on strong engineering foundations. A dedicated platform team maintains our TypeScript monorepo, while our evolving design system team enables consistent, scalable frontend development and improves developer experience.

What You Will Do 🧑🏻‍💻

  • Lead high-complexity feature development by evaluating approaches, communicating trade-offs, driving decisions that balance product value, speed and scalability.
  • Lead technical discovery by researching edge cases, exploring system connections, and bringing insights to backlog refinement.
  • Shape product outcomes by challenging requirements when needed, offering alternatives, and ensuring the most efficient path forward.
  • Collaborate in a cross-functional team with backend engineers and designers, working closely with a product manager to shape solutions and align on outcomes.
  • Improve system quality and resilience by defining and monitoring key metrics, investigating issues, supporting incident analysis, and reducing tech debt.
  • Raise engineering standards through maintainable code, thoughtful architecture, and high-impact code reviews focused on patterns, performance, and long-term health.
  • Strengthen team execution by facilitating discussions, guiding teammates through decisions, and helping align the team on goals, risks, and constraints.

What You Bring 💥

You Have Strong Technical Expertise, Product Intuition And Collaborative Mindset That Helps You Thrive In a Fast-moving, Cross-functional Environment. In Particular, You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience building modern frontend applications with TypeScript and React.
  • A product-oriented mindset: you understand how users interact with the product, use this context to shape solutions and make technical decisions that maximize business value.
  • Ability to tackle high-complexity engineering problems independently and reduce ambiguity through research and clear reasoning.
  • Strong grasp of browser mechanics, performance, rendering, and client-server interactions.
  • Strong communication in English and the ability to collaborate effectively.

What We Offer 🤝🏻

We care about your growth, well-being, and comfort:

  • 🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family.
  • 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family.
  • 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow.
  • 🫶 Flexible benefits package to tailor perks that matters most for you.
  • 🪴 Hybrid work and generous leave options to prioritize your work-life balance.
  • 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks.
  • 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events.

Manychat is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.

This commitment is also reflected through our candidate experience. If you have individual needs that may require an accommodation during the interview process, please indicate this in your application. We will do our best to provide assistance throughout your interview process to ensure you’re set up for success.

With my application, I accept the Manychat Privacy Policy.

We move fast, ship with high ownership, and solve complex product and technical challenges at scale.Who We're Looking For 🌟We’re looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who thrives in a cross-functional, product-driven environment. Someone who enjoys collaborating with backend engineers, designers, and product managers to shape thoughtful, user-focused solutions across complex product areas.Engineers who excel at Manychat think in terms of user value and product impact, look beyond the code to how the team works, enjoy high-complexity problems, appreciate collaborative ownership, and communicate clearly while raising the bar for others.Frontend at Manychat ⚛️Our tech stack is: React, Redux, Typescript, Vite, XState, Jest, Playwright.Here is what stands out about being a frontend engineer at Manychat:Frontend team with real depth. With an average of 9+ years of experience, most of our 30+ engineers are seniors supported by a strong group of tech leads who shape the architecture. It’s a high-bar environment where growth accelerates naturally through thoughtful reviews and solid engineering practices.Engineering connection with Meta. We are an official Meta Business Partner, giving our engineers a direct line into Meta’s ecosystem. This includes early access to new APIs, insight into upcoming platform changes, and the chance to build features aligned with the standards of one of the world’s largest tech companies.Build for millions. Our platform processes 1**+ billion messages a year** for more than 1.5 million customers in 170+ countries, so the features you ship have real global reach.Go beyond standard UI work. Alongside product features, you’ll contribute to complex interactive experiences like our Flow Builder, built on WebGL and PixiJS, so you’ll have opportunities to work on complex interactive systems, not just forms and dashboards.Build on strong engineering foundations. A dedicated platform team maintains our TypeScript monorepo, while our evolving design system team enables consistent, scalable frontend development and improves developer experience.What You Will Do 🧑🏻‍💻Lead high-complexity feature development by evaluating approaches, communicating trade-offs, driving decisions that balance product value, speed and scalability.Lead technical discovery by researching edge cases, exploring system connections, and bringing insights to backlog refinement.Shape product outcomes by challenging requirements when needed, offering alternatives, and ensuring the most efficient path forward.Collaborate in a cross-functional team with backend engineers and designers, working closely with a product manager to shape solutions and align on outcomes.Improve system quality and resilience by defining and monitoring key metrics, investigating issues, supporting incident analysis, and reducing tech debt.Raise engineering standards through maintainable code, thoughtful architecture, and high-impact code reviews focused on patterns, performance, and long-term health.Strengthen team execution by facilitating discussions, guiding teammates through decisions, and helping align the team on goals, risks, and constraints.What You Bring 💥You Have Strong Technical Expertise, Product Intuition And Collaborative Mindset That Helps You Thrive In a Fast-moving, Cross-functional Environment. In Particular, You Bring5+ years of experience building modern frontend applications with TypeScript and React.A product-oriented mindset: you understand how users interact with the product, use this context to shape solutions and make technical decisions that maximize business value.Ability to tackle high-complexity engineering problems independently and reduce ambiguity through research and clear reasoning.Strong grasp of browser mechanics, performance, rendering, and client-server interactions.Strong communication in English and the ability to collaborate effectively.What We Offer 🤝🏻We care about your growth, well-being, and comfort:🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family.💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family.📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow.🫶 Flexible benefits package to tailor perks that matters most for you.🪴 Hybrid work and generous leave options to prioritize your work-life balance.🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks.🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events.Manychat is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.This commitment is also reflected through our candidate experience. If you have individual needs that may require an accommodation during the interview process, please indicate this in your application. We will do our best to provide assistance throughout your interview process to ensure you’re set up for success.With my application, I accept the Manychat Privacy Policy.

Manychat is a leading Chat Marketing platform. We enable businesses and creators to drive more sales and conversions on messaging apps, such as Instagram, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, and Telegram, using automation.

Founded in 2016, we still embrace a startup work culture — making fast decisions, setting ambitions goals, fostering open feedback and transparency. We think big and win together. 🏆

We care intensely about our customers and their goals. By experimenting a lot and testing hypotheses, we continuously improve our product to help businesses grow and generate revenue on their social channels. That’s how we deliver results and dazzle our customers. ⚡️

🚀 Ready to make an impact in a new and fast-evolving market? Explore our job openings here on LinkedIn, or by visiting our careers page: https://careers.manychat.com/

title: Shopify Front-End Developer and Designer
descriptionHtml:
Founded in 2018 and headquartered in The Netherlands, GT Ecom BV is on a mission to build the most efficient global direct-to-consumer infrastructure and become the world’s largest e-commerce company—powered by a collective of successful, scalable brands. By 2026, we’re aiming to achieve $500 million in revenue and operate over 50 thriving online stores worldwide.

With a team of 160+ top-tier remote e-commerce professionals across the globe, we blend local brand experiences with cross-border logistics, ensuring every customer feels connected—no matter where they are.

At our core, we value hard work, freedom with responsibility, constant improvement, and a mindset of positivity. We believe in building a high-performance, remote-first culture where honesty, excellence, and creativity drive everything we do—because the future of work is global, and we’re building it together.

The Upsides of Working with Us

💪 Hard Work That Matters

We’re surrounded by people who care deeply and give their best. We don’t settle for average—we show up, push boundaries, and aim high. That shared drive creates momentum and meaning in everything we do.

🔓 Freedom with Responsibility

You have the freedom to choose how, when, and where you work—but freedom only thrives when it’s paired with ownership. We trust you to manage your time, meet your commitments, and take responsibility for your impact.

📚 Constant Improvement

Growth is part of our DNA. We believe in learning, evolving, and getting 1% better every day. Whether it’s a new skill, a fresh mindset, or sharper execution—stagnation isn’t in our vocabulary.

🌞 Positivity by Default

We approach people, problems, and communication with a positive mindset. That means giving the benefit of the doubt, staying constructive, and keeping energy high—even when challenges arise.

🗣️ Honesty & Transparency

We believe the fastest way to move forward is through clear, honest communication. No politics. No guessing games. Just straight talk that builds trust and strengthens our team.

🏆 Excellence Is the Baseline

We hold ourselves and each other to a high standard—not out of pressure, but out of pride. We care too much about what we’re building to accept "good enough." Excellence is the expectation.

🎯 Creativity Welcome Here

We encourage bold ideas, fast testing, and open collaboration. Failure doesn’t scare us—comfort does. That’s why creativity is valued as a core ingredient in everything from product to process.

We’re on the lookout for a Shopify Front-End Developer to join our expanding team and drive our company’s growth!

The Challenge

The company is dedicated to enhancing the performance of Shopify stores across a variety of markets. To support this initiative, we are on the lookout for a seasoned Front End Developer with proven expertise in Shopify front end development. This role will be instrumental in building responsive, high-performance web applications that enhance user experience and drive conversions.

Day in the Life of a Shopify Front-End Developer at GT Ecom

  • Implement user-friendly interfaces specifically for promotional offers on Shopify using HTML, CSS, and Javascript, ensuring a smooth and engaging customer experience.
  • Work closely with the marketing team to translate promotional offer designs into functional and visually appealing web elements
  • Enhance presentation and performance of promotional features within Shopify, focusing on improving user engagement and conversion rates.
  • Perform thorough testing and debugging of promotional implementations on Shopify to guarantee seamless functionality prior to deployment
  • Regularly maintain and improve existing Shopify codebases related to promotional offers

Your Team When You Join Us

In this role, you will be reporting to the Bulk Store Manager and work alongside an eight-member global team to develop and implement marketing strategies aimed at increasing bulk product visibility and sales through effective campaigns and engaging content.

We would love to hear from you if…

  • You have at least 1 year of experience in Shopify design and front-end development.
  • You are proficient in Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and theme development, with experience in APIs, app integrations, responsive design, and performance optimization. Skilled in debugging, version control, and delivering scalable, high-quality code.
  • You have a strong eye for UI/UX, branding, and visual design, able to craft engaging, conversion-focused storefronts. You are experienced with Figma/Adobe XD and excel at blending aesthetic design with functional usability.
  • You have demonstrated expertise in responsive design principles, particularly in building promotional layouts that adapt seamlessly across devices.
  • You possess excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and strong communication abilities, enabling you to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

If you are excited about the opportunity and feel like you are a good fit, we encourage you to apply today and talk to one of our recruiters. We look forward to seeing how your skills and experiences align with our vision. If unsure, we still welcome your application and would be happy to discuss other potential roles that may be a good fit for you.

Overview Of Our Interview Process

  • Application Submission - We’ll start by reviewing your application.
  • Initial Contact - Our Recruiter will reach out to you to discuss the next steps
    • Written Assessment - You will take a 22-minute test
    • Initial Interview - To be conducted by one of our recruiters if you passed the Written Assessment.
  • Final Interview
    • Meet with the Hiring Manager
  • Offer Discussion - If all goes well, we'll discuss the offer and invite you to our pre-onboarding process.
  • Pre-Onboarding Process
    • Background Check: Verification of your identification and declared address.
    • Reference Check: We’ll contact your three references for their feedback.
  • Onboarding: Once all checks are completed, we’ll initiate the onboarding process.

title: Magento / Hyvä Frontend Developer
location: Berkel en Rodenrijs, South Holland, Netherlands
descriptionHtml:
Word jij blij van mooie, snelle webshops en wil je bouwen aan merken die écht groeien? En vind je het belangrijk om in een team te werken waar je kunt lachen, leren en jezelf ontwikkelen? Dan pas je waarschijnlijk perfect bij ons.


Wat ga je doen?

Bij Cream werk je mee aan het ontwikkelen van moderne e-commerce stores voor verschillende klanten. Samen met designers, backend-developers en projectmanagers zet jij ideeën om in een snelle en fijne gebruikerservaring. Je werkt veel met Hyvä en helpt bestaande shops nog beter te maken.

  • Je bouwt responsive Magento-webshops die snel aanvoelen en goed scoren
  • Je ontwikkelt nieuwe functionaliteiten en verbetert bestaande features
  • Je werkt met Hyvä om moderne storefronts neer te zetten
  • Je denkt mee, deelt ideeën en werkt samen met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines
Wat breng jij mee?

Je hoeft niet alles al te kunnen. Als je wilt groeien, leer je het bij ons.

  • Je voelt je thuis in moderne frontend stacks (Tailwind, Alpine.js)
  • Je kunt overweg met PHP waar nodig
  • Je krijgt energie van e-commerce en een goede user experience
  • Je bent leergierig, zelfstandig en gestructureerd
  • Samenwerken en kennis delen vind je net zo belangrijk als code schrijven
  • Je spreekt Nederlands en liefst ook Engels

Bonuspunten als:

  • Je al Magento en/of Hyvä ervaring hebt
  • Je een Hyvä of Magento certificaat hebt


Wat krijg je van ons?

Naast uitdagende projecten en fijne collega’s, bieden we je alle ruimte om te groeien, technisch en persoonlijk.

  • Goed salaris + flexibele arbeidsvoorwaarden (aantal uren, vakantiedagen, pensioen, leaseauto)
  • Hybride werken, twee dagen op kantoor, verder zoals het past voor jou
  • Mogelijkheid om een paar weken per jaar vanuit het buitenland te werken
  • Een warm, betrokken team waar je je snel thuis voelt
  • Een uitgebreid onboarding-traject zodat je meteen mee kunt draaien
  • Persoonlijk opleidingsbudget + ondersteuning voor certificering (Magento/Hyvä)
  • Werken met collega’s met meer dan 15 jaar Magento-ervaring
  • Ruimte en vertrouwen om je werk te doen op jouw manier
  • Gezamenlijke lunches, wandelrondes & genoeg humor op Slack
  • Legendarische teamuitjes en vieren successen met taart

Als jij graag bouwt aan webshops én aan jezelf, dan hebben we waarschijnlijk een match.


Over Cream

Cream is een digitaal bureau gespecialiseerd in Magento Open Source, Hyvä en e-commerce strategie. We werken voor klanten met ambitie en geloven in lange termijn samenwerking, kwaliteit en plezier in wat je doet.

Bij ons vind je geen logge hiërarchie, maar korte lijnen, humor en veel vrijheid. Iedereen draagt bij aan het succes van het team van developer tot directeur.


Interesse?

Stuur je motivatie en eventueel je portfolio of LinkedIn-profiel naar marcel@cream.nl

companyDescription: Cream creëert en optimaliseert Magento - Hyvä webshops. Wij helpen organisaties om van hun e-commerce strategie een succes te maken. Alles draait daarbij om het behalen van maximaal rendement. Webshops worden gerealiseerd op basis van Magento, het toonaangevende e-commerce platform van dit moment. Cream heeft passie voor internet en oog voor kwaliteit, daarbij biedt Cream toegevoegde waarde door het inzetten van haar jarenlange kennis en ervaring.

title: Medior Backend Developer
descriptionHtml:
Job Description:

You probably remember the best customer journey you’ve ever experienced, and the worst one too. But why is that? What can businesses do to keep you engaged, solve your problems, and make your life easier and more beautiful, not just in one moment, but across every interaction?

“The entire customer journey. One platform”

People move between channels, platforms, apps and physical locations without thinking about it. Wherever your journey starts and wherever it continues, our goal is simple and ambitious: “Enable growing businesses to serve, sell, interact and engage through one Global AI Powered Customer Engagement Platform. We connect conversations, customer data and payments with AI Agents, so that businesses all over the world can grow faster, together.

All our services are fully integrated within our unique business structure, consisting of four business units: Connect, Pay, Live, and Engage.

Now, we’re looking for a Medior Backend Developer to join the Conversational Router development team!

What You Will Do

We are building the ultimate Global AI-Powered Customer Engagement Platform that lets businesses connect with customers, automate work, and handle every interaction through one reliable, user-friendly platform. That is our mission for 2026.

Handling more than a million conversations every day, globally, the conversational router enables smooth handovers between web conversations, AI agents, and the customer service agent inbox. You can think of it as the highly complex, high-volume heart of every customer interaction.

In your first 12 months, you will:

  • Take ownership of developing and maintaining the Conversational Router As a Medior Developer, you’ll ensure the Router handles millions of messages daily across channels like WhatsApp, RCS, and SMS, while connecting seamlessly with products like Web Conversations, Conversational AI Cloud, HALO, and Mobile Service Cloud.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams across CM.com You’ll collaborate with other product teams on a regular base to centralize functionalities from various applications into the Router, while exploring new technologies and AI-related solutions to enhance its capabilities.
  • Improve processes using AI, automation, and smart tooling You’ll tackle technical challenges such as streaming AI messages, data anonymization, and optimizing performance, ensuring the Router operates at scale and remains reliable 24/7.
  • Make decisions fast, test ideas, and learn from what doesn’t work You’ll have the freedom to shape your own solutions, make architectural decisions, and contribute meaningfully to a product that processes significant scale.
  • Help shape how AI will redefine your role as a developer AI is changing the way developers work, and we expect you to explore how it can enhance your workflows. By leveraging AI tools for automation, debugging, and optimization, you’ll help redefine this role and its impact on the Conversational Router and CM.com’s platform.
  • Success is measured by impact, not by perfect plans Your contributions will directly enhance the Router’s performance and scalability, helping CM.com deliver seamless conversational experiences to millions of users worldwide.

That’s why you ideally have

  • At least 3 years of experience as a backend developer.
  • Experience with C#, .NET, and Cloud Services is preferred.
  • A strong passion for writing clean, maintainable, and scalable code, with an eagerness to learn and apply modern development practices.
  • A proactive mindset when working on complex solutions; you enjoy technical challenges and thrive on solving intricate problems.
  • You enjoy working in a relatively small, close-knit team where collaboration is key.
  • Full professional fluency in English and preferably also in Dutch.
  • You live within reasonable commuting distance of our Breda office.

The reality at CM.com

We believe honesty creates better matches. So here it is:

  • You work on-site with your team, collaboration happens face to face.
  • Priorities can shift quickly as technology and insights evolve.
  • AI will change how your role looks, fast. Some tasks you do today may disappear next year.
  • We move before everything is finished or polished.
  • For this position, we can only consider candidates who already hold a permanent work and residence permit for the Netherlands.

If that excites you, you’ll probably feel at home here. If you’re looking for predictability and fixed boundaries, this may not be the right place.

Requirements:

Every CM.com colleague, connects to our 4 shared values:

Drive and Lead

We value your expertise and professional judgement. You understand the mission of CM.com and feel ownership over your role and its contribution to the bigger picture. You take initiative, make decisions and recognize opportunities. Making mistakes is part of moving forward.

Grow and Learn

Growing Faster Together is not just our purpose, it’s how we work. The growth of our colleagues and our customers is our priority. Our organization is designed to support this through the CM Academy, the Young Professional Program and our own CM Business Adventure, the CMBA. But growth also comes from daily curiosity.

You enjoy stepping outside your comfort zone and you like to experiment, learn continuously and actively share knowledge and insights with others.

Together and Care

At CM.com, we work together. We believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. Diversity is therefore essential to us.

We value the social side of work. We trust one another, show genuine interest and care about one another’s well-being. You are looking for that connection, you prefer being together on-site, sharing ideas, meals, workouts and conversations, and you believe that energy is created by meeting in person.

Speed and Change

For more than 25 years, we have operated at the forefront of innovation. Change is not something we respond to, it’s something we actively drive.

By welcoming AI Agents into our organisation, we fundamentally change how work is done. This allows us to move faster, do more with fewer people and continuously rethink roles and responsibilities. You are comfortable with that reality and want to contribute to progress rather than maintaining the status quo.

Company Benefits

At CM.com, we believe in empowering our people to do what they love, excel at what they do, and make a meaningful impact. As a CM.com club member, you’ll have the following benefits:

  • Onboarding: Join our unique 3-days Global Onboarding program in our Headquarters in Breda, a deep dive into the culture of CM.com.
  • Healthy food: Daily healthy lunches and snacks to keep you energized.
  • Effortless commute: The Shuttle mobility card, commuting allowance and Lease-a-bike options get you where you need to be. We have CM company cars that you can use for client visits as well.
  • Invest in your future: A solid pension plan.
  • Time off: Recharge with 25 vacation days, plus the option to purchase 10 additional days.
  • Own your success: Become a shareholder with our Employee Share Purchase Program.
  • Your Development: We support your growth and development through initiatives like the CM Academy, Udemy courses, exclusive meetups with thought leaders, the Young Professional Program, and our own CM Business Adventure (CMBA), ensuring you’re always learning and evolving
  • Vitality: Our Vitality Team organizes a year-round vitality program to support a healthy body and mind for all colleagues. Think of stress prevention workshops, ergonomist visit, weekly bootcamps, yoga sessions and our CM sports day.
  • Together at CM.com: Weekly drinks, board game nights, karaoke throwdowns, yearly ski trip, and more! We have something for everyone.

Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and drive us forward. We welcome everyone, regardless of age, background, or beliefs.

We connect conversations, customer data and payments with AI Agents, so that businesses all over the world can grow faster, together.All our services are fully integrated within our unique business structure, consisting of four business units: Connect, Pay, Live, and Engage.Now, we’re looking for a Medior Backend Developer to join the Conversational Router development team!What You Will DoWe are building the ultimate Global AI-Powered Customer Engagement Platform that lets businesses connect with customers, automate work, and handle every interaction through one reliable, user-friendly platform. That is our mission for 2026.Handling more than a million conversations every day, globally, the conversational router enables smooth handovers between web conversations, AI agents, and the customer service agent inbox. You can think of it as the highly complex, high-volume heart of every customer interaction.In your first 12 months, you will:Take ownership of developing and maintaining the Conversational Router As a Medior Developer, you’ll ensure the Router handles millions of messages daily across channels like WhatsApp, RCS, and SMS, while connecting seamlessly with products like Web Conversations, Conversational AI Cloud, HALO, and Mobile Service Cloud.Work closely with cross-functional teams across CM.com You’ll collaborate with other product teams on a regular base to centralize functionalities from various applications into the Router, while exploring new technologies and AI-related solutions to enhance its capabilities.Improve processes using AI, automation, and smart tooling You’ll tackle technical challenges such as streaming AI messages, data anonymization, and optimizing performance, ensuring the Router operates at scale and remains reliable 24/7.Make decisions fast, test ideas, and learn from what doesn’t work You’ll have the freedom to shape your own solutions, make architectural decisions, and contribute meaningfully to a product that processes significant scale.Help shape how AI will redefine your role as a developer AI is changing the way developers work, and we expect you to explore how it can enhance your workflows. By leveraging AI tools for automation, debugging, and optimization, you’ll help redefine this role and its impact on the Conversational Router and CM.com’s platform.Success is measured by impact, not by perfect plans Your contributions will directly enhance the Router’s performance and scalability, helping CM.com deliver seamless conversational experiences to millions of users worldwide.That’s why you ideally haveAt least 3 years of experience as a backend developer.Experience with C#, .NET, and Cloud Services is preferred.A strong passion for writing clean, maintainable, and scalable code, with an eagerness to learn and apply modern development practices.A proactive mindset when working on complex solutions; you enjoy technical challenges and thrive on solving intricate problems.You enjoy working in a relatively small, close-knit team where collaboration is key.Full professional fluency in English and preferably also in Dutch.You live within reasonable commuting distance of our Breda office.The reality at CM.comWe believe honesty creates better matches. So here it is:You work on-site with your team, collaboration happens face to face.Priorities can shift quickly as technology and insights evolve.AI will change how your role looks, fast. Some tasks you do today may disappear next year.We move before everything is finished or polished.For this position, we can only consider candidates who already hold a permanent work and residence permit for the Netherlands. If that excites you, you’ll probably feel at home here. If you’re looking for predictability and fixed boundaries, this may not be the right place.Requirements:Every CM.com colleague, connects to our 4 shared values:Drive and LeadWe value your expertise and professional judgement. You understand the mission of CM.com and feel ownership over your role and its contribution to the bigger picture. You take initiative, make decisions and recognize opportunities. Making mistakes is part of moving forward.Grow and LearnGrowing Faster Together is not just our purpose, it’s how we work. The growth of our colleagues and our customers is our priority. Our organization is designed to support this through the CM Academy, the Young Professional Program and our own CM Business Adventure, the CMBA. But growth also comes from daily curiosity.You enjoy stepping outside your comfort zone and you like to experiment, learn continuously and actively share knowledge and insights with others.Together and CareAt CM.com, we work together. We believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. Diversity is therefore essential to us.We value the social side of work. We trust one another, show genuine interest and care about one another’s well-being. You are looking for that connection, you prefer being together on-site, sharing ideas, meals, workouts and conversations, and you believe that energy is created by meeting in person.Speed and ChangeFor more than 25 years, we have operated at the forefront of innovation. Change is not something we respond to, it’s something we actively drive.By welcoming AI Agents into our organisation, we fundamentally change how work is done. This allows us to move faster, do more with fewer people and continuously rethink roles and responsibilities. You are comfortable with that reality and want to contribute to progress rather than maintaining the status quo.Company BenefitsAt CM.com, we believe in empowering our people to do what they love, excel at what they do, and make a meaningful impact. As a CM.com club member, you’ll have the following benefits:Onboarding: Join our unique 3-days Global Onboarding program in our Headquarters in Breda, a deep dive into the culture of CM.com.Healthy food: Daily healthy lunches and snacks to keep you energized.Effortless commute: The Shuttle mobility card, commuting allowance and Lease-a-bike options get you where you need to be. We have CM company cars that you can use for client visits as well.Invest in your future: A solid pension plan.Time off: Recharge with 25 vacation days, plus the option to purchase 10 additional days.Own your success: Become a shareholder with our Employee Share Purchase Program.Your Development: We support your growth and development through initiatives like the CM Academy, Udemy courses, exclusive meetups with thought leaders, the Young Professional Program, and our own CM Business Adventure (CMBA), ensuring you’re always learning and evolvingVitality: Our Vitality Team organizes a year-round vitality program to support a healthy body and mind for all colleagues. Think of stress prevention workshops, ergonomist visit, weekly bootcamps, yoga sessions and our CM sports day.Together at CM.com: Weekly drinks, board game nights, karaoke throwdowns, yearly ski trip, and more! We have something for everyone.Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and drive us forward. We welcome everyone, regardless of age, background, or beliefs.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer JS - EdTech
descriptionHtml:
Wait a minute.

Are you inspired by building a pioneering EdTech company that will empower millions of people? Do you dream of creating cutting-edge web applications that seamlessly combine AI, UX/UI excellence, and scalability to create transformative learning experiences at scale ? Knowing that your code is used by thousands of people means something for you.

Are you inspired to work hard, really hard to revolutionize education, innovate with AI, VR, wearables and impact people's lives ?

Deep inside you are looking for a new adventure with…

  • 🗽 Freedom: feeling free to work remotely or hybrid and being trusted to deliver.
  • 🔥 Ambition: growing up surrounded by smart colleagues driven to create an iconic brand like Nike.
  • 😍 Impact: contributing to transform people lives at scale and feel your own impact in the company.

And you deserve it because…

  • You don’t just develop. You architect, optimize, groom and push the boundaries of technology.
  • You had been the CTO or instrumental in a Startup Development.
  • You’re obsessed with clean, efficient, and scalable code.
  • You thrive on solving complex challenges and making applications faster, better, and more intuitive.
  • AI fascinates you, and you see it as a tool to redefine software development and UX/UI user experience.

You don’t want to just code… Education and/or personal development inspires you.

Then, this is the adventure you’ve been waiting for!

You’ll work hard, innovate fearlessly, and grow with us as we strive to make Paradox an iconic brand that changes lives worldwide.

For us, being Iconic is to innovate at the intersection of Psychology x Creativity x Technology.

You'll work closely with our founding team to define our technical vision.

This is a full-time position, carried out from our beautiful offices in Dubai, Lisbon or full-remote from anywhere in the world.

French And English Fluency Is Required.

YOUR MISSION 🚀

🎯 Your main goal will be to take Paradox’s online learning experience to the next level by building the new Paradox App, a state-of-the-art application that integrates AI, delivers an unparalleled user experience. You will be THE key player in creating an online learning management system that can handle several cohorts of hundreds of students at the same time and scales effortlessly to support thousands of students.

Our sources of inspiration are Apple, Nike, Spotify, Disney for their obsession of excelling, having a worldwide impact and not just selling products but crafting experiences.

You will be playing a pivotal role in making Paradox play at that level and becoming an iconic brand.

To do so, here are your 5 responsibilities :

1 | BUILD & INNOVATE

  • Develop new features that enhance the Paradox App and redefine how users learn online.
  • Implement AI-driven functionalities that personalize the learning experience.
  • Continuously test, iterate, and push boundaries to improve performance and usability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate feedback and rapidly iterate on new ideas.

2 | SCALABILITY & PERFORMANCE

  • Ensure the application can handle large volumes of concurrent users while maintaining speed and reliability.
  • Optimize resource usage and infrastructure costs without sacrificing performance.
  • Leverage CDN and caching strategies to improve load times globally.

3 | USER CENTERED DESIGN

  • Work closely with product and design teams to build intuitive, beautiful, and efficient user interfaces.
  • Rapidly prototype features to test and refine customer experiences.
  • Incorporate AI and automation to enhance user interactions.

4 | PROBLEM SOLVING & TROUBLESHOOTING

  • Investigate and resolve technical challenges to ensure a seamless user journey.
  • Analyze recurring issues and proactively implement solutions to prevent future problems.
  • Work across teams to ensure a stable and efficient system.

5 | COLLABORATION & COMMUNICATION

  • Actively participate in tech architecture discussions and planning sessions.
  • Provide and seek constructive feedback to continually improve the development process.
  • Work within Agile frameworks to ensure timely and high-quality delivery.

DO YOU RECOGNIZE YOURSELF? 😍

Must Have

  • 3-6 years of experience in Full Stack Development, or as CTO of a startup.
  • Deep expertise in TypeScript & React.js (minimum 3 years experience).
  • Proficient in Tailwind CSS for sleek and responsive designs.
  • Strong AI mindset – you actively integrate AI into your workflow.
  • Passion for writing clean, maintainable, and scalable code.

Personality

  • You’re a problem-solver who thrives on tackling challenges.
  • Detail-oriented: Clean code is your signature.
  • Autonomous and proactive: You don’t just execute; you bring ideas to the table.
  • You love learning, iterating, and improving
  • You continuously learn and experiment with new technologies
  • You’re organized, rigorous, and adaptable

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Nest.js.
  • Experience with LMS applications and mobile development.

IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU 🙅‍♀️

Let’s be clear, we are looking for someone who is not just Great, and for whom Paradox ambition isn’t just another cool project; but a true mission.

So if those personal interests : personal development / coaching / professional growth / education / edtech / teaching / edutainment are not things you REALLY love, and want to solve for other, let’s forget it

Let’s forget about it also if,

  • You don’t like to be challenged and grow in your job
  • You don't like receiving or giving tough feedbacks
  • You don’t question the status quo: the process are there for a reason, we have always done it this way
  • You like to have very specific & fixed tasks assigned to you. Be told what to do and how to do it.
  • Your only driver is joining a full-remote company: yes, our company culture is cool, but we want people to care about our mission, products, and their job!

🤩 JOIN US IF YOU CRAVE

1 - Growth & Ambition 🚀

🏅 We hire only the best, it’s exhilarating to be surrounded by A-players who strive to perform whilst being in a good mood. You'll be working with some of the best minds. We understand that "A" people attract "A" people.

🏋️‍♀️ No more bosses, but ongoing conversations to support your professional development.

⚡️ Being part of an ambitious company with a lot of growth opportunities.

2 - Impact & Meaning 🔥

🦄 Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products are enjoyed by millions of people

🤩 Waking up in the morning knowing you are making a difference: we receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reach a mile stone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

3 - Freedom & Well Being ��☀️

😎 A company culture based on autonomy & accountability

🗽 Flexible working hours

🌎 A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want

🏤 Magnificent offices in Dubai and Lisbon: you’re at home worldwide

⌨️ Standing desks paid by the company, if you live far from our offices

💻 Macbook: to be the most efficient in your work

🏀 350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great)

📚 150€ per year paid by the company to boost your knowledge (books, education): we are passionate about learning and want to support your growth)

🤝 1:1 coachings: a Paradox coach supporting you personally or professionally to live your best life

✈️ Team buildings

  • those benefits are only for full-time employees

HIRING PROCESS 📃

That job description resonated with you?

Here is your tailor made hiring process

📃 A 6 to 8 minutes application survey (with a short video assignment)

📃 A 15/20 minutes what’s app call with Timy, our Talent Manager, to tell you more about the challenge and see if it fits with your experience and expectations,

💻 A video call with Gab, the Hiring Manager to dive deeper into your technical skills, see how we can match your desires with our needs and for you both to understand how you could fit in Paradox’s social media team.

💻A Technical test, you will present to Gab, so we can learn more about your technical choices and understand if we can write the success story together.

💻 A culture-fit video call with Timy - our culture coach - to check in depth the alignment between you and our values and culture

💼 Reference check to get in-depth insights about how you work in different environments, make your onboarding easier, and give everybody on the team the insurance to be surrounded by A-Players.

🫵🚀 Welcome aboard!

About Our Hiring Process

Our recruitment process is tailored to do our best to avoid that you or us realize that we’re not a perfect fit. Every step serves a purpose and will allow us to get to know you better as much as it’ll help you understand more where you’ll be stepping in.

We also want you to have time to ask all of your questions regarding the mission, the long-term vision of your team and the company, our values, with the relevant interlocutor in front of you.

But maybe YOU WONDER WHAT’S OUR STORY ? 😉

At Paradox, we are convinced that people do not want “just a job” anymore.

We are all craving to have an impact through our professional journey. Some want to start their own venture, some want to become an intrapreneur in their current organization, some others just want their day-to-day tasks to have more meaning.

🎯 PARADOX HAS ONE GOAL: TO EMPOWER PEOPLE AND ORGANIZATIONS TO LIVE THEIR TRUE AMBITIONS.

But where do we start?

If you have an interest in personal development, you probably already know that:

  • Making things happen is a real struggle when you don’t know what truly inspires you and how to get there ;
  • Available resources are either boring 😴 or full of crazy unsubstantiated theories 🤪.

It needs to change, and we’re here to make it happen!

⭐️ OUR AMBITION IS TO MAKE SUCCESS THE ONLY POSSIBLE OUTCOME FOR OUR CLIENTS (WHATEVER SUCCESS MEANS FOR THEM), BY CRAFTING INNOVATIVE & CAPTIVATING BREAKTHROUGH EXPERIENCES.

In other words, we want to make personal growth as entertaining as watching Netflix.

How, you might be wondering?

  • We travel the world and surround ourselves with top entrepreneurs (Richard Branson - Founder of Virgin, Marc Simoncini - Founder of Meeting, Fred Mazzella - Founder of BlablaCar), world athletes (Tony Parker - Hall of fame NBA Player, Frederick Bousquet - World record in 50m free swimming, Frank Leboeuf - WorldCup Footballer), and artists (Gad Elmaleh - Comedian, Franck Dubosc, Barry Osborne - Producer of Lord of the Rings and Matrix) ✊;
  • We reverse engineer their strategies for achieving success and fulfillment and lean on the latest researches about neurosciences ⚙️;
  • We deliver trainings & educational contents around Power Skills (critical thinking, productivity, leadership, public speaking, coaching, stress management, etc.), self-growth and performance, through a balanced set of e-learning programs, events and edutainment videos 💡.

From one well-known Founder to a team of +45 people today (and counting!), this approach has paid off and enabled us to exceed 2 million followers on social networks, and to have thousands of people attending our online events and training courses.

🔥 TOGETHER, WE ARE DRIVEN BY ONE DREAM:

  • Helping 100 000 people achieve their dream and display their pictures on what we call the “100 000 dreams wall” ;
  • Giving our clients access to constant personal growth by reinventing their learning experience ;
  • Leverage AI and other technology to provide an outstanding customized experience to millions of people for them to transform their lives.

And that’s where you come in. Join the Paradox Revolution !

title: Full-stack developer
location: Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij applicaties ontwikkelen waar eindgebruikers blij van worden? En is werksfeer voor jou belangrijk? Dan ben je bij Axians aan het goede adres.

Dit bieden wij jou

Bij Axians werk je in een lokaal hecht team en heb je toch ook de voordelen van werken in een grote internationale organisatie; we vinden jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling erg belangrijk en bieden hier volop mogelijkheden voor. En verder:

  • Werken in een hecht team met betrokken collega's en veel gezelligheid;
  • Een afwisselende rol binnen het snelgroeiende Axians netwerk, ook parttime in te vullen;
  • Afwisselend werken op locatie (Alphen a/d Rijn) en vanuit huis;
  • Budget voor thuiswerkplek;
  • Een transparant salarishuis en groeipad;
  • Leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding
  • Pensioen met 100% bijdrage door werkgever en geen eigen bijdrage;
  • Winstdeling;
  • Axians betaalt aanvullend geboorteverlof 100%
  • Een goede work/life balance (jouw vrije tijd is van jou en respecteren wij);
  • 25 vakantiedagen met de flexibele mogelijkheid meer dagen op te bouwen bij een aanstelling van 36 - 40 uur per week;
  • Laptop, telefoon, opleidingsmogelijkheden aan de VINCI Energies Academy;
  • Mogelijkheid tot deelname aandelenpakket van moederorganisatie VINCI Group;
  • De ruimte en de middelen om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Zo krijg jij onder andere toegang tot de VINCI Energies Academy waar wij een heel afwisselend aanbod aan trainingen en opleiding aanbieden.

Hier krijg jij energie van

Met jouw full-stack ervaring help je ons mee keuzes te maken over de technologie die we nu en in de toekomst omarmen. Je hebt van nature een kritische houding naar je eigen werk, dat van collega's en de klant. Je komt graag met ideeën en onderzoekt nieuwe mogelijkheden en oplossingen. Samen bereiken we een nog hoger niveau; daarom zijn we op zoek naar jou! Wij zorgen dat je je zo snel mogelijk thuis voelt en dat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Samen maken we er een succes van.

Benieuwd naar meer? Ik nodig je uit om via de onderstaande link meer te weten te komen over onze specialisatie Data Analytics:

https://www.axians.nl/expertises/data-analytics/data-driven-applications/

Hier herken jij jezelf in

We zijn op zoek naar een ervaren full-stack developer die

  • Een kick krijgt van het opleveren van uitdagende projecten;
  • Complexe zaken gestructureerd op kan pakken;
  • Weet hoe belangrijk onderhoudbare code is;
  • Graag slimme dingen bedenkt waar de eindgebruikers blij van worden;
  • Goed kan communiceren, je werkt nauw samen met onze product owner en de klant;
  • Ervaring heeft met verschillende programmeertalen, frameworks en bijbehorende tooling;
  • Vloeiende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal
  • Een relevante HBO opleiding heeft afgerond;
  • Minimaal 4 jaar relevante ervaring heeft.

Dit is jouw team

Samen met onze klanten verbeteren we het leven van mensen door het ontwikkelen van intelligente bedrijfsapplicaties en apps voor web, iOS en Android. Dit doen we in een hecht en enthousiast team, waarbij je elkaar ook tijdens de dagelijks verzorgde lunches met aansluitende wandeling op een leuke manier leert kennen.

Wij zijn een team van twintig enthousiaste collega’s, variërend van full-stack developers, low-code developers (Mendix en Microsoft Power Platform), marketing en sales. Vanuit het centrum van Alphen aan de Rijn ontwikkelen wij dagelijks intelligente (web)applicaties die ingewikkelde of herhalende taken vereenvoudigen. Dit allemaal om het werkgeluk van de gebruikers te verbeteren. Ook ons eigen werkgeluk staat hoog op de agenda. Hybride werken is de norm, maar wij vinden het fijn om naar kantoor te komen. Elke dag lunchen we samen en maken een wandeling. Op vrijdag laten we zelfs een middagmaal bezorgen. Verder is er een pooltafel en een Formule 1-simulator aanwezig voor ontspanning en zijn de keukenkastjes goed gevuld met snacks.

title: Full Stack Software Developer MES
descriptionHtml:
Inteqnion in Aalten (35 medewerk(st)ers en onderdeel van de Triott Group) is gespecialiseerd in het ontwerpen, bouwen en implementeren van besturings- en automatiseringssystemen voor de procesindustrie, met een focus op mengvoederfabrieken. Hun oplossingen bieden volledige controle over het productieproces, van bestelling tot levering, en zijn wereldwijd in meer dan 250 installaties geïntegreerd. Door gebruik te maken van data-driven milling en geavanceerde software, helpen ze bedrijven de hoogste outputkwaliteit te bereiken met lagere onderhouds- en energiekosten.


Met meer dan 25 jaar ervaring zorgt Inteqnion voor betere zichtbaarheid, controle en efficiëntie in de productieprocessen van hun klanten, gebaseerd op de beste Europese technologie en ondersteund door een toegewijd team dat zowel de technologie als de veevoederindustrie door en door kent.


Wil jij werken in een dynamische, wereldwijde organisatie en bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van hoogwaardige automatiseringsoplossingen? Dan ben jij als Full Stack Software Developer van harte welkom bij Inteqnion


Full Stack Software Developer MES


Inteqnion heeft een MES softwarepakket ontwikkeld, specifiek voor de stortgoedverwerkende industrie. Het pakket, Batch Explorer genaamd, helpt klanten met het optimaliseren van hun productieproces. Het wordt al jaren succesvol ingezet in de mengvoederindustrie. Door een eenvoudige en zeer overzichtelijke menustructuur zijn productieprocessen snel en vakkundig te beheren. Het ontwikkelteam bestaat uit 4 .NET developers.


Batch Explorer bevat functionaliteit voor artikel- en receptenbeheer, grondstofinname, voorraad- en silobeheer, productieplanning, verlading en tracking & tracing. Managementrapporten zorgen ervoor dat gewenste gegevens overzichtelijk weergegeven worden.


Door Batch Explorer volledig te integreren met de PLC-besturing en SCADA-visualisatie ontstaat een betrouwbare automatisering. Het systeem is al in tientallen installaties toegepast en heeft bewezen een zeer stabiel en krachtig softwarepakket te zijn, waar zowel kleine als grote installaties mee aangestuurd kunnen worden.


De modulaire opbouw van Batch Explorer biedt de mogelijkheid het systeem tot in detail naar klant specifieke processen in te richten. Aanpassingen en uitbreidingen worden in eigen huis gerealiseerd.


Batch Explorer bestaat uit de volgende modules:

• Weegbrugafhandeling

• Inname van grondstoffen

• Silobeheer

• Doseren

• Malen/mengen

• Persen (incl. thermische behandelingen)

• Extruderen

• Verlading en afzakken

• Tracking & Tracing

• Contaminatie preventie

• Koppelingen met andere softwarepakketten (o.a. ERP)


Batch Explorer is standaard beschikbaar in de talen Nederlands, Engels, Duits, Frans, Spaans en Russisch.


Wat ga je doen?

Samen met jouw 4 collega’s draag je zorg voor het ontwikkelen, onderhouden en optimaliseren van de maatwerk MES (Manufacturing Execution System) applicatie, Batch Explorer, inclusief het oplossen van bugs, het ontwikkelen van interfaces met ERP-systemen. Dit alles binnen een Agile/Scrum omgeving. Na verloop van tijd (als je ervaring op hebt gedaan in deze branche) ga je ook meedraaien in de storingsdienst.


Wie ben jij?

  • Minimaal HBO werk- en denkniveau en opleiding in Informatica, Software Engineering of vergelijkbare technische richting;
  • Minimaal 3-5 jaar ervaring in de full stack ontwikkeling, met sterke focus op .NET/C#, SQL, JavaScript, en React;
  • Ervaring in het ontwikkelen van MES-applicaties, met specifieke kennis van productieprocessen en de uitdagingen van het beheren van productiedata;
  • Ervaring met bug fixing en het doorvoeren van verbeteringen in bestaande systemen;
  • Ervaring in een Agile/Scrum omgeving en het werken in met sprints in teamverband;
  • Kennis van SQL Server en andere relationele databases voor het beheren van gegevens, het schrijven van complexe query’s en het optimaliseren van de databaseprestaties;
  • Ervaring met het ontwerpen en implementeren van database-schema's, stored procedures en views;
  • Beheersing van Nederlands en Engels in woord en geschrift;
  • Kerncompetenties: analytisch, communicatief, klantgericht, teamspeler, toegewijd, flexibel, nauwkeurig.


Wat biedt Inteqnion?

Een uitdagende rol binnen een groeiende organisatie die wereldwijd actief is. Je werkt samen met een divers team van professionals en draagt bij aan oplossingen die wereldwijd worden gebruikt. Daarbij horen goede arbeidsvoorwaarden zowel primair als secundair. Inteqnion volgt de CAO kleinmetaal.


Hoe nu verder?

Inteqnion heeft Wijkamp Werkt gevraagd om te ondersteunen bij het werven van deze en toekomstige nieuwe medewerk(st)er(s). Talentscout Edward kent de wensen, eisen en de cultuur van Inteqnion.


Indien jij geprikkeld bent en meer wilt weten bel dan naar 06 10 33 96 51 of mail jouw curriculum vitae naar edward@wijkampwerkt.nl


Een motivatie(brief) toevoegen mag wel (als je dat zelf wenselijk of noodzakelijk vindt) maar is niet nodig! Als jouw curriculum vitae daar aanleiding toe geeft, bespreek ik jouw motivatie liever face-to-face op een door jou te bepalen datum, tijd en locatie. Dat kan dus ook in de avonduren of in een weekend.

title: Full Stack Developer - Build the data platform for smart horticulture
descriptionHtml:
📍 Rotterdam | Product-first | Impact at scale

At 30MHz we transform horticulture with data, sensors and actionable dashboards so growers make better decisions and grow healthier crops. Our platform turns greenhouse data into insights and practical actions for customers around the world.


Your role

You’ll be a key contributor across our stack: designing APIs in Python/Java, building rich Angular frontends in TypeScript, and shipping reliable, secure services on AWS and Google. As our junior/medior full stack developer you collaborate closely with Product, Data/AI and Commercial to turn customer problems into elegant, scalable software. Expect ownership, fast feedback, and real-world impact.


What you’ll do

  • Ship end-to-end features: from schema and service design to polished UI and rollout
  • Build and evolve robust REST APIs, data pipelines and integrations
  • Create clean, modular Angular components and micro-frontends in TypeScript.
  • Engineer for reliability: testing, observability, CI/CD, IaC, and secure-by-default patterns.
  • Improve performance and cost efficiency across services and queries.
  • Collaborate in agile rituals, turning customer insights into backlog items with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Review code, mentor teammates, and raise the engineering bar.


Our tech stack (you don’t need all, but you’re strong in many)

  • Frontend: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, state management, testing (Vitest/Jasmine).
  • Backend: Python (FastAPI/Django/Flask), Java (Spring Boot), SQL/NoSQL, messaging/streaming.
  • Cloud & DevEx: AWS (ECS/Lambda/S3/RDS), Terraform/CDK, Docker, GitHub Actions, OpenAPI, Grafana/Prometheus.


You are

  • 4+ years experience building production web applications end-to-end.
  • Solid CS fundamentals (data modeling, concurrency, distributed systems basics).
  • Pragmatic problem-solver: you ship, measure, iterate.
  • Comfortable owning features across frontend and backend; you enjoy pair programming and code reviews.
  • Collaborative and product-minded; you translate user needs into simple solutions.
  • Fluent in English; Dutch is a plus.


Nice to have

  • Experience with time-series data, IoT/sensors, or data-driven products for operations.
  • GraphQL, gRPC, or event-driven architectures.
  • Security hardening in cloud environments (IAM, secrets, networking).
  • UX empathy and an eye for usable UI details.


What we offer

  • A high-impact role building the core of a real-world, data-driven platform in horticulture.
  • Ambitious, collaborative team with a clear product mission.
  • Hybrid working & a central Rotterdam office, daily healthy lunch, inspiring quarterly team days.


How to apply

Send your CV, brief motivation (or a short Loom/video) and links to 1–2 projects you’re proud of to support@30mhz.com (attn. Dax). Curious first? Share your name and number, we’ll call you.

companyDescription:
30MHz provides real-time remote crop monitoring on any device: Historical insight on what crops experience, and live alerts for direct action. 

From optimising irrigation and ventilation, to preventing disease or sunscald., 30MHz delivers the metrics that matter to agriculture & horticulture, on a single platform that makes sense.

title: Fullstack Developer
descriptionHtml:
3 redenen waarom dit jouw baan is


  • Je graag met verschillende programmeertalen werkt en innoveert.
  • Je zowel met de frontend als de backend van een applicatie uit de voeten kunt.
  • Je het leuk vindt om in een scrum team te werken; je bent een echte teamspeler en communicatief heel sterk.


Jij doet het

Als fullstack developer werk je nauw samen met andere ontwikkelaars en ben je ervaren in het implementeren van zowel Frontend als Backend. Je hebt kwaliteit hoog in het vaandel staan, je werkt met een reviewproces, schrijft unittesten voor je eigen code en documenteert aanpassingen. We werken Agile/scrum. Iedereen draagt daarom brede verantwoordelijkheid en we werken van dag tot dag samen en je werkt daarbij nauw samen met ontwerpers en testers.

Het team onderhoudt en innoveert verschillende portalen in het domein 'PGB'. Daarin maken we op dit moment de transitie van Java API's naar API's in Agular. Jij beheerst de volgende zaken:


  • Onderhouden en optimaliseren van de huidige portalen in Java en JSF;
  • Onderhouden en ontwikkelen van robuuste en gebruiksvriendelijke functionaliteiten in Java, Angular en .NET binnen een moderne microservices-architectuur;
  • Samenwerken in agile/scrum teams met een focus op continue verbetering en klantwaarde;
  • Meedenken over de inrichting van DevOps en security-by-design;
  • Deployen en beheren van applicaties op Openshift (pré);
  • Technisch sparringpartner zijn voor collega’s, PO’s en solution architecten.


Jij bent het

Jij bent een ervaren fullstack ontwikkelaar met een passie voor maatschappelijke impact! Bij de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB) in Amstelveen zoeken we versterking voor ons multidisciplinaire team binnen de afdeling IT Zorg en Welzijn. Jij werkt mee aan het ontwikkelen, onderhouden en optimaliseren van de portalen MijnPGB, MijnWmo en MijnZK – cruciale digitale loketten waarmee burgers, zorgkantoren en gemeentes regie houden over hun zorg.

Als fullstack developer werk je nauw samen met andere ontwikkelaars uit andere teams en ben je ervaren in het implementeren van zowel Frontend als Backend. Je hebt kwaliteit hoog in het vaandel staan, je werkt met een reviewproces, schrijft unittesten en waarborgt kennis door middel van documentatie. We werken Agile/scrum in sprints van 2 weken, waarbij er een nauwe samenwerking is met testers, analisten, ontwikkelaars en devops engineers.

Verder vragen wij:


  • Minimaal 5 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring als fullstack ontwikkelaar;
  • Diepgaande kennis van en ervaring met Java, Spring, Spring Web Flow, JSF, Angular én .NET;
  • Ervaring met agile/scrum werken, DevOps-methodieken, en CI/CD tooling (Azure DevOps);
  • Ervaring met werken in Azure, kennis van Openshift is een duidelijke pré;
  • Je beheerst de Nederlands in woord en geschrift (vereiste);
  • Je weet complexe materie begrijpelijk te maken voor eindgebruikers en collega’s;
  • Een innovatieve mindset en een scherp oog voor kwaliteit, schaalbaarheid en security.


Welke kansen bieden we jou?

Jouw uitdaging, balans en groei: het heeft onze aandacht. Kansen en mogelijkheden om te groeien als persoon en als professional zijn er genoeg. Aan jou de taak om ze te pakken. Ook kan jij bij start als Fullstack Developer (op basis van een 36-urige werkweek) rekenen op:


  • elke maand maximaal € 6.395,00 brutosalaris (fulltime is bij de SVB 36 uur per week).
  • 16,33% individueel keuzebudget. Jij kiest zelf hoe je dit inzet: wil je bijvoorbeeld meer salaris, een sabbatical, meer pensioen opbouwen of meer verlofdagen? Aan jou de keuze.
  • ruim 5 weken vakantie per jaar.


Er is nog meer. Ga voor een compleet overzicht naar http://www.werkenbijdesvb.nl/vacatures/arbeidsvoorwaarden (http://www.werkenbijdesvb.nl/vacatures/arbeidsvoorwaarden).

Jouw werkomgeving

Van kinderbijslag tot AOW-pensioen: namens de overheid en samen met 4.500 collega’s maken we het mogelijk om de volksverzekeringen uit te betalen. Dat betekent dat we elk jaar 62 miljard euro overmaken aan zo’n 5,6 miljoen mensen. Op tijd, eerlijk en efficiënt.

We werken met elkaar samen en ontmoeten elkaar op kantoor. Daarnaast is het in overleg met je team en leidinggevende ook mogelijk deels thuis te werken.

De SVB wil een diverse en inclusieve organisatie zijn, waar iedereen zich thuis voelt. Een afspiegeling van de samenleving. Onze doelgroep is immers ook divers. Teams met diversiteit waar iedereen ertoe doet maken ons effectiever, creatiever en zorgen voor betere dienstverlening.

Solliciteren: jij maakt het verschil

Wil jij als Fullstack Developer het verschil maken binnen de SVB: een organisatie met maatschappelijke impact? Reageer uiterlijk 12 januari op deze vacature. Je krijgt meteen een bevestiging van jouw sollicitatie. En daarna? Rond 15 januari hoor je of wij samen de volgende stap(pen) zetten.

Een VOG-screening maakt onderdeel uit van het proces. Een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van het proces.

Heb je eerst nog vragen? Stel deze aan Sanne via + 31 6 24 37 48 21 of svanputten@svb.nl (mailto:fcardano@svb.nl).
