companySlogan: Dé particuliere schadeverzekeraar in Nederland, alleen via onafhankelijke financieel adviseurs.
companyDescription:
Nh1816 Verzekeringen is sinds 1816 gevestigd in het Westfriese Oudkarspel en heeft zich ontwikkeld tot marktleider voor simple risk particuliere risico’s via lokale verzekeringsadviseurs, onze local hero's.

𝗙𝗶𝗹𝗼𝘀𝗼𝗳𝗶𝗲

Nh1816 is een coöperatieve verzekeraar en onderscheidt zich door een stabiel beleid en innovatieve oplossingen zoals digitalisering van de verzekeringspolis en optimalisering van relatiebeheer. Nh1816 streeft niet de hoogste winst na maar doet zaken in het belang van haar leden. Vanuit die coöperatieve (en solidaire) gedachte wordt een groot gedeelte van de winst teruggegeven aan de samenleving. En is dat niet hoe verzekeren bedoeld is: met elkaar de lasten dragen? 

𝗞𝗲𝘂𝘇𝗲𝘀

We maken duidelijke keuzes, zijn consistent en betrouwbaar. Die keuzes leiden tot cijfers die ons trots maken: 

1. Adviseurs hebben ons ruim 15 keer uitgeroepen tot de beste particuliere schadeverzekeraar van Nederland
2. Ruim 600.000 huishoudens zijn bij ons verzekerd
3. We tellen ruim 2,6 miljoen polissen
4. En meer dan 600 miljoen premievolume
5. Aan beleggingen beheren we 1.200 miljoen  

𝗩𝗲𝗿𝗱𝗲𝗿 𝗴𝗿𝗼𝗲𝗶𝗲𝗻

Authentiek als we zijn, blijven wij trouw aan dat mooie plekje waar het ruim 200 jaar geleden allemaal begon: de Dorpsstraat in Oudkarspel. In de zomer van 2024 namen wij onze intrek in een prachtig nieuw pand. Onze grondlegger Cornelis Eecen zou het geweldig vinden. Daar waar hij houthandel Eecen (nu Pontmeyer) stichtte en in 1816 het idee voor een verzekeringsbedrijf als zaadje ontkiemde, wortelt Nh1816 Verzekeringen verder. De grond is goed hier!

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Your mission

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will be a key player in one of our cross-functional teams, building and shaping the future of our products. You will design, develop, and deploy end-to-end features, translating business needs into robust technical solutions.

Your initial focus will be on a new, cutting-edge project for a major customer. This project leverages a modern stack including .NET 9 (soon .NET 10), Clean Architecture, and DDD principles, with a continuously updated Angular frontend (v18). We're looking for an engineer who is not just a coder, but a curious and inventive problem-solver who enjoys collaborating to build great software.

You Will

  • Design, develop, and deploy robust, scalable, and end-to-end features for our customer-facing applications.
  • Write clean, high-performance, and maintainable code in C#/.NET for the backend and Angular/TypeScript for the frontend.
  • Take ownership of features from concept to deployment.
  • Contribute to our technical direction by applying your knowledge of architectural patterns like Clean Architecture and DDD.
  • Enhance and maintain our modern Angular application, ensuring a seamless and responsive user experience across all devices.
  • Ensure software quality by writing meaningful tests, performing thorough code reviews, and providing constructive feedback.
  • Communicate with stakeholders to refine requirements and ensure the features you build deliver real value.
  • Help create a fun, collaborative, and high-performing team culture.

Your profile

  • Experienced Developer: You have 5+ years of professional software development experience in a team environment.
  • Strong Frontend Foundation: You have a strong command of Angular.
  • Backend Proficiency: You are highly proficient in .NET, C# and SQL. Strong plus if you have experience with Entity Framework.
  • Full-Stack Mindset: Whether you started as a backend or frontend specialist, you are passionate about working across the entire technology stack and are eager to contribute wherever needed.
  • Architectural Awareness: You appreciate clean code and modern software architecture. Experience or familiarity with Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design (DDD) is a major advantage.
  • Maintain High Quality: You have a solid understanding of software testing principles and practical experience writing both unit and integration tests. You actively participate in code reviews to maintain quality.
  • Interest in AI: You are interested in AI-supported development tools such as GitHub CoPilot.
  • Collaborative & Communicative: You are an excellent communicator who can work with stakeholders to gather requirements, lead the development of new features, and test solutions with your colleagues.
  • Curious & Proactive: You are a natural problem-solver, always looking for better ways to do things. You bring ideas and solutions to the table and are not afraid to be inventive.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with Azure Cloud services and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience in a start-up/scale-up environment or having a scale-up mindset.

About Us

Since 2014, Ireckonu has raised the bar in the hospitality tech industry, with many of our solutions becoming industry standards. Led by our vision to accelerate digital transformation in the hospitality industry, we have continuously perfected our state-of-the-art CORE middleware solutions and wrap-around applications. This enables us to support both large international brands and small regional chains in their digital transformation journey. We are proud partners of some of the world’s best hospitality brands, including CitizenM, Okura, and Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group.

All of these achievements are made possible by the passion, talent, and knowledge of our team. At Ireckonu, we take pride in our diverse range of nationalities and backgrounds, where every employee plays an important role in building an environment where hard work is recognized and rewarded. With our annual company events and team outings, we make sure to keep our team spirit.

We aim to be the best in the hospitality tech industry, and this attitude is also visible in the way we work together. One of the best indicators of our competitive side is having an in-house racing simulator, where we like to challenge ourselves for that top positions on the leadership board.

Our Core Values Define Who We Are

Excellence – At Ireckonu, we live excellence through our commitment to high standards, continuous improvement, and delivering outstanding products and services, driven by a culture of dedication and fueled by passion.

Partnership – At Ireckonu, partnership fuels our core, fostering teamwork, trust, and innovation, building lasting customer & partner connections for mutual success.

Transparency – At Ireckonu, we keep it simple – transparency means being open, honest, and sharing information to build trust and keep everyone aligned.

companySlogan: Clean Guest Data. Real Results.
companyDescription:
Ireckonu transforms hospitality with its powerful Customer Data Platform (CDP) and Middleware, providing real-time, two-way integrations that seamlessly connect a hotel’s PMS, F&B, and reservation systems. Its Match and Merge feature consolidates duplicate profiles across these systems, ensuring consistent information at every touchpoint and creating unified Single Guest Profiles. Ireckonu empowers targeted, data-driven insights that enhance marketing revenue, refine management strategies, and deliver personalized, unparalleled guest experiences.

Globally trusted by distinguished brands like Okura, CitizenM, Hard Rock Hotels, and others, Ireckonu stands at the forefront, actively shaping the future of hospitality.

To learn more, visit www.ireckonu.com.

title: Medior front-end developer bij Garansys
descriptionHtml:
Dit is waarom je aan de slag wil als medior front-end developer bij Garansys.

🚀 Werk aan gave, afwisselende projecten: elke klant en applicatie is anders, dus geen dag – en klant – is hetzelfde!

🎓 Blijf groeien en verbreden: ontwikkel je skills in front-end, duik in back-end of ontdek de (Azure) cloud.

🤝 Maak deel uit van een hecht en kundig team: werk samen, leer van elkaar en help anderen groeien.

Werk samen met ons aan innovatieve en gave projecten!

Als medior front-end developer bij Garansys heb je ruime ervaring met moderne webtechnologieën én de drive om jezelf continu te blijven ontwikkelen. Je werkt samen met andere (full-stack) developers aan verschillende producten voor uiteenlopende klanten.

Je hebt ideeën over hoe we de front-end van onze applicaties nóg beter kunnen inzetten en kan anticiperen op de behoeftes van de gebruikers. Je weet welke tools en frameworks je inzet bij een nieuwe opdracht en hebt een goed beeld van moderne front-end architecturen. De juiste keuze is niet one-size-fits-all, maar afhankelijk van de behoeften en requirements van de klant.

Je bent zowel bekwaam in het visuele component van het vak, als de ontwikkeling van de interface met externe systemen en de bijbehorende back-end(s). Je ontwikkelt applicaties die er goed uit zien en toegankelijk zijn voor iedereen, met performance in gedachte.

Als je de ambitie hebt, kun je de ruimte krijgen je zowel in de breedte als de diepte te ontwikkelen. Nieuwe frameworks in de front-end, maar ook vaardigheid in de back-end of op het gebied van de (Azure) Cloud is de ruimte voor.

Maarten Botter - Application Developer & Azure team lead: Discussies met het klantteam zorgen er uiteindelijk voor dat we ook echt de beste oplossing voor de klant bouwen. De ene keer stel ik de vragen, de andere keer beantwoord ik ze juist. Zo houden we elkaar scherp.

Hier worden wij blij van:

Als ervaren front-end developer heb je minimaal drie jaar ervaring met HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript en Angular. Verder heb je een afgeronde HBO-opleiding in de richting van Informatica, Open ICT, Software Development of vergelijkbaar. Je bent een echte teamplayer en draagt je kennis graag over aan junioren. Je blijft graag op de hoogte van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen in het vakgebied en hebt de ambitie om je te ontwikkelen in andere frameworks zoals React of Blazor. Je kunt doorgroeien naar een positie als senior of architect. Verder zien we graag ervaring met:

  • JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Angular
  • HTML5
  • CSS3
  • Responsive design
  • Versiebeheer (bijv. Git)
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Ervaring met andere frameworks (zoals React, Blazor of Vue) is een pré
  • Toepassen van WCAG 2.1 AA toegankelijkheidsrichtlijnen
  • Kennis van relevante front-end standaarden zoals ARIA, semantische HTML, en performance optimalisatie
  • Ervaring met React is een pré
  • Ervaring met testing frameworks (zoals Cypress, Jest of Jasmine) is een pré


Jij wordt hier blij van:

Je krijgt veel vrijheid en flexibiliteit; we denken graag met je mee! In overleg werk je op kantoor, thuis of bij de klant. Jouw (persoonlijke) ontwikkeling staat centraal. Op basis van jouw ontwikkelplan behaal je certificeringen, volg je trainingen met collega’s en bezoek je tech events. Daarnaast kun je deelnemen aan leer- en coachingtrajecten van de Caesar Groep en geniet je van uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden.

🤑 Een salaris tussen de €4.000 en €6.000

🚗 Mobiliteitsbudget om te besteden aan een (lease)auto of NS-businesscard

📅 Een werkweek van minimaal 32 uur

💻 Een laptop naar keuze bij een vaste aanstelling en een onkostenvergoeding (internet/telefonie) voor het thuiswerken

📚 Opleidingsbudget (en -dagen), om nóg beter te worden in wat je doet, bijvoorbeeld door een workshop uit de Caesar Academy te doen

🎡 Gezellige activiteiten zoals Hack Nights, boulderen of een dagje Efteling

🥊 Ondersteuning van onze eigen vitaliteitscoach en wekelijkse boks- en bootcamplessen

⛷️Leuke uitjes, waaronder een jaarlijkse wintersport met onze eigen personeelsvereniging Julius.

Bij Garansys doen we alles nét even anders. We zijn eigenwijs, gedreven en staan voor de nieuwe norm in IT-dienstverlening. Wij geloven dat we waarde creëren voor onze klant door hecht met elkaar samen te werken en onze oplossingen te leveren op het juiste moment, met garantie en zekerheid. Deel jij onze ambitie? Word dan onze nieuwe collega.

Heb je een vraag of wil je kennismaken? Stuur onze recruiter Glen dan gerust een WhatsApp berichtje op telefoonnummer 06 45 27 65 89 of contact hem per g.bruinier@caesar.nl.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

Aan het ongevraagd toesturen van CV’s, profielen of anderszins kunnen dan ook geen enkele rechten worden ontleend

title: Senior PHP Developer bij Rootnet
descriptionHtml:
Bouw mee aan een platform dat op schaal impact maakt.

Rootnet is al jaren een stabiele en innovatieve speler in managed hosting voor digital agencies. Ons platform groeit hard, en daarom zoeken we een Senior PHP Developer die houdt van strak gestructureerde code, schaalbare oplossingen en invloed op architectuur.

Iemand die zijn/haar sporen heeft verdiend in de wereld van SaaS of platformontwikkeling en nu ruimte zoekt om écht verschil te maken in techniek, product en richting.


Wat je gaat doen

Je sluit aan bij een compact, ervaren team van drie PHP-developers. Samen bouwen jullie aan het meest zichtbare deel van ons platform: het dashboard en de API waarmee agencies duizenden webapplicaties beheren.

Je:

  • Ontwerpt en ontwikkelt nieuwe features met focus op schaalbaarheid, performance en security.
  • Werkt nauw samen met ons DevOps-team aan automatisering van de infrastructuur.
  • Neemt initiatief in architectuurbeslissingen en houdt de codebase toekomstbestendig.
  • Signaleert verbeterpunten, refactort waar nodig en deelt actief kennis.
  • Coacht collega’s en helpt het team verder groeien.

We werken bewust en zorgvuldig: leesbare, onderhoudbare en goed geteste code, waardoor we meerdere keren per dag safe kunnen releasen.


Waarom dit interessant is voor jou

  • Je krijgt architecturale invloed op een volwassen platform.
  • Je werkt in een omgeving waar kwaliteit, autonomie en vakmanschap belangrijker zijn dan sprintdruk.
  • Je bouwt aan software met échte schaal: duizenden kritieke applicaties draaien op ons platform.
  • Je krijgt volop ruimte voor experimenteren, verbeteren en meedenken.


Wat jij meebrengt aan Technische skills

  • Diep inzicht in het ontwerpen en bouwen van schaalbare SaaS-applicaties.
  • Ervaring met PHP 8, MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ en Git.
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als PHP-developer in teamverband.
  • Ervaring binnen een groter platform- of SaaS-bedrijf is een pre.
  • Hbo- of wo-opleiding.
  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.


Soft skills

  • Je neemt ownership en ziet wat beter kan.
  • Je communiceert helder, ook richting niet-developers.
  • Je werkt gestructureerd, maar blijft pragmatisch.
  • Je deelt kennis, hebt een growth mindset en houdt van samenwerken.
  • Je voelt je thuis in een cultuur van vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en vertrouwen.


Wat wij bieden

Een rol waarin je als ervaren developer de diepte in kunt.

  • Salaris €5.000 – €6.000 bruto (fulltime), met groeiperspectief.
  • Minimaal 32 uur, flexibele werktijden en deels remote.
  • 24 vakantiedagen + 8% vakantiegeld.
  • Pensioenregeling.
  • Leaseauto of reiskostenvergoeding.
  • €5.000 opleidingsbudget per jaar voor coaching, trainingen, congressen en ontwikkeling.
  • MacBook + accessoires, sportabonnement bij De Vasim en dagelijkse lunch.
  • Barista-training, want koffie is óók core business.
  • Een unieke werkplek op de bovenste verdieping van De Vasim, met uitzicht over de Waal.
  • Een hecht team, borrels en regelmatige activiteiten.


Sollicitatieproces

We houden het graag simpel, overzichtelijk en persoonlijk:

  • Stuur je cv en (optionele) motivatie naar jobs@rootnet.nl
  • Kennismakingsgesprek over jouw ervaring en onze cultuur.
  • Technische deepdive: een dagdeel meelopen met onze developers.
  • Culture Fit Test via Talent Motivatie Analyse.
  • Tweede gesprek voor de verdiepingsslag.
  • Aanbod.


Dutch (C1) proficiency is mandatory

We do not offer visa sponsorship. Only applicants living within a 50 km radius of Nijmegen will be considered.

title: Cloud Platform Engineer | Relocation Offered
descriptionHtml:
Cloud Platform Engineer

Rotterdam, Netherlands

Swisscom

Advanced relocation package

Language courses

Temporary housing

Visa services

Real estate agent

Relocation bonus

📩 Get the premium jobs newsletter

~100 relocation-friendly tech jobs every Thursday ($12/mo)

Get

About Swisscom

We are about 850 IT experts and enthusiasts devoted to creating inspiring customer experiences and developing the best quality services, one of the leading IT providers in Switzerland. In addition, we’re building a new DevOps Center in Rotterdam and are looking to grow this to over 200 new hires over the next few years. Our ambition is to become the #1 DevOps Team. We work on innovative and challenging projects that use “state of the art tech” in an Agile environment. As DevOps engineers, we understand the equal importance of relationships, culture, soft skills, and collaborative working in a friendly environment.

Position

You are a highly skilled DevOps Engineer with deep expertise in AWS and a strong passion for serverless development and AI-driven solutions. You thrive in coding, automation, and cloud-native architectures, and you are motivated by paving the way for others at scale. With this mindset, you are an ideal fit for us!

Your Responsibilities

You will work in a diverse, geographically distributed team of engineers and product owners, helping to evolve Swisscom’s internal AWS platform. In our agile environment, you design and deliver platform-level capabilities within iAWS, Swisscom’s well-architected AWS Landing Zone. Your focus is on making AWS Services easy to consume, secure, and compliant for our internal developer community. By integrating services such as Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, S3, Bedrock, and SageMaker, you turn AWS innovations into reliable self-service solutions.

As a Senior Cloud Platform Engineer, you are curious and eager to integrate state-of-the-art AI services into the development process, the platform offering, and our broader portfolio. You rely on Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, CDK, and CloudFormation, and you ensure quality through automated testing. With your expertise in AWS and cloud-native development, you help us provide a developer-friendly platform that empowers Swisscom teams to innovate faster with serverless and AI-driven solutions.

This team belongs to the Internal Cloud Platform, which is the Shared Service organization in Swisscom. Thanks to you, we can offer AWS as a fully-integrated, secure and compliant self-service platform to all Swisscom internal DevOps teams.

Your qualification

  • Degree in computer science or equivalent work experience
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with AWS
  • Experience with platform testing, unit testing, regression testing, etc
  • Python proficiency is mandatory
  • Knowledge of best practices in code deployment
  • Familiarity with AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, and AI Developer Tools
  • CDK / CloudFormation is a plus
  • Holding one or more of these specific certifications is a plus:
    • AWS Certified Developer - Associate
    • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
  • Team-oriented, adaptable, with a strong drive for continuous improvement
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Excellent problem-solving skills to develop quick and sound solutions that resolve complex issues
  • Experience working in an Agile environment is a plus
  • Team-oriented, very adaptable, a flair for continuous improvement
  • Experience working in an Agile environment is a plus
  • Excellent problem-solving skills to develop quick and sound solutions that resolve complex issues
  • Proficient in English
What we offer

Work environment

  • Agile way of working, multi-cultural work environment promoting work-life balance
  • Autonomy, flexibility, opportunity and growth
  • Cool office space in the World Trade Center Rotterdam!
  • Are you coming to the office by bike or car? You can park right here at the office
  • Be a part of our events to build a stronger Swisscom community - for example, culture lunches, fun quizzes, game nights and a lot more!

Allowances

  • Full relocation support (Housing, settling in, etc.) for you and your family
  • 200 euros per month Telephone/internet allowance
  • 275 euros per month contribution to health insurance
  • 5 Paid training days and access to Swisscom learning platforms
  • Travel allowance reimbursement
  • 500 euros home office allowance
  • Gym subscription, Tax advice, and language course

Leaves policy

  • Work from abroad possibility for one month per year
  • Care, bereavement, maternity and paternity leaves
  • 25 days paid vacation days plus Dutch national holidays

Contract terms

  • To begin with you will receive a fixed term contract (one year), after 6 months of your employment with us, after a feedback meeting with the team, there is a possibility of extending the contract
  • The salary ranges mentioned in our Job Descriptions are base annual gross salaries including the 8% holiday allowance

Additional details

Want to know more about us?

We are serving the Swiss market as Switzerland’s leading IT & Telecom company. Thus, we are actively driving digitalization and networking, and tapping new paths for our customers and our employees. Our values are trustworthy, committed and curious.

Since 2019, we have been building up the coolest DevOps Center with a wonderful office at the World Trade Center in the heart of Rotterdam. We are currently recruiting IT passionate professionals who are keen on developing high-quality software, have an agile mindset and appreciate the collaboration with motivated colleagues from all over the world.

Engineer Python Developer Programmer AWS Agile Amazon Cloud AI Platform CloudFormation Swisscom CDK Platform Engineer Amazon Web Services Unit Testing Platform Developer Cloud Platform Engineer

title: Senior PHP Developer
descriptionHtml:
Ga als ontwikkelaar aan de slag met uitdagende vraagstukken voor één van de grootste e-commerce partijen. Werk met de nieuwste technologieën en groei met ons mee!

Tech stack

De afdeling werkt met tech en tools als PHP, MySQL, Symfony, ElasticSearch, Kubernetes, Figma en meer!

Uitdagende projecten

Innovatie staat centraal in jouw werk aan complexe projecten.

Leuk team

Binnen het IT-team is veel ruimte voor gezelligheid.

Jouw ontwikkeling

Blijf leren en doorgroeien! Je krijgt alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en verder te groeien in jouw specialisme.

Wat ga je doen?

Analyseren, programmeren en creatief nadenken… Ontwikkelen doe jij het liefst elke dag, of het nu om een applicatie of persoonlijke groei van jou of jouw team gaat. Jouw inbreng brengt ons ontwikkelteam verder.

  • Met de laatste tech en de beste tools werk je voor miljoenen klanten.
  • Je komt in een highly skilled development team met de drive om van elkaar te leren.
  • Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met vestigingen in heel Europa.

Je wordt onderdeel van één van onze 6 scrumteams, die elk met sprints van 2 tot 3 weken werken. Zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werk je aan de applicaties die we intern ontwikkelen. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het toevoegen van nieuwe functies aan de webshop(s) of het verbeteren van onze logistieke systemen. Ook help je de Lead Developer met het coachen van junior en medior collega’s.

We hebben innovatiedagen waarop jij kunt werken aan innovatieve projecten die jou interesseren. Laat je creativiteit los op de meest interessante vraagstukken en breng verbeteringen aan waar het hele bedrijf van profiteert. Ook onze andere (internationale) webwinkels maken gebruik van het door onszelf ontwikkelde e-commerceplatform en ERP-systeem. Als PHP Developer wordt jouw werk dus direct ingezet voor meerdere webshops in verschillende landen.

We werken o.a. met PHP 8.2, MySQL 8, ElasticSearch, RabbitMQ, Kubernetes en Angular. Symfony 6 is onze basis voor backend ontwikkeling en TypeScript voor frontend. We houden onze technologieën up-to-date, staan open voor nieuwe ideeën en innovaties en deinzen niet terug voor complexe migraties. Benieuwd naar het soort code waar wij naar streven? Neem dan alvast een kijkje op onze GitHub-pagina.

Dit krijg je van ons!

  • Uitstekend salaris en een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling (wij betalen 75%).
  • Auto van de zaak met tankpas of een reiskostenvergoeding.
  • Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken.
  • 25 vakantiedagen o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband.
  • Veel aandacht voor jouw ontwikkeling door training en opleidingen.
  • Toegang tot 100+ trainingen in onze Online Academy.
  • Elke twee weken een massage.
  • Toegang tot het platform Corporate Benefits met aantrekkelijke kortingen op mode, elektronica, vakanties, dagjes uit en nog veel meer
  • Een gezellige werkomgeving met de leukste collega's.

Wat vragen wij?

  • Je hebt minimaal hbo-werk- en denkniveau.
  • Je hebt minimaal 6 jaar ervaring als Senior Software Developer.
  • PHP en SQL kennen geen geheimen voor jou en object georiënteerd programmeren is je tweede natuur.
  • Je hebt diepgaande technische kennis en analytisch inzicht.
  • Je bent leergierig, ambitieus en deelt graag kennis.
  • Je spreekt en schrijft uitstekend Nederlands en/of Engels.

Het team

De IT-afdeling bestaat uit ongeveer 95 medewerkers die over veel kennis beschikken. De afdeling heeft een informele sfeer en biedt naast werken ook veel ruimte voor gezelligheid. Denk aan game nights, borrels en teamuitjes. Zelfstandig werken is belangrijk, maar samenwerking en kennisdeling staan centraal, zodat we continu van elkaar leren en ons ontwikkelen.

Zo ziet de

sollicitatieprocedure eruit

  • Telefonische intake We nemen telefonisch contact met je op.
  • Kennismaking We nodigen je uit voor een kennismaking bij ons op kantoor.
  • Assessment Voor sommige functies maakt een assessment onderdeel uit van de procedure.
  • Tweede gesprek Klikt het? Dan gaan we in het tweede gesprek nog iets dieper in op de functie.
  • Voorstel We willen graag dat je bij ons komt werken en sturen je een voorstel.

Impact maken als IT'er

Jouw IT-oplossingen hebben een enorme impact in binnen- en buitenland. Je werkt met de nieuwste tech en ontvangt een aantrekkelijke beloning, terwijl je volop ruimte krijgt om te groeien én je eigen projecten te starten. Hoe gaaf is dat?! Duik diep in de features, werk aan complexe uitdagingen en denk mee over de toekomst van onze software.

We verwachten deze functie zelf in te kunnen vullen. Acquisitie vinden we zonde van jouw én onze tijd.

title: Senior Backend Developer
descriptionHtml:
Job Description:

You probably remember the best customer journey you’ve ever experienced, and the worst one too. But why is that? What can businesses do to keep you engaged, solve your problems, and make your life easier and more beautiful, not just in one moment, but across every interaction?

“The entire customer journey. One platform”

People move between channels, platforms, apps and physical locations without thinking about it.eWherever your journey starts and wherever it continues, our goal is simple and ambitious: “Enable growing businesses to serve, sell, interact and engage through one Global AI Powered Customer Engagement Platform. We connect conversations, customer data and payments with AI Agents, so that businesses all over the world can grow faster, together.

All our services are fully integrated within our unique business structure, consisting of four business units: Connect, Pay, Live, and Engage.

Now, we’re looking for a Senior Backend Developer to join the Conversational Router team!

What You Will Do

We are building the ultimate Global AI-Powered Customer Engagement Platform that lets businesses connect with customers, automate work, and handle every interaction through one reliable, user-friendly platform. That is our mission for 2026.

Handling more than a million conversations every day, globally, the conversational router enables smooth handovers between web conversations, AI agents, and the customer service agent inbox. You can think of it as the highly complex, high-volume heart of every customer interaction.

In your first 12 months, you will:

  • Take ownership of the architecture and scalability of the Conversational Router As a Senior Developer, you’ll lead the design and optimization of a core component of CM.com’s platform, ensuring it handles millions of messages daily across channels like WhatsApp, RCS, and SMS. You’ll work on critical integrations with products like Web Conversations, Conversational AI Cloud, HALO, and Mobile Service Cloud, driving technical excellence and reliability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to shape the Router’s future You’ll work closely with teams across CM.com to centralize functionalities from various applications into the Router, making strategic architectural decisions that ensure scalability, security, and long-term success.
  • Solve complex technical challenges using AI and cutting-edge technologies You’ll tackle advanced problems like streaming AI messages, data anonymization, and optimizing performance at scale. With the freedom to explore new technologies, you’ll push boundaries and ensure the Router remains at the forefront of innovation.
  • Mentor and support your team Beyond coding, you’ll play a key role in mentoring and guiding your teammates, helping them grow their skills and tackle challenges effectively. Your leadership will drive the team’s success and foster a culture of collaboration and innovation.
  • Help shape how AI will redefine your role and the Router’s capabilities AI is transforming software development, and we expect you to lead the charge in integrating AI into workflows and processes. By leveraging AI tools for automation, debugging, and optimization, you’ll redefine how this role evolves and ensure the Router stays ahead of industry trends.
  • Success is measured by impact, not by perfect plans Your contributions will directly influence the Router’s performance, scalability, and ability to deliver seamless conversational experiences to millions of users worldwide.

That’s why you ideally have

  • At least 5+ years of experience with C#, .NET, and Cloud Service. You have a passion for writing clean, maintainable code and are eager to learn modern development practices.
  • A proactive attitude towards working on complex solutions. You enjoy technical challenges and thrive on solving intricate problems.
  • A self-starting mindset, a strong sense of responsibility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with direct colleagues.
  • You enjoy being part of a relatively small and close-knit team.
  • You are fluent in English and live near our headquarters in Breda.

The reality at CM.com

We believe honesty creates better matches. So here it is:

  • You work on-site with your team, collaboration happens face to face.
  • Priorities can shift quickly as technology and insights evolve.
  • AI will change how your role looks, fast. Some tasks you do today may disappear next year.
  • We move before everything is finished or polished.
  • For this position, we can only consider candidates who already hold a permanent work and residence permit for the Netherlands.

If that excites you, you’ll probably feel at home here. If you’re looking for predictability and fixed boundaries, this may not be the right place.

Requirements:

Every CM.com colleague, connects to our 4 shared values:

Drive and Lead

We value your expertise and professional judgement. You understand the mission of CM.com and feel ownership over your role and its contribution to the bigger picture. You take initiative, make decisions and recognize opportunities. Making mistakes is part of moving forward.

Grow and Learn

Growing Faster Together is not just our purpose, it’s how we work. The growth of our colleagues and our customers is our priority. Our organization is designed to support this through the CM Academy, the Young Professional Program and our own CM Business Adventure, the CMBA. But growth also comes from daily curiosity.

You enjoy stepping outside your comfort zone and you like to experiment, learn continuously and actively share knowledge and insights with others.

Together and Care

At CM.com, we work together. We believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. Diversity is therefore essential to us.

We value the social side of work. We trust one another, show genuine interest and care about one another’s well-being. You are looking for that connection, you prefer being together on-site, sharing ideas, meals, workouts and conversations, and you believe that energy is created by meeting in person.

Speed and Change

For more than 25 years, we have operated at the forefront of innovation. Change is not something we respond to, it’s something we actively drive.

By welcoming AI Agents into our organisation, we fundamentally change how work is done. This allows us to move faster, do more with fewer people and continuously rethink roles and responsibilities. You are comfortable with that reality and want to contribute to progress rather than maintaining the status quo.

Company Benefits

At CM.com, we believe in empowering our people to do what they love, excel at what they do, and make a meaningful impact. As a CM.com club member, you’ll have the following benefits:

  • Onboarding: Join our unique 3-days Global Onboarding program in our Headquarters in Breda, a deep dive into the culture of CM.com.
  • Healthy food: Daily healthy lunches and snacks to keep you energized.
  • Effortless commute: The Shuttle mobility card, commuting allowance and Lease-a-bike options get you where you need to be. We have CM company cars that you can use for client visits as well.
  • Invest in your future: A solid pension plan.
  • Time off: Recharge with 25 vacation days, plus the option to purchase 10 additional days.
  • Own your success: Become a shareholder with our Employee Share Purchase Program.
  • Your Development: We support your growth and development through initiatives like the CM Academy, Udemy courses, exclusive meetups with thought leaders, the Young Professional Program, and our own CM Business Adventure (CMBA), ensuring you’re always learning and evolving
  • Vitality: Our Vitality Team organizes a year-round vitality program to support a healthy body and mind for all colleagues. Think of stress prevention workshops, ergonomist visit, weekly bootcamps, yoga sessions and our CM sports day.
  • Together at CM.com: Weekly drinks, board game nights, karaoke throwdowns, yearly ski trip, and more! We have something for everyone.

Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and drive us forward. We welcome everyone, regardless of age, background, or beliefs.

title: Founding Full Stack Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Founding Full Stack engineering role on-site in Amsterdam

€70k - €105k base salary + 10-20% bonus + 100-150k€ equity


What if you could build the AI that transforms how European businesses sell?

Venta AI is the leading AI-powered sales solution for European companies. Our technology helps companies generate qualified leads, automate outbound processes, and unlock revenue potential that was previously invisible. In 2025 alone, Venta AI has initiated over 500 real deals, proving the economic impact modern AI can deliver in sales.

As a Founding Full Stack Engineer, you won't just write code – you'll shape the core of a product that's already changing how companies grow. You'll own features end-to-end, from database to UI, and see your work directly drive customer success. You'll build alongside the founders, talk to real users, and make decisions that define our technical direction for years to come.

If you've been waiting for the right moment to join an early-stage company where your work genuinely matters – this is it.



What you’ll drive

This is not a role where you'll be handed specs and expected to execute. You'll work on a product that's live, growing, and used daily by sales teams across Europe. You'll shape what we build and how we build it.


You will:

  • Own and develop core product features across our entire stack (Python/FastAPI backend, TypeScript/React frontend)
  • Collaborate directly with founders and customers to conceptualize, design, and ship new features
  • Make architectural decisions that balance speed, scalability, and maintainability
  • Debug production issues, optimize performance, and ensure our platform stays reliable as we scale
  • Contribute to a codebase that leverages cutting-edge AI – and help us push its boundaries further
  • Take on whatever the moment demands – in an early-stage startup, the lines between roles blur, and that's the point


You won't just build features. You'll help build a company.


Who thrives here

You've built and shipped real products before. You understand what it takes to move fast. You're energized by ambiguity, not paralyzed by it – and you'd rather ask for forgiveness than wait for permission.

You're someone who learns constantly, experiments boldly, thinks in systems – and earns trust through delivery, not promises.


You bring:

  • Significant experience as a full-stack engineer, ideally at a medior/senior level
  • Strong backend skills in Python
  • Solid knowledge in TypeScript and React
  • Experience operating software at scale in production environments
  • Fluent English with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly
  • Genuine alignment with our purpose (our why) and our values (our how)


Nice to have:

  • Experience designing multi-tenancy SaaS architectures
  • Familiarity with modern AI coding tools such as Cursor
  • Experience with Azure cloud infrastructure
  • German language skills to communicate with our mostly German customer base


What this role is not

This is not a job where you'll work on isolated tickets or follow rigid processes defined by others.

  • You won't wait for product specs – you'll help figure it out.
  • You won't optimize for code coverage metrics – you'll optimize for customer impact.
  • We're growing fast – structures evolve, and you'll actively shape them.


Success is measured by what you ship and the difference it makes – not by hours logged or PRs merged.

We reward clarity, real impact, and deep ownership – not activity for its own sake.

If you're thinking: This sounds like the role where I don't just write code, but help build something that matters – we should talk.


About Venta AI

Lucas and Stefan founded their first AI company seven years ago (later acquired) and, learning from that journey, launched Venta AI to build AI employees for sales teams. We believe organizations must harness AI to stay competitive, and our mission is to make AI accessible, compliant, and transparent for European businesses.

We raised a € 2M pre-seed round from Y Combinator, Google’s AI fund and others.

Our Why

We believe AI should handle the repetitive, so people can focus on what truly matters. We're here to help our customers win, drive innovation, and strengthen Europe’s economic power.

Our How

We work with structure, speed, and real passion. We celebrate progress, challenge each other, and boldly try new things — always focused on creating real value, not just ticking boxes.



About the interview

1. Introductory Zoom Call (15–20 min)

A short call with our CTO to get to know each other and align on expectations.


2. Take-Home Assignment

You’ll receive a coding assignment - a mini version of Venta AI - built with our actual tech stack (Python/FastAPI backend + TypeScript/React frontend). You can complete it in your own time and are welcome to use AI coding tools. All expectations and requirements are detailed in the README.


3. Follow-Up Code Review Call (30 min)

A call with one of our team members to walk through your submission and discuss your approach.


4. On-Site Interview in Amsterdam

Join us for lunch at our office, followed by a 45-minute whiteboard session focused on system design and rapid prototyping.

We typically make an offer the next day (pending a standard background check). We never contact referees without your permission.


The full process usually takes 7–10 days.

You'll shape what we build and how we build it.You will:Own and develop core product features across our entire stack (Python/FastAPI backend, TypeScript/React frontend)Collaborate directly with founders and customers to conceptualize, design, and ship new featuresMake architectural decisions that balance speed, scalability, and maintainabilityDebug production issues, optimize performance, and ensure our platform stays reliable as we scaleContribute to a codebase that leverages cutting-edge AI – and help us push its boundaries furtherTake on whatever the moment demands – in an early-stage startup, the lines between roles blur, and that's the pointYou won't just build features. You'll help build a company.Who thrives hereYou've built and shipped real products before. You understand what it takes to move fast. You're energized by ambiguity, not paralyzed by it – and you'd rather ask for forgiveness than wait for permission.You're someone who learns constantly, experiments boldly, thinks in systems – and earns trust through delivery, not promises.You bring:Significant experience as a full-stack engineer, ideally at a medior/senior levelStrong backend skills in PythonSolid knowledge in TypeScript and ReactExperience operating software at scale in production environmentsFluent English with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearlyGenuine alignment with our purpose (our why) and our values (our how)Nice to have:Experience designing multi-tenancy SaaS architecturesFamiliarity with modern AI coding tools such as CursorExperience with Azure cloud infrastructureGerman language skills to communicate with our mostly German customer baseWhat this role is notThis is not a job where you'll work on isolated tickets or follow rigid processes defined by others.You won't wait for product specs – you'll help figure it out.You won't optimize for code coverage metrics – you'll optimize for customer impact.We're growing fast – structures evolve, and you'll actively shape them.Success is measured by what you ship and the difference it makes – not by hours logged or PRs merged.We reward clarity, real impact, and deep ownership – not activity for its own sake.If you're thinking: This sounds like the role where I don't just write code, but help build something that matters – we should talk.About Venta AILucas and Stefan founded their first AI company seven years ago (later acquired) and, learning from that journey, launched Venta AI to build AI employees for sales teams. We believe organizations must harness AI to stay competitive, and our mission is to make AI accessible, compliant, and transparent for European businesses.We raised a € 2M pre-seed round from Y Combinator, Google’s AI fund and others.Our WhyWe believe AI should handle the repetitive, so people can focus on what truly matters. We're here to help our customers win, drive innovation, and strengthen Europe’s economic power.Our HowWe work with structure, speed, and real passion. We celebrate progress, challenge each other, and boldly try new things — always focused on creating real value, not just ticking boxes.About the interview1. Introductory Zoom Call (15–20 min)A short call with our CTO to get to know each other and align on expectations.2. Take-Home AssignmentYou’ll receive a coding assignment - a mini version of Venta AI - built with our actual tech stack (Python/FastAPI backend + TypeScript/React frontend). You can complete it in your own time and are welcome to use AI coding tools. All expectations and requirements are detailed in the README.3. Follow-Up Code Review Call (30 min)A call with one of our team members to walk through your submission and discuss your approach.4. On-Site Interview in AmsterdamJoin us for lunch at our office, followed by a 45-minute whiteboard session focused on system design and rapid prototyping.We typically make an offer the next day (pending a standard background check). We never contact referees without your permission.The full process usually takes 7–10 days.

title: Full Stack Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij met data werken die écht impact heeft op onze leefomgeving? Ben jij een full stack data engineer die graag slimme, praktische oplossingen bouwt en energie krijgt van experimenteren met nieuwe technologie? Dan ontmoeten we jou graag!

Functiebeschrijving

In het Datalab werk je met een team van tien specialisten aan datagedreven producten die de hele organisatie verder helpen. We ontwikkelen nieuwe oplossingen, verbeteren bestaande producten en experimenteren regelmatig met nieuwe technologieën. Denk aan projecten zoals computer vision voor het herkennen van plaagsoorten in watergangen, of het ontsluiten van databronnen op ons dataplatform.

Je werkt veel met Python en draagt bij aan innovatieve projecten zoals onze slimme gemalenregeling. Hierbij worden pompen aangestuurd op basis van o.a. weersvoorspellingen, wat direct zorgt voor schoner water in onze beken. Jij helpt mee aan de ETL-processen en infrastructuur die dit mogelijk maken. We zijn een team dat zich continu ontwikkelt en steeds opnieuw kijkt hoe we relevant blijven in een veranderende wereld.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Het ontwikkelen van nieuwe én verbeteren van bestaande producten van het Datalab.
  • Het meedenken met de analytics translator om wensen te vertalen naar haalbare technische oplossingen. Maar ook het afstemmen met de analytics translator en product owner over voortgang in de sprint maar ook op het einddoel.
  • Het uitvoeren van beheer en onderhoud van onze producten op afgesproken momenten.
  • Het samenwerken met de data analisten/scientists, waarbij jij duidelijk kan aangeven wat er mogelijk is binnen de gestelde kaders.

Functie-eisen

  • Je hebt minimaal Hbo werk- en denkniveau in de richting van Informatica, Data Science of Business IT en 3 jaar relevante werkervaring als Full Stack Data Engineer.
  • Je hebt ruime ervaring met het ontwikkelen en implementeren van digitale producten binnen een team. Je kent de uitdagingen die daarbij komen kijken en pakt die actief aan.
  • Je communiceert duidelijk en proactief. Je neemt initiatief, denkt mee en je geeft én ontvangt graag feedback.
  • Je voelt je thuis in een dynamische en snel veranderende omgeving. Je bent creatief, experimenteert graag en zoekt steeds opnieuw naar wat praktisch haalbaar is.
  • Je bent bekend met agile werken en past deze manier van samenwerken toe in de praktijk.
  • Je hebt ruime ervaring met het werken met, en bouwt actief mee aan, onze tech stack. Onze tech stack bestaat aan de achterkant uit Python (onder andere Django, Pandas en SQLAlchemy), InfluxDB, Postgres en PostGIS voor databasebeheer, verschillende Azure-diensten (Functions/Logic Apps), Ansible, Docker, Terraform en GitHub Actions voor de CI/CD. Aan de voorkant gebruiken we met name standaard dashboarding-applicaties als Power BI en Grafana.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Wij bieden jou een fijne werkplek met betrokken collega’s, een informele sfeer en volop mogelijkheden die bijdragen aan lekker werken & vitaliteit.
  • Een uitdagende en veelzijdige functie met grote mate van zelfstandigheid voor 32 uur per week.
  • Een passend maandsalaris tussen € 4.175,- en € 5.661,- (schaal 10) bij een 36-urige werkweek.
  • Een Individueel Keuze Budget (IKB) van 21% van je bruto jaarsalaris. Met het IKB kun je je arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket gedeeltelijk zelf samenstellen, het bestaat namelijk uit geld en verlofuren dat je kunt inzetten wanneer het jou uitkomt.
  • Een persoonlijk budget van € 6.000,- (tot 35 jaar is dit zelfs € 12.000,-) om opleidingen, cursussen en activiteiten te volgen in een periode van 5 jaar.
  • De mogelijkheid om flexibel te werken.
  • Een vergoeding van maximaal € 1.000,- om je thuiswerkplek arbotechnisch in te richten. Van ons ontvang je daarnaast een thuiswerkset om optimaal thuis te kunnen werken.
  • Een thuiswerkvergoeding van € 3,50 netto per thuiswerkdag.
  • Je ontvangt een reiskostenvergoeding voor zowel woon-werkverkeer als dienstreizen.

Goed om te weten

Ben je enthousiast en wil je graag bij ons komen werken?

  • Reageer dan vóór maandag 9 februari 2026 via het sollicitatieformulier op onze website, t.a.v. Stefan van de Worp, Teamleider BI en informatiemanagement.
  • Voor meer informatie bel je met Stefan via 06-21630487.
  • De eerste sollicitatiegesprekken vinden plaats op maandag 16 februari 2026.

Over het waterschap

Wij staan voor het water in ons gebied: Veilig, schoon, niet te droog en niet te nat. Elke dag zorgen we voor dijken, sloten, beken en rivieren. En we maken afvalwater schoon. Zo kan iedereen genieten van het water in de omgeving waarin ze wonen, werken en ontspannen. Ons waterschap is vakmanschap.

companySlogan: Wij zorgen voor het water in jouw omgeving. Veilig, schoon, niet te droog en niet te nat.
companyDescription: Waterschap Rijn en IJssel zorgt voor het water in Oost-Gelderland, het zuiden van Overijssel en het zuidoosten van de Veluwe. Zodat iedereen daarin veilig kan ondernemen, wonen en recreëren. Veilig, schoon, niet te droog en niet te nat. Dat doen we door het (grond)waterpeil te beheren, rioolwater te zuiveren en te zorgen voor schoon water in beken, sloten en rivieren.

title: Fullstack Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About This Vacancy

Als Fullstack Software Engineer werk je aan de volledige keten van softwareontwikkeling: van gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces tot robuuste backendlogica en cloudintegraties. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen verschillende technologieën en werkt samen met collega’s en klanten aan innovatieve oplossingen die impact maken. Denk aan:

  • Ontwerpen en bouwen van webapplicaties met moderne front-end frameworks (React, Angular, Vue).
  • Ontwikkelen van schaalbare backendservices in bijvoorbeeld Java, C#, Node.js of Python.
  • Integreren van databases, APIs en cloudservices (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Waarborgen van kwaliteit en performance via CI/CD, testautomatisering en DevOps-principes.
  • Samenwerken met UX-designers, data-engineers en domeinexperts om complete oplossingen te realiseren.

What We Expect From You

  • 3 tot 8 jaar ervaring met fullstack softwareontwikkeling in hightech of enterprise-omgevingen.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met zowel front-end (React, Angular of Vue) als back-end (Java, C#, Node.js, Python).
  • Een afgeronde Bachelor-, bij voorkeur Masteropleiding in een technisch vakgebied (bijvoorbeeld informatica, software engineering of wiskunde).
  • Kennis van en ervaring met softwaredesign en ontwikkelprincipes (OOP, TDD, SOLID, Clean Code).
  • Ervaring met cloudplatforms (Azure, AWS of GCP) en containertechnologie (Docker, Kubernetes) is een plus.
  • Ervaring met Scrum, Agile of SAFe methodieken.
  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
  • Een analytische, pragmatische en gestructureerde manier van werken.

What You Can Expect From Us

  • Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd, zodat je stabiliteit hebt in een dynamische omgeving.
  • Een uitgebreide individuele winstdeling.
  • Een individueel opleidingsbudget van €2.200 per jaar, zodat je jezelf continu kunt blijven ontwikkelen.
  • De kans om samen te groeien met onze ervaren professionals in onze kleinschalige, hechte business-cel.
  • Toegang tot ons TMC Entrepreneurial Lab, waar je je eigen ideeën en projecten tot leven kunt brengen.
  • Een omgeving waar jouw stem telt en waar jouw dromen werkelijkheid kunnen worden.

Bij TMC werk je in een uniek model waarin ondernemerschap, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en technologische innovatie samenkomen. Jij bepaalt de koers, wij zorgen voor de support en de mogelijkheden.

TMC - The Member Company. 

If it’s people who drive technology, it makes sense that we provide you with the best driver’s seat available. You’re the driver. So fasten your seatbelt and be prepared to have your tech-mind driven to its limit.

Entrepreneurial technologists with a crush on high tech and business push innovation and creative thinking. This idea is the basis of our dedication to create the perfect environment for technologists. A setting where you’re driven to discover, to evolve and to be challenged. A place where knowledge and know-how are shared to create combined brain power.

At TMC you meet likeminded enthusiasts by working on exciting projects within specialized business cells. You find creative answers to existing issues by joining TechTanks and satisfy your high-tech hunger at pizza-sessions. You work on awesome machines and co-create solutions in our Entrepreneurial Lab for clients such as Philips, ASML and TNO. At the same time, we sharpen your technical and entrepreneurial drive by providing you with the perks of our unique philosophy; Employeneurship.  

Join TMC and drive your career to Employeneurship.

title: Senior PHP Developer
descriptionHtml:
Help build the future of fonQ’s E-commerce Platform 

Are you a senior developer ready for the next challenge and craving real technical depth? This is your chance to make a meaningful impact. 


At fonQ, you’ll work on complex, high-impact initiatives that shape our business and daily operations at scale. Our high-traffic e-commerce platform serves millions of customers every day, which means the technical choices you make are felt immediately—by users, partners, and the business. 


We’re in the middle of a major transformation, moving from legacy systems to a modern, scalable Symfony-based architecture. This journey is about much more than rewriting code; it’s about redefining how we build, scale, and operate our platform for the future. We’re looking for a senior PHP developer with strong hands-on coding skills and a clear technical vision to help drive this change. 


You thrive in complex technical environments and take ownership of challenges from start to finish. You design robust, maintainable solutions, actively contribute to architectural direction, and think ahead about long-term impact. With your experience, you confidently challenge technical decisions, propose smart solutions, and help guide the technical direction. You enjoy sharing your knowledge and helping your team level up on best practices. 


Your key responsibilities include, but aren’t limited to: 

  • Build, test, and maintain software that makes an impact—robust, scalable, and clean. 
  • Designing smart, future-proof solutions that scale with the platform. 
  • Challenge existing designs and decisions to ensure we build the right solutions 
  • Work closely with product, engineering, and key stakeholders to align technical choices with business goals. 
  • Conduct code reviews that raise the bar on performance, scalability, and maintainability. 
  • Create clear technical documentation, workflows, and best practices to keep the team aligned. 
  • Troubleshoot and solve challenging technical issues in both production and test environments. 


You’re comfortable working in an agile, Scrum-based environment, adapted to our context, and actively help shape how we work as a team. As we continue to modernize and scale, you’ll play a key role in transforming our platform and setting the technical standard for the future. 

 

Initiatives you might work on include: 


  • Smarter pricing & promotions: implement and optimize a new promo engine, enabling advanced promotion constructs across our Shopify platform. 
  • Scaling e-commerce operations: enhance dropshipping, warehouse systems, and marketplace seller integrations to make our backend faster, smarter, and ready for growth. 
  • Collaborate with an agency and our developers to implement a new ERP backbone and streamline all integrations and middleware for a solid, scalable foundation. 


Here’s what makes a great fit for this role: 

  • Strong hands-on PHP framework skills: You have at least 5 years of experience with PHP and a modern framework such as Symfony or Laravel. You are confident in building robust integrations, middleware, and systems. You have a deep understanding of SOLID principles and know how to apply them in practice. 
  • You keep data flowing smoothly SQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, and automate testing, deployment, and monitoring like a pro. You feel comfortable working with cloud platforms like GCP or AWS, whether using Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, Kubernetes, or equivalent services. 
  • You are experienced in working with event-driven architectures, building systems that communicate reliably through events and asynchronous workflows. You create and integrate well-structured APIs and understand how to apply Domain-Driven Design principles to create clear boundaries within a service. 
  • E-commerce familiarity: If you’ve built products or systems for e-commerce even better. Understanding how an e-commerce-first company works (like fonQ) will help you get started quickly. Bonus experience: Working with complex data models and SaaS systems is a plus. 
  • Education: You think and work at a Bachelor’s or Master’s level. 
  • Communication: You explain technical concepts clearly, whether you’re talking to teammates or non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Personal qualities: Flexible, self-starter, hands-on, structured, solution-oriented, and always eager to learn. 


IMPORTANT: Fluency in English and the ability to work in a hybrid setup are strict requirements. If you don’t meet these, please don’t apply, as we won’t be able to consider your application. 


Lastly, what can you expect from fonQ? 

  • A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a supportive team 
  • A welcoming and fonQ-y environment that fosters a culture of learning, exploration and problem solving 
  • A diverse work week and a dynamic e-commerce company with plenty of space for new ideas and initiatives, regardless of your role 
  • Unlimited and nicely priced lunch with a roof terrace 
  • Exciting, inviting and frequent events to meet and spend time with your colleagues in Utrecht 
  • A hybrid work environment with a structure that fosters quick and easy collaboration between colleagues. 


More about fonQ 

fonQ is the home store for anyone looking to furnish their home with style, character, and a touch of surprise. We offer unique interior items from leading brands, designers, and styles—everything you need to express your own personal style. Our ambition: to give every home character and a signature that’s truly its own. We believe in innovation, creativity and a passion for exceeding expectations.

You are confident in building robust integrations, middleware, and systems. You have a deep understanding of SOLID principles and know how to apply them in practice. You keep data flowing smoothly SQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, and automate testing, deployment, and monitoring like a pro. You feel comfortable working with cloud platforms like GCP or AWS, whether using Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, Kubernetes, or equivalent services. You are experienced in working with event-driven architectures, building systems that communicate reliably through events and asynchronous workflows. You create and integrate well-structured APIs and understand how to apply Domain-Driven Design principles to create clear boundaries within a service. E-commerce familiarity: If you’ve built products or systems for e-commerce even better. Understanding how an e-commerce-first company works (like fonQ) will help you get started quickly. Bonus experience: Working with complex data models and SaaS systems is a plus. Education: You think and work at a Bachelor’s or Master’s level. Communication: You explain technical concepts clearly, whether you’re talking to teammates or non-technical stakeholders. Personal qualities: Flexible, self-starter, hands-on, structured, solution-oriented, and always eager to learn. IMPORTANT: Fluency in English and the ability to work in a hybrid setup are strict requirements. If you don’t meet these, please don’t apply, as we won’t be able to consider your application. Lastly, what can you expect from fonQ? A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a supportive team A welcoming and fonQ-y environment that fosters a culture of learning, exploration and problem solving A diverse work week and a dynamic e-commerce company with plenty of space for new ideas and initiatives, regardless of your role Unlimited and nicely priced lunch with a roof terrace Exciting, inviting and frequent events to meet and spend time with your colleagues in Utrecht A hybrid work environment with a structure that fosters quick and easy collaboration between colleagues. More about fonQ fonQ is the home store for anyone looking to furnish their home with style, character, and a touch of surprise. We offer unique interior items from leading brands, designers, and styles—everything you need to express your own personal style. Our ambition: to give every home character and a signature that’s truly its own. We believe in innovation, creativity and a passion for exceeding expectations.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend)
descriptionHtml:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Senior/Staff/Lead Engineer to join the Launchpad team and take the lead in shaping the future of open-source collaboration.

Launchpad is a platform for managing open-source development projects. It includes code hosting and review, bug tracking, package building, translations, and other facilities used by free and open-source software developers.

As a senior or staff-level engineer passionate about Linux, web services, and scalable development platforms, you'll have the opportunity to architect and refine a mature, Python-driven system that supports major projects like Ubuntu. Your work will be instrumental in maintaining business-critical services while driving innovation, whether by expanding package-building capabilities, enhancing developer workflows, or modernizing the web UI.

In this role, you'll empower developers across the world by ensuring that Launchpad remains a well-structured, high-velocity environment for open-source contribution. As part of Canonical's globally distributed team, you'll collaborate with some of the brightest minds in open-source technology, building essential infrastructure that enables the next generation of software development. If optimizing large-scale projects, driving continuous improvement, and supporting developers excites you, this is the perfect opportunity to make a lasting impact.

Location: This is a remote role based in the EMEA region. Candidates will be expected to be located within this region.

The role entails

  • Influencing and driving design, architecture, and feature decisions across distributed teams, to ensure high-impact solutions.
  • Crafting exceptional, API-first Python code with unit tests, that delivering robust, well-structured systems that scale.
  • Diagnosing and resolving complex technical challenges, implementing high-quality fixes that enhance performance and reliability.
  • Mentoring and uplifting fellow engineers, leading code reviews that reinforce best practices and elevate team excellence.
  • Enjoying the freedom of remote work while staying globally engaged. Travelling internationally 2 to 4 times a year to collaborate in key internal discussions and industry-leading external events—expanding your network, sharing expertise, and shaping innovation on a global stage.

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology, working with brilliant people, and solving interesting problems
  • You are a strategic thinker who thrives on solving complex challenges and driving innovation
  • You are curious, adaptable, and articulate with strong leadership and collaboration skills
  • You have proven technical excellence in Python development and delivering high-quality, production-ready code
  • You have expertise in maintaining and improving large-scale web applications and database management (PostgreSQL a plus)
  • You have a deep understanding of integration, infrastructure, and operations in distributed environments
  • You have a security-focused mindset, ensuring robust implementation at every stage of development
  • You have a familiarity with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform
  • You have a solid grasp of software packaging systems, including Debian/Ubuntu packages
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

companySlogan: Enterprise open source, secured and delivered by the publisher of Ubuntu.
companyDescription:
We deliver open source to the world faster,  more securely and more cost effectively than any other company.

We're also the publishers of Ubuntu, the world’s most popular enterprise Linux from cloud to edge, together with a passionate global community of 200,000+ contributors. 

Ubuntu means 'humanity to others'​. We chose it because it embodies the generosity at the heart of open source, the new normal for platforms and innovation.

Together with a community of 200,000, we publish an operating system that runs from the tiny connected devices up to the world's biggest mainframes, the platform that everybody uses on the public cloud, and the workstation experience of the world's most productive developers.

Secure and reliable, elegant and intuitive, and open for innovation - this is the future of open source, which is why we're proud to be the developers of the fastest growing Linux in the world despite already being the most widely deployed.

If you're interested in a career at Canonical, we are a remote-first company so please apply to any suitable role as skills are valued more than location, despite some having a preferred geographic preference.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Wärtsilä is an innovative technology company known for being a forerunner in the Marine and Energy markets. Every day, we – Wärtsilians - put our hearts and minds into turning Wärtsilä's purpose of enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services into reality. Our ultimate aim is to provide increased value to both our customers and society. New, game-changing ideas and continuous improvement have been part of our DNA since 1834. Together, we can create new business opportunities and more sustainable future that we can all be proud of.

We want to transition the world towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. By pushing the boundaries of engineering and technology, we can make it work. We are always on the lookout for future-oriented talent – want to join the ride?

We are now looking for a

Senior Full-Stack Developer

to join our team working for a better future.

The preferred location for the position is in Drunen, The Netherlands.

What are your main tasks and responsibilities?

  • You enjoy creating efficient solutions that are scalable over hundreds of installations.
  • You are a key part of the development and maintenance of our streaming data platform, pipelines, databases and APIs.
  • You align implementation efforts with other developers across multiple development teams.
  • You participate in the setup of monitoring for data pipeline status and data quality.
  • You have clarity that the teams are also responsible to deploy to production and keep everything running.
  • You are a team player and embrace opportunities to help the team and product to grow.
  • You enjoy learning new things and aren't afraid to experiment.

What do we expect from you?

  • A Bachelor or Master's degree in Computer Science or at least 3 years of relevant experience.
  • We are looking for cross-front-end/back-end/DS/UX people
  • Proficient in programming languages (Java, Python, TypeScript), with good knowledge of Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker AWS.
  • Solid experience with DevOps practices, Continuous Integration (CI), and Continuous Deployment (CD).
  • Passion for high quality product, including (end-2-end) testing practices
  • Demonstrated problem-solving capabilities and the creation of innovative solutions.
  • Thorough understanding of Agile and Scrum frameworks, effective teamwork, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Deep knowledge of software architecture and design principles.

It's a big plus if you are:

  • Experience with industrial communication protocols like OPC-UA, Modbus and/or NMEA.
  • Experience with relational and time series databases.
  • Experience with DS and UX.

Why you and us?

We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership and taking responsibility of our work. We support each other’s growth and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have courage to see opportunities and take initiative.

We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe in that by being your own true self you can accomplish so much more. We don’t always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?

We have an amazing team and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.

Contact & next steps

We hope to hear from you soon, by submitting your application through our careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.

Welcome to join us in shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy!

Last application date: 30/11/2025

At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job-relevant merits and abilities.

Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.

This is Wärtsilä

Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Our team of 18,300 professionals, in more than 230 locations in 77 countries, shape the decarbonisation transformation of our industries across the globe. Read more on www.wartsila.com.

title: Back End Developer
descriptionHtml:
Wij groeien en zoeken daarom versterking van onze impactmakers! Ben je op zoek naar een plek waar je de vrijheid krijgt om mee te denken en werken aan innovatieve web- en softwareapplicaties? Werk je daarnaast graag samen met een team van gedreven digitale experts, om samen met onze klanten écht impact te maken? Dan is dit misschien wel de plek voor jou!


Wij zijn Digital Impact

Digital Impact is een tech consultant en digital agency gevestigd in hartje Rotterdam. Wij begeleiden onze klanten in het vertalen van bedrijfsstrategie naar digitale strategie en helpen ze bij het aanbrengen van structuur in hun digitaliseringsambities. Vanuit dat vertrekpunt ontwikkelen we doorlopend aan digitale producten, digitale ecosystemen en digital marketing strategieën. Dit beweegt van webapplicaties, maatwerk software, IoT oplossingen tot business apps en online marketing. Binnen ons bedrijf werken 35 enthousiaste professionals met diverse vakinhoudelijke expertises en achtergronden. Digital Impact is een platte organisatie met korte lijnen waarbinnen we altijd snel kunnen schakelen. Dit doen we in multidisciplinaire teams, werkend voor meer dan 600 opdrachtgevers in Nederland en soms daarbuiten.


Wat ga je doen als Backend Developer?

Wij zijn op zoek naar een Backend Developer om onze teams te helpen bij het creëren en verbeteren van technisch uitdagende oplossingen aan onze websites, webshops en online platformen. Je houdt van vernieuwen en het verschil maken. Geen technische uitdaging is je te moeilijk! De meest complexe maatwerk webapplicaties bouwen is jou op het lijf geschreven en dat wil je iedere dag een stukje beter doen. Zie jij jezelf helemaal terug in deze functie, dan gaan wij graag met je in gesprek!


Wij zoeken jou!

Als Backend Developer:

  • Heb je ervaring met PHP, Laravel, MySQL en werk je graag aan de backend van digitale oplossingen;
  • Ben je bekend met tools als: Jira, Git en de principes van SCRUM-agile werken;
  • Ervaring met React en Tailwind is een pré;
  • Werk je graag in multidisciplinaire teams aan uiteenlopende projecten;
  • Ben je bekend met de command line en heb je ervaring met gecontaineriseerde applicaties (zoals Docker);
  • Beschik je over een MBO- of HBO-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een relevante opleiding;
  • Heb je minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als developer, idealiter binnen een agency-omgeving;
  • Heb je affiniteit met web development trends, data-analyse en user experience;
  • Heb je interesse of ervaring in AI-first development en wil je ontdekken hoe je AI kunt inzetten als serieuze co-developer;
  • Beheers je zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal;
  • Ben je beschikbaar voor 32 tot 40 uur per week.


Wij bieden!

Naast een mooi salaris biedt Digital Impact veel meer. Wij vinden jouw persoonlijke groei namelijk van groot belang. We stimuleren dat je altijd doorleert en je ondernemende skills verder laat groeien. Dit doen we op maat. Een toffe cursus op het oog of een enorm goed idee? Wij denken graag mee! Verder zijn de vrijdagmiddag borrels legendarisch door de ligging van ons kantoor pal naast de Witte de Withstraat in Rotterdam. Leuke uitjes, sporten en tripjes zijn ons ook niet onbekend. Werken én plezier maken staat voor ons namelijk centraal. Nog even op een rijtje:


  • Een tof team en organisatiestructuur waarin je mee kunt groeien;
  • De salarisrange is breed. Dit is sterk afhankelijk van jouw skills en ervaring. Hier gaan we samen over in gesprek;
  • De mogelijkheid om op ons HQ in Rotterdam te werken en deels vanuit huis in overleg;
  • Pensioenregeling;
  • MacBook;
  • Telefoonvergoeding;
  • OV-vergoeding;
  • 25 vakantiedagen o.b.v. 40 uur;
  • Mogelijkheden om cursussen en opleidingen te volgen;
  • 1-op-1 coachingsgesprekken;
  • Een dynamische werkomgeving naast de Witte de Withstraat in Rotterdam met gezellige vrijdagmiddagborrels en teamuitje


We zien jouw sollicitatie graag tegemoet!
