Dan is deze vacature iets voor jou! Om deze energietransitie mogelijk te maken is Alliander flink aan het digitaliseren. Samen met enthousiaste collega’s ga jij met de nieuwste technologie aan de slag om tools voor netarchitecten verder uit te bouwen, vorm te geven en toekomstbestendig te maken. Dit betreft een Python en Angular positie en staat open voor 32, 36 or 40 uur. Jij maakt het net innovatiever
industries: Civil Engineering, Industrial Machinery Manufacturing, and Oil and Gas
companySlogan: Werken bij Alliander - Maakt het net beter
companyDescription:
Als groot Nederlands energienetwerkbedrijf hebben wij de verantwoordelijkheid voor de energievoorziening van 3,3 miljoen klanten en nemen wij onze verantwoordelijkheid voor de energietoekomst voor Nederland. Alliander wordt gevormd door een groep bedrijven, waaronder Liander en Liandon. Samen staan we voor hoogwaardige kennis van energienetwerken, energietechniek en technische innovaties. Bij Alliander werken circa 7.000 medewerkers. 

Wij zijn experts in het ontwikkelen, onderhouden en beheren van energienetwerken van hoge betrouwbaarheid; het inzichtelijk maken van energiestromen over die netwerken, zodat leverancier en klant elkaar vrij kunnen vinden en het helpen van klanten om over te schakelen naar duurzame vormen van energie.

Wij staan voor een energievoorziening die iedereen onder gelijke condities toegang geeft tot betrouwbare, betaalbare en duurzame energie. Dat is waar wij iedere dag aan werken.

Via energienetwerken zorgt Alliander voor de distributie van gas en elektriciteit in een groot deel van Nederland. Met ons werk maken wij wonen, werken, transport en recreatie mogelijk. Wij willen de samenleving versterken door vrije toegang tot de energie-infrastructuur mogelijk te maken en onze klanten meer inzicht in hun energieverbruik te geven. Alliander brengt een open en duurzame energiemarkt dichterbij. 

Onze belangrijkste taak is om gas en elektriciteit te distribueren naar consumenten, bedrijven en instellingen. De netbeheerder Liander houdt daarom de energienetten in goede staat, zorgt voor de distributie en sluit klanten aan op de energienetten.
 
Omdat het energielandschap verandert, werken we aan een toekomstbestendig en open netwerk met plaats voor meerdere energie-aanbieders. Om inzicht te krijgen in energieambities overleggen we met provincies, gemeenten en andere klanten. Wij helpen hen bij hun energievraagstukken en ontwikkelen complexe energie-infrastructuren, onder meer via Liandon.

title: Data-Driven Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Product-first, Data-driven SaaS. Build real product.

Work close to the data. Skip the corporate noise.


At Billy Grace (HQ Amsterdam), we build an AI-driven SaaS platform that brings strategy, creativity and clarity back to marketing. Our product gives teams control over their entire funnel through first-party tracking, attribution and creative intelligence. As a Data-Driven Full Stack Developer, you’ll have real impact from day one. You build and maintain features used daily by customers, work on our in-house tracking pixel, and operate close to both the product and the data with clear ownership from idea to production.


Your impact

You work on the core of the platform at a significant moment in the company’s growth. The features you build and the technical decisions you make directly influence performance, scalability and user experience. Your work turns complex data into reliable, intuitive insights our customers depend on every day.


What you will do

  • Develop backend logic for loading, transforming and mutating data for analytics and reporting
  • Design and implement Django APIs, using ORM and raw SQL for performance-critical use cases
  • Write and optimise complex SQL queries in data-heavy environments
  • Build and maintain React.js components for a fast, intuitive user experience
  • Own features end-to-end, contributing to architecture, scalability and reliability


What we offer you

You’ll join a team that builds together, learns together and makes each other better. We’re working on something big with energy, curiosity and plenty of room for your ideas. Here’s what you can expect:

  • A salary based on your background and experience
  • A MacBook and a workspace in the heart of Amsterdam (hybrid).
  • 25 vacation days + your birthday off.
  • Lots of trust, freedom and space for your ideas.
  • Access to OpenUp for mental health and wellbeing.
  • An annual volunteer day where we give back together.
  • Daily lunch, great coffee and an open, warm culture.
  • Opportunities to learn, experiment and grow.
  • Enthusiastic colleagues, team drinks and outings that actually make you smile.
  • Company Ski Holiday in March!


What you bring

  • 3+ years of experience as a Full Stack Developer (preferably in SaaS)
  • Solid experience with React and Python-based frameworks (Django, Flask or FastAPI)
  • Strong affinity with data-driven products, including complex SQL and analytics use cases
  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience with pandas (required)
  • Ownership-driven, communicative and comfortable taking responsibility
  • Living in the Netherlands and able to work hybrid (3 days in the office, no IND sponsorship)


Why Billy Grace

At Billy Grace, you help shape both the product and the engineering culture from the ground up. You’ll work in a focused tech team of five full stack developers, four data scientists and two data engineers. Your managers are hands-on engineers who write code, review PRs and make architectural decisions alongside you.

In practice, that means:

  • Meetings only when they move the work forward, most days are for building, not talking
  • No corporate theatre no vague roadmaps, buzzwords or politics
  • Lightweight process we skip heavy Scrum rituals in favour of direct collaboration
  • Fast decisions, real ownership if you own a feature, you ship it

If you’re done with planning poker, endless standups and process for process’ sake, you’ll feel at home here. Together, we build technology used daily by brands and agencies that want to move fast from Patagonia, XXL Nutrition to Stanley1913, and from Draft Digital to Happy Horizon.


Apply

Want to join our team as a Data Driven Full Stack Developer? We’d love to hear from you!


For this role, we are currently not collaborating with external agencies.

In the complex world of marketing, many challenges lead to marketers getting lost in data. 
For many marketers, a lot of tracking data is missing or incorrect;

It's time to bring back the balance in marketing and globally change the way marketers work! Check out our website for more information. 

Headquartered in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

title: Senior Fullstack Developer
descriptionHtml:
Jouw uitdaging
Als Senior Fullstack Developer binnen het kwaliteitsdomein werk je aan toepassingen die direct impact hebben op de internationale sierteeltketen. Samen met kwaliteitsinspecteurs, product owners, designers en collega-developers vertaal jij businesswensen naar schaalbare, betrouwbare en gebruiksvriendelijke oplossingen.
Onze kwaliteitsinspecteurs gebruiken dagelijks onze digitale tools om producten te beoordelen en transparant te maken voor de markt. Daarmee versterken we het vertrouwen tussen kwekers, aanvoerders en kopers. Jij bouwt mee aan de software die dit mogelijk maakt — van backend logica en API’s tot de frontend die een inspecteur in het veld gebruikt.
Je neemt de lead in technische keuzes, begeleidt collega’s en zorgt ervoor dat onze oplossingen niet alleen vandaag werken, maar ook klaar zijn voor de toekomst.
Wat ga je doen?
  • Vertalen van businessbehoeften naar schaalbare en onderhoudbare oplossingen.
  • Signaleren, analyseren en structureel oplossen van complexe technische problemen.
  • Leiden en onderbouwen van technische keuzes richting stakeholders en teamleden.
  • Actief bijdragen aan kennisdeling, begeleiden van collega’s en stimuleren van samenwerking.
  • Gebruikersfeedback vertalen naar praktische, gebruiksvriendelijke oplossingen voor kwaliteitsinspecteurs en marktpartijen.
Jouw profiel
Wat neem je mee?
  • HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau, met minimaal zeven jaar ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar.
  • Ervaring als Fullstack Developer:
  • - Frontend: React, TypeScript, CSS, MUI, Playwright, Vite, SignalR.
  • - Backend: .NET, API’s, serverless oplossingen.
  • Ervaring met Cloud & DevOps, waaronder AWS-diensten (API Gateway, Lambda, ECS/EKS, Aurora, Route 53, WAF).
  • Ervaring met CI/CD pipelines (GitLab, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) en Infrastructure as Code (AWS CDK/CloudFormation).
  • Grondige kennis van design patterns, SOLID en OOP.
  • Ervaring met testen: unit, integratie en testautomatisering.
  • Bekend met observability & monitoring (Grafana, Prometheus, Sentry, OpenTelemetry).
  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en communicatief vermogen.
  • Gedreven om continu te leren en verbeteren; kennis van DORA metrics en de 12factor-principes is een pre.
  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, in woord en geschrift.
Ons aanbod
  • Een bruto maandsalaris (o.b.v. 38 uur per week) tussen € 4.771,42 en € 6.769,89 exclusief vakantietoeslag.
  • Het werken met de nieuwste technologieën, waarbij je kennis en kunde wordt uitgedaagd om met vernieuwende ideeën te blijven komen.
  • Hybride werken en een mooie uitvalsbasis op ons kantoor in Aalsmeer.
  • Uitstekende secundaire voorwaarden: een zeer goede pensioenregeling, thuiswerkvergoeding, reiskostenvergoeding, MacBook Pro, telefoon(-vergoeding), vakantiegeld (8,33%) en 27 vakantiedagen.
  • Plantcadeau! Elk kwartaal een plant cadeau en een bos bloemen op je verjaardag.
  • Een baan bij een uniek bedrijf met een lange historie: de grootste internationale marktplaats voor bloemen en planten!
Meer informatie?
Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over de vacature waar de tekst je geen antwoord op geeft? Neem gerust contact op met Karen van Lohuizen via karenvanlohuizen@royalfloraholland.com.
Een online screening, referentiecheck en aanvraag van een VOG maken deel uit van het sollicitatieproces.
Werk je bij een bureau en wil je een kandidaat voorstellen voor deze vacature bij Royal FloraHolland? Bedankt, maar hier gaan we niet op in. We werven onze nieuwe collega graag zelf.
De afdeling
Je staat er misschien niet bij stil, maar de digitale achterkant van Royal FloraHolland is ronduit vernieuwend. Data, machine learning en AI: alles zetten we in voor het perfect servicen van onze klanten en het optimaliseren van (logistieke) processen. Met onze IT-projecten maak je tot ver over de grenzen impact en versterk je onze leidende positie. Zo bouw je mee aan Floriday, het digitale platform dat wereldwijd, 24/7, duizenden kwekers en kopers bij elkaar brengt. Ook beheren we de supply chain waarin dagelijks miljoenen ‘fusten’ – onze beroemde bloemenemmers – verwerkt worden. Naast developers vind je daarom ook architecten, cloud engineers, data scientists, security officers en andere rollen in het team. Onmisbaar bij het ontwikkelen en digitaliseren van processen en systemen.
Waar ga jij aan de slag?
Royal FloraHolland is de grootste internationale sierteeltmarktplaats van bloemen en planten: een vereniging van kwekers met een bedrijf. Al meer dan 100 jaar streven we samen naar een optimale prijs voor bloemen en planten, met de beste kwaliteit tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten. Een dubbelzijdig Royal FloraHolland platform: een digitaal platform, Floriday, en een logistiek platform, waarmee logistieke, financiële en vastgoeddiensten nauw met elkaar verbonden zijn.
We streven naar duurzaam succes voor onze leden en werken samen met alle partijen in de sierteeltsector, zodat de sector blijft groeien. Wij geloven dat we samen meer bereiken dan alleen. We willen waarde toevoegen via ons internationale B2B platform en vanuit een gezonde coöperatie. Via onze diensten zorgen we dat we onze klantbeloftes ook duurzaam waarmaken: makkelijk handelen, passende logistiek en slim ondernemen. Zo groeien we samen en bouwen we aan een efficiënte, duurzame en toekomstbestendige sierteeltsector.

companySlogan: Connect to grow
companyDescription:
Royal FloraHolland is a leading international floriculture marketplace. For more than 100 years, we have brought growers and buyers together. Through our digital marketplace and physical hubs, we make the widest and deepest floriculture assortment in the world easily accessible to buyers from all countries and markets.  Our aim is an optimal market price at the lowest possible cost. ​

We strive for sustainable success for our members and collaborate with all parties in the floriculture sector so that the industry continues to grow. We believe that we achieve more together than alone. As a cooperative, we provide simplified dealmaking, customised logistics, and help our customers to do smart business. This is how we grow together and build an efficient, sustainable and future-proof floriculture sector​

ROYAL FLORAHOLLAND – CONNECT TO GROW​

title: Lead Software Engineer - Frontend (Angular)
descriptionHtml:
At Schuberg Philis, we don’t just deliver IT solutions, we design, build, and run mission-critical systems that our customers rely on every single day. From infrastructure to cloud-native platforms, every layer of technology is crafted with one goal in mind: uncompromising reliability and excellence. We take pride in working shoulder-to-shoulder with our customers, ensuring their most vital operations run smoothly, no matter how complex the challenge.


We are looking for an experienced Lead Frontend Software Developer who can work in the core of our organization with a tightly knit and small DevOps team to deliver business value using modern cloud technologies and a DevOps way of working.


As a senior software engineer, you will join our existing "backbone team", responsible for the digital core of Schuberg Philis, and improve its software development capabilities, working closely with internal stakeholders in sales, finance, and people planning. You will work daily within a DevOps team where your colleagues will expect you to maintain a wide overview while guarding aspects like quality, security, and planning.


Our ideal colleague is someone who has experience with:


  • Angular 18+ (modern Angular features, standalone components, zoneless change detection)
  • TypeScript, strictly typed
  • NgRx SignalStore / Angular Signals
  • RxJS and functional programming patterns
  • Angular Material and Handsontable
  • Jest (including ng-mocks)
  • OpenAPI
  • HTML/(S)CSS
  • Nx Monorepo with module boundaries & dependency constraints
  • Affinity for mentoring mid-level developers in a self-steering context
  • Fluency in English required


Nice to have:


  • Playwright for end-to-end testing
  • Python (automation, scripts, and integrations with backend)
  • GitHub CI/CD


Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. The hiring and appraisal process at Schuberg Philis is designed to be thorough and equitable, implementing fair payment, benefits, and opportunities across all demographics.


It is our desire to be a company that brings together multiple nationalities, cultures, religions, genders, abilities, and talents within and across our teams. We welcome colleagues from diverse backgrounds to join Schuberg Philis and actively support diversity and inclusion in the tech industry.

companyDescription:
Some systems just have to work. They keep power grids stable, logistics moving, payments flowing, and vital public services online. You don’t hear much about them when they work, but when they stop, the impact is immediate, visible, and far-reaching.

That’s exactly the kind of work we do. We design, build, and run IT systems that must be reliable, secure, and uncompromising because people depend on them every single day. We call it mission-critical IT.

At Schuberg Philis, we go beyond traditional IT services by delivering promised outcomes, not just projects. Our Plan-Build-Run model means the same team takes ownership from start to finish: no handoffs, no middlemen. It’s how we’ve made 100% customer satisfaction not a goal, but a requirement. And it’s why 99.9% of our projects are delivered on time and on budget, helping customers realize solutions that are better, cheaper, and faster.

Our engineers bring deep expertise in cloud, data & AI, software, and security, not as abstract offerings, but as the means to solve business-critical challenges. Whether it’s banks handling millions of transactions, logistics firms keeping supply chains running, or energy providers maintaining grid stability, customers trust us when failure is not an option.

What sets us apart?
- We engineer outcomes, not just deliver technology.
- Our autonomous teams carry end-to-end responsibility.
- We focus on long-term resilience and impact.

This approach has made us the #1 ranked IT company in the Netherlands, according to Whitelane Research. Since 2000, we’ve built enduring partnerships across vital industries, delivering secure, scalable, and seamless solutions that keep society moving.

We’re expanding across Europe with one clear mission: to be more than an IT provider. We’re a partner who understands your business inside out, and who is fully invested in your success.

title: Principal Frontend Engineer | Rotterdam
descriptionHtml:
Join us on our mission to build the world’s most efficient platform for customized products.

As we scale fast, we’re evolving our entire frontend landscape and we’re looking for a Principal Frontend Engineer to lead the way. You’ll be based in our Rotterdam HQ, taking ownership of our most frontend-heavy applications and playing a key role in shaping a high-performing, modern engineering environment.

  • Lead our frontend architecture You’ll be the go-to person for everything frontend—making sure decisions are aligned, scalable, and not stuck in silos.
  • Drive speed through smart engineering We're shifting toward AI-enhanced workflows that remove friction and accelerate delivery. You'll help us embed that mindset and approach in every sprint.
  • Keep us shipping We work in a two-week delivery cadence, focused on calm, consistent progress that drives commercial outcomes fast.
  • Remove friction, increase flow You’ll spot the bottlenecks before they happen and design smarter, simpler systems to keep the team moving.
  • Champion decoupling and modular design From headless architectures (Vue.js/NUXT) to backend-agnostic frontends, you’ll help us build for speed, scale, and flexibility.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Architectural Leader – You think big-picture and long-term, aligning fragmented efforts into a single, future-ready architecture.
  • Team Builder – You share your knowledge, coach senior engineers, and lead by example, across borders and time zones.
  • Tech Expert – You’re fluent in modern frameworks (Vue.js/NUXT) and know how to build clean, modular, API-first systems.
  • Performance-Minded – You obsess over mobile speed and frontend efficiency, not for vanity, but because it drives business.
  • Fast & Pragmatic – You ship. You simplify. You make things work today, and improve them tomorrow.
  • Present in Rotterdam – You’re available to work from our Rotterdam office 5 days a week.
  • Close enough to commute – Ideally, you live within 60 minutes of the office, one way.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in e-commerce or high-growth tech environments.
  • Hands-on experience transitioning from monolithic to headless architectures.

What We Offer:

🎯 Career Growth & Development: Room to Design Yourself, opportunities grow quickly within and beyond HelloPrint.

🌍 International Experience: Work in a diverse team of 150+ professionals from 34+ nationalities in our Rotterdam or Valencia office.

🚀 Innovation & Impact: Shape the future of customized products in a high-growth, tech-driven company where your ideas make a real difference.

💡 Collaboration & Ownership: Work with experienced leaders, take initiative, and drive meaningful projects with the freedom to innovate.

💰 Competitive Salary & Benefits: including 24/7 access to our HelloFit gym, OneFit discount, and company-sponsored healthy meals every day.

Are You Ready to Build the Future? This isn’t a job for just anyone. We need bold thinkers, fast executors, and AI-first problem solvers. If that sounds like you, apply now. Let’s redefine an industry together.

title: Lead PHP (Symfony) Developer | tot €85.000 p/j | Hybride
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij als Lead PHP (Symfony) Developer niet alleen bouwen, maar ook richting geven aan een volwassen SaaS-platform dat écht verschil maakt in de automotive sector? In deze rol werk je in een energiek team aan een product dat dagelijks door honderden bedrijven wordt gebruikt om commerciële processen te stroomlijnen. Denk aan het automatiseren van leads, sales, marketing en dashboards, allemaal in één platform.


Je krijgt de ruimte om technische keuzes te maken, codekwaliteit te verhogen en je stempel te drukken op de architectuur. Je werkt met een moderne PHP-stack in een omgeving waar ontwikkeling en innovatie centraal staan. Je bent hands-on, maar ook verantwoordelijk voor het team en de technische koers.


Je komt terecht in een informele organisatie met korte lijnen, waar je écht invloed hebt op roadmap en uitvoering.


🚀 Waarom dit interessant is voor jou als developer

  • Je hebt technische impact op een volwassen SaaS-platform met echte gebruikers
  • Je werkt aan complexe, schaalbare software in een security- en performance-gericht domein
  • Je hebt veel vrijheid in architectuur, tooling en verbeteringen
  • Je combineert hands-on development met een lead-rol


🧩 Wat ga je doen?

  • Bouwen en verbeteren van backend-functionaliteit in Symfony (PHP)
  • Bepalen en bewaken van architectuur en codekwaliteit
  • Technisch leiderschap: coachen, reviewen en sparren met het team


🧠 Wie past hier goed?

  • Je hebt sterke PHP/Symfony-ervaring
  • Je hebt lead-ervaring (formeel of informeel)
  • Je houdt van bouw- en verbetervraagstukken en bent geen “only feature builder”


🏠 Werken & flexibiliteit

Je werkt hybride, met een gezonde mix tussen thuiswerken en samenwerken op kantoor.


💰 Wat je krijgt

  • Salaris tot €85.000 per jaar
  • Pensioenregeling
  • Reiskosten- en thuiswerkvergoeding


Interesse?

Herken jij jezelf in deze rol en wil je impact maken op een complex, schaalbaar platform? Reageer direct op deze vacature of neem contact op met Tim Rijnaarts via t.rijnaarts@altrum.nl. We vertellen je graag meer!


(Sluit je cv nou niet perfect aan maar is je interesse wel gewekt, dan denken we graag mee in de mogelijkheden)

title: Senior Backend Developer (PHP)
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

3 reasons you should join our team

  • You will work on systems that cannot go down. You design and maintain a high-availability platform that processes millions of secure transactions every day around the globe
  • You will go deep on backend craft. From creating and optimising microservices to levelling up database performance, you help build a backend known for accuracy, security, and long-term reliability
  • You will join a sharp and friendly engineering team. You collaborate with more than 30 experienced engineers, ship in agile teams, share knowledge, and solve complex payment challenges that actually matter

Our offices are located in Delft, near Rotterdam. If you do not know Delft yet, it is one of the most loved cities among engineers, with beautiful canal-lined streets, good beers, a strong tech vibe, reasonable housing prices, a walkable centre that keeps life easy, and public transport that gets you anywhere fast.

Build the backbone of global e-commerce

What started as five people, a small office, and some orange nerf guns has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs. With 150+ colleagues, offices in Delft, Berlin, and London, and Worldline as our partner, we’ve got the perfect mix: the power of a global leader with the energy of a scale-up. At OPP, we build the technology that powers the next generation of e-commerce. From eBay Kleinanzeigen to IKEA, millions of users rely on our systems every day. We don’t just process payments, we enable platforms to accept, hold, and disburse funds securely. 24/7.

As Senior Backend Developer, you contribute both strategically and hands-on. You work on the core of our platform: strengthening critical services, introducing cleaner architectures, and preparing our systems for new payment flows across Europe. You help us make smart choices about performance, reliability, and security, and you are comfortable dealing with the real-world complexity that comes with scale. With traffic rising across all regions, you help us stay fast and reliable under pressure and you guide teammates through complex engineering trade-offs. You do all this as part of one of our four agile Scrum teams focused on in-platform payments, onboarding, and core product innovation. You work with developers who know payments inside out and who tend to stay, because the work is meaningful and the team is strong. Our tech office sits in the city centre of Delft, a dedicated dev-only space for deep work with plenty of places nearby to grab a coffee or clear your head.

Some of the projects you’ll be part of

  • Build new in-platform payment flows that move money in ways traditional e-commerce never had to.
  • Level up onboarding and compliance, making it faster for users and stricter where it counts.
  • Break big systems into clean microservices that stay fast when traffic hits across Europe and the UK.
  • Create the APIs and tools platforms need to grow without waiting on us.

Our tech stack

PHP, Laravel, Symfony, MySQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD.

Job requirements

Your track record tells us

  • You have deep experience with PHP and MySQL and know how to build stable, well-performing systems.
  • You can build and ship at a senior level in Laravel or Symfony.
  • You have worked on high-traffic platforms or microservice architectures.
  • CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, caching, queues, optimization, scalability, and performance tuning are part of your everyday toolkit. If you have experience with Redis or scalable microservices, even better.
  • You can communicate complex technical topics clearly, also to people outside engineering.
  • You are currently based in the Netherlands.

How We Invest In You

Here you get the space to do serious engineering work, the trust to make technical decisions, and a team that values building things properly. You work in an environment that is stable, focused, and set up for deep work. We also offer:

  • All-in salary up to € 95.000 a year
  • Hybrid working in a modern, flexible environment
  • 24 + 2 paid vacation days
  • One-year contract with the intent to extend indefinitely
  • Home office setup, Macbook and an NS Business Card
  • Access to a bike plan if you work 24 hours per week or more
  • A developers-only office in the centre of Delft, built for focus and surrounded by good coffee
  • Catered lunches and regular team drinks in a relaxed, social atmosphere

From contact to contract

Want to know more about our projects?

Let’s talk! We’ll tell you everything you need to know. Send your CV or get in touch with our tech recruiter Julia at julia.vanbaren@onlinepaymentplatform.com or +31 6 48419011.

title: Senior Python Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at Fashion Cloud we are transforming the fashion industry and supporting our customers through our solid base of software products. We are seeking a software engineer to help us grow and maintain our web platform.

About The Job

Join our Replenishment team as a Senior Python Developer, where you’ll play a key role in shaping one of our most in-demand products. Working in two-week sprints, you’ll contribute to everything from feature development to system design, with plenty of room for autonomy, ownership, and impact.

  • Feature development: Build end-to-end features that directly impact thousands of users.
  • Tech stack: Work with Python, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and CubeJS.
  • Cloud-first mindset: Design and maintain scalable services in AWS, using service-oriented and event-driven architecture.
  • System design & architecture: Help shape new services, ensuring our platform stays robust, flexible, and ready for growth.

About You

You’re an experienced backend engineer who enjoys building reliable systems at scale. With 5+ years of hands-on experience, you’re fluent in Python and confident working with large datasets. Ideally, you’ve already taken on senior responsibilities and are ready to bring that experience into a collaborative, product-focused environment.

We think you’ll be a great fit if you bring:

  • Strong proficiency in Python (Django, Flask, or FastAPI experience welcome)
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cube, and ClickHouse
  • Solid AWS knowledge, including services like S3, ECS, Lambda, EC2, and RDS
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or similar)
  • A track record of designing and implementing scalable, fault-tolerant architectures
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on building clean, maintainable solutions
  • A proactive, structured approach and an interest in data pipelines and data management challenges

You value thoughtful communication, welcome feedback, and enjoy working in teams that challenge and support each other to grow.

About The Team

You’ll be part of our Replenishment team, responsible for the Order and Smart Replenishment services. The team is currently eight engineers strong, supported by a product manager and product designer. We use Angular and Node for user-facing applications and Python for the backend.

Collaboration is at the heart of how we work - both within the team and with other product teams across the company. Expect plenty of opportunities to connect, share ideas, and build solutions together.

What’s in it for you?

  • Amsterdam-based role with 20 Days Remote Working Program
  • A great office - we stick to a hybrid work model (minimum 2 days per week working at the office) and enjoy flexibility between working face to face with the colleagues at the office and opportunity to work from home
  • Laptop and equipment provided (e.g. MacBook)
  • Regular team activities - Christmas party, Trivia nights and even trips abroad to celebrate success together!
  • Health is wealth - Sports membership discount + mental health support by nilo.health
  • Continuous education - 1000€ yearly development budget, books and free online tutorials from Pluralsight
  • Sabbatical option - one month for 3 years of Fashion Cloud and 3 months if you’ve been with us for 5 year

Not your dream job?

Then take a look at our other vacancies here - maybe there is something suitable for you.

And if you still have questions, have a look at our FAQs for applicants where you'll find answers to many of your questions regarding your application at Fashion Cloud.

By the way, your application will be processed under our Applicant Privacy Policy.
descriptionText: Here at Fashion Cloud we are transforming the fashion industry and supporting our customers through our solid base of software products. We are seeking a software engineer to help us grow and maintain our web platform.About The JobJoin our Replenishment team as a Senior Python Developer, where you’ll play a key role in shaping one of our most in-demand products. Working in two-week sprints, you’ll contribute to everything from feature development to system design, with plenty of room for autonomy, ownership, and impact.Feature development: Build end-to-end features that directly impact thousands of users.Tech stack: Work with Python, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and CubeJS.Cloud-first mindset: Design and maintain scalable services in AWS, using service-oriented and event-driven architecture.System design & architecture: Help shape new services, ensuring our platform stays robust, flexible, and ready for growth.About YouYou’re an experienced backend engineer who enjoys building reliable systems at scale. With 5+ years of hands-on experience, you’re fluent in Python and confident working with large datasets. Ideally, you’ve already taken on senior responsibilities and are ready to bring that experience into a collaborative, product-focused environment.We think you’ll be a great fit if you bring:Strong proficiency in Python (Django, Flask, or FastAPI experience welcome)Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cube, and ClickHouseSolid AWS knowledge, including services like S3, ECS, Lambda, EC2, and RDSFamiliarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or similar)A track record of designing and implementing scalable, fault-tolerant architecturesStrong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on building clean, maintainable solutionsA proactive, structured approach and an interest in data pipelines and data management challengesYou value thoughtful communication, welcome feedback, and enjoy working in teams that challenge and support each other to grow.About The TeamYou’ll be part of our Replenishment team, responsible for the Order and Smart Replenishment services. The team is currently eight engineers strong, supported by a product manager and product designer. We use Angular and Node for user-facing applications and Python for the backend.Collaboration is at the heart of how we work - both within the team and with other product teams across the company. Expect plenty of opportunities to connect, share ideas, and build solutions together.What’s in it for you?Amsterdam-based role with 20 Days Remote Working ProgramA great office - we stick to a hybrid work model (minimum 2 days per week working at the office) and enjoy flexibility between working face to face with the colleagues at the office and opportunity to work from homeLaptop and equipment provided (e.g. MacBook)Regular team activities - Christmas party, Trivia nights and even trips abroad to celebrate success together!Health is wealth - Sports membership discount + mental health support by nilo.healthContinuous education - 1000€ yearly development budget, books and free online tutorials from PluralsightSabbatical option - one month for 3 years of Fashion Cloud and 3 months if you’ve been with us for 5 yearNot your dream job?Then take a look at our other vacancies here - maybe there is something suitable for you.And if you still have questions, have a look at our FAQs for applicants where you'll find answers to many of your questions regarding your application at Fashion Cloud.By the way, your application will be processed under our Applicant Privacy Policy.
companyDescription:
Fashion Cloud is Europe's leading B2B platform that connects over 30,000 retailers (40,000 POS) with 700 brands from 126 countries. As an all-in-one solution, Fashion Cloud offers a convenient way to exchange marketing materials and product data as well as order digitally via a central platform. 

More than 100 employees work on the success of the company at its two locations in Hamburg and Amsterdam.

Check out our homepage www.fashion.cloud for information on our products, company, career opportunities and more.

title: Full stack-ontwikkelaar
descriptionHtml:
Wie zijn wij

Bij Intramed bouwen ze samen aan betere zorg! Hun slimme software voor paramedische zorgverleners zet zich in om zorgverleners te kunnen ontzorgen. Zij bieden een volledige EPD (Elektronisch Patiënten Dossier). Hiermee hebben zorgverleners binnen de paramedische wereld meer tijd voor het verlenen van zorg, want dat is waar het écht om draait!

Met meer dan 4.000 klanten, ruim 16.000 gebruikers en 85 bevlogen medewerkers bouwen ze samen aan het succes van ons EPD en onze organisatie. Dit doen ze samen, als één team. Daarnaast is er veel aandacht voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en word je hierin ondersteund. Dus doe jij mee?


Jij maakt het mogelijk als Full-Stack Developer

Als Full-Stack Developer neem je eigenaarschap voor het product en technische uitdagingen. Samen met je teamleden en Product Owner kom je tot nieuwe ideeën om het product nog beter te maken. Naast onderhoud en nieuwe functionaliteiten binnen de bestaande Intramed applicatie, breng je ervaring op front-end ontwikkelingen met de nieuwste technieken. Hierdoor draag je je steentje bij aan onze toekomstgerichte oplossing Intramed Web gebaseerd op React en GraphQL. Kwaliteit zit in je DNA gebakken en zaken als unittesten en SonarQube zijn geen onbekenden voor je.


Daarnaast vind je het leuk om:

  • oplossingen te maken die de zorg echt verder helpen;
  • mee te denken met complexe vraagstukken samen je team en product owner;
  • te werken aan de toekomst van Intramed (React / GraphQL) en daarnaast aan ons huidig product (Delphi) te werken;
  • technische richting te geven aan onze architectuur gezamenlijk met je mede teamleden en onze lead developer;
  • als full-stack developer bezig te zijn inclusief korte lijnen naar het infra-team.


Dit ben jij

Als developer ben jij een onmisbaar deel van het team, dat elke dag actief bezig is de zorg een beetje beter te maken. Wil jij die cruciale schakel zijn?


Dan helpt het als je:

  • hbo werk- en denkniveau hebt op het gebied van informatica of iets soortgelijk;
  • je Nederlandstalig bent en je jezelf in het Engels zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed kunt uitdrukken;
  • je een medior of senior Typescript/Javascript (React) developer bent;
  • je ervaring hebt met Scrum/Agile werken;
  • je minimaal 32 uur beschikbaar bent, waarbij 40 uur de voorkeur heeft;
  • je ervaring hebt met het GraphQL;
  • je gemakkelijk en graag kennis en informatie deelt met anderen.


Wat je van Intramed kunt verwachten

Naast een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamisch en vooruitstrevende en informele organisatie vinden ze eigen inbreng en zelfontplooiing erg belangrijk.


Daarnaast krijg je de volgende zaken:

  • een goede werk/privé balans; met ruimte voor thuiswerken, 28 vakantie dagen, een sabbatical regeling (na 5 jaar dienstverband krijg je 5 extra weken betaald verlof om even tijd te maken voor iets anders);
  • een goed marktconform salaris (Het salaris zal worden bepaald op basis van ervaring);
  • een uitgebreid pakket aan secundaire voorwaarden met o.a. dertiende maand, een goede pensioenregeling, een winsttoeslag, een thuiswerkvergoeding, opleidingsmogelijkheden en als je op kantoor werkt een geweldige lunch!
  • leuke collega’s die er naar uit kijken om jou welkom te heten in het team.

title: Fullstack .NET Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Bij Welk Bedrijf Je Gaat Werken

  • Wil jij het verschil maken als ontwikkelaar van EPD-software?
  • Ben jij een .NET Software Engineer met ambitie?
  • Heb jij ervaring in fullstack webontwikkeling en bugfixing?

Vaste baan: .NET Software Engineer | €4.000 - €5.500

Wij ontwikkelen gebruiksvriendelijke online EPD-webapplicaties.

We optimaliseren software voor zorgprofessionals door slimme features.

Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid in een informeel team.

Welke Taken Horen Bij Een .NET Software Engineer WebApps

  • Bouw mee aan diverse webapplicaties
  • Los complexe .NET bugs op
  • Voer updates uit voor software producten
  • Werk zowel back-end als front-end
  • Wees de vraagbaak voor collega's als .NET Software Engineer

Dit Ben Jij

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau vereist
  • Ervaring met .NET Framework en Core
  • Kennis van JavaScript, JQuery, CSS3
  • Ervaring met SQL, Angular, Entity Framework
  • Bekend met SVN, API Design, DevExpress

Wat maakt werken bij deze werkgever zo leuk?:

  • Brutosalaris van €4.000 - €5.500 per maand per maand (40u)
  • Fulltime vast dienstverband van 40 uur per week
  • Opleidingsbudget €500, 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld

  • Informele werksfeer, korte lijnen en hands-on mentaliteit

Solliciteer Binnen Enkele Muisklikken

Naast de genoemde termen kom je in dit vak meer tegen. Denk aan Softwareontwikkelaar, Coder of Programmeur.

Voor deze vacature is in de buurt wonen handig. Wij zitten in Dordrecht, dus als jij in Zwijndrecht, Papendrecht, Sliedrecht, Barendrecht of Ridderkerk woont dan is dat gunstig.

title: Senior Python Full Stack Developer - Django & FastAPI
descriptionHtml:
Over de functie

Voor een toonaangevende organisatie in Amsterdam zijn wij op zoek naar een Senior Python Full Stack Developer met uitgebreide expertise in Django en FastAPI frameworks. Je ontwerpt en ontwikkelt robust, scalable applications en APIs, waarbij je werkt aan API integrations, data processing en cloud-based deployments met moderne frameworks en DevOps practices.

Functiegegevens

  • Vacaturenummer: 10466065
  • Functietitel: Senior Python Full Stack Developer - Django & FastAPI
  • Standplaats: Amsterdam, Nederland (volledig onsite)
  • Startdatum: 02-01-2026
  • Duur: 5 maanden, met optie tot verlenging
  • Dienstverband: Loondienst of ZZP
  • Opleidingsniveau: HBO
  • Taal: Engels (Nederlands niet vereist)
  • Status: Open

Jouw Rol

Als Senior Python Full Stack Developer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van high-performing, scalable web applications en microservices. Je werkt met modern Python frameworks (Django, FastAPI) om RESTful APIs te bouwen, implementeert CI/CD pipelines voor seamless deployment, en zorgt voor API robustness, scalability en security compliance. Je speelt een key technical role in het development team, waarbij je bijdraagt aan architectural decisions, code quality standards, en mentoring van junior developers.

Wat bieden wij vanuit ITproposal B.V.

Must-have Kwalificaties

Python Expertise

  • 8-10 jaar professional experience in Python development
  • Strong proficiency in Core Python development
  • Expert knowledge van Python 3.7+ en modern Python features
  • Understanding van object-oriented programming en design patterns

Framework Experience

  • Hands-on experience met Django framework
  • Proficiency in FastAPI for modern API development
  • Experience met Django REST Framework
  • Understanding van asynchronous programming in Python

API Development

  • Extensive experience in API development en RESTful services
  • Designing en implementing scalable APIs
  • Experience met microservices architecture
  • Knowledge van API security, authentication en best practices

Azure DevOps & CI/CD

  • Knowledge of Azure DevOps for CI/CD and deployment automation
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines in Azure
  • Hands-on met Azure Pipelines en YAML configurations
  • Understanding van continuous integration/continuous delivery workflows

Database Skills

  • Expertise in SQL and database integration
  • Experience met PostgreSQL, MySQL databases
  • Query optimization en database performance tuning
  • Knowledge van ORM frameworks (Django ORM, SQLAlchemy)

Version Control

  • Familiarity with Git for version control
  • Experience met branching strategies en collaborative workflows
  • Understanding van pull requests, code reviews process

Data Processing

  • Experience in data processing workflows en transformations
  • Experience met API integration en external data sources
  • Knowledge van Python libraries (Pandas, NumPy) voor data manipulation

Code Quality & Testing

  • Writing unit tests en maintaining high test coverage
  • Implementing automated testing in CI/CD pipelines
  • Developing reusable, maintainable code
  • Code quality mindset met focus on scalability and extensibility

Nice-to-have (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
  • Understanding of containerization (Docker/Kubernetes)
  • External certifications in Python or Azure technologies
  • Experience met Azure App Service, Azure Functions
  • Knowledge van message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Redis Streams)
  • Familiarity met GraphQL implementations
  • Experience met WebSockets voor real-time applicationsWat bieden wij vanuit ITProposal B.V.
  • Modern tech stack: Werk met cutting-edge Python frameworks (Django, FastAPI)
  • Cloud-native development: Azure-based infrastructure en DevOps practices
  • API-first architecture: Build scalable microservices en RESTful APIs
  • CI/CD automation: Implement modern deployment pipelines met Azure DevOps
  • Technical impact: Design en build production-grade applications
  • Innovation: Werk met asynchronous programming en high-performance frameworks
  • Amsterdam locatie: Volledig onsite werken in Amsterdam
  • Mogelijkheid tot verlenging na initiële periode van 5 maanden
  • Flexibel dienstverband: Beschikbaar als ZZP-opdracht of loondienst
  • Professional growth: Werken met moderne Python ecosysteem en cloud technologies

Technische Stack

Programming: Python 3.7+, Core Python

Web Frameworks: Django, FastAPI, Django REST Framework

API Development: RESTful APIs, Microservices, Asynchronous APIs

Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB (optional)

CI/CD: Azure DevOps, Azure Pipelines, YAML Pipelines

Cloud: Microsoft Azure (App Service, Functions, preferred)

Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes (optional)

Version Control: Git, GitHub, Bitbucket

Data Libraries: Pandas, NumPy (optional)

Testing: Pytest, Unittest, Integration Testing

API Documentation: Swagger/OpenAPI, ReDoc

Additional Tools: Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, Uvicorn, Celery (optional)

Over ITProposal B.V.

ITProposal is een toonaangevend IT-dienstverlener gespecialiseerd in het leveren van hoogwaardige IT-professionals voor complexe Python development opdrachten. Wij zijn NEN4400-1 gecertificeerd en voldoen aan de hoogste normen op het gebied van arbeidsomstandigheden en compliance. Met onze ISO 9001 en ISO 14001 certificeringen garanderen wij kwaliteit en duurzaamheid in al onze diensten.

Interesse?

Herken jij jezelf in dit profiel en ben je klaar voor een nieuwe uitdaging? Stuur dan je CV en motivatie naar info@itproposal.nl. Voor vragen kun je contact opnemen via +31 (0)20 241 0280. We kijken ernaar uit om van je te horen!

  • Understanding van Agile/Scrum methodologies

title: Webdeveloper bij organisatie in de uitvaartbranche
descriptionHtml:
Werken als Webdeveloper een organisatie in de uitvaartbranche (hoofdkantoor Amsterdam)

Ben jij een code-koning(in) met gevoel voor stijl én weet je hoe je clicks omzet in conversies? Snap jij zowel front-end als back-end én raak je niet in paniek van Google Ads? Lees dan verder en ontdek of deze functie jouw volgende stap is!


Werken bij een uitvaartorganisatie in Amsterdam

Deze uitvaartorganisatie is allesbehalve standaard. Hier staat persoonlijke aandacht voorop – niet alleen richting families in rouw, maar ook intern. Je werkt in een warme, professionele organisatie waar respect en kwaliteit altijd leidend zijn. Binnen het team krijg jij alle ruimte om met jouw digitale skills écht impact te maken. Of je nou iets optimaliseert op de website of een Ads-campagne draait: jouw werk helpt mensen verder in een belangrijke fase van hun leven.


Bij deze uitvaartorganisatie heerst een sfeer waarin alle collega's dit begrijpen en met deze energie elke dag weer aan het werk gaan. Je krijgt veel zelfstandigheid in je baan en een zeer hecht team waarin het groepsgevoel altijd voelbaar is. Altijd is er de mogelijkheid om met je collega's te sparren. De goede sfeer en hechte band binnen het team is terug te zien in hoe lang mensen blijven werken bij deze uitvaartorganisatie.


Wat ga je doen als Webdeveloper?

Als webdeveloper ben je verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen, onderhouden én verbeteren van de digitale omgeving. Je combineert technische skills met marketingkennis en zorgt ervoor dat alles digitaal klopt én converteert.


Dit zullen je taken zijn:

  • Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt de website, zowel front- als back-end;
  • Je zorgt voor een fijne UX/UI en past SEO-technieken toe;
  • Je koppelt externe systemen en zorgt voor soepele integraties;
  • Je zet campagnes op via Google Ads en analyseert de resultaten;
  • Je houdt je veel bezig met marketing om de online impact te vergroten.


Dit heb jij in huis

Jij bent zelfstandig, creatief en technisch sterk. En je weet dat jouw werk pas echt telt als het ook gebruiksvriendelijk én vindbaar is.


Daarnaast ben jij:

  • Een webdeveloper met minimaal 3 jaar ervaring en hbo-werk- en denkniveau;
  • Bekend met CMS- en websitebouwplatformen (zoals WordPress, Webflow of vergelijkbaar) en heb je kennis van HTML, CSS en JavaScript.
  • Bekend met Google Ads en je weet hoe je met slimme SEO de juiste doelgroep bereikt.


Dit biedt de organisatie

Jij kan per direct aan de slag als Webdeveloper bij deze uitvaartorganisatie voor minimaal 32 uur per week. Je krijgt een bruto maandsalaris tussen de €2.947 en €4.122 (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van je ervaring. Daarnaast krijg je goede secundaire voorwaarden zoals een pensioenregeling, opleidingsbudget en reiskostenvergoeding. Je werkt in een hecht team dat niet alleen professioneel is, maar ook openstaat voor jouw ideeën en initiatieven.


Zie jij jezelf al werken als Webdeveloper? Solliciteer direct!

Via de 'eenvoudig solliciteren' knop op deze pagina! Mocht je nog aanvullende vragen hebben, dan kan je natuurlijk altijd even contact opnemen met Britt!


Bij Career Pilots kijken wij verder dan jouw cv, wat ook inhoudt dat wij alle kandidaten die op deze vacature solliciteren gelijk behandelen zoals beschreven in ons antidiscriminatiebeleid. Ben jij een kandidaat met afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt? Niet bij ons! We moedigen je aan om altijd te solliciteren, zodat we in gesprek kunnen over alle mogelijkheden.

title: Senior Python Full Stack Developer - Django & FastAPI & Kafka
descriptionHtml:
Over de functie

Voor een toonaangevende organisatie in Amsterdam zijn wij op zoek naar een Senior Python Full Stack Developer met uitgebreide expertise in Django, FastAPI en Kafka. Je ontwerpt en ontwikkelt robust, scalable applications en APIs, waarbij je werkt aan API integrations, data processing, streaming architectures en cloud-based deployments met moderne frameworks en DevOps practices.

Functiegegevens

  • Vacaturenummer: 10469410
  • Functietitel: Senior Python Full Stack Developer - Django & FastAPI & Kafka
  • Standplaats: Amsterdam, Nederland (volledig onsite)
  • Startdatum: 03-01-2026
  • Duur: 5 maanden, met optie tot verlenging
  • Dienstverband: Loondienst of ZZP
  • Opleidingsniveau: HBO
  • Taal: Engels (Nederlands niet vereist)
  • Status: Open

Jouw Rol

Als Senior Python Full Stack Developer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van high-performing, scalable web applications, microservices en event-driven architectures. Je werkt met modern Python frameworks (Django, FastAPI) om RESTful APIs te bouwen, implementeert Kafka voor real-time data streaming, configureert CI/CD pipelines voor seamless deployment, en zorgt voor API robustness, scalability en security compliance. Je speelt een key technical role in het development team, waarbij je bijdraagt aan architectural decisions, code quality standards, en mentoring van junior developers.

Wat breng jij als Senior Python Full Stack Developer - Django & FastAPI & Kafka

Must-have Kwalificaties

Python Expertise

  • 8-10 jaar professioneel experience in Python development
  • Strong proficiency in Core Python development
  • Expert knowledge van Python 3.7+ en modern Python features
  • Understanding van object-oriented programming en design patterns

Framework Experience

  • Hands-on experience met Django framework
  • Proficiency in FastAPI for modern API development
  • Experience met Django REST Framework
  • Understanding van asynchronous programming in Python

API Development

  • Extensive experience in API development en RESTful services
  • Designing en implementing scalable APIs
  • Experience met microservices architecture
  • Knowledge van API security, authentication en best practices

Kafka & Event-Driven Architecture

  • Hands-on experience met Apache Kafka for real-time data streaming
  • Building event-driven architectures en message processing
  • Understanding van Kafka producers, consumers en topics
  • Experience met streaming data pipelines

Azure DevOps & CI/CD

  • Knowledge of Azure DevOps for CI/CD and deployment automation
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines in Azure
  • Hands-on met Azure Pipelines en YAML configurations
  • Understanding van continuous integration/continuous delivery workflows

Database Skills

  • Expertise in SQL and database integration
  • Experience met PostgreSQL, MySQL databases
  • Query optimization en database performance tuning
  • Knowledge van ORM frameworks (Django ORM, SQLAlchemy)
  • Experience met non-relational databases (MongoDB, Redis)

Version Control

  • Familiarity with Git for version control
  • Experience met branching strategies en collaborative workflows
  • Understanding van pull requests, code reviews process

Data Processing

  • Experience in data processing workflows en transformations
  • Handling structured and unstructured data ingestion
  • Experience met API integration en external data sources
  • Knowledge van Python libraries (Pandas, NumPy) voor data manipulation

Code Quality & Testing

  • Writing unit tests en maintaining high test coverage
  • Implementing test-driven development practices
  • Experience met pytest, unittest frameworks
  • Understanding van code quality tools en linting

Nice-to-have Kwalificaties

  • Experience met container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)
  • Familiarity with frontend technologies (React, Vue.js)
  • Understanding van Agile/Scrum methodologies
  • Experience met monitoring and logging tools (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana)
  • Knowledge of security best practices en secure coding
  • Contributions to open-source projects

Wat bieden wij vanuit ITproposal B.V.

Wat bieden wij vanuit ITproposal B.V.

ITproposal B.V. is een gerenommeerde IT managed services provider die hoogwaardige IT-professionals levert aan toonaangevende organisaties. Wij zijn gecertificeerd volgens NEN4400-1, ISO 9001 en ISO 14001, wat onze toewijding aan kwaliteit en duurzaamheid bevestigt.

Wat Wij Bieden

  • Uitdagende projecten bij vooraanstaande Nederlandse en internationale organisaties
  • Moderne technologie stack met Django, FastAPI, Kafka en Azure DevOps
  • Aantrekkelijk arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket - deze vacature kan je in loondienst en of als zzper in dienst gaan
  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling
  • Professionele werkomgeving met ervaren collega's
  • Flexibiliteit in werk-privébalans
  • Investering in certificeringen en trainingen
  • Direct contact met opdrachtgevers
  • Moderne kantoorlocatie in Amsterdam

Waarom kiezen voor ITproposal B.V.?

Bij ITproposal B.V. werk je aan complexe en uitdagende projecten waarbij je jouw Python, Django, FastAPI en Kafka expertise volledig kunt inzetten. Je wordt onderdeel van een dynamische organisatie die waarde hecht aan innovatie, kwaliteit en professionaliteit. Wij bieden een omgeving waarin je kunt groeien en jezelf kunt ontwikkelen terwijl je werkt met de nieuwste technologieën en best practices.

Onze certificeringen (NEN4400-1, ISO 9001, ISO 14001) garanderen dat wij werken volgens de hoogste kwaliteits- en duurzaamheidsnormen. Als Senior Python Full Stack Developer krijg je de ruimte om architecturale beslissingen te nemen en een belangrijke rol te spelen in het ontwikkelingsteam.

Reageer nu!

Ben je een ervaren Python Full Stack Developer met expertise in Django, FastAPI en Kafka die op zoek is naar een nieuwe uitdaging? Solliciteer dan direct via onze website of neem contact met ons op voor meer informatie over deze vacature.

ITproposal B.V. - Your Technology Partner

Wij kijken ernaar uit om jouw sollicitatie te ontvangen!

title: Dev Ops Engineer - Fullstack/AI
descriptionHtml:
This Is What We Offer You

  • Salary: Gross monthly salary between EUR 4,931 and EUR 7,043 (scale 09).
  • Extras: a thirteenth month, 8% holiday allowance, and a 10% Employee Benefit Budget.
  • Development budget: EUR 1,400 development budget per year for your growth and development.
  • Hybrid working: a balance between home and office work (possible for most roles).
  • Pension: decide for yourself the amount of your personal contribution.

Or view all our benefits.

Our Tech4Dev Area is growing fast to meet the demand for next-generation AI solutions. As a bank, our customers expect us to stay ahead - and we’re committed to leading the way. That’s why we’re looking for engineers who combine technical excellence with adaptability, collaboration and a strong sense of ownership. These qualities are key to making our cultural shift real and impactful. We’re recruiting the next wave of GenAI changemakers.

You & you role

We are looking for tenacious engineers - passionate about software engineering, craftsmanship and relentless in their pursuit of impact. You finish what you start, thrive in ambiguity, adapt when priorities shift and persist through technical complexity. Your work will directly influence how millions of customers experience AI-driven banking.

Your mindset matters

Are you an entrepreneurial thinker whose ideas deserve to be heard? In our Area, leadership actively drives innovation and removes roadblocks so you can focus on what matters. We’ve got your back.

What Makes This Role Special

  • Work in a culture that values initiative, grit and impact.
  • Freedom to experiment, learn and grow- with full leadership support.
  • A healthy work-life balance because sustainable performance matters.
  • We value curiosity, resilience and the ability to learn fast.

A word of caution

We’re not just looking for GenAI enthusiasts - we’re looking for exceptional full stack engineers. People who aim for excellence, thrive on solving tough challenges and know how to build from first principles. If your coding journey started before the rise of GenAI, you’ll feel right at home. We value engineers who understand the fundamentals, who can build & beyond.

Practical examples

  • You are part of an empowered self-performing team. Your voice is heard and you contribute directly to the product, or service, your squad is responsible for.
  • Design and build responsible and cost effective GenAI solutions for up to 9,5 million Rabobank customers.
  • Convert a use-case specific code base to re-usable building blocks used by 100+ tech teams.
  • Pair-program with members of your squad and across other Squads within Rabobank to solve critical or complex problems.

Facts & figures

  • 36 or 40 hours per week.
  • Mostly greenfield, very little legacy work.
  • Approx. 43,822 Rabobank colleagues around the world.

Top Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the design and implementation of GenAI solutions, leveraging Azure services such as Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Databricks, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Functions, and others.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Terraform, and Bicep to automate deployment and cloud infrastructure provisioning.
  • Build and maintain Python-based microservices and automation tools to streamline GenAI workflows and manage infrastructure.
  • Integrate and manage GenAI products to support complex multi-step workflows and decision-making processes.
  • Ensure performance, reliability, and security of GenAI workloads in cloud-native environments.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Work closely with Data Scientists, Solution Architects, Product Owners, and Engineers to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Participate in the development of robust and scalable AI workflows including prompt chaining, memory management, and agent orchestration.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly within cross-functional teams.
  • Support integration of GenAI capabilities into existing platforms and services.

Growth & Contribution

  • Continuously improve engineering practices and contribute to team knowledge sharing.
  • Stay up to date with emerging GenAI technologies and cloud-native patterns.
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and sprint planning.

The Tech4Dev team designs and builds next-generation AI solutions for Rabobank customers worldwide. Collaboration is our approach; as one focused, data-minded team within Rabobank, we drive innovation and deliver impact.

Work on yourself and the world around you at the same time

At Rabobank, your development and that of society go hand in hand. That’s why we invest in you and work together for a better world. In short: at Rabobank, you work on yourself and the world around you. This is reflected in your personal development budget, our hybrid work environment, and a healthy work-life balance. You’ll work on banking for our private and business customers, but also on societal issues such as food and energy transitions.

‘Work in a culture that values initiative, grit and impact. Freedom to experiment, learn and grow—with full leadership support. A healthy work-life balance because sustainable performance matters.’ Karina Karapetyan - Solution Architect

Why everyone is welcome at Rabobank

At Rabobank, we believe we become stronger by complementing each other. By embracing our differences, we bring out the best in each other. We seek diversity in knowledge, skills, and experience, as well as in gender, background, and culture. Every department strives for variety and the space to be yourself- whoever you are. That’s what diversity and inclusion at Rabobank is all about.

You & your talent

Technical Ownership

  • Build robust Python-based microservices and automation scripts to support GenAI workflows and infrastructure provisioning.
  • Ensure security, compliance, and performance optimization across GenAI workloads.

Stakeholder Management:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Data Science, Product, and Business to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and influence decision-making.
  • Act as a trusted advisor for GenAI strategy and infrastructure scalability.

Soft Skills & Leadership Qualities

  • You are “relentless” in getting things done, you don’t give up, you adapt and find another way to complete your assignment.
  • Entrepreneurial - Salesmanship mindset – you see valuable opportunities to pitch your ideas to Leadership, and you have the persistence to adapt your pitch even if you are told “no”.
  • Excellent communication skills – able to simplify complex ideas and build trust across teams.
  • Mentorship mindset – passionate about helping the Junior colleagues grow and succeed.

Required Qualifications

  • 2–4 years in technical roles such as DevOps, Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Data Science.
  • Practical experience with cloud platforms - Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP.
  • Proficiency in Python for development, automation and API integration.
  • Hands-on experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for GenAI applications using tools like Azure DevOps, Terraform, Kong and Bicep to automate deployment and cloud infrastructure provisioning.
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and exposure to orchestration tools (Kubernetes).
  • Hands-on experience deploying AI workloads (preferably Generative AI or agentic systems) in development or staging environments.
  • Basic familiarity with Generative AI, including LLM application development frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), and AI workflow orchestration concepts.
  • Understanding of vector databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns at a conceptual level.
  • Awareness of security and monitoring practices for cloud and AI systems.
  • Knowledge of API development and integration; exposure to API gateways is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within Agile teams (SCRUM or Kanban).

Apply

To ensure that we assess all candidates equally for suitability for this position, we do not require a mandatory cover letter. Instead, we ask all candidates the same three questions to see how your profile matches the role. Please pay sufficient attention to answering these questions and explaining your answers. together with your CV, these responses form the basis for our evaluation in this round. Submitting both a CV and answers to the three questions is the minimum requirement to be considered in the selection process. A cover letter is not mandatory but may be submitted optionally.

You may draw on your work experience, volunteer work, education, private life, and so on. Use a maximum of 200 words per question and provide no more than two examples. Below are the questions:

  • Can you share an example of an AI or software engineering project you contributed to? Include the tech stack and how you ensured performance and reliability.
  • Describe a situation where you faced changing priorities or technical complexity. How did you adapt and still deliver impact?
  • How do you make sure your technical ideas are heard in a multidisciplinary team? Give an example of collaborating with non-technical stakeholders to reach a solution.

Please submit these answers in the application section titled 'Add your cover letter (optional)' on the website portal.

You & the application process

  • Any questions about working at Rabobank and the process? Ashley Lumbantobing, IT Recruiter, ashley.lumbantobing@rabobank.nl
  • We will hold the interviews through a video call. If you are selected for an interview, Bo, our virtual assistant, will reach out to you via SMS and email to schedule the interview.
  • You can find answers to the most frequently asked questions on rabobank.jobs/en/faq
  • A screening is part of the process.
  • We respect your privacy.

To be considered for this position, you must be located in the Netherlands and have the legal right to work in the Netherlands. We are unable to consider candidates requiring relocation from another country.

A word of cautionWe’re not just looking for GenAI enthusiasts - we’re looking for exceptional full stack engineers. People who aim for excellence, thrive on solving tough challenges and know how to build from first principles. If your coding journey started before the rise of GenAI, you’ll feel right at home. We value engineers who understand the fundamentals, who can build & beyond.Practical examplesYou are part of an empowered self-performing team. Your voice is heard and you contribute directly to the product, or service, your squad is responsible for. Design and build responsible and cost effective GenAI solutions for up to 9,5 million Rabobank customers. Convert a use-case specific code base to re-usable building blocks used by 100+ tech teams. Pair-program with members of your squad and across other Squads within Rabobank to solve critical or complex problems. Facts & figures36 or 40 hours per week. Mostly greenfield, very little legacy work. Approx. 43,822 Rabobank colleagues around the world. Top ResponsibilitiesContribute to the design and implementation of GenAI solutions, leveraging Azure services such as Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Databricks, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Functions, and others. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Terraform, and Bicep to automate deployment and cloud infrastructure provisioning. Build and maintain Python-based microservices and automation tools to streamline GenAI workflows and manage infrastructure. Integrate and manage GenAI products to support complex multi-step workflows and decision-making processes. Ensure performance, reliability, and security of GenAI workloads in cloud-native environments. Collaboration & DeliveryWork closely with Data Scientists, Solution Architects, Product Owners, and Engineers to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Participate in the development of robust and scalable AI workflows including prompt chaining, memory management, and agent orchestration. Communicate technical concepts clearly within cross-functional teams. Support integration of GenAI capabilities into existing platforms and services. Growth & ContributionContinuously improve engineering practices and contribute to team knowledge sharing. Stay up to date with emerging GenAI technologies and cloud-native patterns. Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and sprint planning. The Tech4Dev team designs and builds next-generation AI solutions for Rabobank customers worldwide. Collaboration is our approach; as one focused, data-minded team within Rabobank, we drive innovation and deliver impact.Work on yourself and the world around you at the same timeAt Rabobank, your development and that of society go hand in hand. That’s why we invest in you and work together for a better world. In short: at Rabobank, you work on yourself and the world around you. This is reflected in your personal development budget, our hybrid work environment, and a healthy work-life balance. You’ll work on banking for our private and business customers, but also on societal issues such as food and energy transitions.‘Work in a culture that values initiative, grit and impact. Freedom to experiment, learn and grow—with full leadership support. A healthy work-life balance because sustainable performance matters.’ Karina Karapetyan - Solution ArchitectWhy everyone is welcome at RabobankAt Rabobank, we believe we become stronger by complementing each other. By embracing our differences, we bring out the best in each other. We seek diversity in knowledge, skills, and experience, as well as in gender, background, and culture. Every department strives for variety and the space to be yourself- whoever you are. That’s what diversity and inclusion at Rabobank is all about.You & your talentTechnical OwnershipBuild robust Python-based microservices and automation scripts to support GenAI workflows and infrastructure provisioning. Ensure security, compliance, and performance optimization across GenAI workloads. Stakeholder Management:Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Data Science, Product, and Business to translate requirements into technical solutions. Communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and influence decision-making. Act as a trusted advisor for GenAI strategy and infrastructure scalability. Soft Skills & Leadership QualitiesYou are “relentless” in getting things done, you don’t give up, you adapt and find another way to complete your assignment. Entrepreneurial - Salesmanship mindset – you see valuable opportunities to pitch your ideas to Leadership, and you have the persistence to adapt your pitch even if you are told “no”. Excellent communication skills – able to simplify complex ideas and build trust across teams. Mentorship mindset – passionate about helping the Junior colleagues grow and succeed. Required Qualifications2–4 years in technical roles such as DevOps, Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Data Science. Practical experience with cloud platforms - Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP. Proficiency in Python for development, automation and API integration. Hands-on experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for GenAI applications using tools like Azure DevOps, Terraform, Kong and Bicep to automate deployment and cloud infrastructure provisioning. Experience with containerization (Docker) and exposure to orchestration tools (Kubernetes). Hands-on experience deploying AI workloads (preferably Generative AI or agentic systems) in development or staging environments. Basic familiarity with Generative AI, including LLM application development frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), and AI workflow orchestration concepts. Understanding of vector databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns at a conceptual level. Awareness of security and monitoring practices for cloud and AI systems. Knowledge of API development and integration; exposure to API gateways is a plus. Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within Agile teams (SCRUM or Kanban). ApplyTo ensure that we assess all candidates equally for suitability for this position, we do not require a mandatory cover letter. Instead, we ask all candidates the same three questions to see how your profile matches the role. Please pay sufficient attention to answering these questions and explaining your answers. together with your CV, these responses form the basis for our evaluation in this round. Submitting both a CV and answers to the three questions is the minimum requirement to be considered in the selection process. A cover letter is not mandatory but may be submitted optionally.You may draw on your work experience, volunteer work, education, private life, and so on. Use a maximum of 200 words per question and provide no more than two examples. Below are the questions:Can you share an example of an AI or software engineering project you contributed to? Include the tech stack and how you ensured performance and reliability. Describe a situation where you faced changing priorities or technical complexity. How did you adapt and still deliver impact? How do you make sure your technical ideas are heard in a multidisciplinary team? Give an example of collaborating with non-technical stakeholders to reach a solution. Please submit these answers in the application section titled 'Add your cover letter (optional)' on the website portal.You & the application processAny questions about working at Rabobank and the process? Ashley Lumbantobing, IT Recruiter, ashley.lumbantobing@rabobank.nl We will hold the interviews through a video call. If you are selected for an interview, Bo, our virtual assistant, will reach out to you via SMS and email to schedule the interview. You can find answers to the most frequently asked questions on rabobank.jobs/en/faq A screening is part of the process. We respect your privacy. To be considered for this position, you must be located in the Netherlands and have the legal right to work in the Netherlands. We are unable to consider candidates requiring relocation from another country.
