companySlogan: We Build Smart Organizations
companyDescription:
We Build Smart Organizations.

- Intelligent Solutions for Sales, Service & Marketing
- Business Processes, AI and Data
- Highest status Salesforce partner

Ready to take your sales, service, and marketing to the next level?

Building a smart organization is more than just implementing technology. It requires a partner that understands the deep connection between your business strategy, your operational processes, and your people.

This business-first understanding is the foundation of our “clicks, not code” philosophy. We focus on configuring the powerful, standard features of Salesforce to solve your core challenges—delivering a solution that is robust, scalable, and easy to maintain.

And for those unique requirements that create a true competitive advantage? That’s when our expert developers build targeted, custom solutions that integrate perfectly.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer OSINT
descriptionHtml:
Dit ga je doen

Voel jij je aangetrokken tot Open Source Intelligence (OSINT)? Beschik je over de kennis, enige ervaring en inspiratie om in een klein team van hardware- en software engineers bij te kunnen dragen aan de ontwikkeling van complexe IT-systemen en tools ter ondersteuning van het OSINT proces? Dan zouden we je willen uitnodigen om te solliciteren.

In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor de volgende werkzaamheden:

  • Je ontwerpt, ontwikkelt (en beheert), voornamelijk in teamverband, software die van betekenis is voor de slagkracht op OSINT van de AIVD;
  • Je verricht verschillende werkzaamheden en draagt bij aan verschillende projecten, voor het verbeteren van OSINT mogelijkheden van de dienst. Hierbij kan je denken aan interne en externe projecten met gebruik van nieuwste technologieën, OSINT tool-beheer en gebruik, tool-ontwikkeling of plug-ins op platforms etc;
  • Je onderhoudt nauw contact met je afnemers om een zo goed mogelijk beeld te krijgen van de behoeften. Dat kunnen Internet Investigators zijn van OSINT, maar ook OSINT experts of behoeftestellers in het Inlichtingenproces. Je werkt samen binnen de dienst met de experts van verschillende afdelingen, en ook extern met software engineers en OSINT specialisten zowel nationaal als internationaal;
  • Je staat open voor feedback en advies van collega’s en voelt je je evenzo vrij om advies en feedback te geven. Door jouw kennis en ervaring draag je bij aan de professionalisering van de afdeling;

Dit krijg je

  • schaal 12 €4.691,71 - €6.907,67 (bruto)
  • Arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op onbepaalde tijd
  • 1 jaar
  • 32 - 36 uur
  • Het salaris is gebaseerd op een volledige werkweek. Daarnaast is aan het werken bij de AIVD een toeslag verbonden. Deze toeslag bedraagt bij indiensttreding € €267,81 en loopt op tot maximaal € €840,03 bruto per maand bij een volledige werkweek.

Dit bieden we nog meer

Naast het salaris ontvang je een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB). Het IKB bestaat uit geld (16,5% van je bruto jaarsalaris) en tijd. Met het IKB maak jij de keuzes die bij jou passen en kun je een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samenstellen. Je kunt er bijvoorbeeld voor kiezen om een deel van je maandinkomen te laten uitbetalen wanneer jij dat wenst. Ook kun je dit budget omzetten in verlof, of verlof juist omzetten in budget. Of je kunt het besteden aan fiscaal vriendelijke doelen, zoals het aflossen van je studieschuld of het aanschaffen van een fiets. De Rijksoverheid hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en loopbaanontwikkeling en biedt daarvoor tal van mogelijkheden. Tot de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden behoren onder meer verschillende studiefaciliteiten, bedrijfsfitness, volledige vergoeding van je OV-reiskosten woon-werkverkeer en gedeeltelijk betaald ouderschapsverlof.

Dit vragen wij

Voor deze functie zoeken we iemand met uitgebreide kennis en ervaring met software design. Daarnaast is het van belang dat je gewend bent aan zowel projectmatig werken als met werken met peer reviews. In deze functie ga je veel samenwerken en afstemmen met collega’s binnen de afdeling, dus we zoeken wel iemand die graag in teamverband werkt.

Daarnaast heb je:

  • WO werk- en denkniveau;
  • Beheersing van OO talen zoals C#, Java, Typescript/Javascript, NodeJS, Python, Go;
  • Kennis van front-end frameworks zoals Angular en/of React;
  • Bekend met (REST) API’s en microservices;
  • Ervaring met interne Cloud Services zoals Kubernetes is een pré;

De AIVD omarmt diversiteit en inclusie en wil graag dat medewerkers zich thuis voelen. Verschillende perspectieven, achtergronden en inzichten zijn een verrijking voor onze organisatie. Bij ons is iedereen die aan de voorwaarden voor een Verklaring van Geen Bezwaar (VGB) voldoet welkom, ongeacht culturele achtergrond, arbeidsvermogen, leeftijd, gender of seksuele voorkeur. Samen werken we aan de veiligheid van Nederland.

Hier kom je te werken

Meer over jouw toekomstige plek in de organisatie

De directie Operatiën voert operationele activiteiten uit voor onderzoeken van de directie Inlichtingen. Het werk omvat diverse taken op het gebied van techniek, advies, beveiliging en cyber.

De afdeling Open source intelligence levert aan alle onderdelen van de AIVD gespecialiseerde diensten voor het vinden van informatie in open, meestal online bronnen. Op basis daarvan kunnen eventueel andere onderzoeksmethoden gericht worden ingezet. De medewerkers leveren daarmee een belangrijke bijdrage aan het vinden van de juiste informatie én aan de veiligheid van Nederland.

Over Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst

De Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (AIVD) beschermt de democratie tegen nationale en internationale dreigingen, zodat we in vrijheid kunnen leven. Als je bij de AIVD werkt ben je verbindend, wendbaar, gewetensvol en moedig. Bij de AIVD doe je werk dat er toe doet: elke minuut van de dag.

We waken, vaak onzichtbaar, over Nederland en zijn bevolking. We doen daarvoor onderzoek in binnen- en buitenland. De AIVD doet wat nodig is om te voorkomen dat staten, organisaties of personen onze rechtsstaat tegenwerken, ondergraven of aanvallen. Ons werk doen we niet alleen. De AIVD heeft zijn eigen rol in het netwerk van overheidsorganisaties die de veiligheid van Nederland beschermen.

De AIVD is onderdeel van het ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties. De taken van de AIVD zijn vastgelegd in de Wet op de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten (Wiv 2017).

Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst

Bijzonderheden

  • Solliciteren? Stuur ons een cv en sollicitatiebrief waaruit duidelijk en onderbouwd je motivatie blijkt om te willen werken bij de AIVD.
  • Na de sluitingsdatum is het niet meer mogelijk om te solliciteren.
  • Je sollicitatie wordt alleen in behandeling genomen wanneer je op de juiste manier, via de daarvoor bestemde sollicitatie-knop reageert. Je uitgebreide motivatie is ingevuld en je cv is bijgesloten.
  • We vragen je om niet met anderen te spreken over je sollicitatie bij de AIVD. Het kan je sollicitatie en eventuele loopbaan bij de AIVD schaden en je veiligheid in gevaar brengen.
  • Om veilig te solliciteren, raden we je sterk aan je online sollicitatie vanuit Nederland te versturen. Verblijf je in het buitenland, wacht dan tot je weer in Nederland bent.
  • Een veiligheidsonderzoek op niveau A, psychologische onderzoeken, het opvragen van referenties en online screening zijn onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure.
  • Om in aanmerking te komen voor een functie bij de AIVD moet je de Nederlandse nationaliteit hebben en (in principe) de afgelopen 10 jaar in Nederland hebben gewoond. Ook aan je eventuele partner en andere mensen in je omgeving worden bepaalde eisen gesteld.
  • Houd er rekening mee dat de selectieprocedure, inclusief het veiligheidsonderzoek, ongeveer 6 maanden in beslag kan nemen.
  • De AIVD gebruikt een digitale manier om te solliciteren. Houd er rekening mee dat het invullen van het sollicitatieformulier mogelijk technische problemen met zich meebrengt. Wacht dus niet tot het laatste moment met solliciteren.

Over de functiegroep Senior Operationeel Specialist WIV /WVO

Door het Functiegebouw Rijk worden medewerkers en leidinggevenden geholpen bij het maken van resultaat- en ontwikkelafspraken in functioneringsgesprekken en krijgt men inzicht in de loopbaanmogelijkheden binnen de Rijksoverheid.

Meer informatie op Functiegebouw Rijksoverheid
descriptionText: Dit ga je doenVoel jij je aangetrokken tot Open Source Intelligence (OSINT)? Beschik je over de kennis, enige ervaring en inspiratie om in een klein team van hardware- en software engineers bij te kunnen dragen aan de ontwikkeling van complexe IT-systemen en tools ter ondersteuning van het OSINT proces? Dan zouden we je willen uitnodigen om te solliciteren.In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor de volgende werkzaamheden: Je ontwerpt, ontwikkelt (en beheert), voornamelijk in teamverband, software die van betekenis is voor de slagkracht op OSINT van de AIVD; Je verricht verschillende werkzaamheden en draagt bij aan verschillende projecten, voor het verbeteren van OSINT mogelijkheden van de dienst. Hierbij kan je denken aan interne en externe projecten met gebruik van nieuwste technologieën, OSINT tool-beheer en gebruik, tool-ontwikkeling of plug-ins op platforms etc; Je onderhoudt nauw contact met je afnemers om een zo goed mogelijk beeld te krijgen van de behoeften. Dat kunnen Internet Investigators zijn van OSINT, maar ook OSINT experts of behoeftestellers in het Inlichtingenproces. Je werkt samen binnen de dienst met de experts van verschillende afdelingen, en ook extern met software engineers en OSINT specialisten zowel nationaal als internationaal; Je staat open voor feedback en advies van collega’s en voelt je je evenzo vrij om advies en feedback te geven. Als je eerst eens kennis wilt maken, dat kan ook. Bijvoorbeeld in de vorm van een rijkstraineeship, financial traineeship, audit traineeship, juridisch (vak)traineeship of stage. Of je nu een doener of meer een denker bent, een adviseur of een ondersteunende kracht. Heb je bijvoorbeeld leidinggevende aspiraties, organisatorisch talent of verdiep je je liever in nieuwe dossiers over onderwijs, kunst of landbouw? Bij de Rijksoverheid kun je alle kanten op.

Full-Stack Data Engineer - APO

  • Eneco - Rotterdam
  • Tech
  • 3-5 years
  • €71.000 - €100.000

Apply

  • Contribute directly to the energy transition by building data platforms that help Eneco achieve its goal of becoming CO₂-neutral by 2035.
  • Collaborate closely with domain experts, and engineers to translate complex operational challenges into practical, data-driven solutions.
  • Build production-ready data solutions that move beyond POCs and optimize real-world heat assets at operational scale.

Why choose Eneco?

At Eneco, we’re driving the energy transition forward with our One Planet plan, with the ambition to become the first CO₂-neutral energy company by 2035. Data plays a crucial role in achieving this goal.

event.target.parentNode.classList.toggle('open'))()">

What you’ll do

As a Full-Stack Data Engineer within the Asset Performance Optimization (APO) team, you will contribute to building and operating reliable data platforms that support heat asset monitoring, optimization, and analytics. You will work closely with senior engineers, product owners, and domain experts to turn data into actionable insights, while growing your technical depth and impact.

event.target.parentNode.classList.toggle('open'))()">

Is this about you?

Is this about you?

  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or Backend Engineer in a data-intensive or operational environment
  • Solid Python skills and familiarity with software engineering best practices
  • Good SQL knowledge and hands-on experience with Snowflake and/or PostgreSQL
  • Experience using Git in a collaborative development environment
  • Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and DevOps tooling (experience with Azure DevOps is a plus)
  • Basic to intermediate experience with Kubernetes and containerized applications
  • Willingness to learn, take ownership of components, and grow toward more complex technical responsibilities
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic environment where not everything is fully defined yet

event.target.parentNode.classList.toggle('open'))()">

You’ll be responsible for

As a Medior Data Engineer, you will actively contribute to the development, maintenance, and improvement of the APO data landscape across several evolving products and platforms. You will support initiatives such as operational monitoring, optimization tooling, and performance analytics for district heating systems and related assets.

Your Responsibilities Include

  • Contributing to improvements in APO data ingestion pipelines and core platform components
  • Supporting the transition of POCs and project-based solutions into stable run-and-maintain environments
  • Implementing and maintaining production-ready data pipelines and backend services
  • Ensuring data products are reliable, observable, and well documented
  • Developing a physics-based calculation model for district heating using asset data and telemetry
  • Upscaling and implementing control algorithms for heat sources and substations
  • Maintaining the asset database supporting business dashboards and asset analysis
  • Collaborating with senior engineers on technical decisions involving Snowflake, Python services, Kubernetes workloads, and database design
  • Actively participating in code reviews and knowledge sharing within the team

You’ll be responsible for

  • Developing and maintaining data pipelines and backend services for APO use cases
  • Working with Snowflake data models and PostgreSQL databases to support analytics and reporting
  • Helping ensure reliability, performance, and observability of Kubernetes-based services
  • Writing clean, maintainable Python code following agreed engineering standards
  • Translating functional requirements into solid technical implementations
  • Documenting solutions and contributing to technical standards and best practices

event.target.parentNode.classList.toggle('open'))()">

This is where you’ll work

You will join Eneco’s Asset Performance Optimization (APO) team, where data and engineering directly support the transition to a CO₂-neutral energy system. In this environment, you’ll collaborate closely with business and technical stakeholders to transform complex operational challenges into scalable, production-ready data platforms. You’ll work on systems that monitor and optimize heat assets in real time, helping evolve APO products from experimental solutions into stable, future-proof operational services — all within a culture that values ownership, technical excellence, and meaningful impact on the energy transition.

What we have to offer

Gross annual salary between €71.000 and €100.000

Including FlexBudget, 8% holiday allowance, and depending on your role a bonus or collective profit sharing.

FlexBudget

Including FlexBudget, 8% holiday allowance, and depending on your role a bonus or collective profit sharing. Have it paid out, use it to buy extra holiday days or save it up for something nice, it's up to you.

Personal and professional growth

Eneco is fully committed to help you in your personal and professional development.

Hybrid working: home, office or abroad

Work 40% at the office, 40% from home, and 20% flexibly. With manager approval, you may work abroad (within approved countries) up to 3 weeks/year, max 2 consecutively.

Want more information about our terms of employment?

Here's What You Get From Us

Work that works for you and the climate

If you decide on a career at Eneco, you are choosing ambition, growth and opportunities. You will have all the space you want to improve yourself and do your job the way that suits you best, which includes having a good work-life balance. You can work to a flexible schedule and work partly from home if your role allows it.

That is how you can work on your own future and on the future of the world. After all, you and your 4,000 colleagues are committed to our mission: climate neutrality by 2035. We assist customers to accelerate their sustainability efforts, devise innovative solutions and seize opportunities with both hands. Are you ready?

The Phases Of Our Application Procedure

Want to know more about this job function?

Questions about the application procedure

Feel Free To Contact Our Recruiter

Venetia de Wit

+31615850813

Send an email

Would you like to receive our newest job vacancies?

With this job opening, we want to recruit a new Eneco colleague ourselves. This is not a call for acquisition.

companyDescription:
Eneco Ventures aims to help the future stars in sustainable energy light up even brighter. We do so by investing in start-ups & scale-ups that accelerate the energy transition. We are a venture capital and growth financing investor backed by Eneco (a leading Dutch utility) and look to work with start-ups and scale-ups throughout Europe. 

At Eneco Ventures, we look for companies providing smart solutions, services and/or software that positively impact the energy transition. These companies typically are at their early growth stage, having shown they are now ready to scale with a business model that can impact the energy transition. We believe in the combination of innovative and ambitious entrepreneurs and Eneco Ventures as devoted strategic investor. As no single party can provide the innovation and acceleration that is needed alone, we can only succeed if we start connecting ambitions, ideas, technologies, people and companies.

With our expertise, extensive network, resources and millions of customers in 5 countries we know how to support startups and accelerate their growth. Are you a start-up or scale-up with a smart concept at the crossroads of renewable energy, mobility or digital? Do you already have commercial traction, but also a desire to grow faster? 

Get in touch with us, please send an email to ventures@eneco.com 
We look forward to meeting you and see how we can work and invest into a sustainable future together!

title: Full stack infra engineer / technisch applicatiebeheerder - Overheid, Zorg en Welzijn
descriptionHtml:
Functiebeschrijving

Ben jij een allround technisch IT-specialist die graag een uitdaging aangaat? Werk je graag in een complexe en omvangrijke IT-omgeving en heb je een "get-things-done" mentaliteit? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Jouw rol in ons team

Met jouw brede kennis en ervaring op het gebied van technisch applicatiebeheer, ben je een waardevolle aanvulling voor ons team. Samen met je collega's ben je verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van Microsoft Exchange (online) omgevingen, Citrix Workspace, en houd je je bezig met mailbox issues, shared mailboxen, mailflows, cloudmigraties en online diensten, Dragon ondersteuning en Proofpoint spamfilter in een omvangrijk landschap. Je voert technische wijzigingen en updates door en beantwoordt vragen en verzoeken van de Servicedesk. Je helpt mee in projecten die de huidige omgeving naar een moderne online en cloud omgeving brengen.

Hoe jij ons team versterkt

Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze IT-systemen stabiel en van hoge kwaliteit blijven, ook als dat soms betekent dat je creatief te werk moet gaan om zaken gedaan te krijgen. Met jouw ervaring en kennis ben je in staat om technische problemen snel te identificeren en op te lossen. Je bent procesgericht maar flexibel genoeg om in een dynamische omgeving te werken.

Dit ben jij:

  • Minimaal een afgeronde relevante MBO-4 opleiding, HBO werk- en denkniveau;
  • Je bent in het bezit van 2 of meerdere vakgerichte basis certificaten
  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in het vakgebied, met name op het gebied van Microsoft Server - 365 producten, Citrix Workspace en Ivanti;
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met Infrastructuur componenten zoals firewalls, switches en storage;
  • Scripting kennis zoals Powershell, Python, Terraform
  • Ervaring met netwerktechnologieën: TCP/IP, SSH, DNS, FTP, Routering, Firewalls, WAF, IDS/IPS, SDN; Forward/Reverse Proxies
  • Je hebt kennis van en/of bent ITIL 3 of hoger gecertificeerd;
  • Ervaring in het gebruik van TOPdesk of soortgelijke tooling is een pré.
  • Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en/of Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Waar kom je terecht (optional)

Je gaat deel uitmaken van een dynamisch en gedreven team dat zich richt op de zorg binnen de rijksoverheid, publieke gezondheid en de GGZ. Als strategisch partner helpen we onze klanten om uitdagingen op het gebied van IT te overwinnen, zoals continuïteit, capaciteit en wendbaarheid.

Ons team werkt samen in multidisciplinaire teams waarin zowel beheerwerk als IT-veranderprojecten worden uitgevoerd. We geloven in de kracht van samenwerking en flexibiliteit, daarom werk je zowel bij de klant op locatie of op afstand vanuit CGI-kantoor of vanuit je eigen huis aan deze doelstellingen. Bij ons krijg je de kans om te groeien in een inspirerende omgeving waar creativiteit en een servicegerichte aanpak centraal staan. Samen zorgen we voor innovatieve oplossingen en dienstverlening die een echte impact maken in de zorgsector. Sluit je aan bij ons team en draag bij aan het verbeteren van de zorg met jouw IT-expertise!

Waarom CGI

CGI is één van 's werelds grootste IT-consultancy bedrijven. Onze mensen houden Nederland draaiende. Overheidsinstellingen, banken, lucht- en ruimtevaart, infrastructurele organisaties en energie-, transport- en productiebedrijven zijn klanten van CGI. We werken aan interessante projecten die het alledaagse leven van miljoenen mensen raken. We zijn regionaal aanwezig, versterkt met wereldwijde domeinkennis, ons ecosysteem en collega's verspreid over de hele wereld.

We zijn trots op de impactvolle projecten die we samen met onze collega’s tot een succes maken.

Bij CGI hechten we veel waarde aan diversiteit en inclusie, omdat dit niet alleen de samenwerking bevordert, maar ook vaak leidt tot betere resultaten. We kijken uit naar jouw bijdrage aan ons team! Werken in kleine zelfsturende teams bestaande uit experts in je vakgebied.

  • De regie over je eigen carrière met daarbij de ruimte om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen.
  • Je werkt met de nieuwste technologieën.
  • Een uitstekend salaris en aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden
  • Direct een vast contract
  • Parttime mogelijkheden
  • En de mogelijkheid om CGI aandeelhouder te worden

Een pre-employment screening maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure.

Sluit je aan bij ons team van experts en solliciteer direct!

We nemen dan zo snel mogelijk contact met je op! Heb je nog vragen over de inhoud van de vacature, stel ze aan Michiel den Boer via michiel.den.boer@cgi.com of +31 6 222 323 03.

Vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure? neem contact op met recruiter Ferhun Dogan via ferhun.dogan@cgi.com of +31611484743

We werken niet samen met externe recruitment bureau’s. Acquisitie wordt daarom niet op prijs gesteld.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Criteria

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

In 1976 opgericht als een familiebedrijf, is CGI vandaag de dag een van de grootste onafhankelijke zakelijke en ICT-dienstverleners ter wereld. Bij ons draait het om ownership, teamwork en respect. Je krijgt de ruimte om al je talenten volledig te ontplooien.

Vanaf je eerste werkdag ben je mede-eigenaar van CGI. We profiteren samen van ons succes en je krijgt de kans én verantwoordelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de koers en strategie van ons bedrijf.

Jouw inzet voegt waarde toe. Je werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen en bouwt aan je netwerk van collega's en klanten. Je hebt toegang tot wereldwijde kansen om je ideeën te realiseren, mogelijkheden te benutten en te profiteren van onze kennis van de industrie en technologische expertise.

Ontdek bij ons de mogelijkheden voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling en zet de volgende stap in je carrière. Hier staat jouw succes centraal!

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer R&D x2
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for two experienced and proactive Senior Fullstack Engineers to join our R&D team at our Studyportals headquarters is in Strijp-S, Eindhoven, the Netherlands. Flexibility to work hybrid from our office in Eindhoven.

About Studyportals.

We change the lives of millions of students and leave the world a bit brighter than we found it. Every minute 100 students around the world trust our platforms (e.g., mastersportal.com) to find their best matching education for free. At the same time, we help educators diversify their (international) student population and reduce dropouts.

With forty different nationalities among the 150 people working at Studyportals, we are an international bunch of people. Eager to learn and serious about fun. Want to know more?

Why are we searching for you?

We want to strengthen our ability to innovate and stay ahead in the era of AI. Studyportals has a strong pipeline of strategic ideas that we’re transforming into tangible experiments and new products.

As part of our new R&D team, you’ll play a key role in exploring emerging technologies, testing bold ideas, and building prototypes that could shape the future of our platforms. Your work helps us discover what truly drives value for students and universities - combining creativity, data, and engineering craftsmanship to turn innovation into impact.

What are your three main goals?

  • Experiment and innovate by exploring new technologies, especially AI, to build and validate early-stage ideas through rapid technical prototyping and data-driven experimentation.
  • Deliver real impact by turning promising concepts into product features that help students discover study opportunities tailored to them, increasing engagement, retention, and overall platform value. You ensure we build high-quality and scalable products.
  • Help us to become more scalable as a platform, by decoupling our dependencies and driving our microservice architecture. Staying in control of quality is key!

What does your team look like?

The Product Engineering department consists of 35 talented engineers and designers, organized into small, autonomous teams. You’ll join a cross-functional R&D team of five, working closely with your Product Owner to explore and develop new ideas that increase user engagement and harness the potential of AI.

As part of this team, you have real influence - from identifying opportunities to designing, building, and validating solutions. The R&D team operates with a strong sense of ownership, focusing on rapid experimentation, technical excellence and scalability, and learning through iteration.

You’ll be supported by experienced technical leadership that ensures you have the freedom, tools, and guidance to innovate, remove roadblocks, and continuously grow as an engineer.

What Tech Stack do we use?

The technology behind Studyportals’ platforms is based on PHP, Typescript, Node/NPM, Docker and AWS. Virtually all our systems have been developed in-house and are following modern quality standards. We work in a service-oriented architecture, powered by our own RESTful API and AWS. In parallel, we are scaling up our infrastructure, moving towards SOC2 compliance.

We also experiment with new technologies when they help us innovate faster or smarter — from AI tooling to emerging frameworks.

What are we looking for?

  • At least a bachelor’s degree, preferably in Computer Science or a related field.
  • You have 6+ years of experience as a Full Stack Web Developer.
  • Experience building applications in JavaScript component-based frameworks (e.g., VueJS, React or Angular). Modern JavaScript, TypeScript, NPM, and Webpack. Proficient in both Front-end and Back-end development.
  • HTML5 and SCSS/CSS3 are second nature to you, and you care about performance, accessibility, and responsive design.
  • You have a solutions architect level of Amazon Web Services (AWS) and know how to design and build distributed cloud native applications.
  • You have a proven track record of architecting and implementing scalable and reliable back-end systems.
  • Experience with (different types of) automated testing as part of CI/CD driven software development.
  • You write clean, modular, and maintainable code, following SOLID and modern software design principles.
  • You like to collaborate, appreciate open communication, and are comfortable with working cross-functionally.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary including a bonus and pension.
  • 32 vacation days (including bank holidays) you have the flexibility to take your holidays whenever you want (e.g., be off on Chinese New Year instead of King’s Day)
  • Reimbursement of your work-related travel costs.
  • Flexibility to work remotely 3 days per week, including a remote working allowance.
  • Possibility to work from abroad 2 times a year.
  • An annual personal development budget because personal growth is KEY!
  • A nice and fun office in the heart of Eindhoven; five minutes’ walk away from the station

Studyportals is the international study choice platform, helping students to find and compare their study options across borders. With over 245,000+ published courses from over 3,500+ participating HE institutions and over 50 million users per year, Studyportals is a leading information source for study seekers. At the same time, the company’s results-based channels support universities with digital marketing, analytics, and international student recruitment, enabling them to reach a global audience and diversify their student population. 

Our mission is to empower the world to choose education

Our team consists of nearly 200 people from over 35 different nationalities. Our headquarters is located in Eindhoven, in the iconic Klokgebouw, at Strijp-S, a hub of entrepreneurship, technology, and design. We also have operations in Boston, Melbourne, Manchester, Monterrey, Stockholm, and Bucharest.

title: Head of Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Why we exist

AI is everywhere, shaping how we live and work. We believe it should help people stay in control, build real connections, and pursue long‑term goals. Autonomy, relationships, and purpose are the foundations of a meaningful life. Ascending AI builds tools that strengthen all three. We’ve invested €5m of our own capital to stay independent, move fast, and focus on building what matters most.


What we’re building

We’re starting with a product that helps people map their relationships, spot communication patterns, and improve how they connect - bringing instant clarity and intention to daily life. This is the foundation for a broader suite of tools designed to protect human autonomy, strengthen connections, and support long-term goals.


Job requirements

This is not a "manager" role. This is a hands-on, high-velocity execution role. You will be the first marketer on the ground. You are the media buyer, the copywriter, the designer, and the strategist wrapped in one. If you are a relentless executor and want to build a revenue engine from scratch with a significant budget and total autonomy, this is your arena.


Your first 12 months

We are pre-launch and currently in stealth. You will be responsible for putting our product into the hands of 1,000,000 users within the first year. Start lean, then scale growth aggressively once you crack the audience and hit audience-channel fit. You will need to know exactly which tools to use at the right time.


You will

  • Own paid and organic marketing strategy and execution, including budget forecasting, allocation, and revenue planning across Meta, TikTok, ASA, Reels, SEO, and content marketing.
  • Lead data-driven experimentation across channels to understand the customer journey from prospect to active user, testing formats, hooks, CTAs, and distribution to optimize performance.
  • Build reports and dashboards to track channel performance at campaign and creative level, and guide development of analytics, BI, and adtech infrastructure for end-to-end visibility.
  • Lead market intelligence by monitoring trends, competitors, and emerging growth methodologies.
  • Work closely with the co-founders and product teams to align growth strategies with overall business objectives.


What we’re looking for

  • 4–8 years of direct experience running growth at a consumer start-up.
  • Zero-to-one experience setting up analytics and tracking systems from scratch and finding channel fit through rapid experimentation across multiple channels.
  • Demonstrated experience running 6-figure+ paid campaigns on Meta, TikTok, and ASA.
  • Experience growing a social media profile organically to a large number of engaged followers from scratch.
  • Strong analytical skills and deep understanding of LTV modeling, mobile attribution, and interpreting performance data to drive decision-making.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-moving environment and are not intimidated by ambiguity or change. You enjoy new challenges and jump in headfirst when facing an issue.
  • Comfortable operating with autonomy, hitting deadlines, and influencing senior stakeholders.


Bonus

  • No need to wait for design to ship creatives or landing pages. You use Canva/Figma and Framer/web builders to execute fast turnarounds independently.
  • SQL / data skills to query data, analyze metrics, and turn insights into growth strategy and customer discussions.
  • Hands-on enough to fix a pixel and set up Zapier workflows without needing a developer.
  • Active in online communities (X.com, Reddit, Discord, Hacker News, Product Hunt).


Why join us now?

You’ll define how our product looks, feels, and flows - working directly with the founders and a small product-tech team to shape a company built to make AI serve humanity, not the other way around. We’re remote-friendly (CET ±3h) and offer relocation support to Amsterdam if you want to join us onsite. In addition to the salary, there is the opportunity to participate in our success through stock based rewards. This is your chance to build fast, design with purpose, and leave a real mark on how humans and AI coexist.

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Hebrew speaker
descriptionHtml:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

We realize people do not fit into neat boxes. We are looking for curious and empathetic individuals who are committed to developing themselves and learning new skills, and we are ready to help you do that. We cannot complete our mission without building a diverse and inclusive team. We hire the best people based on an evaluation of their potential and support them throughout their time at Cloudflare. Come join us!

Available Locations: London/Munich/Amsterdam/Paris

As a Solution Architect, AI / Cloudflare Developer Platform and a member of the sales team you will help customers understand the technical details and business value proposition of the Cloudflare AI / Developer Platform and demonstrate the path and advantages of building applications with our products.

In this role, you will serve as the Regional Lead for Cloudflare AI / Developer Platform sales. You will advise sales leadership on programs to grow Developer revenue and support strategic opportunities. You will collaborate closely with technical sales teams to design innovative solutions, develop proof of concept demonstrations, and showcase the technical capabilities of these designs to meet customer needs and expectations.

Serving as a trusted technical advisor you will help guide and enable clients, partners and teams within Cloudflare on product capabilities, positioning and competitive intelligence. You will form a tight feedback loop with product, product marketing, and technical pre-sales to refine and evolve our product.

The ideal candidate possesses a consultative mindset, strong selling skills, along with a deep understanding of modern Web Technologies, Cloud Architecture , and the advantages of a Distributed Serverless Platform. No matter your background, you have natural curiosity and desire to solve problems, achieve goals, and design the most elegant and efficient solutions to address client needs.

What you'll do:

  • You will partner with the sales organization to drive revenue, new customers and pipeline of AI and Developer Platform solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product management, sales, and marketing to drive developer platform revenue and customer adoption
  • Present to strategic customers as an expert of our Developer platform solutions
  • Develop programs to drive the overall sales and pipeline strategy for the Cloudflare Developer Platform in partnership with regional and country sales leaders
  • Align Director and C-Level perceived business and technical value with Cloudflare developer solutions
  • Prepare and give regular business reviews to the management team highlighting attainment progress and challenges to closing business
  • Generate a succinct feedback loop with cross-functional teams to deliver relevant Developer content, use cases, customer stories, and data driven value propositions. .


In order to be successful, you will need to become a thought leader, trusted advisor, and spokesperson for the Cloudflare AI and Developer platform.

What you'll need:

  • 3+ years of experience selling or supporting the technical sales of cloud computing and storage, full-stack Engineering, or Cloud Developer
  • Technical expertise in cloud infrastructure, web technologies and AI/ML as a solutions engineer, entrepreneur, or solution architect.
  • Knowledge and experience of Systems Design
    • You’ve built a web application, either professionally or as a hobbyist, and will be able to explain your design choices clearly during the interview process
    • Able to hear a clear, non-technical description of an Application (“It is a chat room, for our 150 most important users”) and quickly determine which Compute, Data, and Security components are needed to build this application
  • Software development experience delivering full-stack applications, preferably using modern JavaScript frameworks and a variety of databases
  • In-depth knowledge of at least one major public cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc.)
  • Have a good understanding of systems design theory and practice for distributed, full-stack applications (frontend, backend, databases, related services); ideally in a serverless paradigm
  • Have a strong understanding of developer workflows (branching, release, versioning, CI/CD practices, system integrations)
  • Act as an AI and Developer product expert, educating internal teams and external stakeholders on the value and capabilities of the Cloudflare Developer platform
  • Knowledge of key market players/competitors in the cloud computing, AI and storage spaces
  • 30% travel
  • Fluency in both English and Hebrew

Other desirable skills areas include:

  • You’ve built something on Cloudflare Workers
  • AWS Solutions Architect or GCP Cloud Architect certifications
  • Prioritize and manage the product roadmap, making strategic trade-offs to ensure the product meets customer needs and business goals
  • Participate in product launch activities, including developing messaging and positioning, coordinating with marketing and sales teams
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends and advancements in cloud computing to inform product strategy and roadmap


What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

title: Business Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to build the future of web games?


We are Poki! An Amsterdam based tech scale up. With our dedicated team of 60, we are on a mission to create the ultimate online playground: a platform for play where players and game developers come together to play and create. We are the global market leaders in web games with our platform Poki.com , reaching more than 90 million monthly players on all devices.📱 🖥


The popularity of the web as a destination for games is growing rapidly, and so is our platform. To strengthen our content catalogue and grow our game developer community, we are looking for an experienced Business Development Manager.


About The Role

The games on our platform are created by our thriving developer community of over 500 independent game developer teams from all over the world (such as Blumgi 🇫🇷 , Sybo 🇩🇰 , ZnK Games 🇮🇳 and Fingersoft 🇫🇮 ). By working closely together we are turning small web games like Level Devil ( 1B+ social media impressions ) and Vortella’s Dress-Up ( 100M plays) into global hits, played by millions of fans every single day.


As our Business Development Manager, you will build strategic partnerships with the most talented game developer teams and relevant industry partners. You combine a great feeling for games and industry trends with outstanding people skills, and enjoy the thrill of generating new business in a growing and competitive niche.


Your Challenge

  • From indie developers to some of the most successful game studios of the past decade: source and sign games and developer teams that will launch the next hit on Poki. Support those game developers by offering them our competitive deal terms, customising them according to their ambitions and needs.
  • Develop and execute business development tactics that fit Poki’s position as market leader on the web. Be creative with finding new acquisition channels, optimise the return-on-investment of the existing ones, with the goal to increase awareness and impact.
  • Bring experience and leadership to the team. Help team members to make the right trade-offs and collaborate with various departments and stakeholders to drive business development efforts.
  • Be the face of our platform - attending industry events like GDC , Pocket Gamer Connects and Gamescom . You are a web games advocate in the industry, and inform our internal product roadmap with the insights you gained in the industry.


You

  • Have 8+ years experience in the gaming industry and a proven track record in negotiating custom deals, from prospecting to dealmaking.
  • Combine a gut feel for games with an analytical approach in order to identify promising games and talented game developers, and thrive in a collaborative environment.
  • Have a passion for games and helping game developers be successful, allowing them to focus on what they love most: creating awesome games.
  • Have an open mind to different cultures, and are able to do engage with a wide range of partners - from young hobbyists to C-level executives.
  • Thrive in a community defined by personal connections, a growth mindset and trust.
  • Like travelling and are able to do so on a regular basis in order to grow our global game developer community.


Bonus

  • You have worked in the casual gaming market.
  • You have experience as a speaker at industry events.
  • You are based in Amsterdam, or willing to relocate.


Why Work At Poki

  • Direct impact on the experience of our team, both hybrid and at the office, and on our community of 500+ game developers.
  • A lot of personal responsibility and freedom, plus the chance to work together with a diverse, international, talented and self-motivated team.
  • Play is how we learn; we make sure everyone is being challenged and and offer an annual training budget.
  • When you grow, we grow: build your career at a fast growing tech scale up. Many members of our team have been with us since their internships and are now in senior roles.
  • We care about our team, and your wellbeing matters. We have a dedicated colleague who focuses on a variety of wellbeing initiatives from regular check-ins with everyone to bi-weekly massages at the office.
  • An opportunity to connect with colleagues through work retreats, drinks every Thursday and team activities.
  • A full-time contract (36-40 hours/week) and a competitive salary - we value our teams’ skills and experiences.


Are you passionate about games and want to work on growing our community of talented game developers? Do you enjoy working side by side with creative and innovative people across the globe? And do you know your way around in the game developer industry?

Then please apply!

companyDescription:
At Poki, play is how we learn. That's why we’re on a mission to create the ultimate free web games playground. With tons of games for all ages and interests, we’re bringing fun to 100+ million players every month.

By giving smart and creative people the freedom to do great work, we’re committed to creating the best experience in browser gaming for players, game developers, and advertisers. We’re always looking for new opportunities and challenges, whether it’s rewriting our stack from scratch, partnering with some of the world’s leading game developers, or mastering the latest racing game. 

We put play into everything we do, including the work environment we strive to create for our team. Flexible hours, free healthy lunches, and paid yearly retreats are just a couple of the perks we provide, and we’re continuously working on our culture to make sure all team members feel empowered and supported in their work. 

Want to level up your career? Check out our job openings: http://jobs.poki.com
